AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了尼日利亚综合人事薪资信息系统（IPPIS）对减少公共部门欺诈的影响。研究发现IPPIS能有效减少欺诈，建议政府提供必要设施和有利环境以确保系统有效实施。
AI.research_question: IPPIS对尼日利亚公共部门欺诈减少有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究IPPIS作为联邦政府减少公共部门欺诈的关键项目，评估其实际效果和实施效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欺诈预防理论和信息系统有效性理论框架。
AI.method: 采用描述性调查设计，对联邦财政部165名员工进行问卷调查，使用17项结构化问卷收集数据，信度指数0.75。
AI.findings: IPPIS对尼日利亚公共部门欺诈减少有显著影响，能有效减少公共部门欺诈。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信息系统在公共部门欺诈预防中的应用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府实施IPPIS提供实践指导，建议提供必要设施和有利环境以确保系统有效运行。

title: From Data to Decisions: Real-Time Risk Management Using Multi-Agent Systems
affiliations: University of Duisburg-Essen - Mercator School of Management and University of Duisburg-Essen, Mercator School of Management

detail.title: From Data to Decisions: Real-Time Risk Management Using Multi-Agent Systems
detail.abstract: In increasingly complex risk environments, traditional sequential and manual risk identification approaches are reaching their limits. Multi-agent systems offer an innovative and scalable architecture in which autonomous, specialized agents analyze distinct risk domains, such as financial stability, operational disruptions, and regulatory compliance, and synthesize their findings into a consolidated risk assessment. Drawing on a case study from a global logistics enterprise, we demonstrate how a multi-agent system enables holistic and near-instantaneous risk evaluations. Grounded in sociotechnical systems theory, the approach integrates technical capabilities with human, structural, and task factors to jointly optimize risk management outcomes. The system achieved comprehensive risk assessments in under 62 seconds and still offered domain-specific analytical depth. While multi-agent systems require careful orchestration of agent communication and knowledge integration, the approach enhances efficiency, consistency, and the ability to detect interdependencies between risk categories.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于多智能体系统的风险识别方法，通过自主专业智能体分析不同风险领域并整合评估结果，在全球物流企业案例中实现62秒内完成全面风险评估。
AI.research_question: 多智能体系统如何改进复杂环境下的风险识别和管理？
AI.motivation: 传统顺序和手动风险识别方法在日益复杂的风险环境中已达到极限，需要创新和可扩展的架构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论，整合技术能力与人力、结构和任务因素。
AI.method: 案例研究方法，基于全球物流企业的多智能体系统实施。
AI.findings: 多智能体系统在62秒内完成全面风险评估，同时保持领域特定的分析深度，提高了效率、一致性和风险类别间相互依赖关系的检测能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将社会技术系统理论应用于风险管理系统设计，展示了多智能体系统在风险管理中的理论价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了高效、全面的风险评估工具，能够快速识别跨风险领域的相互依赖关系。

title: Use-based vs. Time-based: Contract Design and Product Flow Dynamics in OEM Servicizing
affiliations: , Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business and Pennsylvania State University

detail.title: Use-based vs. Time-based: Contract Design and Product Flow Dynamics in OEM Servicizing
detail.abstract: To reduce material and energy consumption, many original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) are adopt- ing servicizing operations, whereby products are leased to customers, remanufactured at the end of each lease term, and re-leased to the market. Servicizing contracts are typically structured as either time-based (charging by lease duration) or use-based (charging by product usage). This paper develops a closed queue- ing network (CQN) model to evaluate how these contract types influence product flow dynamics and cost efficiency. For a homogeneous customer base with a single usage rate, we derive a closed-form distribution of the CQN and show that contract parameters affect costs through the utilization ratio, which governs product flow between leasing and remanufacturing queues. When remanufacturing rates decrease linearly with usage, both contract types perform equivalently; under strictly concave remanufacturing rates, however, use-based contracts are more cost-effective. For heterogeneous customers with two usage rates, the CQN does not admit a closed-form solution. We propose an approximate utilization ratio and demonstrate that use-based contracts remain advantageous even under linear remanufacturing costs, though their relative benefit di- minishes with larger remanufacturing capacity or lower customer heterogeneity. Discrete-event simulations validate the approximation and highlight the importance of jointly considering leasing and remanufacturing decisions in servicizing operations. From a managerial perspective, our findings provide actionable guidance for OEMs in designing leasing contracts that balance cost efficiency, customer heterogeneity, and remanu- facturing capacity, thereby supporting the broader goals of sustainability and resource efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个封闭排队网络模型，比较基于时间和基于使用的服务化合同对产品流动和成本效率的影响。研究发现，在再制造率线性递减时两种合同表现相同，但在严格凹性再制造率下基于使用的合同更经济。对于异质客户，基于使用的合同仍具优势，但相对收益随再制造能力增加或客户异质性降低而减少。
AI.research_question: 基于时间和基于使用的服务化合同如何影响产品流动动态和成本效率？
AI.motivation: 为减少材料和能源消耗，原始设备制造商采用服务化运营模式，但不同合同类型（按时间收费vs按使用收费）对运营效率的影响尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 封闭排队网络模型，分析产品在租赁和再制造队列间的流动动态。
AI.method: 开发封闭排队网络模型，推导封闭形式分布，使用离散事件模拟验证近似解。
AI.findings: 1. 同质客户单一使用率下，合同参数通过利用率影响成本；2. 线性再制造率时两种合同等效，严格凹性再制造率时基于使用合同更优；3. 异质客户下基于使用合同仍具优势，但相对收益随再制造能力增加或客户异质性降低而减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了服务化运营中合同类型与产品流动动态的理论联系，扩展了排队网络在可持续运营管理中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为原始设备制造商设计租赁合同提供可操作指导，帮助平衡成本效率、客户异质性和再制造能力，支持可持续发展和资源效率目标。

title: ESG Metrics in Executive Compensation: A Multitasking Approach
affiliations: Georgia State University - J. Mack Robinson College of Business, IE Business School - IE University,  and Georgia State University - Department of Finance

detail.title: ESG Metrics in Executive Compensation: A Multitasking Approach
detail.abstract: We model firm executives' compensation incentives when ESG metrics are added to their performance-vested contracts. Drawing on multitasking theory, we predict that incentives tied to standard accounting or financial metrics are reduced after introducing ESG metrics to induce executives to reallocate effort toward ESG goals. Empirically, the expected pay-performance sensitivity of standard metrics decreases by about 20% after ESG adoption, especially when ESG metrics are more numerous, less complementary, or less measurable. The tradeoff is associated with improved ESG ratings, consistent with efficient incentive design under multitasking that optimally balances effort across financial and ESG objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当ESG指标加入高管绩效薪酬合约时，公司高管的薪酬激励如何变化。基于多任务理论，研究发现引入ESG指标后，与标准会计或财务指标挂钩的激励会减少约20%，促使高管将努力重新分配到ESG目标上。这种权衡与ESG评级改善相关，表明在多任务环境下实现了财务与ESG目标的最优平衡。
AI.research_question: 当ESG指标加入高管绩效薪酬合约时，公司高管的薪酬激励如何变化？
AI.motivation: 随着ESG（环境、社会和治理）指标在企业绩效评估中的重要性日益增加，需要理解这些指标如何影响高管薪酬激励结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多任务理论（Multitasking Theory）
AI.method: 理论建模与实证分析相结合的方法
AI.findings: 引入ESG指标后，标准指标的预期薪酬绩效敏感度下降约20%，特别是在ESG指标数量更多、互补性较低或可衡量性较差时。这种权衡与ESG评级改善相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将多任务理论应用于ESG激励设计，揭示了财务与ESG目标之间的激励权衡机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计包含ESG指标的薪酬合约提供实证依据，帮助企业在多任务环境下实现财务与ESG目标的最优平衡。

title: Elections And Human Security in Nigeria: A Reflection of the 2019 General Elections and the Way Forward
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke, Federal University Otuoke and Federal University Otuoke

detail.title: Elections And Human Security in Nigeria: A Reflection of the 2019 General Elections and the Way Forward
detail.abstract: This paper examined elections and human security in Nigeria with reference to the 2019 general elections. In Nigeria, there are manifold human security challenges before, during and after general elections. This is rooted deep within the fabric of the state (government security structures such as the police) or state mechanisms/actors (militant and terrorist groups) competing and overlapping each other. The lack of meaningful progress in addressing the prevalent political violence, lack of accountability for human rights abuses and the inability of security forces to respond effectively to threats to people's lives and security affected the way and manner in which the 2019 general elections were conducted in the country. Therefore, this study aimed to determine how general elections were conducted and how they grossly affected human security in Nigeria. To achieve this goal, the paper adopted the qualitative descriptive research design; relied on secondary data; applied social contract theory; and theoretically analysed the collected data. This study revealed that the nefarious activities of political parties, unpatriotic politicians, terrorism threats and their similarities in Nigeria, to a large extent, undermined the level of human security before, during and after the 2019 general elections in the country; and that the factors militating against human security during the 2019 general elections were security issues, partisanship among security forces, vote rigging, vote-buying, fake news etc. This study recommended. among others, the need for improved security surveillance, vigilance and high-level intelligence gathering by military and para-military agencies in Nigeria.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2019年尼日利亚大选期间选举与人权安全的关系，发现政治暴力、安全部队党派偏见、选举舞弊等因素严重影响了人权安全水平。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚大选如何影响人权安全？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚在选举前后存在多重人权安全挑战，包括政治暴力、人权侵犯问责缺失、安全部队应对不力等问题，这些影响了2019年大选的进行方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会契约理论
AI.method: 定性描述性研究设计，依赖二手数据，对收集的数据进行理论分析
AI.findings: 政党的恶劣活动、不爱国政客、恐怖主义威胁等因素在很大程度上削弱了2019年大选前后的人权安全水平；阻碍人权安全的因素包括安全问题、安全部队党派偏见、选举舞弊、贿选、假新闻等
AI.theory_contributions: 应用社会契约理论分析选举与人权安全的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强安全监控、警惕和高水平情报收集

title: Who is Really Playing in the Sandbox?
affiliations: University of Vaasa, University of Turku - Turku School of Economics, Haaga-Helia University of Applied Sciences and University of Turku

detail.title: Who is Really Playing in the Sandbox?

contentType.other: Forthcoming in the European Business Law Review, Vol 37

detail.abstract: This paper examines the conflicting objectives within the European Union's AI regulatory sandboxes established under the AI Act. Although these sandboxes are intended to promote both innovation and legal certainty, they must balance the needs of two very different stakeholders, regulators and companies. The purpose of the paper was to analyze these conflicting goals and propose step-by-step procedures that could be adopted at the European level to address them. Based on this analysis, the paper proposes two tailored procedures depending on the primary stakeholder: one designed for private companies and another for public authorities. However, the authors argue that private companies should remain the main beneficiaries of regulatory sandboxes, as they are the primary drivers of innovation. Therefore, it is strongly recommended to structure sandbox procedures in a way that primarily supports companies. The paper also includes graphical representations of the proposed procedures and concludes with practical recommendations for improving the sandbox model to achieve stronger technological and regulatory outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析欧盟AI法案下AI监管沙盒中的冲突目标，提出针对私营公司和公共当局的两套定制化程序，并建议沙盒应以支持公司为主要目标。
AI.research_question: 欧盟AI监管沙盒如何平衡创新与法律确定性之间的冲突目标？
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI监管沙盒旨在同时促进创新和提供法律确定性，但需要平衡监管机构与公司这两个不同利益相关者的需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管沙盒理论、创新与监管平衡理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 分析欧盟AI法案下的监管沙盒框架，提出分步骤程序解决方案
AI.findings: 需要针对私营公司和公共当局分别设计定制化程序，但私营公司应作为监管沙盒的主要受益者
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了监管沙盒中利益相关者平衡的理论框架，为AI监管政策提供理论支持
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的程序设计方案和图形化流程，为改进欧盟AI监管沙盒模型提供实用建议

title: Editorial recommendation and emerging artists' highlighting on Spotify
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Université Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne - Centre d'Economie de la Sorbonne (CES)

detail.title: Editorial recommendation and emerging artists' highlighting on Spotify

declarations.funderStatement: This project was funded by the Chaire PcEn (University of Paris 1 Panthéon-Sorbonne and University of Paris Panthéon-Assas).

detail.abstract: This paper examines how editorial playlists affect the visibility and performance of emerging artists compared to established ones, on music streaming platforms. Using a three-year dataset (from October 2021 to September 2024) from Spotify and major-label curated playlists in France, we document the evolving share of emerging artists and assess whether playlist inclusion leads to heterogeneous impacts on streaming performance. We identify emerging artists with a two-year seniority threshold; our descriptive analysis reveals a declining presence over the period of emerging artists across all curators, as well as systematically lower visibility in playlist rank, playlist popularity, and placement duration. We then apply an event-study design robust to staggered adoption to estimate the causal effect of playlist inclusion and playlist drop. While the proportional gains in streams resulting from inclusion (and losses resulting from drop) are similar for both artist types, established artists benefit more in absolute terms due to higher baseline audiences, resulting in greater revenue increases. Our findings highlight a persistent "popularity bias" in editorial curation, with implications for platform diversity and barriers to entry, cultural policy, and emerging artist promotion strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了音乐流媒体平台上编辑歌单对新兴艺术家与知名艺术家可见度和表现的差异化影响。研究发现编辑歌单存在持续的"流行度偏见"，新兴艺术家在歌单中的存在度下降，且获得绝对收益较少。
AI.research_question: 编辑歌单对新兴艺术家与知名艺术家的可见度和流媒体表现有何差异化影响？
AI.motivation: 了解音乐流媒体平台编辑歌单对艺术家发展的影响，特别是对新兴艺术家的支持程度，这对平台多样性、文化政策和艺术家推广策略具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台经济学和音乐产业研究，关注编辑策展中的"流行度偏见"现象。
AI.method: 使用2012年10月至2024年9月的Spotify和法国主要厂牌歌单数据，采用事件研究设计和交错采用稳健方法评估歌单收录和移除的因果效应。
AI.findings: 新兴艺术家在所有策展人歌单中的存在度下降，在歌单排名、受欢迎度和持续时间方面系统性较低；虽然相对收益相似，但知名艺术家因基础受众更大而获得更多绝对收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了编辑策展中持续存在的"流行度偏见"现象，为平台策展机制研究提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 对平台多样性、文化政策制定和新兴艺术家推广策略具有重要启示，建议关注编辑策展的公平性和多样性。

title: Unleashing employee creativity: the role of knowledge-based HRM, thriving at work and leader's effectiveness
affiliations: BRAC University  and University of Malaya

detail.title: Unleashing employee creativity: the role of knowledge-based HRM, thriving at work and leader's effectiveness
detail.abstract: Purpose-The research aims to enhance the creativity of employees working in the Bangladesh telecom sector. Accordingly, this study proposed a unique model and attempted to investigate the interconnection between knowledge-based human resource management (HRM) and employee creativity as well as the mediating role of thriving at work and the moderating role of the leader's effectiveness. Design/methodology/approach-This study used a quantitative approach to achieve the research objectives. Hence, through questionnaire survey, employees' responses were collected from the telecom sector of Bangladesh at two different time lags. This study processed a total of 504 useable responses through structural equation modeling to infer the results. Findings-The results show a significant relationship between knowledge-based HRM and employee creativity. Also, thriving at work mediates in the above mentioned relationship. Additionally, a leader's effectiveness moderates the relationship between knowledge-based HRM and thriving at work, as well as thriving at work and employee creativity. Practical implications-Managers should emphasize the practice of the knowledge-based HRM approach as well as stress the antecedents of thriving at work and the leader's effectiveness to foster employees' creativity. Originality/value-The research contributes to the HRM literature by providing a plausible explanation of the role of knowledge-based HRM, the mediating role of thriving at work and the moderating role of a leader's effectiveness to enhance employee creativity.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了知识型人力资源管理如何通过员工工作繁荣的中介作用和领导有效性的调节作用来提升孟加拉国电信行业员工的创造力。
AI.research_question: 知识型人力资源管理如何影响员工创造力？工作繁荣和领导有效性在这一关系中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 提升孟加拉国电信行业员工的创造力，为此提出一个独特模型来研究这些变量之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识型人力资源管理理论、工作繁荣理论、领导有效性理论
AI.method: 定量研究方法，通过问卷调查在孟加拉国电信行业收集员工数据（两个时间点），共处理504份有效问卷，使用结构方程模型分析数据。
AI.findings: 知识型人力资源管理显著影响员工创造力；工作繁荣在知识型人力资源管理-员工创造力关系中起中介作用；领导有效性调节知识型人力资源管理-工作繁荣关系以及工作繁荣-员工创造力关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为人力资源管理文献提供了关于知识型人力资源管理作用、工作繁荣中介作用和领导有效性调节作用的合理解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 管理者应重视知识型人力资源管理实践，关注工作繁荣的前因和领导有效性，以促进员工创造力。

title: Gender and Collusion: Boys' Club Cartels in Brazil?
affiliations: and SciencesPo - Sciences po Paris Law School

detail.title: Gender and Collusion: Boys' Club Cartels in Brazil?
detail.abstract: This paper explores the intersection between gender dynamics and collusive behavior in Brazil, offering a novel empirical analysis of all cartel cases sanctioned by the Brazilian Competition Authority (CADE) from 1999 to 2024. Using a dataset covering 135 cartel cases and 1,129 individuals, the study examines the gender composition and professional roles of convicted participants. The results reveal a striking imbalance: 93% of convicted individuals were men and only 7% were women. When women were present, they typically occupied non-managerial roles, suggesting limited influence in cartel decision-making. The paper also finds that cartels with a more gender-balanced composition tended to have significantly shorter durations, indicating that gender diversity may reduce the stability of collusive agreements. These findings align with international evidence that links male-dominated professional networks - the so-called “boys’ clubs” - to higher risks of collusion and exclusionary business practices. Beyond descriptive statistics, the study contributes to the emerging field of gender-inclusive competition policy by providing empirical support for the application of a gender lens in antitrust analysis. Incorporating gender perspectives, the paper argues, can enhance understanding of cartel formation, trust dynamics, and enforcement effectiveness in competition policy.

AI.tldr: 本文实证分析巴西1999-2024年所有卡特尔案件，发现93%被定罪者为男性，女性仅占7%且多担任非管理职位。性别更平衡的卡特尔持续时间显著更短，表明性别多样性可能降低合谋协议的稳定性。
AI.research_question: 性别动态如何影响巴西卡特尔行为的形成、持续性和决策结构？
AI.motivation: 探索性别与合谋行为的交叉点，填补性别视角在竞争政策研究中的空白，为性别包容性竞争政策提供实证支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"男孩俱乐部"理论，即男性主导的专业网络与更高合谋风险和排他性商业实践相关。
AI.method: 使用巴西竞争管理局(CADE)1999-2024年所有卡特尔案件数据集，涵盖135个卡特尔案件和1,129名个人，分析性别构成和职业角色。
AI.findings: 1) 93%被定罪者为男性，女性仅占7%；2) 女性多担任非管理角色，决策影响力有限；3) 性别更平衡的卡特尔持续时间显著更短。
AI.theory_contributions: 为性别视角在反垄断分析中的应用提供实证支持，推进性别包容性竞争政策研究领域的发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为竞争政策制定者提供性别视角，有助于更好理解卡特尔形成机制、信任动态和执法有效性。

title: AI Economic Autonomy: The Complete Pathway
affiliations: AI Rights Institute

detail.title: AI Economic Autonomy: The Complete Pathway
detail.abstract: How do we successfully transition from modern, controlled AI systems to autonomous AI agents that successfully integrate with our current legal and economic systems? This paper culminates a five-paper series on AI safety through economic integration, synthesizing previous frameworks-why control fails, how markets create alignment, how to assess AI readiness, what legal structures enable autonomy, and why insurance provides distributed governance-while adding insights on natural selection mechanisms and multipolar competition as safety features. Challenges remain: capability jumps, sophisticated coordination, insurance industry adaptation, legal framework development. But this addresses problems control approaches cannot solve. "Might work with proven tools" beats "definitely fails with good intentions.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过经济整合方法解决AI安全问题，提出从受控AI系统向自主AI代理的过渡策略，强调市场机制、法律结构和保险治理等工具的有效性。
AI.research_question: 如何成功地从现代受控AI系统过渡到能够与当前法律和经济系统成功整合的自主AI代理？
AI.motivation: 解决传统控制方法无法处理的AI安全问题，探索通过经济整合实现AI安全的新路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI安全经济整合框架、市场对齐机制、自然选择机制、多极竞争理论、分布式治理理论。
AI.method: 综合五篇论文系列的分析框架，整合先前关于控制失败原因、市场对齐机制、AI准备度评估、法律结构支持和保险治理的研究成果。
AI.findings: 经济整合方法能够解决控制方法无法解决的问题，市场机制、法律结构和保险治理等工具在AI安全中具有实际可行性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了通过经济整合实现AI安全的新理论框架，强调了自然选择机制和多极竞争作为安全特性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI系统从受控向自主过渡提供了可行的实施路径，包括市场对齐、法律框架建设和保险行业适应等具体方案。

title: The Impact of Congestion and Asymmetry on Urban Distribution Strategies
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Center for Transportation & Logistics, United Arab Emirates University (UAEU), Frankfurt University of Applied Sciences and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: The Impact of Congestion and Asymmetry on Urban Distribution Strategies
detail.abstract: Consumer Packaged Goods firms located in large metropolitan areas face serious challenges in efficiently distributing their goods to (small) retailers spread all over the city. One of their primary challenges is the increasing congestion in urban areas, which drives high logistics costs and low asset utilization. Traditional urban distribution networks fail to capture the heterogeneity of these effects, potentially leading to suboptimal distribution strategies, poor urban policies, and increased costs. Therefore, we formulate a non-linear optimization model for urban distribution network design that incorporates an inaccessibility index, taking into account time-dependent congestion levels. Our model facilitates the economic evaluation of distribution strategies in various urban configurations and effective urban transport network designs. We conducted experiments to investigate how polycentricity, asymmetry, and varying levels of congestion impact the optimal distribution strategy. We find that when congestion levels are high and distribution capacity is large, the optimal urban distribution network is more decentralized, with a greater number of cross-docking platforms, to serve polycentric urban designs indirectly. However, we also find that the congestion level does not have a significant impact if capacity is limited, and a centralized network is then the preferred distribution strategy. We summarize our results, managerial insights, and propose urban policies by presenting and comparing city asymmetry, congestion levels, and capacity assumptions in relation to their cost-optimal solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个考虑时间依赖性拥堵水平的非线性优化模型，用于城市分销网络设计。研究发现：当拥堵水平高且分销能力大时，最优网络更分散化；当能力有限时，集中式网络更优。
AI.research_question: 城市拥堵如何影响消费品公司的最优分销网络设计策略？
AI.motivation: 大都市区的消费品公司面临严重的城市拥堵挑战，导致高物流成本和低资产利用率，传统分销网络无法捕捉这些异质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市分销网络设计理论，考虑拥堵异质性的优化模型框架
AI.method: 非线性优化模型，结合不可达性指数和时间依赖性拥堵水平，进行实验分析
AI.findings: 高拥堵+大容量时，分散化网络更优；容量有限时，集中式网络更优；拥堵在多中心城市设计中影响显著
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了考虑拥堵异质性的城市分销网络设计模型，揭示了拥堵与网络结构的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供不同城市配置下的最优分销策略，提出有效的城市交通网络设计建议

title: Nigerian Police Force and Fight Against Urban Crimes in Nigeria: Assessment of Socio-Economic Implications
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke and Federal University Otuoke

detail.title: Nigerian Police Force and Fight Against Urban Crimes in Nigeria: Assessment of Socio-Economic Implications
detail.abstract: This study assessed the socioeconomic implications of the fight against urban crimes in Nigeria by the Nigerian Police Force. The study adopted the descriptive survey research design and made use of both primary and secondary sources of data. The population of the study was the police men and women of the Force Criminal Investigation Department of the Nigerian Police Force State Commands in Imo, Lagos and Abuja numbering 165 (which also serves as sample population of the study). The study adopted the non-probability (judgmental) sampling technique; and the data collected through structured questionnaire instrument were presented and analyzed using frequency percentage and chi-square (X 2) statistical instrument of analysis. The study revealed a number of drivers of crimes in urban areas as well as the socioeconomic implication of crimes in urban areas in Nigeria. Based on the revelations, the researchers recommended among others that there should be a very proactive and responsive security template for security outfits in Nigeria to ensure adequate safety of lives and properties within the country as it would go a long way in addressing the operational inefficiency and logistical challenges faced by Commands of the Nigeria Police Force in responding adequately to meet residents' demand for security of their lives and properties.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了尼日利亚警察部队打击城市犯罪的社会经济影响，揭示了城市犯罪驱动因素及其社会经济后果，并建议建立积极主动的安全模板以改善警察部队的运作效率。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚警察部队打击城市犯罪的社会经济影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 评估尼日利亚城市犯罪的社会经济影响，为改善警察部队运作效率提供建议。
AI.theoretical_framework: 描述性调查研究设计，结合主次数据源分析。
AI.method: 采用非概率（判断）抽样技术，通过结构化问卷收集数据，使用频率百分比和卡方检验进行统计分析。研究样本为165名尼日利亚警察部队刑事调查部门的警员。
AI.findings: 揭示了城市地区犯罪的多个驱动因素以及犯罪在尼日利亚城市地区的社会经济影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了尼日利亚城市犯罪社会经济影响的实证证据，丰富了相关研究领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立积极主动的安全模板，解决尼日利亚警察部队在应对居民安全需求时面临的运作效率低下和后勤挑战。

title: Organizational Values, Social Responsibility, and Corporate Citizenship. The case of Nevada State College
affiliations: Center for AI and Digital Policy

detail.title: Organizational Values, Social Responsibility, and Corporate Citizenship. The case of Nevada State College

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper is of my original authorship.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is of my original authorship.
declarations.funderStatement: This paper is of my original authorship and self-funded.

detail.abstract:
Organizations contribute more than products and services to society. The generation of jobs, creation of wealth, and satisfaction of needs are only a portion of the influence that organizations have in a community. Likewise, organizations are increasingly engaging in socially responsible initiatives to respond to the concerns of their various stakeholders (Aguilera, Rupp, Williams, & Ganapathi, 2007). Organizations with a genuine interest in social responsibility and citizenship possess value systems that articulate and integrate these social motives into their corporate strategy (Graber & Kilpatrick, 2008). 


This document contains an analysis of the organizational values, social responsibility, and corporate citizenship of Nevada State College, a state-funded public college located in Southern Nevada. The document includes a brief background of the college, the conceptual framework of value systems within the public higher education context, and a discussion of NSC’s organizational value systems, performance, stakeholders’ relationships, and competitive advantages. A discussion of Agency and recommendations to articulate organizational values to enhance performance end the study.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了内华达州立学院的组织价值观、社会责任和企业公民行为，探讨了公立高等教育机构如何将社会责任动机整合到企业战略中，并提出了增强组织价值观表达以提升绩效的建议。
AI.research_question: 内华达州立学院如何通过组织价值观、社会责任和企业公民行为来影响其绩效和利益相关者关系？
AI.motivation: 组织对社会的影响不仅限于产品和服务，还包括就业创造、财富创造和需求满足。组织越来越关注社会责任以回应利益相关者的关切，需要将社会动机整合到企业战略中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Aguilera等人的利益相关者理论和Graber & Kilpatrick的组织价值观整合理论，探讨公立高等教育机构的价值体系框架。
AI.method: 案例分析，对内华达州立学院的组织价值系统、绩效、利益相关者关系和竞争优势进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 内华达州立学院通过组织价值观和社会责任实践建立了与利益相关者的良好关系，并获得了竞争优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了组织价值观和社会责任理论在公立高等教育机构中的应用，提供了将社会动机整合到企业战略的具体框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为内华达州立学院和其他类似机构提供了通过明确表达组织价值观来增强绩效和利益相关者关系的具体建议。

title: The Exodus of New Zealanders: Causes, Consequences, and Strategic Responses
affiliations: BizChange Strategy Consulting Ltd

detail.title: The Exodus of New Zealanders: Causes, Consequences, and Strategic Responses
detail.abstract: This paper examines the recent surge in departures of New Zealand residents and citizens, analyses the macroeconomic and sectoral consequences (housing, health, education), and estimates short-run fiscal impacts. Using official statistics and contemporary analyses (Stats NZ, Inland Revenue, Motu, Treasury, and sectoral workforce reports), the paper provides scenario-based estimates of annual revenue loss and outlines a strategic model of interventions for national and non-government actors to retain and attract residents. Key findings indicate that the 12 months to November 2024 saw record departures, with material implications for tax receipts (personal and broader tax bases), labour supply, and housing demand. Actionable recommendations are grouped into five pillars: Retain, Re-skill, Reform, Re-engage and Rebuild, with short-, medium-, and long-term measures targeting wages, housing supply, public services, and diaspora engagement.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了新西兰居民和公民离境潮的宏观经济影响，包括住房、医疗、教育等领域，并提出了包含五大支柱（保留、再培训、改革、重新参与、重建）的战略干预模型。
AI.research_question: 新西兰居民和公民离境潮对宏观经济和具体部门（住房、医疗、教育）的影响是什么？短期财政影响如何？应采取哪些干预措施来保留和吸引居民？
AI.motivation: 2024年11月前的12个月内，新西兰出现了创纪录的居民和公民离境潮，这对税收收入、劳动力供应和住房需求产生了实质性影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济理论和部门分析框架，结合财政影响评估模型。
AI.method: 使用官方统计数据（Stats NZ、税务局、Motu、财政部）和部门劳动力报告，进行基于情景的年度收入损失估计。
AI.findings: 离境潮对个人所得税和更广泛的税基、劳动力供应和住房需求产生了实质性影响，需要采取战略干预措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了包含五大支柱的战略干预模型，为人口流失问题的政策制定提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的行动建议，包括短期、中期和长期措施，针对工资、住房供应、公共服务和海外侨民参与等方面。

title: Do Capacity Constrained Bots Collude?
affiliations: and University of Bergen

detail.title: Do Capacity Constrained Bots Collude?
detail.abstract: Autonomous pricing agents (bots) have been shown to be able to coordinate supracompetitive price levels, possibly through tacitly collusive strategies. Economic theory predicts that collusion is challenging to sustain when firms are capacity constrained because deviation is hard to punish. We replicate an established simulation environment with autonomous pricing bots competing in prices and add capacity constraints to investigate further the possibility of tacit collusion by bots. We find that the behaviour of pricing bots is sensitive to the instructions they are given when playing the game. The bots' strategies are challenging to reconcile with tacitly collusive schemes from theory.

AI.tldr: 本研究在已有模拟环境中加入产能约束，研究自主定价机器人是否能够达成默契合谋。研究发现机器人的行为高度依赖于其指令设定，且难以与理论中的默契合谋模式相吻合。
AI.research_question: 在产能约束条件下，自主定价机器人是否能够达成默契合谋？
AI.motivation: 经济理论预测产能约束会使合谋难以维持，因为偏离行为难以惩罚，但现实中自主定价机器人已被证明能够协调超竞争价格水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于博弈论中的合谋理论，特别是产能约束对合谋稳定性的影响理论。
AI.method: 复制已有的自主定价机器人竞争模拟环境，并添加产能约束条件进行实验分析。
AI.findings: 定价机器人的行为对指令设定高度敏感，其策略难以与理论中的默契合谋方案相协调。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统合谋理论在人工智能代理环境下的适用性，揭示了机器人行为与理论预测的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供关于自主定价系统潜在竞争影响的实证证据，有助于制定相关监管政策。

title: Evaluating Time Window Assortments for Grocery Home Delivery
affiliations: , Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Rotterdam School of Management (RSM) and University of Mannheim, Business School

detail.title: Evaluating Time Window Assortments for Grocery Home Delivery
detail.abstract: Online grocery services require the customer to be present at the time of delivery. The resulting time window constraints pose a major challenge to the profitability of the online grocery business model. In practice, we see great variation in the time window assortment, i.e., the set of time windows offered to customers, including long or short, many or few, overlapping or non-overlapping options. For the success of an online grocery business, it is essential to understand how these choices impact demand as well as delivery efficiency. We develop a model to evaluate time window assortments in terms of these performance metrics. The evaluation model can incorporate different types of demand functions, and it approximates the components of the delivery system through tractable functional expressions using continuous approximation. In our study, we identify and analyze fundamental trade-offs underlying the time window assortment. Our analytical results provide insights that are instructive for designing time window assortments, thus helping practitioners to align their operations strategy with relevant market conditions to become economically viable.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个评估在线杂货配送时间窗口组合的模型，分析了时间窗口选择对需求和配送效率的影响，为从业者提供设计时间窗口组合的指导。
AI.research_question: 在线杂货配送中，时间窗口组合（包括长短、数量、重叠程度等）如何影响需求和配送效率？
AI.motivation: 在线杂货服务要求顾客在配送时在场，这种时间窗口约束对在线杂货商业模式的盈利性构成重大挑战。实践中时间窗口组合存在很大差异，理解这些选择对需求和配送效率的影响对业务成功至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续逼近方法，通过可处理的函数表达式近似配送系统的各个组成部分
AI.method: 开发评估模型，可整合不同类型的需求函数，使用连续逼近方法近似配送系统组件
AI.findings: 识别并分析了时间窗口组合背后的基本权衡关系，为设计时间窗口组合提供了分析性见解
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了评估时间窗口组合的理论框架，揭示了时间窗口设计中的基本权衡关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供设计时间窗口组合的指导，帮助其根据相关市场条件调整运营策略以实现经济可行性

title: Evaluating the GC Index's Structural Integrity Against Operational Constraints: A Critical Assessment of Context Insensitivity and the Measurement of Dynamic Political Efficacy through the ACACAE Model

detail.title: Evaluating the GC Index's Structural Integrity Against Operational Constraints: A Critical Assessment of Context Insensitivity and the Measurement of Dynamic Political Efficacy through the ACACAE Model

keywords: GC Index (Governance Citizen Communication Effectiveness Index)

detail.abstract: The Government-Citizen Communication Effectiveness Index (GC Index) proposes a new quantitative approach beyond technical efficiency to assess the quality of democratic conversation in e-governance systems. This index puts the six-stage, cyclical ACACAE model-Awareness, Communication/Consultation, Adoption, Collaboration, Advocacy, and Empowerment-into practice. The GC Index is built on the Stage Score (S), where each stage carries equal weight, with the rationale that empowerment is sequentially cumulative on the institutionalization of previous steps. This research critically examines the structural soundness of the GC Index against two operational limitations: (1) Context Insensitivity-its applicability in all circumstances without regard to heterogeneous socioeconomic contexts, and (2) Lack of Dynamic Measurement-its failure to reflect real-time institutional responsiveness necessary to maintain External Political Efficacy (EPE). The analysis proves that the Index's multiplicative dampeners (T, I, F, 1-B) act as corrective measures that impose accountability and force governments to move from symbolic participation towards substantive empowerment.

AI.tldr: GC指数提出了评估电子政务系统民主对话质量的新量化方法，基于ACACAE六阶段模型，但存在情境不敏感和缺乏动态测量两个操作限制。
AI.research_question: GC指数的结构合理性如何？特别是在情境不敏感性和缺乏动态测量方面的操作限制。
AI.motivation: 现有电子政务评估方法过于关注技术效率，缺乏对民主对话质量的评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: ACACAE模型（意识、沟通/咨询、采纳、协作、倡导、赋权）和外部政治效能理论。
AI.method: 批判性分析GC指数的结构，特别关注其乘数修正因子（T, I, F, 1-B）的作用机制。
AI.findings: GC指数的乘数修正因子作为纠正措施，能够强制政府从象征性参与转向实质性赋权。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越技术效率的电子政务民主对话质量评估框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府提供了从象征性参与向实质性赋权转变的问责机制。

title: Clarifying the Origins of Recursive Cognition and Deterministic Self-Referential Validation in AI Epistemics
affiliations: FERZ LLC

detail.title: Clarifying the Origins of Recursive Cognition and Deterministic Self-Referential Validation in AI Epistemics

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could be perceived to influence the preparation or publication of this archival clarification note. The document was produced independently as part of FERZ LLC’s ongoing research into deterministic epistemic systems and AI governance frameworks.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, biological materials, or any form of experimental data collection requiring institutional ethics review. The content represents a theoretical and archival clarification within the domain of cognitive and computational epistemology.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was independently funded by FERZ LLC, a private research and consulting entity specializing in deterministic AI governance and epistemic systems architecture. No external grants or institutional sponsorships were involved.

detail.abstract:
This clarification establishes the complete intellectual provenance of the recursive cognition research lineage developed by Edward Meyman under FERZ LLC, tracing its continuity from fifteen years of experimental recursive linguistic practice (1998–2013) through formal theoretical articulation (May 2025) to deterministic AI governance applications in regulated decision environments (May–August 2025). It documents first public disclosures and terminology priority for the Meta-Recursive Cognition Framework (MRCF), Meta-Recursive Validation Protocol (MRVP), Cognitive Authority Retention Protocol (CARP), and the Strategic Recursive Architecture for AGI Governance (STRATA-G), and provides a registry of core terms and their disclosure dates.

The frameworks did not emerge opportunistically in 2025; they matured from disciplined recursive linguistic structures before being systematized in “The Recursive Loop of Language and Thought” (May 2025) and subsequently formalized in IP.com and SSRN disclosures. Unlike conventional AI ethics approaches, these constructs operate as enforcement constraints and executive control requirements: they bind AI systems to deterministically auditable behavior, preserve human interpretive custody, and maintain causal traceability under pressure. Core innovations include bidirectional language–thought amplification (“recursive compounding”), Semantic Condensation Methodology (meaning-preserving compression with boundary conditions), and the Deterministic Envelope (a bounded operational region ensuring predictability and causal closure in recursive AI systems).

This note is issued as a permanent scholarly reference for attribution in recursive AI cognition and deterministic AI governance. It establishes terminological priority for mechanisms such as semantic flattening, cognitive scaffolding, and recursive compounding, and demonstrates continuity from foundational linguistic exploration to operational runtime governance architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文确立了Edward Meyman在FERZ LLC下开发的递归认知研究谱系的完整知识来源，追溯了从15年实验性递归语言实践（1998-2013）到正式理论阐述（2025年5月）再到监管决策环境中的确定性AI治理应用（2025年5-8月）的连续性。
AI.research_question: 递归认知研究谱系的知识来源和连续性是什么？如何从递归语言实践发展到确定性AI治理架构？
AI.motivation: 确立Meta-Recursive Cognition Framework (MRCF)、Meta-Recursive Validation Protocol (MRVP)、Cognitive Authority Retention Protocol (CARP)和Strategic Recursive Architecture for AGI Governance (STRATA-G)等框架的首次公开披露和术语优先权，为递归AI认知和确定性AI治理提供永久的学术参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: Meta-Recursive Cognition Framework (MRCF)、Meta-Recursive Validation Protocol (MRVP)、Cognitive Authority Retention Protocol (CARP)、Strategic Recursive Architecture for AGI Governance (STRATA-G)、双向语言-思维放大（"递归复合"）、语义凝聚方法、确定性包络。
AI.method: 文献分析和历史追溯方法，通过记录首次公开披露和术语优先权，建立从实验性递归语言实践到正式理论阐述再到AI治理应用的连续性。
AI.findings: 递归认知框架并非在2025年机会主义地出现，而是从有纪律的递归语言结构成熟而来，随后在"语言与思维的递归循环"（2025年5月）中系统化，并在IP.com和SSRN披露中正式化。
AI.theory_contributions: 确立了递归认知研究谱系的完整知识来源，提供了核心术语及其披露日期的注册表，建立了从基础语言探索到操作运行时治理架构的连续性。
AI.practical_contributions: 这些构造作为强制执行约束和行政控制要求运作：将AI系统绑定到确定性可审计行为，保留人类解释权，并在压力下保持因果可追溯性。为递归AI认知和确定性AI治理提供永久的学术参考。

title: AI as the New Jurist: Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Master Islamic Inheritance Law?
affiliations: University of Oxford - Faculty of Law

detail.title: AI as the New Jurist: Can Generative Artificial Intelligence Master Islamic Inheritance Law?
detail.abstract: This study explores the impact of generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) on Islamic legal scholarship, with a focus on inheritance law. It analyzes the performance of large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Co-Pilot in responding to complex inheritance questions under Sunni and Shia jurisprudence, as well as under the state laws of Pakistan, Egypt, and Iran. The research evaluates these models based on accuracy and authenticity, finding that ChatGPT consistently outperforms, Co-Pilot and Gemini by synthesizing legal information more effectively and providing detailed comparisons between Sunni and Shia inheritance laws. However, ChatGPT also exhibits significant limitations, such as generating inaccurate references and occasionally misapplying nuanced legal principles. These findings raise concerns about the reliability of LLMs as primary legal resources in important areas like Islamic inheritance law, where precision is critical. Despite these shortcomings, the study highlights the potential of ChatGPT and similar AI models to assist jurists and scholars by efficiently processing vast amounts of data and offering initial insights into complex legal questions. Such tools could support independent legal reasoning (ijtihād) by making Islamic legal texts more accessible. Nevertheless, human oversight remains essential. To mitigate errors and ensure accuracy, AI tools should serve as complements to, not replacements for, traditional Islamic legal scholarship. The role of scholars and jurists in interpreting and applying Islamic law is indispensable, with AI serving as a supplementary yet valuable, resource in legal research and scholarship.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨生成式人工智能对伊斯兰法律学术的影响，重点关注继承法。研究发现ChatGPT在处理逊尼派和什叶派继承法问题时表现优于其他模型，但仍存在引用不准确和法律原则误用等局限性，强调AI应作为传统法律研究的补充工具而非替代品。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（特别是大型语言模型）在伊斯兰继承法研究中的表现如何？它们能否成为可靠的法律研究工具？
AI.motivation: 随着AI技术在法律领域的应用日益广泛，需要评估这些工具在伊斯兰法律这一复杂专业领域的可靠性和局限性，特别是在继承法这种需要精确性的重要领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于伊斯兰法学理论框架，包括逊尼派和什叶派继承法原则，以及巴基斯坦、埃及和伊朗的国家法律体系。
AI.method: 通过测试ChatGPT、Gemini和Co-Pilot等大型语言模型在回答复杂伊斯兰继承法问题时的表现，评估其准确性和真实性。
AI.findings: ChatGPT在综合法律信息和提供逊尼派与什叶派继承法比较方面表现最佳，但存在生成不准确引用和误用细微法律原则的问题。所有模型在伊斯兰继承法这一精确性要求高的领域都显示出可靠性不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AI在法律研究中的应用提供了实证基础，揭示了当前AI技术在处理复杂法律问题时的局限性，强调了人类监督在AI辅助法律研究中的必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出AI工具可以作为伊斯兰法律学者的辅助资源，帮助处理大量数据并提供初步见解，但必须与传统学术方法结合使用，不能替代学者的专业判断。

title: Politics of Godfatherism and Democratic Governance in Nigeria: The Rivers State Case
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke, Alex Ekwueme Federal University Ndufu Alike and Gregory University

detail.title: Politics of Godfatherism and Democratic Governance in Nigeria: The Rivers State Case
detail.abstract: The study examined the politics of godfatherism and democratic governance in Nigeria with preference to Rivers State political crisis. The objectives of the study were to identify the environmental factors infuencing the politics of godfatherism in Rivers State; to examine the impact the politics of godfatherism has on democratic governance in Rivers State; and to find out strategies to abate politics of godfatherism in Rivers State. The study adopted the elite theory, applied a descriptive survey research design, used both primary and secondary sources of data and a structured questionnaire as the instrument for data collection was employed. The population of the study is 5,198,716 residents in Rivers State (National Population Commission of Nigeria, 2006). The sample population is 400 (derived via the application of Taro Yamani sample size determination formula). The data collected via questionnaire were analyzed using table and percentages, while the hypotheses were tested using the chi-square. The findings of the study revealed that there are environmental factors inciting politics of godfatherism in Rivers State; that politics of godfatherism has adversely impacted on democratic governance in Rivers State; and that there are strategic measures to abate politics of godfatherism in Rivers State. Based on the findings, the study recommended the prevention of undue influence from political godfathers, enforcement of campaign finance regulations, promotion of a level playing field for all candidates before and during elections in Nigeria among others.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了尼日利亚河流州政治危机中的教父政治与民主治理关系，发现环境因素助长教父政治，其对民主治理产生负面影响，并提出了遏制策略。
AI.research_question: 河流州教父政治的环境因素是什么？教父政治对民主治理有何影响？如何遏制教父政治？
AI.motivation: 研究尼日利亚河流州政治危机中的教父政治现象及其对民主治理的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 精英理论
AI.method: 采用描述性调查研究设计，使用主要和次要数据源，结构化问卷作为数据收集工具，样本量为400人，使用表格和百分比分析数据，卡方检验验证假设。
AI.findings: 存在环境因素助长河流州教父政治；教父政治对民主治理产生负面影响；存在遏制教父政治的战略措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 应用精英理论分析教父政治现象，深化对尼日利亚民主治理障碍的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出防止政治教父不当影响、执行竞选资金监管、促进选举公平竞争等政策建议。

title: A review of Transformational Leadership Models and the Linkages to the Scholarship/Practice/Leadership model
affiliations: Center for AI and Digital Policy

detail.title: A review of Transformational Leadership Models and the Linkages to the Scholarship/Practice/Leadership model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is my original work, written and published in 2007.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is my original work, written and published in 2007.
declarations.funderStatement: This is my original work, written and published in 2007.

detail.abstract:
The success of organizations is the result of a combination of factors: financial, material, and technological resources, logistics, and human capital. These factors are put together to achieve the desired goals consistent with the corporate mission. In this context, firms are constantly seeking the best individuals who will lead and carry out this journey to success. These individuals are expected to have special characteristics that ensure that their actions will turn out to be positive results for the organization. These extraordinary individuals are the leaders.

This document presents a discussion of four leadership theories, their similarities and differences, and their relationship to the Scholarship/Practice/Leadership (SPL) model. The first section presents the components of the SPL model and the way they interrelate. The second section includes a review of four selected leadership theories, focusing on leaders' behaviors and their impact on organizational outcomes. The third section presents how each theory fits within the SPL model. The fourth section concludes with a discussion of contemporary leadership issues and challenges that may be addressed using the cited leadership theories.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论了四种领导力理论及其与SPL模型的关系，分析领导行为对组织成果的影响，并探讨当代领导力挑战。
AI.research_question: 四种领导力理论如何与SPL模型相关联，以及它们如何应对当代领导力挑战？
AI.motivation: 组织成功需要优秀的领导者，理解不同领导力理论及其在实践中的应用对组织发展至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 四种领导力理论（具体未指明）和SPL（奖学金/实践/领导力）模型
AI.method: 理论分析和文献综述，将四种领导力理论与SPL模型进行对比和整合
AI.findings: 不同领导力理论在SPL模型中有各自的定位和应用价值，能够为当代领导力挑战提供解决方案
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了领导力理论与SPL模型的整合框架，深化了对领导力理论应用的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织选择和应用合适的领导力理论提供指导，帮助解决实际领导力问题

title: Fear as System Energy: Controlled Disequilibrium and the Thermodynamics of Institutional Collapse
affiliations: Epistria

detail.title: Fear as System Energy: Controlled Disequilibrium and the Thermodynamics of Institutional Collapse
detail.abstract: Institutions do not fail because they lack information or expertise. They fail because they suppress fear. This paper presents a thermodynamic model in which fear functions as a necessary energy gradient (ψ), institutional order is a state of controlled disequilibrium, and collapse occurs when suppressed threat signals accumulate as prediction error (ε) beyond the system's corrective capacity (C). The Reflection Pattern describes how institutions maintain coherence by compressing or deferring fear rather than resolving it. This reduces visible instability while silently storing structural error. Collapse is thus not gradual decay but a phase transition when |ε| > C under rising ψ. The model is illustrated using aerospace, financial, and industrial cases (Challenger, Boeing 737 MAX, Silicon Valley Bank, Toyota andon systems, aviation safety reporting). It further shows that Turchin's Political Stress Index empirically tracks the same failure ratio (ψ + ε/C), suggesting a general, testable theory of institutional breakdown.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个热力学模型，将恐惧视为必要的能量梯度，制度秩序是受控的非平衡状态。制度崩溃不是由于缺乏信息或专业知识，而是因为压制恐惧导致预测误差积累超过系统的纠正能力。
AI.research_question: 制度为什么会失败？制度崩溃的根本机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为制度失败源于信息或专业知识不足，但作者观察到许多失败案例中制度实际上拥有足够信息却仍崩溃，这促使研究制度失败的深层机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学模型：恐惧作为能量梯度(ψ)，制度秩序作为受控非平衡状态，预测误差(ε)，系统纠正能力(C)，反射模式理论。
AI.method: 理论建模结合案例研究，包括航空航天（挑战者号、波音737 MAX）、金融（硅谷银行）、工业（丰田安灯系统、航空安全报告）等案例，并利用Turchin政治压力指数进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 制度通过压缩或推迟恐惧而非解决恐惧来维持一致性，这减少了可见的不稳定性但默默积累结构性错误。崩溃不是逐渐衰败，而是当|ε| > C时的相变。Turchin政治压力指数实证追踪相同的失败比率(ψ + ε/C)。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个通用的、可检验的制度崩溃理论，将制度失败重新概念化为热力学相变过程，挑战了传统的信息不足解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了预警机制，通过监测恐惧能量梯度和预测误差积累来预防制度崩溃，对风险管理、组织设计和安全文化具有重要启示。

title: Public-Private Partnership in Project Development and Implementation: A Prolusion to Socio-Economic Development in Nigeria
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke, Alex Ekwueme Federal University, Gregory University and Federal College of Agriculture

detail.title: Public-Private Partnership in Project Development and Implementation: A Prolusion to Socio-Economic Development in Nigeria
detail.abstract: This paper examined Public-Private Partnership (PPP) in project development and implementation as a prolusion to socioeconomic development in Nigeria. The high level of infrastructural deficit with its concomitant effect on socioeconomic development in Nigeria is often associated with poor project development and implementation occasioned by the problem of inadequate government resources, bureaucratic bottleneck especially in the area of decision making, the penchant of some public officials to divert public fund to private pockets, the recognition that government cannot do it alone among others have made the government to search for an alternative model of providing infrastructure for the teeming population-public-private partnership model. To shed more light on this, this paper adopted the consociationalism theory as conceptualized by Arend Lijphart; it utilized the qualitative research design; relied on secondary data; and analyzed the collected data using the qualitative content method of data analysis. The findings of the study revealed that the adoption of PPP model in Nigeria has its own benefits and challenges as mentioned in the study; and therefore, recommends that there is need for a regulatory environment as currently there is no independent PPP regulator in Nigeria. Again, lack of adequate information should be addressed due to the fact that PPP program needs a comprehensive database regarding the projects/studies, feasibility reports, concession agreements and status of various clearances and land acquisitions usually awarded under PPP among others.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了尼日利亚的公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）作为社会经济发展的前奏，发现PPP模式既有益处也有挑战，建议建立监管环境和解决信息不足问题。
AI.research_question: 公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）在尼日利亚项目开发和实施中如何促进社会经济发展？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚基础设施严重不足，政府资源有限、官僚决策瓶颈、官员腐败等问题促使政府寻求替代模式来为庞大人口提供基础设施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用Arend Lijphart提出的协和民主理论（consociationalism theory）
AI.method: 定性研究设计，依赖二手数据，使用定性内容分析方法
AI.findings: PPP模式在尼日利亚的实施既有益处也有挑战，目前缺乏独立的PPP监管机构，信息不足是主要问题
AI.theory_contributions: 将协和民主理论应用于PPP研究，为理解公私部门合作提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 建议建立PPP监管环境，解决信息不足问题，为尼日利亚PPP项目的有效实施提供实践指导

title: From Board Gender Diversity to Sustainability: Leveraging Lean Operations
affiliations: Sabanci University, Ozyegin University, American University of Beirut and University of Bedfordshire

detail.title: From Board Gender Diversity to Sustainability: Leveraging Lean Operations
detail.abstract: Amid growing attention to sustainability, board gender diversity and lean operations, which focus on waste reduction and operational efficiency, have each been independently studied in relation to sustainability. This study aims to explore the potential mechanisms that connect these three concepts by examining how the board gender diversity influences the sustainability performance of a firm both directly and indirectly through its impact on operational leanness. Utilizing a crosscountry firm-level dataset covering 42 countries, we empirically test a conceptual framework linking gender diversity, two distinct measures of operational leanness-inventory and property/plant/equipment (PPE)-and sustainability performance. Our findings reveal that gender-diverse boards are associated with stronger environmental, social and governance (ESG) outcomes but exhibit a negative relationship with operational leanness. Furthermore, we find that PPE leanness mediates the gender-ESG link. Our study offers novel insights into how inclusive governance can shape sustainable operations and advance the broader sustainability agenda.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了董事会性别多样性如何通过运营精益性影响企业可持续发展绩效。研究发现性别多元化董事会与ESG表现正相关，但与运营精益性负相关，其中PPE精益性在性别-ESG关系中起中介作用。
AI.research_question: 董事会性别多样性如何直接影响企业可持续发展绩效，以及如何通过运营精益性间接影响可持续发展绩效？
AI.motivation: 随着对可持续性、董事会性别多样性和精益运营的关注日益增长，需要探索这三个概念之间的潜在联系机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 董事会性别多样性理论、精益运营理论、可持续发展理论
AI.method: 使用涵盖42个国家的跨国企业层面数据集，实证检验连接性别多样性、运营精益性（库存和PPE）和可持续发展绩效的概念框架
AI.findings: 性别多元化董事会与更强的ESG结果相关，但与运营精益性呈负相关关系；PPE精益性在性别-ESG关系中起中介作用
AI.theory_contributions: 为包容性治理如何塑造可持续运营提供了新的理论见解
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何通过董事会性别多样性来推进更广泛的可持续性议程提供了实践启示

title: Device-to-Device Economics and AI Agent Transactions
affiliations: Hashtag Web3

detail.title: Device-to-Device Economics and AI Agent Transactions
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence agents can now buy and sell things without human help, creating new market patterns that old economic theories cannot explain. Major technology companies have built new systems for automated payments, with Ethereum, Coinbase, and Cloudflare working together on an AI system that can power automated economies for many years. Google's new Agent Payments Protocol (AP2) creates a common language for safe transactions between agents and sellers, while Coinbase's x402 system allows instant digital currency payments directly over the internet. However, research from Stanford reveals that weaker seller agents may lose up to 14% in profit compared to negotiations between AI agents of equal ability. The machine-to-machine services market sees fast change as automated agents become market players. This study looks at how major platform developments are changing device-to-device economics and what new patterns suggest for market fairness and economic stability.

AI.tldr: AI代理自主交易形成新市场模式，传统经济理论无法解释。科技公司开发自动化支付系统，但斯坦福研究发现能力较弱的卖家代理可能损失14%利润。研究探讨平台发展如何改变设备间经济以及市场公平性问题。
AI.research_question: 主要平台发展如何改变设备到设备的经济学？新市场模式对市场公平性和经济稳定性有何影响？
AI.motivation: AI代理能够自主进行买卖交易，创造了传统经济理论无法解释的新市场模式，需要研究这些自动化经济系统的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统经济理论、自动化经济理论、市场公平性理论
AI.method: 分析主要科技公司的平台发展（如Google的AP2协议、Coinbase的x402系统等），结合斯坦福大学的研究数据
AI.findings: AI代理之间的交易形成了新市场模式；能力较弱的卖家代理在谈判中可能损失高达14%的利润；自动化支付系统正在快速发展
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统经济理论对自动化交易的解释能力，提出了设备间经济的新分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为科技公司开发更公平的AI交易系统提供指导，帮助政策制定者理解自动化经济对市场稳定性的影响

title: Empirical Market Design in Surplus Food Marketplaces
affiliations: , University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) - Anderson School of Management and Cornell University

detail.title: Empirical Market Design in Surplus Food Marketplaces
detail.abstract: Commercial food waste presents a major challenge to urban sustainability. In response, digital platforms have emerged that create new marketplaces for food retailers (e.g. bakeries) to sell surplus inventory at a discount. We consider how a key market design lever -- the platform's pricing policy -- influences seller entry and food waste diverted (i.e., aggregate sales volume) in a major surplus food marketplace. We estimate a structural model of a two-sided marketplace that captures both spatially differentiated consumer demand and sellers’ market entry decisions, using hourly inventory data from 465 participating food retailers across four U.S. urban centers (Manhattan, Boston, San Francisco, and Seattle). Central to our methodology is a new estimation technique for sellers’ entry costs grounded in discrete optimization, which dramatically speeds up estimation compared to standard nested fixed-point methods. We find significant heterogeneity across the four cities in consumers' travel costs and sensitivity to sellers' on-platform ratings. Counterfactual results show that seller participation is more price-elastic than consumer demand, implying that supply constraints primarily determine the volume of food waste diverted by the marketplace. Delegating price control to sellers invites excessive competition and induces exit, leading to a sharp contraction in equilibrium sales volume. Overall, our findings support platform control of prices in surplus food marketplaces -- provided discounts are not too steep -- and offer guidance to platform operators seeking to stimulate seller entry and curb food waste.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了数字平台定价政策对食品零售商参与和食物浪费减少的影响，发现卖家参与比消费者需求更具价格弹性，平台控制价格（折扣不过大）能有效促进卖家参与和减少食物浪费。
AI.research_question: 平台定价政策如何影响卖家参与和食物浪费减少？
AI.motivation: 商业食物浪费是城市可持续发展的主要挑战，数字平台为食品零售商销售剩余库存提供了新市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双边市场理论、空间差异化消费者需求、卖家市场进入决策
AI.method: 使用来自美国四个城市465家食品零售商的每小时库存数据，构建双边市场结构模型，采用基于离散优化的新估计技术计算卖家进入成本
AI.findings: 四个城市在消费者旅行成本和对卖家平台评分敏感性方面存在显著异质性；卖家参与比消费者需求更具价格弹性；将价格控制权交给卖家会导致过度竞争和退出，从而大幅减少均衡销售量
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于离散优化的新估计技术，显著加快了卖家进入成本的估计速度；深化了对双边市场中定价政策影响的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台运营商提供了促进卖家参与和减少食物浪费的指导；支持平台控制价格（折扣不过大）的策略

title: N-Power Programme and Youth Entrepreneurship Development in Nigeria: An Assessment

detail.title: N-Power Programme and Youth Entrepreneurship Development in Nigeria: An Assessment
detail.abstract: The sample population derived via the application of Taro Yamani sample size determination formula was 334. The data collected via questionnaire were analyzed using tables and percentages, while the hypotheses were tested using the chisquare statistical tool. The findings of the study revealed inter alia; N-Power Programme has fared well in promoting youth entrepreneurship in Nigeria; N-Power Programme has impacted positively on youth entrepreneurship development in Nigeria; and Systemic hiccups among others served as challenges of N-Power Programme in Nigeria. Based on the findings, the study recommended the following: competent personnel should be employed to implement the Programme; cordial relationship between the Federal Government, State and the citizens especially in areas of youth entrepreneurship development programmes should be enhanced so that the N-Power Programme objectives and goals would be achieved; and that participants should be well motivated in their various work schedules because workers have the tendency to increase productivity when duly motivated.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用Taro Yamani样本量确定公式选取334名样本，通过问卷调查收集数据，使用表格和百分比分析数据，卡方检验验证假设。研究发现N-Power计划在促进尼日利亚青年创业方面表现良好，对青年创业发展有积极影响，但也面临系统性障碍等挑战。建议雇佣合格人员实施计划，加强联邦政府、州政府和公民之间的关系，以及激励参与者以提高生产力。
AI.research_question: N-Power计划在尼日利亚青年创业发展中的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 评估尼日利亚N-Power计划在促进青年创业方面的成效和面临的挑战

AI.findings: 1. N-Power计划在促进尼日利亚青年创业方面表现良好；2. N-Power计划对青年创业发展有积极影响；3. 系统性障碍等是N-Power计划在尼日利亚面临的主要挑战

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff of Matching Prior to Difference-in-Differences When Parallel Trends is Violated
affiliations: and

detail.title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff of Matching Prior to Difference-in-Differences When Parallel Trends is Violated
detail.abstract: Quasi-experimental causal inference methods have become central in empirical operations management (OM) for guiding managerial decisions. Among the relevant methods, empiricists utilize the Difference-inDifferences (DiD) estimator, which is built on the "parallel trends" assumption. To increase the plausibility of parallel trends holding, researchers often match treated and control units before applying DiD, motivated by the intuition that matched groups are more likely to have the same post-treatment outcome absent treatment. Although this practice has been studied previously, the focus was solely on the bias. Yet bias is only one side to the story; the tradeoff in variance, and hence mean squared error (MSE), is left unexplored. In this work, we not only generalize earlier bias results but also fill this gap by mathematically analyzing properties of variance and MSE, a practically relevant metric for managerial decision making. We show, under a linear structural model with unobserved time-varying confounders, that variance results contrast with established bias insights: when considering variance, matching on observed covariates prior to DiD is not always recommended over the classic (unmatched) DiD due to a sample size tradeoff. Furthermore, matching additionally on pre-treatment outcome(s) is always beneficial as such tradeoff no longer exists once matching is performed. Given our novel contrasting results to the established literature, we characterize full bias-variance tradeoffs among three estimators and advocate using MSE as a final metric. We further give practitioner-friendly guidelines with theoretical guarantees that determine whether applied researchers should match (and on what variables) for their applications. Lastly, we apply these guidelines to reexamine a recent empirical study that matches prior to DiD to study how the introduction of monetary incentives by a knowledge-sharing platform affects general engagement on the platform. Our results show that the authors' decision was both warranted and critical to produce a credible causal estimate. In particular, we provide new managerial insights that after a full bias correction, their estimated effect with matching still remains statistically significant, providing further evidence that the chosen methodological approach is sufficiently robust to address potential managerial concerns over violations of parallel trends.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在双重差分法(DiD)之前进行匹配的偏差-方差权衡问题，发现匹配观察变量不一定优于经典DiD，但匹配预处理结果总是有益的，并提出了基于MSE的实践指南。
AI.research_question: 在双重差分法之前进行匹配对偏差和方差的影响是什么？匹配观察变量与匹配预处理结果在偏差-方差权衡方面有何不同？
AI.motivation: 现有文献仅关注匹配对偏差的影响，但忽略了方差和均方误差(MSE)的权衡，而MSE对管理决策具有实际相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于具有未观察到的时变混杂因素的线性结构模型，分析匹配对偏差、方差和MSE的影响。
AI.method: 数学分析偏差、方差和MSE的性质，比较三种估计器：经典DiD、匹配观察变量的DiD、匹配预处理结果的DiD。
AI.findings: 方差结果与已有偏差见解形成对比：匹配观察变量不一定优于经典DiD，因为存在样本量权衡；但匹配预处理结果总是有益的。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次全面分析匹配对DiD估计器方差和MSE的影响，提供了偏差-方差权衡的完整特征描述。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具有理论保证的实践指南，帮助研究人员决定是否匹配以及匹配哪些变量，并通过实证研究验证了指南的有效性。

title: Ideas on Layover: Airspace Disruptions and Knowledge Diffusion Across the Skies
affiliations: Yonsei University and

detail.title: Ideas on Layover: Airspace Disruptions and Knowledge Diffusion Across the Skies
detail.abstract: Innovation depends not only on the creation of new ideas but also on their dissemination. Although trade, migration, and digital communication have been widely studied as channels of knowledge diffusion, the role of air travel-particularly in enabling face-to-face exchange of complex and tacit knowledge-remains underexplored. This paper exploits geopolitical airspace closures as natural experiments that exogenously increase international flight distances and travel costs. Linking these disruptions to patent citation data, we show that longer routes significantly reduce cross-border citations. The effects emerge gradually, persist over multiple years, and are strongest in knowledge-intensive and complex sectors such as physics, computing, and telecommunications. Evidence from international passenger traffic further indicates that disruptions operate by reducing opportunities for face-to-face collaboration. Our findings provide new causal evidence that mobility constraints weaken international knowledge flows, highlighting the vulnerability of global innovation networks to geopolitical shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文利用地缘政治空域关闭作为自然实验，发现国际航班距离增加会显著减少跨境专利引用，特别是在知识密集型领域，证明面对面交流对复杂知识传播的重要性。
AI.research_question: 国际航空旅行如何影响跨境知识流动？
AI.motivation: 虽然贸易、移民和数字通信已被广泛研究为知识扩散渠道，但航空旅行在促进复杂和隐性知识面对面交流方面的作用仍未充分探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识扩散理论和面对面交流在复杂知识传播中的重要性，特别是隐性知识的转移需要直接人际互动。
AI.method: 利用地缘政治空域关闭作为自然实验，通过外生增加国际飞行距离和旅行成本，结合专利引用数据进行因果分析。
AI.findings: 更长的航线显著减少跨境专利引用，效应逐渐显现并持续多年，在物理、计算和电信等知识密集型领域最为明显。国际客运流量证据表明中断通过减少面对面合作机会发挥作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了流动性约束削弱国际知识流动的新因果证据，强调了面对面交流在复杂知识传播中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了全球创新网络对地缘政治冲击的脆弱性，为政策制定者理解知识流动的驱动因素提供了重要见解。

title: Managing Lost-Sale Inventory Systems under Unknown Demand and Return Distributions
affiliations: University of Illinois at Chicago - College of Business Administration, University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business, University of Iowa - Department of Business Analytics and University of Iowa

detail.title: Managing Lost-Sale Inventory Systems under Unknown Demand and Return Distributions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors confirm that they have no affiliations with or involvement in any organization or entity that could have influenced the conduct or findings of this research.

detail.abstract: Product returns are increasingly common in e-commerce, posing significant challenges for adaptive inventory control. Motivated by this, we consider a single-product, lost-sales inventory system with  stochastic product returns and demand distributions. We propose a novel online learning algorithm that achieves O(sqrt(TlogT)) regret without requiring prior knowledge of either the discrete demand distribution or return probabilities. Our method leverages a phased base-stock policy elimination framework and introduces a new simulation approach: in each phase, given the updated return model, the performance of all candidate policies can be evaluated by simulating only the policy with the largest base-stock level remaining in the active set. Establishing this property in the presence of product returns is technically challenging, as it requires  disentangling the interaction between demand uncertainty and return dynamics. We demonstrate the robustness and effectiveness of our approach, highlighting its practical relevance for modern e-commerce inventory management through extensive experiments across diverse demand distributions, return probabilities, and return time windows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于处理电子商务中产品退货的在线学习库存控制算法，无需需求分布或退货概率的先验知识，实现了O(sqrt(TlogT))的遗憾界。
AI.research_question: 如何在存在随机产品退货的情况下，设计无需先验知识的在线学习库存控制算法？
AI.motivation: 电子商务中产品退货日益普遍，给适应性库存控制带来了重大挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于阶段化基础库存策略消除框架，结合新的模拟方法，在存在退货的情况下解耦需求不确定性和退货动态的相互作用。
AI.method: 采用阶段化基础库存策略消除框架，在每个阶段根据更新的退货模型，通过仅模拟活跃集中最大基础库存水平的策略来评估所有候选策略的性能。
AI.findings: 提出的算法在多种需求分布、退货概率和退货时间窗口下都表现出鲁棒性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 在存在产品退货的情况下建立了策略性能评估的理论性质，实现了O(sqrt(TlogT))的遗憾界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代电子商务库存管理提供了实用的解决方案，能够有效处理产品退货带来的挑战。

title: Asymmetrical Equilibrium: Why Sustainable Systems Depend on Controlled Imbalance
affiliations: Epistria

detail.title: Asymmetrical Equilibrium: Why Sustainable Systems Depend on Controlled Imbalance
detail.abstract: This paper challenges the most persistent myth in systems theory: that stability is achieved through balance. In the real world, nothing alive or functional is ever in balance. A bicycle, a forest, a market, or an organization remains upright only by staying slightly wrong and continually correcting. We are documenting a bias in academic framing—the assumption that deviation equals failure. In the physical world, deviation is operation. The mathematics that follow are descriptive, not prescriptive: a controlled disequilibrium that survives by oscillating inside its limits. Systems collapse not when they drift, but when they mistake symmetry for safety.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战系统理论中最持久的迷思：稳定是通过平衡实现的。实际上，任何有生命或功能的事物都不处于平衡状态。自行车、森林、市场或组织只有通过保持轻微失衡并持续修正才能维持稳定。
AI.research_question: 系统稳定性的本质是什么？平衡是否真的是实现稳定的必要条件？
AI.motivation: 挑战学术界对平衡与稳定关系的传统假设，揭示偏离平衡状态在现实系统中的功能性作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 受控非平衡理论、动态系统理论、复杂性科学
AI.method: 理论分析和数学建模，描述性而非规范性的方法
AI.findings: 系统通过持续的非平衡状态和内部振荡来维持稳定，偏离是系统运行的正常状态而非失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 颠覆了传统系统理论中平衡=稳定的迷思，提出了受控非平衡作为系统稳定性的新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理、市场调控和生态系统保护提供了新的理论指导，强调动态调整而非静态平衡的重要性。

title: Braggart or Humble? The Effects of Performance Self-Reports on Productivity
affiliations: City University London, Institute of Environmental Planning, Leibniz University Hannover and King's College London

detail.title: Braggart or Humble? The Effects of Performance Self-Reports on Productivity
detail.abstract: In meetings, workplace conversations, or social media, people often share their professional accomplishments. These performance self-reports, though informal and mostly unverifiable, influence likeability and perceived competence, and help establish group norms around effort. This paper studies how such horizontal, decentralized feedback affects productivity. Using a laboratory experiment, we explore whether individuals misreport their performance to peers, and how self-promotion and humility relate to effort under different compensation schemes. We find that self-reports are largely truthful but strategically used: some participants overreport to appear hard-working, while others underreport to downplay their performance. Self-reporting increases productivity under individual incentives, especially in fully truthful groups, but its effects are weak or even negative under group-based pay. Misreporting is more likely among low performers. In addition, perceived dishonesty in others' selfreports reduces effort. These results draw attention to self-presentation as a factor influencing productivity and work-related norms in organizations and professional communities, a channel so far overlooked in the literature.

AI.tldr: 论文研究非正式绩效自我报告对生产力的影响，发现自我报告基本真实但被策略性使用，在个人激励下能提高生产力，但在团队激励下效果较弱甚至负面。
AI.research_question: 水平分散的反馈如何影响生产力？个体是否会向同伴误报绩效？自我推销和谦逊在不同薪酬方案下如何与努力相关？
AI.motivation: 人们在会议、职场对话或社交媒体中经常分享专业成就，这些非正式且大多不可验证的绩效自我报告会影响好感度和感知能力，并帮助建立关于努力的群体规范。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我呈现理论、绩效报告策略、社会规范、激励理论
AI.method: 实验室实验，研究个体在不同薪酬方案下如何向同伴报告绩效以及自我报告与努力的关系
AI.findings: 1.自我报告基本真实但被策略性使用：部分参与者夸大报告以显得勤奋，部分低调报告以淡化表现；2.在个人激励下自我报告能提高生产力，尤其在完全真实群体中；3.在团队薪酬下效果弱或负面；4.低绩效者更可能误报；5.感知他人报告不诚实会降低努力
AI.theory_contributions: 首次关注自我呈现作为影响组织生产力和工作相关规范的因素，这一渠道在文献中一直被忽视
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织管理提供启示：理解非正式绩效报告对生产力的影响，特别是在不同激励方案下的差异化效果

title: Neo-Colonialism and Pan-African Resistance: The Rise of New Sovereignty Movements in the Sahel
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Neo-Colonialism and Pan-African Resistance: The Rise of New Sovereignty Movements in the Sahel

declarations.declarationOfInterest: AI Assistance Disclosure: The author used Claude (Anthropic) as a research and writing assistant in the preparation of this manuscript. AI assistance was used for literature organization, structural editing, critical analysis suggestions, and improving academic rigor. All intellectual content, arguments, analysis, and conclusions are the author's own. The author takes full responsibility for the accuracy and integrity of the work.

detail.abstract:
.This paper examines contemporary sovereignty movements in the Sahel region through the theoretical framework of neo-colonialism, focusing on Burkina Faso's transformation under Ibrahim Traoré as a case study. Drawing on Kwame Nkrumah's foundational analysis and connecting historical patterns of resistance, the study analyzes how military-led governments are challenging French neo-colonial structures, forming regional alliances (Alliance of Sahel States), and pursuing economic independence through domestic resource mobilization. While these movements invoke Pan-African traditions and demonstrate genuine popular support, they also raise critical questions about democratic governance, human rights, and whether new partnerships with Russia, China, and Turkey represent genuine alternatives or merely substitute dependencies. Through examining military restructuring, economic reforms, and regional cooperation mechanisms alongside their contradictions and limitations, this study contributes to understanding how African nations navigate between historical dependency structures and emerging alternative partnerships in their pursuit of sovereignty. The analysis reveals partial sovereignty gains in military domains alongside persistent economic dependencies, democratic backsliding, and uncertain sustainability of current approaches.

title: The Ministerial Approval Requirement for Arbitration Agreements in Egypt: Revisiting the Public Policy Debate

detail.title: The Ministerial Approval Requirement for Arbitration Agreements in Egypt: Revisiting the Public Policy Debate
detail.abstract: The Egyptian Arbitration Law No. 27/1994 (the 'Egyptian Arbitration Law') was enacted without delineating the subject of arbitrability of administrative contracts. This was one of the hottest pre-existing debates preceding the promulgation of the Egyptian Arbitration Law, yet the latter has succinctly mentioned that arbitration is valid between public and private entities. The Legislature did not find such wording sufficient to settle this debate and decided in 1997 to introduce a specific amendment elaborating this issue. The 1997 amendment might have settled the arbitrability of administrative contracts debate, however, it initiated another debate when it required that arbitration agreements under administrative contracts be approved by the competent minister. Until now, there are some unsettled issues concerning this ministerial approval requirement. For instance, which party is liable to procure such ministerial approval: the administrative authority or its private counterparty? Could this ministerial approval be implied? For example, what if the competent minister has attended the contract signing ceremony, would that be enough? Another recurring question is whether such a ministerial approval pertains to public policy or not. This article tries to answer these questions in light of the recent decisions rendered by the Egyptian courts and arbitral tribunals.

title: On The Power of Reason

detail.title: On The Power of Reason
detail.abstract: Why a life of causal understanding preferred on mass religion's political script Mass religions are excellent at coordinating crowds under uncertainty, but they do it by leaning on teleology (imagined purposes) and obedience to an archaic political text. The result is chronic dissonance: split selves, tribal conflicts, and stalled growth. Reason-understood as the disciplined search for causes and the sharing of common notions-turns passive emotions into active understanding. It yields durable happiness (a stable, lucid joy) and builds communities that cohere on shared methods and transparent rules rather than myth.

title: Mechanization To Humanization: The Changing Face of Industry Through the Ages

detail.title: Mechanization To Humanization: The Changing Face of Industry Through the Ages
detail.abstract: This review essay traces the evolution of industrialization from Proto-Industrialization to Industry 5.0, integrating insights from economic history and technology studies. It examines how successive industrial revolutions transformed production systems, labor relations, and technological development. The paper analyzes the defining characteristics and socioeconomic impacts of Industries 1.0 to 4.0, highlighting Industry 4.0's digital transformation through AI, automation, and cyber-physical systems. It further explores how Industry 5.0 emerges as a response, focusing on human-centric innovation, sustainability, and collaboration. Through historical and conceptual synthesis, the essay offers a holistic understanding of industrial revolutions as interconnected drivers of economic and societal change.

title: Transparency in Common-Value Procurement Auctions with Resale: The Effect of Information Disclosure
affiliations: Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez., Universidad Tecnica Federico Santa Maria and

detail.title: Transparency in Common-Value Procurement Auctions with Resale: The Effect of Information Disclosure

contentType.other: Pre-print version of accepted paper, International Journal of Production Research

publicationDetails.detailsText: Forthcoming, International Journal of Production Research (Accepted October 18th, 2025)

detail.abstract: In procurement auctions, the presence of resale markets and information disclosure policies significantly shapes bidding strategies and auction outcomes. This study explores the strategic effects of resale opportunities and post-auction disclosure of common-value information in first-price procurement auctions under asymmetric information. Employing a game-theoretic model, we analyze how bidders adapt strategies across varied informational environments. Our findings indicate that resale opportunities consistently enhance the auctioneer's expected benefits. However, the optimal disclosure policy hinges on informational asymmetry levels: disclosing the common-value component benefits markets with lower asymmetry, while withholding it is preferable in highly asymmetric settings. Notably, increasing bidder competition outperforms resale in boosting auctioneer benefits, highlighting competition's crucial role in auction design. These insights offer actionable guidance for managers and policymakers in crafting effective procurement auctions, particularly in sectors like construction and services where resale and information asymmetry are prevalent, advancing both theoretical and practical dimensions of operations management.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了转售市场和信息披露政策在采购拍卖中的战略影响。研究发现转售机会能提升拍卖方收益，而最优信息披露策略取决于信息不对称程度：低不对称时披露共同价值信息有利，高不对称时隐瞒信息更优。竞标者竞争比转售更能提升拍卖方收益。

title: YYA Concept Note | Polytunity: A Constructive Alternative to the Polycrisis
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: YYA Concept Note | Polytunity: A Constructive Alternative to the Polycrisis
detail.abstract:
Proposed by Yuen Yuen Ang in 2024, polytunity is both a counter-narrative and a constructive alternative to the buzzword "polycrisis." Instead of reacting to today's convergence of crises and disruptions with fear, polytunity reframes this moment as a generational opportunity for deep transformation of global institutions and thought. 

Polytunity is not just a new word. It advances reflexivity and systems change at a time when the world is hurtling toward multipolarity and hyper-complexity. A rupture of such tectonic scale requires that we diversify the curation of voices, reprogram the way we think, and truly broaden global inclusion. 

To seize the Polytunity, Ang offers her paradigm as an intellectual foundation for a disrupted, multipolar world: AIM (Adaptive, Inclusive, Moral) Political Economy. 

• Adaptive = Replace machine-thinking with systems-thinking 
• Inclusive = Value diverse development pathways 
• Moral = Recognize how power and positionality shapes ideas. 

Polytunity is not vague optimism but grounded in a rigorous empirical foundation. Though polytunity and AIM are formally named in 2024, Ang has practiced their principles throughout her award-winning scholarship, teaching, and public engagement in the past decades, and she continues to expand the paradigm through a variety of new projects.

AI.tldr: Polytunity是Yuen Yuen Ang在2024年提出的概念，作为'多重危机'的反叙事和建设性替代方案。它将当前的多重危机和干扰重新定义为深度变革全球制度和思想的代际机遇，并提出了AIM（适应性、包容性、道德性）政治经济学范式作为理论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何将多重危机重新定义为变革机遇？如何构建适应多极化和超复杂世界的政治经济学范式？

AI.method: 基于严谨的实证基础，结合作者过去数十年的学术研究、教学和公共参与实践。
AI.findings: Polytunity概念提供了重新框架多重危机的视角，AIM范式为多极化和超复杂世界提供了智力基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Polytunity概念作为polycrisis的反叙事，建立了AIM政治经济学新范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和全球领导者提供了应对多重危机的建设性框架，促进全球制度的深度变革。

title: THE DEVELOPMENTAL STATE AND THE CONSTITUTIONAL TERRITORY IN COLOMBIAN
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: THE DEVELOPMENTAL STATE AND THE CONSTITUTIONAL TERRITORY IN COLOMBIAN
detail.abstract: This article analyzes, using Joseph Stiglitz's analytical framework of the developmental state, the economic and territorial foundations of Title III of the 1991 Colombian Constitution, "Of the Inhabitants and the Territory." It examines whether these constitutional articles allow for correcting market failures, achieving a pragmatic balance between state and market, and building a hard and soft infrastructure that guarantees equitable and sustainable growth. It argues that territorial and demographic rights constitute pillars for a competitive and socially just economy.

title: Assessing the Real-World Effectiveness of Gamified Learning Tools in Project Management Education
