detail.title: Assessing the Real-World Effectiveness of Gamified Learning Tools in Project Management Education

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the content, analysis, or conclusions presented in this study. This research was independently conducted and is not affiliated with any commercial gamification platform or third-party education vendor. The study was developed solely for academic purposes, and all referenced tools (e.g., Sim4Projects, Trello) are cited based on their educational relevance, not commercial endorsement.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve original data collection from human participants. Instead, it synthesized and adapted findings from previously validated, de-identified sources to construct a practice-informed instructional model. As such, formal review by a Research Ethics Board (REB) was not required. The research adhered to the ethical principles outlined in Canada's Tri-Council Policy Statement: Ethical Conduct for Research Involving Humans (TCPS 2), including respect for participant anonymity, responsible data use, and transparent sourcing.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was self-initiated and conducted independently, with all resources and materials drawn from publicly accessible or previously published sources.

detail.abstract: Gamified learning has gained traction across educational domains, yet its applied effectiveness in project management education, a field demanding both technical expertise and adaptive decision-making remains underexplored. This study presents a simulation-based synthesis of validated empirical research to model the real-world impact of gamified tools in academic and corporate learning environments. Anchored in Experiential Learning Theory, Self-Determination Theory, and Cognitive Load Theory, it evaluates how gamification influences learner engagement, knowledge retention, and applied project management competencies. Using adapted assessment data, learning analytics, and simulation results from prior studies, the paper contrasts traditional instructional methods with gamified platforms such as Sim4Projects and Trello. Synthesized findings show consistent gains in student motivation, task completion, and conceptual understanding, with notable improvements in risk management, decision-making, and deadline adherence. While the study does not involve original human-subject research, it contributes a novel, practice-informed framework for embedding gamification into project-based learning. Ethical considerations, implementation barriers, and policy implications are also examined. This work bridges disciplinary silos and provides actionable insights for educators, instructional designers, and training institutions aiming to modernize project management education. By modeling the integration of gamified tools, it lays the foundation for future empirical research and scalable curriculum reform.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过模拟验证的实证研究，探讨了游戏化学习在项目管理教育中的应用效果。基于体验学习理论、自我决定理论和认知负荷理论，研究发现游戏化工具能显著提升学习动机、任务完成度和概念理解，特别是在风险管理、决策制定和截止日期遵守方面。

title: SOCIAL EMPOWERMENT THROUGH WOMEN ENTREPRENEURSHIP DEVELOPMENT IN BANGLADESH
affiliations: and Coordinator-GEAR, Better Work Bangladesh, International Labour Organization, Bangladesh

detail.title: SOCIAL EMPOWERMENT THROUGH WOMEN ENTREPRENEURSHIP DEVELOPMENT IN BANGLADESH
detail.abstract: There is a paramount importance of equal empowerment of women for the socioeconomic development and balanced growth of Bangladesh. Research shows that only 7% of the total business establishments headed by the women entrepreneurs. The reasons could be attributed by the lack of women entrepreneurship development, social influencing and networking abilities, and decisionmaking abilities of the women. Hence, this study aims at identifying the factors related to social empowerment due to women entrepreneurship development (WED). The causal research used primary data collected from women entrepreneurs in Small and Medium Enterprise (SME) businesses. The study used both probability and non-probability sampling techniques to select 397 women entrepreneurs for interview. We analyzed data by using Exploratory Factor Analysis and Structural Equation Modelling techniques. The results show that the factors concerning women entrepreneurship development include enterprise management, enterprise resourcing, generating business ideas and harvesting and growth significantly related to the overall development of women entrepreneurship in Bangladesh. The WED helps in developing women social empowerment especially decision making abilities, social influencing abilities, and social networking abilities. This study suggests that the policy makers of SME sector should focus on the WED significant factors in order to expedite entrepreneurship development and improve women social empowerment of Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了孟加拉国女性创业发展(WED)与社会赋权之间的关系，发现企业管理、资源配置、商业创意生成以及收获与成长是WED的关键因素，这些因素显著影响女性的决策能力、社会影响力和社交网络能力。
AI.research_question: 女性创业发展(WED)如何影响孟加拉国女性的社会赋权？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国仅有7%的企业由女性领导，这归因于女性创业发展不足、社会影响力和网络能力以及决策能力的缺乏，因此需要研究WED对社会赋权的影响。

detail.abstract: This paper constitutes a standardized reference document that unifies the scientific use of the core indicators of the Positive Statistics Methodology and clarifies the analytical conditions and practical limitations associated with each indicator. The framework aims to ensure consistency and precision in applied research employing the methodology, while minimizing variation in interpretation and computation among researchers. It presents the official equations, provides a demonstrative applied example, and establishes the philosophical and methodological foundations for employing traditional statistical tools (such as correlation, regression, and analysis of variance) within the constructive paradigm that defines Positive Statistics.

title: Real-World Pathways to Manufacturing Jobs
affiliations: , Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Real-World Pathways to Manufacturing Jobs
detail.abstract:
This white paper analyzes 59 million workers’ career histories to address two important objectives: (1) to help US manufacturers identify non-traditional sources of potential workers for hard-to-fill advanced manufacturing roles, and (2) to help low-paid workers  identify promising career opportunities in advanced manufacturing. 

DoD manufacturers, and US manufacturers in general, struggle to find workers. Formal education and on-the-job training can fill some but not all of this gap. Manufacturers know where to reach existing manufacturing workers; they are far less familiar with finding possible new workers from outside the sector. This white paper, part of a research project funded by DoD OSD ManTech and NextFlex, helps them know where to look. 

The research team tackled this challenge through a novel approach: examining the full set of job transitions experienced by 59 million American workers. Examining these individuals’ transition numbers from and to more than 1,000 specific jobs enabled us to identify the most frequent origin jobs of workers moving to 20 current manufacturing jobs in critical need of workers. Using a different methodology, we also estimated the most promising origin jobs for 10 emerging manufacturing jobs—jobs that do not yet exist in government taxonomies but that are expected to grow in demand in the near future. Looking across these different origin jobs, we also identified the jobs that are most promising origins across the full set of current and emerging manufacturing jobs. 

Critically important is that approximately half of the origin jobs we identified are outside of the manufacturing sector. These origin jobs, such as computer user support specialists, retail salespersons, and automotive service technicians, can be a fertile area in which to identify individuals who have skills or mindsets that are useful for advanced manufacturing technician roles but may not have considered the possibility before. 

The results form a useful roadmap for manufacturing recruiters looking to find new talent. In parallel, the results provide useful guidance to help low-paid workers identify promising career opportunities in advanced manufacturing.

AI.tldr: 分析5900万工人职业历史，识别制造业难招岗位的非传统人才来源，帮助制造商寻找新工人，同时为低收入工人提供先进制造业职业机会。

AI.method: 分析5900万美国工人的完整职业转换记录，研究1000多种具体工作之间的转换频率，识别20个急需工人的制造业岗位的最常见来源岗位，并预测10个新兴制造业岗位的潜在来源。
AI.findings: 约一半的制造业工人来源岗位来自制造业外部，如计算机用户支持专家、零售销售人员、汽车服务技术员等，这些岗位的工人具备适合先进制造业的技能和思维方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于大规模职业转换数据识别跨行业人才流动模式的新方法，为劳动力市场研究提供新视角。

title: Optimal Return Windows for Experience Goods
affiliations: , Pennsylvania State University - Smeal College of Business and University of Wisconsin-Madison

detail.title: Optimal Return Windows for Experience Goods
detail.abstract: In this paper, we study an expected-profit-maximizing retailer's optimal return window when selling an experience good to consumers that are uncertain regarding their utility from the product before purchase. The retailer offers full refund and chooses a return window, and consumers make their dynamic return decisions based on direct experiences with the product during this return window. Contrary to conventional wisdom, which suggests that longer return windows increase returns, we identify two opposing forces in the case of experience goods: a consumption effect that makes retaining the product less attractive after the return window, and an information effect that potentially increases the appeal of keeping the product beyond the return window. We also consider a consumer market heterogeneous in their level of information regarding the product's utility and analyze the attractiveness of a return policy where the retailer provides a choice between a return window and a price discount to opt out of returns. We find that the salvage value of returns plays a pivotal role in determining the retailer's optimal return policy, and that having a choice may benefit or hurt the consumers depending on the level of information heterogeneity in the market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究零售商在销售体验商品时的最优退货窗口策略，发现与传统认知相反，更长的退货窗口不一定增加退货率。当退货残值较高时，零售商应提供更长的退货窗口；当残值较低时，应提供较短窗口或让消费者选择退货窗口与价格折扣。
AI.research_question: 零售商在销售体验商品时，如何确定最优的退货窗口策略？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为更长的退货窗口会增加退货率，但对于体验商品，消费者在退货窗口期间获得产品体验，这可能改变他们的退货决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于期望利润最大化理论，考虑消费者的动态退货决策过程，分析消费效应和信息效应两种相反力量的影响。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，考虑消费者对产品效用的不确定性，以及退货窗口期间消费者通过直接体验获得信息的过程。
AI.findings: 1. 更长的退货窗口不一定增加退货率；2. 退货残值是决定最优退货政策的关键因素；3. 提供退货窗口与价格折扣的选择对消费者的影响取决于市场信息异质性程度。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了体验商品退货政策中消费效应与信息效应的相互作用，挑战了传统关于退货窗口长度的认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为零售商提供了基于退货残值确定最优退货政策的决策框架，以及在不同市场条件下是否提供退货选择策略的指导。

detail.abstract: Financial Inclusion is a popular catchphrase used in the 21st century. Although governments of different countries have taken many steps to provide financial inclusion to the people, the measurement of financial inclusion is important as it reflects how effective the measures are. This paper discusses how different authors have included different indicators or dimensions to measure Financial Inclusion. What different methodologies are adopted to calculate the same? The paper is an attempt to what key dimensions must be included and what methodologies should be adopted to develop a comprehensive financial inclusion index.

title: Structural Mechanisms of Theoretical Limits: A Compact Cross-Domain Framework (v1.32)

detail.title: Structural Mechanisms of Theoretical Limits: A Compact Cross-Domain Framework (v1.32)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research received no external financial or non-financial support.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable to this research as no patients or participants were involved in this work.
declarations.funderStatement: The author funded this research. There are no additional relationships to disclose.

detail.abstract:
Impossibility results (no-go theorems and hard bounds) recur across mathematics, physics, and computer science. This note proposes a compact, mechanism-based taxonomy: the SCR triad: Self-Reference/Diagonalization (S), Context/Incompatibility (C), and Resource/Monotonicity (R). We illustrate the lens with canonical anchors (Gödel/Tarski/Turing; Heisenberg/Kochen–Specker/Bell; Carnot/Landauer/Shannon/Bekenstein) and an at-a-glance “Impossibility Matrix” mapping domains × mechanisms. 

The framework offers a practical “method at a glance”: state assumptions; identify mechanism; look for a standard witness (fixed-point, no-global-assignment, monotone); then choose mechanism-appropriate relaxations (raise the meta-level; accept explicit trade-offs; add resources or reversible steps). Intended uses are educational and methodological; a companion line of work operationalizes the taxonomy in a machine-readable catalog (IPF) for limits-aware research workflows. 

The note is versioned and released under CC BY 4.0; future work explores predictive power, scale/emergence, and geometric/topological obstructions.

Companion working paper: Impossibility Patterns Finder (IPF): A Reliability Layer for AI-Assisted Research (SSRN working paper, 2025). It operationalizes the SCR taxonomy in a machine-readable catalog and minimal /barrier-check API that flags mechanism-level barriers and proposes typed relaxations.

title: Intellectual property rights and innovation in vertically related industries
affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute

detail.title: Intellectual property rights and innovation in vertically related industries
detail.abstract: This paper examines the economic impact of intellectual property rights (IPRs) in the context of complementary vertical innovation by firms in upstream and downstream industries. I provide empirical evidence that industry downstreamness is associated with 1) a greater intensity of product versus process innovation, and 2) a greater relative importance of patents versus trade secrecy in firm appropriation strategies. I develop a novel model of endogenous growth to explore the implications of these findings. The model predicts that strengthening patent protection generates downstream-biased technical change in most cases. The corresponding reallocation of resources across industries creates distributional effects from patent policy that existing analysis do not account for. I examine the impact of these effects on economic growth and social welfare, and explore their implications for optimal patent policy.

title: The "Resource Curse" Dilemma for the Latin America Mineral-Rich Countries
affiliations: MGIMO University

detail.title: The "Resource Curse" Dilemma for the Latin America Mineral-Rich Countries
detail.abstract: The research examines the current development agenda of Latin American countries, taking into account its resource wealth, which not only determines its economic growth trajectory, but also becomes the arena of political and technological contradictions in the choice of ways to extract minerals and foreign trade. This is happening against the backdrop of historically the fourth commodity boom in the world, when the cost of metals and mineral resources is constantly increasing. The contribution of both economic influence on decisions in the field of using countries' natural resources and the influence of the "resource curse" philosophy in explaining the phenomenon of developing countries, which in most cases choose the path of catch-up or dependent development, is assessed. The analysis of the resource supply of Latin American countries in terms of oil, copper, and mineral extraction is carried out. The main directions for the organization of extraction and trade of raw materials are highlighted, taking into account relations with partner countries and access to investments and technologies. An assessment was made of the growth potential of sovereign wealth funds in Latin America countries (using Brazil as an example) from the sale of raw materials, taking into account the experience of developed and developing countries, and approaches to their activities were identified, taking into account the objectives of strategic and economic development.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了拉丁美洲国家在当前第四次全球大宗商品繁荣背景下的发展议程，探讨资源财富如何影响其经济增长轨迹，并成为政治和技术矛盾的交汇点。研究评估了资源诅咒理论在发展中国家的适用性，分析了拉美国家在石油、铜矿等资源供应情况，以及原材料贸易组织方式，并以巴西为例评估了主权财富基金的增长潜力。
AI.research_question: 拉丁美洲国家如何在其丰富的自然资源基础上制定发展议程？资源财富如何影响其经济增长、政治决策和对外贸易选择？
AI.motivation: 全球正处于历史上第四次大宗商品繁荣期，金属和矿产资源价格持续上涨，拉丁美洲国家拥有丰富的自然资源，这些资源不仅决定其经济增长轨迹，也成为政治和技术矛盾的交汇点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资源诅咒理论、追赶发展理论、依附发展理论、主权财富基金理论
AI.method: 分析拉丁美洲国家在石油、铜矿和矿产开采方面的资源供应情况；评估与伙伴国家关系和获取投资技术的原材料贸易组织方式；以巴西为例评估主权财富基金的增长潜力。

AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对资源诅咒理论在发展中国家的适用性理解；扩展了主权财富基金在资源丰富国家发展中的作用研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拉丁美洲国家制定资源开发战略提供参考；为主权财富基金的运作和管理提供经验借鉴；为发展中国家在资源丰富条件下的发展路径选择提供指导。

title: Predicting Human Development Using Machine Learning: Evidence from African Countries
affiliations: , University of Cape Coast - Department of Economics, Students, University of Cape Coast and School of Economics University of Cape Coast, Ghana

detail.title: Predicting Human Development Using Machine Learning: Evidence from African Countries
detail.abstract: This study employs Random Forest machine learning to predict the Human Development Index (HDI) for 41 African countries, with separate models developed for West Africa (comprising 16 countries) and Southern Africa (comprising 12 countries). It analyses an imbalanced panel dataset with 6.6% missing data, processed to 83 predictors from the ND-GAIN dataset after removing highly correlated features. The results identify economic wealth, environmental management, infrastructure, health, and governance as key drivers of the HDI. West Africa emphasizes rural areas, education, and health, reflecting its agrarian economy and early-stage development, while Southern Africa prioritizes economic output, governance, and urbanization, driven by advanced economies like South Africa. The models perform strongly (testing R-squared: 0.83-0.94), capturing complex, non-linear patterns missed by traditional methods. These findings support policymakers in targeting investments in education, health, and infrastructure, guide ECOWAS and SADC in developing regional strategies for agriculture, education, and governance, and assist the African Union in promoting human development and unity through evidence-based policies.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用随机森林机器学习预测41个非洲国家的人类发展指数，分别建立了西非和南非模型。识别出经济财富、环境管理、基础设施、健康和政府治理是HDI的关键驱动因素，模型表现优异（测试R平方：0.83-0.94），为政策制定提供数据支持。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习方法预测非洲国家的人类发展指数，并识别影响HDI的关键驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以捕捉HDI的复杂非线性模式，需要更先进的方法来为非洲地区的发展政策提供数据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人类发展理论，结合机器学习预测框架，分析经济、环境、基础设施、健康和政府治理等多维度因素对HDI的影响。
AI.method: 使用随机森林机器学习方法，分析ND-GAIN数据集中的83个预测变量，分别建立西非16国和南非12国的预测模型。
AI.findings: 西非地区强调农村地区、教育和健康，反映其农业经济和早期发展阶段；南非地区优先考虑经济产出、治理和城市化，受南非等发达经济体驱动。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了机器学习方法在捕捉HDI复杂非线性模式方面的优势，超越了传统方法的局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供投资教育、健康和基础设施的指导，协助ECOWAS和SADC制定区域战略，支持非洲联盟通过证据政策促进人类发展和团结。

title: REFRAMING HISTORICAL RESEARCH: THE INTERSECTIONS OF DIGITAL ARCHIVES AND ORAL NARRATIVES
affiliations: Himalayan University

detail.title: REFRAMING HISTORICAL RESEARCH: THE INTERSECTIONS OF DIGITAL ARCHIVES AND ORAL NARRATIVES
detail.abstract: This paper examines the transformative convergence of digital archives and oral narratives in contemporary historical research. Traditional archives, though foundational, have long privileged elite voices while excluding subaltern experiences. Digital archives expand access, preserve fragile sources, and generate new forms of evidence, yet they also raise critical concerns regarding authenticity, bias, and the reproduction of existing hierarchies. Oral narratives, once dismissed as unreliable, have emerged as essential tools for recovering silenced voices and reconstructing lived experience, though they too present methodological and ethical challenges rooted in memory, subjectivity, and power relations. By analyzing the strengths and limitations of both approaches, the paper argues that their integration offers the most promising path forward. Digital technologies enhance the preservation and dissemination of oral testimonies, while oral traditions complicate and enrich the archival record. Together, they democratize historical practice, broaden participation, and produce more inclusive narratives. The study concludes that a critical and ethical synthesis of these methods can redefine historical inquiry, creating histories that are both rigorous and profoundly humane.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨数字档案与口述叙事在历史研究中的融合，分析两者各自的优势与局限，认为二者的整合能够实现更民主、包容的历史实践。
AI.research_question: 数字档案与口述叙事如何通过整合来改善历史研究方法并创造更包容的历史叙述？

What Makes a Happy Country? A Large Computational Search
Suggests Anti-Authoritarianism, Not Institutions, as the Primary
Mechanism for Life Satisfaction

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author does not have competing financial or non-financial interests. Neither the United States Treasury, nor Carnegie Mellon University, provided funding for this work.

detail.abstract: To improve human wellbeing, we must understand what drives it. Data on life satisfaction has been collected internationally since 2005, but the most widely accepted statistical model of its drivers provides only vague and limited policy guidance. We improve on the current standard by aggregating nation-level data on an unprecedented number of potential drivers (n=5,533). We use common computational methods for variable selection to construct a simple but highly accurate model with low risk of omitted variables or human selection bias. We show this model has higher prediction accuracy than the current world standard published by the United Nations, and the variables it selects are more consistent with studies from political science, social psychology, and other fields. The algorithms select many well-studied variables the current standard does not, including clean water, education, LGBTQ+ acceptance, gender equity, and democratically accessible political power. The search process also selects few of the variables hypothesized by recent Nobel-awarded economics work. Finally, we show that our model is more consistent with theories of anti-authoritarian psychology than with "institutions" as a driver of national outcomes and discuss what this means for the current situation in the United States.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过整合5333个潜在驱动因素的国家级数据，构建了一个比联合国现有标准模型更准确的生活满意度预测模型。该模型选择了清洁用水、教育、LGBTQ+接纳度、性别平等和民主政治权力等关键变量，与政治学、社会心理学等领域的研究更一致，但与诺贝尔经济学奖得主的研究假设存在差异。

AI.method: 使用常见的计算变量选择方法，整合5333个潜在驱动因素的国家级数据，构建简单但高度准确的预测模型，降低遗漏变量和人为选择偏见的风险。

title: Deterministic Governance as Epistemic Commitment: Why Reproducibility Matters for AI Accountability
affiliations: FERZ LLC

detail.title: Deterministic Governance as Epistemic Commitment: Why Reproducibility Matters for AI Accountability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of FERZ LLC, which develops deterministic AI governance and auditability frameworks for regulated environments. The arguments in this paper reflect the author’s professional position that high-stakes automated systems must be auditable, reproducible, and subject to deterministic oversight. No other financial or personal interests are declared.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This work does not involve human subjects, patient data, or experiments requiring institutional review board (IRB) or ethics committee approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This work did not receive external funding. It was developed as part of FERZ LLC’s ongoing internal research into deterministic AI governance and auditability. All views expressed are solely those of the author.

detail.abstract:
As AI systems assume decision-making authority in regulated domains—finance, healthcare, government services—the question of accountability shifts from technical implementation to philosophical foundation. This paper argues that existing approaches to AI governance fail at the epistemological level: post-hoc monitoring cannot reconstruct historical decision contexts; unversioned guardrails drift semantically over time; and probabilistic explanations cannot answer the fundamental question "would the same decision be made again under identical conditions?"

Here, determinism means reproducibility of governed decisions, not rigidity of model behavior—a distinction that preserves innovation while making exercised authority answerable.

We propose that meaningful AI accountability requires reproducibility, not merely explainability. Drawing on concepts from epistemology, democratic theory, and science & technology studies, we argue that governance-layer determinism—the property that identical states produce identical verdicts—creates a fundamentally different accountability regime than inference-layer determinism or post-hoc auditing.

A key architectural innovation is tri-state decision-making (allow/deny/abstain), where abstention represents not system failure but controlled epistemic boundary—explicit transfer of authority to human judgment when deterministic verification cannot be achieved. This distinguishes deterministic governance from probabilistic confidence scoring and conventional "human-in-the-loop" approaches.

The paper introduces cohort-bound governance as an architectural response to this philosophical requirement, demonstrating how version-binding, evidence handles, and cryptographic replay enable bit-for-bit verification of historical decisions without compromising operational flexibility. This approach preserves human cognitive authority while enabling AI augmentation—a balance that existing probabilistic governance architectures cannot achieve.

Finally, we examine the regulatory and organizational implications of treating governance as an epistemic commitment rather than a technical control, showing why this philosophical shift matters for democratic accountability in an age of algorithmic authority.

Keywords: Epistemic Commitment • Deterministic Governance • Reproducibility • Democratic Accountability • AI Regulation • DAGS-CVCA

AI.tldr: 本文认为现有AI治理方法在认识论层面存在缺陷，提出有意义的AI问责需要可重现性而不仅仅是可解释性。通过引入确定性治理和三元决策机制，在保持创新性的同时确保决策权威的可问责性。

AI.findings: 确定性治理能够在不损害操作灵活性的情况下实现历史决策的可验证性，在保持人类认知权威的同时实现AI增强。

title: Security And Sustainable Development Goals: A Focus on Nigeria
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke and Caritas University

detail.title: Security And Sustainable Development Goals: A Focus on Nigeria
detail.abstract: Sustainable development and security are closely related. Security has a crucial role to play in realizing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Nigeria, given the high level of insecurity in the country. This paper, therefore, examined security and sustainable development goals with kin interest in Nigeria. Its research design is descriptive design adopted in order to bring to bear the current state of security challenges in the country. Secondary data sourced from text books, journals, newspapers, the internet and so on were used in this work. The paper identified the following security challenges in Nigeria to include the nefarious activities of Boko Haram, farmer-herder clashes, the Islamic Movement of Nigeria, Niger-Delta militancy, banditry, kidnapping; and the nature of politics, multi-ethnic nature of Nigeria and religious rivalries, corruption, unemployment, poverty etc.; and the lookworm attitude of the government, its security apparatus and the stakeholders to adequately address these challenges have adversely affect the actualization of the SDGs in the country. However, leadership development, good governance, socioeconomic development, elimination of corruption and entrenchment of social justice, radical change in values, intelligence gathering and surveillance, modernization of security agencies, pre-damage responses to national security, and coordinated preventive measure policy, remained the core panacea for addressing security challenges and the achievement of the SDGs in Nigeria and in West African sub-region by 2030.

title: The Burrito Optimization Game: An Educational Resource for Optimization in Operations Research, Business Analytics and Supply Chain Management
affiliations: Lehigh University - Department of Industrial and Systems Engineering, University of Southern California and

detail.title: The Burrito Optimization Game: An Educational Resource for Optimization in Operations Research, Business Analytics and Supply Chain Management
detail.abstract: The Burrito Optimization Game is a fun, free, and interactive online game that aims to introduce learners to the basic ideas behind mathematical optimization (MO) in the operations research (OR), business analytics (BA), and supply chain management (SCM) fields. In the game, players drag and drop burrito trucks onto a city map in order to serve customers and maximize the profit of the burrito company. The underlying problem is a classic type of MO problem called a facility location problem. We conducted an experiment to explore the effectiveness of the game as an aid for teaching MO in a classroom environment. Our results show that the game is effective in both building understanding of and confidence in MO, as well as reinforcing players' prior knowledge of the concepts under proper instructor-guided discussion.

title: Uniform Versus Quality-Specific Pricing for Trade-in Programs
affiliations: Chongqing University - School of Economics and Business Admininstration, Chongqing University - School of Economics and Business Admininstration, University of Wisconsin - Milwaukee - Sheldon B. Lubar School of Business, University of Surrey and Chongqing University - School of Economics and Business Admininstration

detail.title: Uniform Versus Quality-Specific Pricing for Trade-in Programs
detail.abstract: Trade-in programs are widely adopted across industries, typically implemented through one of two pricing strategies: uniform pricing, which offers the same discount to all returning consumers, and quality-specific pricing, which varies the discount based on the condition of the returned product. While the prevailing view suggests that quality-specific pricing is optimal only for highly durable goods, the growing diversity of trade-in programs, particularly in emerging markets, highlights practical developments that go beyond this conventional wisdom. To examine this phenomenon, we develop a stylized model that isolates the retailer's trade-in pricing decision. Building on the relevant literature, our model captures the fundamental heterogeneity in how consumers value new versus old products. For new products, this heterogeneity stems from variations in consumers' willingness to pay, whereas for old products, it is primarily driven by differences in the actual quality of the items themselves. We further incorporate the quality improvement embedded in new products, and reveals that the retailer's optimal pricing strategy may exhibit a non-monotonic pattern with respect to this key factor. Specifically, uniform pricing is optimal when the degree of quality improvement is either sufficiently low or sufficiently high. We demonstrate the robustness of this result through extensions that account for supply-side and demand-side variations. These findings not only provide a more plausible rationale for seemingly counterintuitive pricing strategies observed in practice, but also offer actionable implications for the optimal design of trade-in programs in an evolving marketplace.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，以旧换新项目的最优定价策略与产品质量改进程度呈非单调关系：当质量改进程度足够低或足够高时，统一定价最优；而在中等质量改进程度时，质量特定定价最优。

title: INTRODUCTION TO CULTURAL METASYNERGY
affiliations: EDUKIVOTOS

detail.title: INTRODUCTION TO CULTURAL METASYNERGY
detail.abstract:
The Theory of Cultural Metasynergy is a philosophical, aesthetic, and epistemological proposal that reinterprets the interaction between humanity, technology, and spirituality in the age of the metaverse. Drawing from an integrative reading of symbolic economy, simulated reality, and the cognitive expansion of the subject, this framework articulates six interdependent environments: Natuverso, Cosmoverso, Sacroverso, Socioverso, Polisverso, and Ultrafantasea. Each represents a vital sphere of contemporary cultural fabric, where consciousness becomes collaborative energy, technology turns into a vehicle of meaning, and economy evolves into a system of symbolic reciprocity.

The model is grounded in the convergence of simulation theory (Bostrom, 2003), extended mind theory (Clark & Chalmers, 1998), cyberculture (Lévy, 1999), virtual economy (Castronova, 2005; Rifkin, 2014), and posthumanism (Ferrando, 2019; Haraway, 1991; Hayles, 1999). From this perspective, the human being is redefined as a hybrid entity co-evolving with artificial intelligence and digital ecosystems, generating new forms of knowledge, spirituality, and social organization.

The Natuverso represents the ecological root of culture; the Cosmoverso, the ontological expansion of consciousness in digital environments; the Sacroverso, the ethical and spiritual dimension of technology; the Socioverso, the networked bonds of cooperation; the Polisverso, the reflection on governance and digital sovereignty; and the Ultrafantasea, the aesthetic realm of imagination where art, myth, and artificial intelligence merge into a single creative language.

This theory conceives cultural metasynergy not merely as an intellectual construct but as a civilizational project linking knowledge, art, and economy around sustainability, diversity, and balance between the human and posthuman condition. Written from the perspective of an author with a background in economics, finance, and territorial, conflict, and cultural studies, it envisions technology as an ethical dimension of development rather than a mere tool of production or control.

Ultimately, this framework invites us to understand the metaverse as a new sphere of humanization, where natural and digital worlds may converge under a shared logic of harmony and cooperation. Cultural Metasynergy thus becomes a symbolic architecture of the future, a theory of balance that celebrates the diversity of possible worlds and reclaims the creative mind as the true engine of civilizational transformation.

Keywords: Cultural metasynergy, metaverse, cyberculture, posthumanism, symbolic economy.

title: Discrete Screening
affiliations: UW Bothell School of Business and University of California, Davis - Department of Economics

detail.title: Discrete Screening

declarations.funderStatement: ARO Contract W911NF2210282

keywords: level-k reasoning. JEL Classification Numbers: D82

detail.abstract: We consider a principal who wishes to screen an agent with discrete types by offering a menu of discrete quantities and discrete transfers. We assume that the principal's valuation is discrete strictly concave and use a discrete first-order approach. We model the agent's cost types as non-integer, with integer types as a limit case. Our modeling of cost types allows us to replicate the typical constraint-simplification results and thus to emulate the well-treaded steps of screening under a continuum of contracts. We show that the solutions to the discrete F.O.C.s need not be unique even under discrete strict concavity, but we also show that there cannot be more than two optimal contract quantities for each type, and that-if there are two-they must be adjacent. Moreover, we can only ensure weak monotonicity of the quantities even if virtual costs are strictly monotone, unless we limit the "degree of concavity" of the principal's utility. Our discrete screening approach facilitates the use of rationalizability to solve the screening problem. We introduce a rationalizability notion featuring robustness with respect to an open set of beliefs over types called ∆-O Rationalizability, and show that the set of ∆-O rationalizable menus coincides with the set of usual optimal contracts-possibly augmented to include irrelevant contracts.

detail.title: Poverty Reduction and Sustainable Development Goals in Rural Areas in Nigeria: A Study of Selected Local Government Areas in Enugu State, Nigeria
detail.abstract: This study examined poverty reduction and SDGs in rural areas in Nigeria with reference to selected local government areas in Enugu State. The study adopted the descriptive survey research design and made use of both primary and secondary sources of data. The population of the study was 722,664 people of the three local government areas selected to represent Enugu State, while the sample size was 400 derived via Taro Yamani formula size determination. The cluster sampling technique was applied to select the sample from the population of the study, while the data collected were presented and analyzed using frequency percentage and chi-square (X 2) analysis. The study revealed a number of factors contributing to increasing rate of poverty in the rural areas in Nigeria-corruption, debt burden, unemployment, overdependence on oil, lack of political will, ethno-religious conflicts among others. The study also revealed the challenges of implementing SDGs to reduce poverty in rural areas in Nigeria-endemic corruption, lack of effective policies, lack of accountability, insecurity, poor infrastructure among others. The study discovered the SDGs based rural poverty reduction strategic framework in place for rural areas in Nigeria to include job creation, adequate budgetary allocation, integrated rural development program, provision of basic needs, creation of awareness, adoption of the basic needs strategy, full integration of the rural poor, targeting among others. Finally, the study also revealed bottom-up approach, capacity acquisition, provision of infrastructure, inter-agency cooperation, objective targeting among others as measures to efficient implementation of SDGs in rural poverty reduction in Nigeria. Based on these findings, the researchers recommended that the Nigerian government should address the issues of poverty reduction programs via effective implementation of poverty reduction related program/policies among others.

title: An Asset Allocation Model with Private and Public Assets
affiliations: and AssetMark

detail.title: An Asset Allocation Model with Private and Public Assets
detail.abstract: We construct an asset allocation model with both private and public assets employing a surplus utility model. The model is stable and has sensible asset allocation trade-offs along the frontier. We accomplish this stability through a few key features. First, we incorporate two known optimal portfolios, both specified by the investor or based on market consensus.  This provides two fixed points.  One for tracking error relative to a reference and the other for implied returns.  Second, we decompose the investor utility function into several risk-return pairs. This gives us a better ability to characterize the investor’s preferences and allows us to dial in investor preferences in a sensible manner.  As a result, the model allows us to directly size the investor’s risk allocations through their risk aversion rather than applying hard constraints.  Both sets of features lead to stable optimizations with smooth transitions along the frontier.  Another consequence is that the model leads to an ability to characterize the investor’s aversion into different types of investments and gives us intuition on the trade-offs.

declarations.funderStatement: It's all done by the same author, Soufie El Jallad

detail.abstract: This doctoral research proposal aims to examine the effect of transformational leadership on teacher retention in private schools, particularly within the context of ongoing economic crisis. The study seeks to explore whether transformational leadership practices, such as individualized support, motivation, and vision can positively influence teachers’ willingness to remain in their roles despite financial and professional instability. A mixed methods approach will be employed, combining quantitative survey data with qualitative insights from semi-structured interviews. The research will investigate how leadership style interacts with teacher satisfaction, loyalty, and intention to leave during periods of institutional and economic stress. By integrating both numerical and experiential data, the study aims to provide a deeper understanding of how effective leadership can mitigate attrition during crisis conditions. The anticipated findings may inform leadership development and teacher retention strategies in private education settings.

title: Inventory Competition Under Algorithmic Demand Allocation
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Inventory Competition Under Algorithmic Demand Allocation
detail.abstract: We explore how platform allocation rules can influence seller competitive behavior in an online marketplace. Specifically, by focusing on multiple newsvendor-type sellers competing to offer identical products on a platform, we investigate the effects of different demand allocation rules on sellers' inventory levels and the platform's payoff. Somewhat surprisingly, we show that all inventory-agnostic priority rules exactly mirror sole sourcing from the most efficient seller with the largest critical fractile. In contrast, incorporating randomness into demand allocation intensifies competition among sellers and increases the platform's payoff. Moreover, inventory-aware random allocation rules further incentivize competitive behavior among sellers. We make two extensions. First, we examine how different platform allocation rules affect sellers, highlighting trade-offs among the platform's payoff, customer fill rate, and seller profit disparities, which provides a fairness perspective on the design of allocation mechanisms. Second, we investigate a scenario in which sellers must learn the allocation rules through reinforcement learning algorithms, potentially leading to algorithmic collusion. We propose mitigation strategies and demonstrate how the studied allocation rules can be adapted to sustain a competitive marketplace in a dynamic environment.

title: 40 Years of The Psychology of Waiting: A Celebration and Update of Maister's Eight Propositions
affiliations: University of Cincinnati - Department of Operations, University of Cincinnati, University of Cincinnati, University of Victoria, Utah State University - Huntsman School of Business and Rutgers University

detail.title: 40 Years of The Psychology of Waiting: A Celebration and Update of Maister's Eight Propositions
detail.abstract: We engage in a comprehensive, 40-year retrospective analysis of David Maister's seminal 1985 work "The Psychology of Waiting Lines" and its enduring influence on service research and practice. Through systematic assessment of nearly 1,500 citations and detailed examination of 201 peer-reviewed journal articles, we evaluate how Maister's eight propositions have been operationalized, tested, and extended across disciplines including operations management, marketing, healthcare, and hospitality. While empirical support varies across propositions, our review reveals that Maister's overall framework remains deeply embedded in contemporary scholarship. Our synthesis of this literature then advances four key contributions to the psychology of waiting scholarship. First, we propose shifting focus from perceived waiting time to the "tolerability" of waits, as interventions typically improve acceptance rather than time perceptions. Second, we emphasize the centrality of perceived progress in shaping wait experiences. Third, we present a causal chain linking uncertainty, loss of control, and anxiety to help explain customer responses. Fourth, we integrate these insights into a service value framework where willingness to wait depends on the ratio of benefits to costs for both the service and the waiting experience itself. The analysis also examines how emerging technologies, from smartphones enabling customer-directed distraction to generative AI's ability to redefine or eliminate waits, are reshaping the psychology of waiting. This literature, these insights, and ongoing technological developments all serve to validate Maister's original insights while creating new opportunities for research and practice in increasingly complex service environments.

AI.tldr: 对David Maister 1985年经典著作《排队心理学》进行40年回顾性分析，评估其8个命题在服务研究中的操作化、验证和扩展情况。研究发现Maister框架仍深刻影响当代研究，并提出了等待容忍度、感知进展、不确定性-控制-焦虑因果链、服务价值框架等四个新贡献，同时探讨了新兴技术对等待心理的重塑作用。
AI.research_question: David Maister的《排队心理学》及其八个命题在过去40年中如何被操作化、验证和扩展？这些命题在当代服务研究中的持续影响力如何？
AI.motivation: 对Maister经典著作进行系统性回顾，评估其理论框架的持久影响力，并基于40年的研究进展提出新的理论贡献，以指导现代服务环境中的等待管理实践。
AI.theoretical_framework: David Maister的排队心理学框架（八个核心命题）、感知等待时间理论、服务价值理论、不确定性-控制-焦虑因果链理论。
AI.method: 40年回顾性分析，系统评估近1,500次引用，详细分析201篇同行评审期刊文章。
AI.findings: Maister的八个命题获得了不同程度的实证支持，但其整体框架仍深刻嵌入当代学术研究；新兴技术正在重塑等待心理学；提出了四个新的理论贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 从感知等待时间转向等待容忍度概念；2. 强调感知进展在等待体验中的核心作用；3. 提出不确定性-控制-焦虑因果链；4. 将等待整合到服务价值框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务提供商提供基于容忍度而非时间感知的等待管理策略；强调通过增强感知进展和减少不确定性来改善客户体验；指导企业在新技术环境下优化等待管理。

title: Optimizing Dynamic Assemble-to-Order Inventory Systems Using Cost-Sensitive Machine Learning
affiliations: KU Leuven - Faculty of Economics and Business, VIVES University of Applied Sciences and KU Leuven - Faculty of Business and Economics (FEB)

detail.title: Optimizing Dynamic Assemble-to-Order Inventory Systems Using Cost-Sensitive Machine Learning

declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by Research Foundation Flanders (FWO) under grant number 1107926N.

detail.abstract: An assemble-to-order inventory strategy allows companies to improve customer service and reduce inventory by pooling component inventories of different end products. Existing methods to optimize component inventories assume demand follows some known stationary distribution. Such an assumption, however, rarely holds in practice and when violated can lead to decreased customer service and excess inventory that the strategy sought to avoid in the first place. To address this weakness, we propose a heuristic predict-and-optimize machine learning method that integrates demand forecasting and inventory control for replenishment decisions in assemble-to-order systems. Our method combines problem-specific techniques such as newsvendor decomposition and a steepest descent algorithm with cost-sensitive learning techniques to enable efficient optimization under non-stationary demand. Moreover, our method does not require any distributional assumptions, can directly leverage covariate data, and is scalable to assemble-to-order systems with dozens of components and products. We evaluate our method through a case study of the Belgian IKEA restaurants, and show that our method outperforms existing heuristics by significant margins under different target service levels.

title: Theory-Based Decisions: Foundations and Introduction
affiliations: , Bocconi University - Department of Management and Technology and University of Utah

detail.title: Theory-Based Decisions: Foundations and Introduction
detail.abstract: Theories are foundational for decision making. We point to a normative agenda that emphasizes the need for decision makers-including managers, firms, entrepreneurs, and startups-to develop their own theories. Our argument is that decision makers should be like scientists and use the scientific method-theories, causal reasoning, and experimentation-to problem solve and generate new data and value. In this paper and special issue introduction, we discuss the foundations of the theory-based view (TBV), particularly as it relates to forwardlooking reasoning and decision making under uncertainty. Rather than handing prescriptive theories to others, the goal of the TBV is to provide the scaffolding for economic actors themselves to develop their own, idiosyncratic theories. Theories are built on heterogeneous beliefs and causal reasoning that enable the generation of unique paths to value. We discuss the implications of this argument for key theories within strategy and economics, along with highlighting research opportunities at the nexus of the TBV and topics such as learning, entrepreneurship, finance, ownership and leadership. We also introduce the special issue papers and discuss their contributions to the TBV.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了理论基础观(TBV)，强调决策者应该像科学家一样开发自己的理论，运用科学方法进行问题解决和价值创造，而不是依赖现成的规范性理论。

AI.motivation: 理论对决策至关重要，但传统的规范性理论限制了决策者的创造性和独特性，需要一种新的视角来赋能决策者自主开发理论。

AI.findings: TBV为经济参与者提供了自主开发个性化理论的框架，基于异质性信念和因果推理创造独特的价值路径
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了理论基础观(TBV)，挑战了传统规范性理论的局限性，强调决策者自主理论开发的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者、企业家、初创企业等决策者提供了实用的方法论框架，帮助他们在不确定性环境下进行更有效的决策和价值创造

title: Two cross-species drivers of fertility
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Two cross-species drivers of fertility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research was conducted independently with no personal, financial, or institutional relationships that could be perceived to influence the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involves no human participants, animals, or identifiable personal data; it is a theoretical/synthesis paper using publicly available information. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this work. The study was self-initiated and self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: Why is fertility declining worldwide? Economic stress and gender shifts are often blamed, but they cannot explain why some war-affected societies maintain high birth rates while peaceful, wealthy nations collapse below replacement levels. Here we show that reproductive timing across life-from plants to humans-follows a shared rule: organisms reproduce earlier under survival threat, but delay or forgo reproduction when competition becomes overwhelming. Crucially, these decisions are not made in adulthood, but shaped during adolescence by the perceived safety and fairness of the world. In South Korea, intense societal competition signals "do not reproduce"; in Israel, persistent security threats promote earlier childbearing. Current policies fail because they intervene too late-like fertilizing pumpkins in autumn and expecting flowers. The solution is not to incentivize birth, but to ensure that every young person grows up believing the future is safe, stable, and worth reproducing into.

AI.tldr: 全球生育率下降的根本原因不是经济压力或性别转变，而是青少年时期感知到的世界安全性和公平性。当生存受威胁时，生物会提早繁殖；当竞争过度时，则会延迟或放弃繁殖。政策干预过晚无效，关键在于确保年轻人成长过程中相信未来是安全、稳定且值得繁衍的。
AI.research_question: 为什么全球生育率在下降？为什么战争影响的社会保持高生育率，而和平富裕国家却跌破替代水平？
AI.motivation: 经济压力和性别转变等传统解释无法解释生育率下降的全球现象，特别是无法解释战争社会与和平富裕国家之间的生育率差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生殖时机理论：从植物到人类，生物在生存威胁下会提早繁殖，但在竞争过度时会延迟或放弃繁殖；这些决定在青少年时期由感知到的世界安全性和公平性塑造。
AI.method: 比较分析不同社会背景下的生育模式，特别是南韩（高强度社会竞争）和以色列（持续安全威胁）的案例研究。
AI.findings: 南韩的激烈社会竞争发出"不要繁殖"的信号；以色列的持续安全威胁促进早育；当前政策干预过晚，如同在秋天给南瓜施肥却期待开花。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于青少年时期感知环境安全性的生殖时机理论，解释了全球生育率下降的根本机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：不应激励生育，而应确保每个年轻人在成长过程中相信未来是安全、稳定且值得繁衍的。

title: Improving the Performance of Manufacturing Supply Chains in Industry 5.0: An Analysis Using Fuzzy-topsis Approach
affiliations: University of Southampton - Southampton Business School, University of Southampton, Teesside University, University of Southampton and University of Surrey

detail.title: Improving the Performance of Manufacturing Supply Chains in Industry 5.0: An Analysis Using Fuzzy-topsis Approach
detail.abstract: As the latest industrial revolution, Industry 5.0 has the potential to profoundly reshape the design and management of supply chains in multiple ways, such as to make the supply chain more human-focus, sustainable, and flexible. This offers opportunities for organisations to promote their business competitiveness. While the adoption of Industry 5.0 is gaining momentum in the manufacturing sector, there exists a risk of failure and being locked into ineffective strategies during the transition. Despite this pressing need, research on Industry 5.0 remains in early stage. Particularly, there is a lack of adequate discussion on how to evaluate manufacturing supply chain performance in the context of Industry 5.0. This paper aims to enhance supply chain performance by identifying a comprehensive list of performance indicators and prioritising potential solutions and alternatives based on their levels of significance. A multistep research methodology was adopted in this study, including (1) using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) method to identify a comprehensive list of key performance indicators and alternative solutions to improve manufacturing supply chain performance in Industry 5.0; (2) collecting survey data from three industry professionals to quantify the level of significance of the identified alternatives; and (3) applying the fuzzy Technique for Order of Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS) to prioritise the identified alternatives. The study identified a total of 28 indicators and four potential alternatives for improving manufacturing supply chain performance in Industry 5.0. The findings reveal that the implementation of a real-time operational framework, the promotion of transparency and information sharing among supply chain partners, and the leveraging of advanced technologies are the most significant alternatives in this regard. This paper contributes to the existing body of knowledge by providing a foundational foothold for researchers and industry practitioners to make informed strategic decisions pertaining evaluation of and improvement in supply chain performance, further enhancing companies’ competitiveness, profitability, and sustainability in the era of Industry 5.0.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统文献回顾和模糊TOPSIS方法，识别了28个工业5.0环境下制造供应链性能指标和4个改进方案，发现实时运营框架、供应链伙伴间透明度和信息共享、先进技术应用是最重要的改进方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在工业5.0背景下评估和改进制造供应链性能？
AI.motivation: 工业5.0作为最新工业革命，能够重塑供应链设计和管理，使其更人性化、可持续和灵活，但相关研究仍处于早期阶段，缺乏对制造供应链性能评估的充分讨论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工业5.0理论、供应链性能评估理论
AI.method: 采用多步骤研究方法：(1)使用PRISMA方法识别关键性能指标和改进方案；(2)收集三位行业专家的调查数据；(3)应用模糊TOPSIS方法对改进方案进行优先级排序
AI.findings: 识别了28个性能指标和4个改进方案，其中实施实时运营框架、促进供应链伙伴间透明度和信息共享、利用先进技术是最重要的改进方案
AI.theory_contributions: 为工业5.0环境下供应链性能评估提供了理论基础和方法框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和行业从业者提供了评估和改进供应链性能的决策依据，有助于提升企业在工业5.0时代的竞争力、盈利能力和可持续性

title: Carbon Taxation and Firm Behavior in Emerging Economies: Evidence from South Africa
affiliations: Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), Federal University of Bahia (UFBA), National University Singapore, University of Münster and Carnegie Mellon University

detail.title: Carbon Taxation and Firm Behavior in Emerging Economies: Evidence from South Africa

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper provides the first comprehensive evidence on how firms in emerging economies respond to carbon taxation. Using detailed administrative data, we study the announcement and implementation of South Africa’s 2019 carbon tax—a potential trailblazer for other developing countries with limited state capacity amid the global expansion of carbon pricing. Contrary to concerns that carbon taxes might hinder growth or employment, we find no negative effects on firm performance or jobs. Firms facing higher effective tax rates increased activity following the tax’s announcement, four years before implementation, likely reflecting the resolution of regulatory uncertainty and efforts to mitigate stranded asset costs. While we find no measurable reduction in emissions— likely due to this anticipatory behavior—our results suggest that carbon taxation can be implemented without harming economic outcomes, even in the short term and in low- and middle-income settings.

AI.tldr: 本文首次全面研究新兴经济体企业对碳税的反应。基于南非2019年碳税的详细行政数据，研究发现碳税并未对企业绩效或就业产生负面影响，反而促使面临更高有效税率的企业在政策宣布后增加活动。虽然未观测到可衡量的排放减少，但结果表明碳税可在不损害经济成果的情况下实施。
AI.research_question: 新兴经济体企业如何应对碳税政策？碳税是否会对企业绩效和就业产生负面影响？
AI.motivation: 碳定价在全球范围内扩展，但发展中国家因国家能力有限，实施碳税面临挑战。南非2019年碳税可能成为其他发展中国家的先行者，需要实证证据评估其经济影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳税政策效应理论、监管不确定性理论、搁浅资产成本理论
AI.method: 使用详细的行政数据，研究南非2019年碳税的宣布和实施效应，采用实证分析方法
AI.findings: 1) 碳税未对企业绩效或就业产生负面影响；2) 面临更高有效税率的企业在政策宣布后增加活动；3) 未观测到可衡量的排放减少；4) 碳税可在不损害经济成果的情况下实施
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为新兴经济体碳税政策提供全面实证证据，挑战了碳税会阻碍经济增长的传统观点，揭示了企业应对监管不确定性的行为模式
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家实施碳税政策提供信心，证明碳税可在不损害经济成果的情况下实施，为政策制定者提供重要参考

title: Written Feedback in Response to 'Public Consultation on Guide for Using Generative Artificial Intelligence in the Legal Sector'
affiliations: University of Leeds School of Law, United Nations Joint Staff Pension Fund - Office of Investment Management

detail.title: Written Feedback in Response to 'Public Consultation on Guide for Using Generative Artificial Intelligence in the Legal Sector'
detail.abstract:
Legal service providers should be encouraged to have company-level energy strategies, such as investing in energy-efficient hardware, software, and promoting internal practices that work towards sustainable energy consumption. This is important because, following human resources, a sustainable and competitive energy policy is the second most important building block of competitiveness in this area. Energy is a limited resource using resources (such as water) fundamentally necessary for human life. Further, energy efficiency means more cost-efficient legal services and therefore an overall positive impact on the entire economy.

The future of LegalTech and AI-driven legal services depends on affordable, secure, and sustainable energy. As Sam Altman told the U.S. Senate in May 2025, “I can’t think of anything more important than energy”, and I fully share this view.  With AI, data centres, and cloud computing set to double global energy demand by 2030, energy is not simply a compliance matter but a strategic priority.  Energy efficiency needs to be embedded, in particular, into the highly digitalised sectors, such as the legal sector and the financial sector. This will make the legal sector and the LegalTech ecosystem more competitive. By making energy efficiency a Key Principle in the Guide for Using Generative Artificial Intelligence in the Legal Sector ('Guide'), legal service providers will be encouraged to demonstrate leadership in ESG, CSR, align with client expectations, and strengthen both their competitiveness and long-term sustainability. Currently, the above important aspects are not captured in the Guide, hence my present feedback (submitted on 9 Sept. 2025).

AI.tldr: 该论文主张将能源效率作为法律科技和AI驱动法律服务的关键原则，强调能源政策是法律服务业竞争力的重要基石，建议在法律服务提供商中推广公司级能源战略。
AI.research_question: 如何将能源效率原则纳入法律科技和AI驱动法律服务的指导框架中，以提升法律服务业竞争力和可持续性？
AI.motivation: 随着AI、数据中心和云计算到2030年将使全球能源需求翻倍，能源已不仅是合规问题，而是战略优先事项。法律服务业作为高度数字化部门，需要将能源效率嵌入其运营中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于ESG（环境、社会和治理）、CSR（企业社会责任）理论框架，结合能源效率与竞争力关系理论。
AI.method: 政策分析和建议，通过将能源效率原则纳入《在法务部门使用生成式人工智能指南》来实现。
AI.findings: 当前指南未涵盖能源效率等重要方面，需要将其作为关键原则加入，以鼓励法律服务提供商在ESG和CSR方面展现领导力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将能源效率理论扩展到法律科技领域，建立了能源效率与法律服务竞争力之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律服务提供商提供具体的能源战略实施指导，帮助其降低成本、提升竞争力，并促进整个经济的积极影响。

title: China-Russia-Iran Joint Naval Exercise in the Gulf of Oman: What Is Its Impact?
affiliations: Department of International Relations, University of Dhaka

detail.title: China-Russia-Iran Joint Naval Exercise in the Gulf of Oman: What Is Its Impact?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author(s) declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research adhered all ethical approvals.
declarations.funderStatement: The research received no specific funding.

detail.abstract: In the dynamic landscape of global politics, the recent joint naval exercise in the Gulf of Oman in mid-March 2024 involving China, Russia, and Iran has sparked intense discussions and raised critical questions about the geopolitical implications of this strategic convergence. Dubbed the “Maritime Security Belt 2024,” this exercise not only showcased the military prowess of these nations but also signaled a potential shift in regional power dynamics and global alliances. The trilateral naval drills, however, come at a time of heightened tensions in the Middle East region. The protracted conflict between Israel and Hamas in Gaza has raged for six months, threatening to escalate into a wider regional conflagration. Meanwhile, the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have intensified their attacks on international shipping in the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, posing a notable threat to maritime trade and prompting the formation of a U.S.-led naval coalition to protect commercial vessels. Against this volatile backdrop, the joint exercise involving the naval forces of China, Russia, and Iran in the strategically vital Gulf of Oman has raised eyebrows and sparked concerns among Western powers. The convergence of these three nations, each with its own regional ambitions and global aspirations, has the potential to reshape the geopolitical landscape and challenge the existing world order. China, the rising economic and military powerhouse, has long sought to expand its influence in the Middle East and secure vital maritime trade routes that are critical to its continued economic growth. Russia, embroiled in its ongoing conflict with Ukraine and facing isolation from the West, has increasingly turned its attention to the Middle East as a means of diversifying its alliances and asserting its global influence. Iran, on the other hand, has long been a contentious actor in the Middle East, with its nuclear program and support for proxy groups like Hamas and the Houthis drawing international scrutiny and sanctions. By aligning with global powers like China and Russia, Tehran aims to break out of its diplomatic isolation, mitigate the effects of sanctions, and assert its regional dominance . According to Iranian Admiral Mostafa Tajaddini, the three countries’ drill, which is their fourth since 2019, was also intended to enhance trade, battle “piracy and terrorism,” promote humanitarian activities, and exchange knowledge in the field of rescue. However, as these three powers converge in the Gulf of Oman, a critical waterway for global maritime trade and energy supplies, the exercise takes on broader geopolitical significance. It raises questions about the strategic motivations of the participants, the potential impact on regional stability and maritime security, and the implications for the realignment of global alliances and power dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2024年3月中国、俄罗斯和伊朗在阿曼湾举行的"海上安全带2024"联合海军演习的地缘政治意义，探讨了这一战略趋同对区域权力动态和全球联盟体系的潜在影响。
AI.research_question: 中国、俄罗斯和伊朗在阿曼湾的联合海军演习如何影响区域地缘政治格局和全球联盟体系？
AI.motivation: 这一三方联合演习发生在中东地区紧张局势加剧的背景下，包括持续六个月的以哈冲突和胡塞武装对红海航运的袭击，引发了西方国家对地缘政治格局变化的担忧。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地缘政治理论、联盟理论和权力转移理论，分析三国战略趋同对现有世界秩序的挑战。
AI.method: 通过分析演习背景、参与国战略动机和区域安全环境，进行定性案例研究。
AI.findings: 联合演习反映了三国各自的地缘政治诉求：中国寻求确保关键海上贸易路线，俄罗斯试图突破西方孤立，伊朗旨在缓解制裁压力。这一趋同可能重塑中东地区权力平衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解新兴大国与传统大国在关键地区的战略互动提供了理论框架，深化了对多极世界秩序形成过程的认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于中东地区安全动态的新视角，有助于评估全球联盟体系演变对国际航运安全和能源供应的影响。

title: Inflation and Political Business Cycles in Nigeria (1981-2024): Evidence from an ARDL Framework

detail.title: Inflation and Political Business Cycles in Nigeria (1981-2024): Evidence from an ARDL Framework
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the dynamics of inflation in Nigeria and the role of political business cycles between 1981 and 2024. Using annual data and applying the Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) framework, the study evaluates both short-and long-run relationships between inflation, fiscal expansions, and crude oil price fluctuations, while incorporating pre-election dummy variables to capture electoral cycles. The results indicate that pre-election years are typically associated with increased government expenditure, which triggers inflationary pressures, while post-election periods tend to show relative stabilization as fiscal adjustments are implemented. Evidence further suggests that monetary policy responses have been inadequate in countering politically induced inflationary surges. These findings underscore the persistent influence of political cycles on Nigeria's macroeconomic stability. The study highlights the need for a dual-cycle policy strategy: one that limits pre-election fiscal and monetary manipulation, and another that mitigates the inevitable post-election adjustments. The paper concludes by recommending institutional reforms to strengthen fiscal discipline, enhance the autonomy of monetary authorities, and increase transparency in electoral financing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1981-2024年尼日利亚通胀动态与政治商业周期的关系，发现选举前政府支出增加导致通胀压力，选举后相对稳定，货币政策应对不足，建议双周期政策策略和制度改革。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚的通胀动态与政治商业周期之间存在怎样的关系？选举周期如何影响通胀、财政扩张和原油价格波动？
AI.motivation: 理解政治选举周期对尼日利亚宏观经济稳定的持续影响，特别是对通胀动态的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治商业周期理论，通胀动态理论，ARDL框架分析短期和长期关系
AI.method: 使用1981-2024年年度数据，应用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）框架，纳入选举前虚拟变量捕捉选举周期
AI.findings: 选举前年份通常与政府支出增加相关，引发通胀压力；选举后时期相对稳定；货币政策应对政治引发的通胀激增不足
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了政治商业周期理论在发展中国家特别是尼日利亚的应用，深化了对选举周期与通胀动态关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 提出双周期政策策略：限制选举前财政和货币操纵，缓解选举后调整；建议制度改革加强财政纪律、增强货币当局自主性和选举融资透明度

title: Decline in Job Satisfaction and How It Relates to Investment Decisions of the Self-Employed
affiliations: University of Trier - Faculty of Management, University of Trier, Europa-Universitaet Viadrina - Fakultat fur Wirtschaftswissenschaften and German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin)

detail.title: Decline in Job Satisfaction and How It Relates to Investment Decisions of the Self-Employed

publicationDetails.journalName: IZA Institute of Labor Economics Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Despite substantial research on job satisfaction in self-employment, we know little about the consequences for the venture when job satisfaction declines after an external shock. Taking the pandemic as an example of an external shock and drawing on 7,000 self-employed in Germany, we investigate how declines in job satisfaction are related to their investment decisions. Having separated job satisfaction into its financial and non-financial aspects, we build in our analysis on two perspectives to predict how reductions in financial and non-financial job satisfaction relate to investments in venture development. Our results show that decreasing financial job satisfaction is positively related to time investments, providing support for the performance feedback perspective. Negative performance, in terms of reduced financial job satisfaction, induces higher search efforts to improve the business situation. Moreover, we observe that reductions in non-financial job satisfaction are negatively associated with both time and monetary investments. This supports the broadening-and-build perspective in that negative experiences narrow the thought-action repertoire, thus hindering resource deployment.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于德国7000名自雇者的调查数据，探讨疫情冲击下工作满意度下降对创业投资决策的影响。研究发现：财务工作满意度下降会促进时间投资（支持绩效反馈视角），而非财务工作满意度下降则会抑制时间和金钱投资（支持拓展-建构理论）。
AI.research_question: 外部冲击导致的工作满意度下降如何影响自雇者的投资决策？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有大量关于自雇者工作满意度的研究，但对外部冲击导致工作满意度下降对创业投资决策的影响知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 绩效反馈视角和拓展-建构理论
AI.method: 基于德国7000名自雇者的调查数据，将工作满意度分为财务和非财务两个维度进行分析
AI.findings: 财务工作满意度下降与时间投资正相关；非财务工作满意度下降与时间和金钱投资负相关
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了绩效反馈视角和拓展-建构理论，深化了对工作满意度不同维度影响投资决策机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为自雇者在外部冲击下的投资决策提供理论指导，帮助理解不同类型工作满意度变化对创业行为的影响

title: Leadership in Islam: How Personality, Audience, and the Power of Words Shape Influence
affiliations: University of Ghardaia

detail.title: Leadership in Islam: How Personality, Audience, and the Power of Words Shape Influence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest related to this study.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no financial support or grants from universities, government agencies, funding organizations, or other entities.

keywords: Word Influence. The Power of Speech

detail.abstract: This study investigates the central role of speech and words in shaping leadership within Islamic religious institutions. It explores how Imams, as leaders, employ the power of speech and the influence of words to guide, inspire, and communicate with congregants. By focusing on contextual factors such as language comprehension, visual cues, education level, and the timing of interactions, the study highlights how these elements shape the effectiveness of spoken messages and their interpretation. In doing so, it emphasizes the Imam's role not only as a religious authority but also as a communicator whose leadership is deeply rooted in the ability to use words persuasively, meaningfully, and motivationally.A survey conducted with one hundred eighteen participants who attended the discourses of Imams gathered insights into their experiences and perceptions of communication during these interactions within the mosque. The study found that visual engagement with the Imam enhances comprehension, attention to discourse fosters behavioral change, and good comprehension is linked with emotional engagement. Discourse is a key tool in religious leadership, fostering engagement, understanding, and behavioral transformation, with most congregants preparing for and attentively engaging during the Imam's guidance. The findings demonstrate that leadership in Islamic institutions is marked by a balance of spiritual authority, interpersonal engagement, and adaptive communication strategies that strengthen the connection between the Imam and the congregants.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了演讲和语言在伊斯兰宗教机构领导力中的核心作用，重点关注伊玛目如何运用语言力量引导、激励信徒，以及语境因素如何影响沟通效果。
AI.research_question: 演讲和语言在伊斯兰宗教机构领导力中扮演什么角色？伊玛目如何运用语言力量来引导和激励信徒？
AI.motivation: 理解伊斯兰宗教领导力中语言沟通的重要性，以及语境因素如何影响伊玛目与信徒之间的有效沟通。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力沟通理论、宗教领导力理论、语言说服理论
AI.method: 对118名参加伊玛目讲道的参与者进行问卷调查，收集他们对讲道期间沟通体验和感知的见解
AI.findings: 视觉参与增强理解力，关注讲道促进行为改变，良好理解与情感参与相关；讲道是宗教领导力的关键工具，促进参与、理解和行为转变；大多数信徒会准备并专注参与伊玛目的指导

title: We Built It Anyway: Autoethnographic Reflections on Innovation, Risk, and Institutional Apathy
affiliations: Bandung Institute of Technology - School of Business and Management

detail.title: We Built It Anyway: Autoethnographic Reflections on Innovation, Risk, and Institutional Apathy
detail.abstract: The aim of this article is to examine what occurs when a practitioner-academic launches an innovation and entrepreneurship program within a Southeast Asian university that neither requested nor rewarded such work. Despite widespread promotion of entrepreneurial education, this study shows that institutional transformation depends not on imported models but on cultural fit. The importance of this inquiry lies in exposing how postcolonial institutional culturesrooted in hierarchy, compliance, and certification-undermine pedagogies built on autonomy, experimentation, and risk. Although policy discourse frames innovation as universally desirable, its deployment into unreceptive environments produces contradiction rather than change. The urgency of this intervention arises from intensifying regional pressure on universities to "entrepreneurialize" without confronting the logics that structure rejection. Using critical autoethnography, the author reflects on seven years of program-building in a system where innovation was tolerated but not absorbed. Still, student engagement surged when given space to practice rather than perform. Yet the institution's immune response-through bureaucratic friction and evaluative silence-revealed what remains unspeakable in metrics-driven reform. Culture, in this context, does not merely constrain; it adjudicates what counts as knowledge, initiative, and legitimacy. Whereas many studies locate innovation failure in flawed design or weak leadership, this article argues that culture is the decisive mechanism shaping whether innovation can take root. By rendering this mechanism visible, the article contributes to autoethnographic scholarship on entrepreneurship education, critical pedagogy, and higher education reform in postcolonial contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过批判性自传民族志研究，探讨了在东南亚大学推行创新与创业教育的文化障碍，揭示了后殖民制度文化如何阻碍创新教育的真正落地。
AI.research_question: 当实践型学者在未要求也未奖励此类工作的东南亚大学中推行创新与创业项目时会发生什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管创业教育被广泛推广，但本研究旨在揭示制度转型依赖于文化契合而非引进模式的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 后殖民制度文化理论、批判教育学、创新扩散理论
AI.method: 批判性自传民族志，基于七年项目建设的反思
AI.findings: 制度的文化免疫反应（官僚摩擦和评估沉默）揭示了度量驱动改革中不可言说的障碍；学生参与度在获得实践空间而非表演空间时激增；文化不仅是约束，还裁决什么算作知识、主动性和合法性

title: Dynamic Platform Competition 'In' and 'For' the Market
affiliations: University of Liège and

detail.title: Dynamic Platform Competition 'In' and 'For' the Market

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In many industries, platforms compete with incumbents that are open to all consumers, whereas platforms require user affiliation. Consequently, platforms face two layers of competition: for the market, to attract users, and in the market, to compete with incumbents. We develop a dynamic model integrating these layers, showing that as platform affiliation grows, in the market competition intensifies, pushing incumbents toward more aggressive pricing. Conversely, for the market competition diminishes, reducing the platform's incentive to compete aggressively. This interplay generates dynamic pricing behavior that can be non-monotonic over time, capturing the shifting incentives driving platform-incumbent competition across both dimensions.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个动态模型，分析平台与现有企业竞争的双层结构：为市场（吸引用户）和在市场（与现有企业竞争）。研究发现随着平台用户增长，市场竞争加剧，现有企业定价更激进；而为市场竞争减弱，平台竞争动机降低，导致动态定价行为呈现非单调性。
AI.research_question: 平台与现有企业竞争的双层结构如何影响动态定价行为？
AI.motivation: 在许多行业中，平台需要用户注册才能使用，而现有企业对所有消费者开放，这种差异导致平台面临为市场和在市场的双重竞争。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台竞争理论和动态定价理论，构建整合两个竞争层次的动态模型。
AI.method: 开发动态模型，分析平台用户增长与竞争强度之间的相互作用。
AI.findings: 随着平台用户增长，市场竞争加剧，现有企业定价更激进；而为市场竞争减弱，平台竞争动机降低，导致动态定价行为呈现非单调性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了平台竞争的双层结构理论框架，揭示了跨维度竞争激励的动态变化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台企业和现有企业提供理解动态定价策略的理论指导，帮助制定更有效的竞争策略。

title: Digital Twins in Service Systems: The Process Twin Loop in Courts
affiliations: Tel Aviv University - Coller School of Management, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management and Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Digital Twins in Service Systems: The Process Twin Loop in Courts
detail.abstract:
Congested service systems pose challenges for efficiency, equity, and access, with court systems being a particularly salient example. Misalignment between the five faces of a process: designed, expert-perceived, data-reflected, real, and optimal, highlights why static approaches fall short and motivates the vision of a digital twin of the system as a unifying, adaptive model.

We introduce the Process Twin Loop (PTL) as an operational framework that moves from existing information-system data to event logs, process maps, and dashboards, and then conducts baseline simulations and counterfactual evaluations of interventions. The post-intervention state is subsequently fed back into the models for ongoing improvement. Using courts as the anchor setting, we detail each step and outline the remaining requirements for live integration. While real-time connections and optimization are future work, the PTL shows how management analytics can bridge the gap to prescriptive digital twins in congested services. A practical benefit of our approach is rapid model generation from event logs, which enables frequent cycles from data to simulation to decision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Process Twin Loop（PTL）框架，通过数字孪生技术解决拥堵服务系统（如法院系统）的效率、公平性和可及性问题。该框架从信息系统数据生成事件日志、流程地图和仪表板，进行基线模拟和干预措施的反事实评估，实现持续改进。
AI.research_question: 如何通过数字孪生技术弥合拥堵服务系统中设计、专家认知、数据反映、实际和最优流程之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 拥堵服务系统（特别是法院系统）在效率、公平性和可及性方面面临挑战，静态方法无法解决流程多维度之间的不对齐问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字孪生理论、流程管理理论、服务系统优化理论
AI.method: Process Twin Loop（PTL）操作框架，包括从信息系统数据到事件日志、流程地图、仪表板的转换，以及基线模拟和反事实干预评估。
AI.findings: PTL框架能够快速从事件日志生成模型，实现从数据到模拟再到决策的频繁循环，为管理分析弥合到规范性数字孪生的差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Process Twin Loop框架作为统一、自适应的系统模型，推进了数字孪生在服务系统中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为拥堵服务系统（如法院）提供了可操作的改进框架，能够快速评估干预措施效果，实现持续流程优化。

title: Solving Assortment Optimization with First-Order Methods and Neural Networks: A Computational Framework and Public Benchmark
affiliations: Renmin University of China, UNC Kenan-Flagler Business School - Finance Area, , University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, CUHK-SZ, Indian School of Business - Indian School of Business, Mohali, Xi'an Jiaotong University (XJTU) and Renmin University of China

detail.title: Solving Assortment Optimization with First-Order Methods and Neural Networks: A Computational Framework and Public Benchmark
detail.abstract: Assortment optimization under complex customer choice models and operational constraints is a central challenge in revenue management. This is because its non-linear objective function, coupled with large-scale and discrete decision variables, renders it computationally expensive to solve. Meanwhile, first-order methods like gradient descent have seen widespread adoption for continuous optimization in large-scale AI systems. We propose a computational framework that combines first-order methods and neural networks to efficiently solve assortment optimization. Our framework features straight-through estimators, which enable gradients to flow through discrete variables, and utilizes neural networks to perturb the gradient updates. We theoretically ground our framework by proving that our method is guaranteed to converge to the globally optimal solution for the unconstrained problem under the Multinomial Logit model (MNL). Furthermore, recognizing the need for standardized evaluation in this domain, we develop and release a public benchmark dataset, available at https://github.com/wch444/Assortment-Benchmark. This dataset, comprising several challenging assortment optimization problems, serves both to empirically test our proposed framework and to provide a robust testbed for the wider research community to evaluate novel algorithmic solutions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个结合一阶方法和神经网络的计算框架，用于高效解决品类优化问题。该框架采用直通估计器处理离散变量，并使用神经网络扰动梯度更新。理论证明在无约束MNL模型下能收敛到全局最优解，并发布了公开基准数据集。
AI.research_question: 如何高效解决大规模、离散决策变量的品类优化问题？
AI.motivation: 品类优化在收益管理中具有核心挑战性，其非线性目标函数和大规模离散决策变量导致计算成本高昂，而一阶方法在AI系统连续优化中广泛应用但难以直接应用于离散优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于多项式Logit模型(MNL)的品类优化理论框架，结合一阶优化方法和神经网络技术。
AI.method: 提出结合一阶方法和神经网络的计算框架，使用直通估计器处理离散变量，神经网络扰动梯度更新。
AI.findings: 理论证明在无约束MNL模型下能收敛到全局最优解，并通过基准数据集验证了方法的有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为品类优化问题提供了理论保证，证明在MNL模型下能收敛到全局最优解，扩展了一阶方法在离散优化中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了公开基准数据集，为研究社区提供标准化评估平台；提出的计算框架能高效解决大规模品类优化问题。
