title: Stuck in The Past: The United States’ Disproportionate Lag in Addressing Contemporary Issues
affiliations: Midtown High School

detail.title: Stuck in The Past: The United States’ Disproportionate Lag in Addressing Contemporary Issues

publicationDetails.detailsText: Accepted to Curieux Academic Journal, awaiting publication.

detail.abstract: Despite producing more than a quarter of global GDP, the United States ranks only 44th on the 2024 Sustainable Development Goal Index. This paper reviews comparative SDG data, IMF economic statistics, and secondary political science and sociology research to explain this paradox. The analysis identifies three main drivers of the U.S. lag: structural inefficiency in government policymaking, which fosters gridlock and nostalgia-driven rhetoric; widening social and economic inequalities in healthcare, education, mobility, and housing; and weak climate policy that has diminished U.S. credibility with global partners. Together, these findings show that the nation's underperformance is not due to limited resources, but to political dysfunction and misplaced priorities. Unless U.S. leaders adopt future-oriented, bipartisan approaches, the gap between economic capacity and sustainable development outcomes will continue to widen.

AI.tldr: 美国虽然GDP占全球四分之一以上，但在2024年可持续发展目标指数中仅排名第44位。研究发现这种矛盾主要源于政府决策的结构性低效、日益扩大的社会经济不平等以及薄弱的应对气候变化政策。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国在可持续发展目标指数中表现不佳，与其经济实力不匹配？
AI.motivation: 美国作为全球经济大国却在可持续发展目标排名中表现落后，这种矛盾现象值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、政治决策理论、社会不平等理论
AI.method: 比较SDG数据、IMF经济统计数据、政治学和社会学二手研究
AI.findings: 三个主要驱动因素：政府决策的结构性低效导致僵局和怀旧言论；医疗、教育、流动性和住房方面的社会经济不平等加剧；气候政策薄弱损害了美国的全球信誉
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了经济实力与可持续发展表现之间的脱节机制，强调了政治功能失调和优先事项错位的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国政策制定者提供了改进方向，强调需要采取面向未来的两党合作方法

title: A Systematic Approach to Community of Practice Evaluation using the Value Creation Framework

detail.abstract: Communities of Practice (CoPs) are a widely used tool to foster collaboration and knowledge exchange across disciplines. However, systematic evaluations of them remain limited due to the dynamic nature of CoPs and the lack of tested methodologies. In this manuscript, we present the evaluation of a CoP conducted by pairing the Value Creation Framework with guidance developed by the Centers for Disease Control (CDC). Through qualitative analysis using a structured coding framework, we examine participants’ experiences in the CoP and assess the types of value the CoP generated for its members, the barriers that may have hindered value creation, and the perceived benefits of participation in the CoP at both personal and organizational levels. We identified value creation across the four core cycles, identified barriers (i.e., capacity) and facilitators (e.g., discussion-oriented atmosphere, relationship building, and trust) to value, and visualized how value flows across cycles to ensure CoPs meet members’ needs. Our findings demonstrate the utility of this systematic approach, highlighting the individual and organizational benefits of participation in a conservation-focused CoP while offering a codebook and guidance for future CoP evaluations.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用价值创造框架和CDC指南相结合的方法，系统评估了实践社区(CoPs)的价值创造过程，识别了价值创造的四个核心周期、障碍因素和促进因素，并可视化价值流动过程。

AI.motivation: 实践社区被广泛用于促进跨学科合作和知识交流，但由于CoPs的动态特性和缺乏经过验证的方法论，对其的系统评估仍然有限。

title: Revolutionizing Identity Understanding Through Phonetic Resonance Coding (PRC): A Scientific Breakthrough
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Revolutionizing Identity Understanding Through Phonetic Resonance Coding (PRC): A Scientific Breakthrough

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that Phonetic Resonance Coding (PRC) is an original framework developed by him and forms the basis of ongoing research, consultancy, and product offerings in identity analytics. detail.abstract: Phonetic Resonance Coding (PRC) is a reproducible framework mapping alphabetic sound patterns into numeric codes based on phonetic articulation principles. Drawing from ancient Indian śikṣā phonetics and validated by modern linguistic and neuroscientific findings, PRC classifies English letters into nine numeric categories reflecting acoustic and articulatory features. Unlike mystical numerology and computational phonetic search algorithms, PRC provides a transparent and empirical sound-number system for identity analytics across individuals, families, and organizations. Importantly, PRC deliberately reserves the number 9, since adding 9 to any number does not alter its digital root, positioning it as a mathematical archetype of completion and closure (Ifrah, 2000). This paper details PRC v1.0 classification, its cognitive foundation, and its applications, offering a scientifically grounded alternative to traditional esoteric approaches.

AI.tldr: PRC是一个基于语音发音原理将字母声音模式映射为数字代码的可重复框架，提供科学的音-数系统用于身份分析。

AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于语音发音原理的音-数映射理论框架，连接古代语音学与现代科学。

title: Corruption and Innovation in the European Union: A Regional Analysis
affiliations: , Dublin City University Business School and Dublin City University Business School

detail.title: Corruption and Innovation in the European Union: A Regional Analysis
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the complex relationship between corruption and innovation within the European Union. To do that, as innovation is highly contextual, we employ regional-level data from 210 NUTS II regions across the EU for the years 2010, 2013, and 2017. Our findings indicate that higher levels of corruption are consistently associated with lower regional innovation performance. Furthermore, we find that in countries characterised by high regulatory burdens, corruption exerts an even more pronounced negative effect on innovation, contradicting the hypothesis that corruption can "grease the wheels" in over-regulated environments. These results are robust across multiple econometric specifications and highlight the critical role of good governance in fostering innovation. The study underscores the importance of anti-corruption policies as a foundational element of effective regional placebased innovation policies in the European Union.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现欧盟地区腐败与创新呈负相关，腐败水平越高，区域创新表现越差。在监管负担较重的国家，腐败对创新的负面影响更为显著，反驳了腐败能在过度监管环境中"润滑车轮"的假设。
AI.research_question: 腐败与创新在欧盟地区存在怎样的复杂关系？腐败是否能在监管负担较重的环境中起到"润滑车轮"的作用？
AI.motivation: 研究腐败与创新之间的关系，特别关注在监管负担较重的环境中腐败是否可能促进创新，这对于欧盟制定有效的区域创新政策具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于腐败与创新关系的理论框架，特别是"润滑车轮"假说与"阻碍车轮"假说的对比分析。
AI.method: 使用欧盟210个NUTS II地区在2010年、2013年和2017年的区域层面数据进行实证分析，采用多种计量经济学模型。
AI.findings: 腐败水平与区域创新表现呈显著负相关；在监管负担较重的国家，腐败对创新的负面影响更为显著；结果在多种计量模型中都保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 反驳了腐败能在过度监管环境中"润滑车轮"的假设，为腐败与创新关系理论提供了新的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调良好治理在促进创新中的关键作用，为欧盟制定基于地区的创新政策提供了重要参考，突出反腐败政策作为有效区域创新政策的基础要素。

title: Review of Finance and Economic Risk Management

detail.title: Review of Finance and Economic Risk Management
detail.abstract: Risks facing economic and financial institutions are numerous throughout their operations, to the extent that risks can be considered inherent elements of any organizational activity. Achieving predetermined objectives cannot occur without confronting these risks. Among the most significant and oldest business risks are financial risks, which include liquidity-related risks, financial market-related risks, risks arising from difficulties controlling accounting techniques, and risks associated with challenges in cost and expenditure control. Enhancing efficiency and effectiveness in economic institutions requires implementing wellconsidered procedures for managing these risks and selecting appropriate strategies to address them. This is only possible when the institution possesses the fundamental keys necessary for effective risk management.

title: Finishing the Cycle: A Predictive Assessment of Renewed U.S.-Israeli Operations against Iran (October 2025 -March 2026)
affiliations: University of Tehran - Faculty of Law and Political Sciences

detail.title: Finishing the Cycle: A Predictive Assessment of Renewed U.S.-Israeli Operations against Iran (October 2025 -March 2026)

declarations.ethicsApproval: This assessment reflects independent analysis of open-source information as of October 1, 2025. Strategic dynamics evolve rapidly; probability estimates should be updated continuously as indicators change rather than treated as static predictions. The 70-80% forecast represents analytical judgment about likelihood, not inevitability, desirability, or policy recommendation. Decision-makers bear responsibility for policy choices; analysts provide structured probability assessments to inform, not determine, those choices. The author welcomes critique and alternative interpretations that strengthen collective understanding of this consequential period.

contentType.other: No intention to publish except online

detail.abstract: This strategic assessment analyzes the probability of renewed U.S.-Israeli military operations against Iran's nuclear and military infrastructure during October 2025-March 2026, following the June 2025 twelve-day conflict. Employing multi-method convergence analysis integrating capability-intent-opportunity frameworks, deterrence theory, and Bayesian probability updating, the study identifies eleven independent structural variables simultaneously aligning toward military resumption. The assessment concludes a 55-75% probability (central estimate: 65%) of comprehensive operations within the six-month window, with concentration in October-November 2025 (55-60% cumulative). This high-confidence forecast reflects unprecedented convergence: demonstrated operational access from June precedent, multilateral sanctions snapback (September 28-29), complete IAEA verification opacity regarding 440kg enriched uranium, zero-sum diplomatic deadlock, constrained Iranian retaliation capacity through regional realignments (Saudi-Pakistan defense pact, U.S.-Qatar security guarantee), and improved Israeli defenses potentially incorporating Iron Beam directed-energy systems. The analysis introduces the "persistent air denial" operational concept—continuous combat air patrol over Iranian territory enabled by tanker support—compressing campaign duration to 5-10 days with projected 15-45 Israeli casualties while achieving nuclear throughput destruction, missile production elimination, and mobile launcher attrition exceeding 70-85%. Strategic implications include regional security architecture transformation, U.S. force reorientation toward Indo-Pacific competition, and critical tests for global nonproliferation regime effectiveness. The study provides structured indicators framework enabling continuous probability updating, explicit falsification criteria, and honest acknowledgment of irreducible uncertainties in forecasting complex geopolitical systems.

title: Reframing Failures: How Repeated Internally Versus Externally Caused Failures Shape Distinct Learning Trajectories
affiliations: ESCP Business School, Carnegie Mellon University, University College Dublin (UCD) - UCD School of Business and Independent

detail.title: Reframing Failures: How Repeated Internally Versus Externally Caused Failures Shape Distinct Learning Trajectories
detail.abstract: Existing research on organizational learning from failure typically assumes that once causes are identified, their meanings remain stable-internal failures consistently promote learning, whereas external ones do not. We challenge this static view by developing a dynamic attributional perspective, arguing that as organizations experience repeated failures of the same cause, their causal attributions can shift-revising perceptions of controllability and, in turn, altering their motivation to learn. Specifically, we propose that repeated internally caused failures may eventually be reframed as uncontrollable, reducing motivation to learn, whereas repeated externally caused failures may be reinterpreted as manageable, prompting proactive learning responses. Using 15 years of panel data from major U.S. airlines, complemented by qualitative interviews, we find distinct nonlinear learning trajectories consistent with these predictions: internally caused failures exhibit an inverted-U pattern, whereas externally caused failures follow a U-shaped pattern. Our findings advance a dynamic attributional view of organizational learning, demonstrating how accumulated experience reshapes attributions and responses to internal versus external failures.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了组织从失败中学习的静态观点，提出了动态归因视角，认为随着组织经历相同原因的重复失败，其归因会发生变化，进而改变学习动机。研究发现内部失败呈现倒U型学习轨迹，外部失败呈现U型学习轨迹。
AI.research_question: 组织对内部和外部失败原因的归因如何随着重复经历而动态变化，以及这种变化如何影响学习动机？
AI.motivation: 现有研究假设失败原因的含义是稳定的，但本文认为归因会随着重复经历而动态变化，需要挑战这种静态观点。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态归因理论、组织学习理论、归因理论
AI.method: 使用15年美国主要航空公司的面板数据，辅以定性访谈
AI.findings: 内部原因失败呈现倒U型学习轨迹（先升后降），外部原因失败呈现U型学习轨迹（先降后升）
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了动态归因视角，挑战了组织学习研究中关于失败归因稳定性的假设
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助管理者理解重复失败如何改变归因和学习动机，为失败管理提供新见解

title: How Training Effectiveness Drives Employee Creativity during the Covid-19 Pandemic
affiliations: Hasanuddin University, Hasanuddin University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: How Training Effectiveness Drives Employee Creativity during the Covid-19 Pandemic
detail.abstract: PurposeThis study investigates the impact of training effectiveness on employee creativity among Indonesian alumni of the Japanese “Kenshusei” program. Drawing on Human Capital Theory and Dynamic Capabilities Theory, it explores the mediating roles of human resource quality (HRQ) and hard skill competence (HSC).Design/methodology/approachA quantitative survey was conducted involving 121 respondents selected from a population of 523 Kenshusei alumni. Data were gathered via an online questionnaire and subsequently analyzed using structural equation modeling (SEM) with Amos 24.FindingsTraining effectiveness significantly improves HRQ, which subsequently enhances HSC and employee creativity. While direct effects of training on HSC and creativity were not statistically significant, the indirect effect through HRQ and HSC was significant, with a total effect size of 0.605.Practical implicationsThe findings show that training programs should teach more than just technical skills. These findings should also develop dynamic capabilities. HR managers should ensure that training initiatives strengthen human capital and support creativity and adaptability within the workforce.Originality/valueThis study provides empirical validation of a mediational model linking training effectiveness to creativity via HRQ and HSC. It contributes to the literature by contextualizing training and innovation outcomes within a unique group of international labor program alumni during the Covid-19 crisis.

title: The Cost of Curbing Externalities with Market Power: Alcohol Regulations and Tax Alternatives
affiliations: Leonard N. Stern School of Business - Department of Economics and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: The Cost of Curbing Externalities with Market Power: Alcohol Regulations and Tax Alternatives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We do not have any financial interest that is related to this work.

detail.abstract: Products with negative externalities are often subject to regulations that limit competition. The single-product case may suggest that it is irrelevant for aggregate welfare whether output is restricted via corrective taxes or limiting competition. However, when products are differentiated, curbing consumption through market power can be costly. Firms with market power may not only reduce total quantity, but distort the purchase decisions of inframarginal consumers. We examine a common regulation known as post-and-hold (PH) used by a dozen states for the sale of alcoholic beverages. Theoretically, PH eliminates competitive incentives among wholesalers selling identical products. We assemble unique data on distilled spirits from Connecticut, including matched manufacturer and wholesaler prices, to evaluate the welfare consequences of PH. For similar levels of ethanol consumption, PH leads to substantially lower consumer welfare (and government revenue) compared to simple taxes, because it distorts consumption choices away from high-quality/premium brands and towards low-quality brands. Replacing PH with volumetric or ethanol-based taxes could reduce consumption by 10-11% without reducing consumer surplus, and roughly triple tax revenues.

AI.tldr: 本文研究表明，对于具有负外部性的产品，通过市场力量限制竞争（如后置定价机制）相比简单税收，会导致更低的消费者福利和政府收入，因为它扭曲了消费选择，使消费者从高质量品牌转向低质量品牌。
AI.research_question: 对于具有负外部性的差异化产品，通过市场力量限制竞争与通过税收限制产出，对福利的影响有何不同？
AI.motivation: 单产品情况下，通过税收或限制竞争来限制产出对总福利的影响可能无关紧要，但当产品差异化时，通过市场力量遏制消费可能成本高昂。
AI.theoretical_framework: 负外部性产品监管理论、差异化产品市场竞争理论、后置定价机制理论
AI.method: 使用康涅狄格州烈酒销售的独特数据，包括匹配的制造商和批发商价格，评估后置定价机制的福利后果
AI.findings: 在相似的乙醇消费水平下，后置定价机制相比简单税收导致显著更低的消费者福利和政府收入，因为它扭曲了消费选择，使消费者从高质量/高端品牌转向低质量品牌
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了在差异化产品市场中，通过市场力量限制竞争相比税收会产生额外的福利损失，因为会扭曲边际内消费者的购买决策
AI.practical_contributions: 研究表明用体积税或乙醇税替代后置定价机制，可以在不减少消费者剩余的情况下减少10-11%的消费，并使税收收入大约增加三倍

title: Profiting from Enabling Technologies?
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Management and Technology, Baylor University, Bayes Business School (formerly Cass), City, University of London and University of California, Berkeley - Business & Public Policy Group

detail.title: Profiting from Enabling Technologies?
detail.abstract: How to to profit from innovation has been an important question for both innovation scholars and practitioners over the years. It is certainly a relevant question for all types of technological innovation, including emerging ones. Teece's (1986) profiting from innovation (PFI) framework sets forth a theory of the relevant contingencies. However, Teece's framework focuses on technologies with applications in specific domains. We focus on the question of how to profit from enabling technologies: technologies that are applicable across multiple domains. We argue that capturing value in such circumstances is fundamentally different from profiting from less-enabling technologies and raises new issues with respect to the relevant business models and public policies. This paper's contribution is threefold. It formally revises and extends the original PFI framework to include the case of enabling technologies; it provides empirical evidence to support the distinction between profiting from enabling as compared to profiting from narrower "discrete" technologies; and it generates perspectives on the appropriate business models for these technologies and discusses related public-policy implications, in light of the fact that the share of the benefits the innovator can capture is likely to be even smaller for enabling than for discrete technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文修订并扩展了Teece(1986)的PFI框架，专门研究如何从跨领域应用的使能技术中获利，指出这与传统离散技术的获利方式存在根本差异，并探讨了相应的商业模式和公共政策含义。
AI.research_question: 如何从使能技术（跨多个领域应用的技术）中获利？
AI.motivation: Teece的PFI框架主要关注特定领域应用的技术，而缺乏对跨领域使能技术获利策略的研究，这在实际创新管理中具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Teece(1986)的获利创新(PFI)框架，但进行了修订和扩展以包含使能技术的情况。
AI.method: 理论框架修订与实证证据支持。
AI.findings: 从使能技术中获利与从离散技术中获利存在根本差异，创新者从使能技术中能获取的收益份额可能更小。
AI.theory_contributions: 正式修订和扩展了原始PFI框架，将使能技术纳入分析范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为使能技术提供了适当的商业模式视角，并讨论了相关的公共政策影响。

title: Enhancing RA 9003: A Comprehensive Analysis and Future Directions for Ecological Solid Waste Management in the Philippines

detail.title: Enhancing RA 9003: A Comprehensive Analysis and Future Directions for Ecological Solid Waste Management in the Philippines
detail.abstract: The Philippines' historic Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000, also known as Republic Act No. 9003, was created with the goal of implementing a methodical, all-encompassing, and environmentally friendly approach to solid waste management. This essay gives a summary and critical evaluation of RA 9003, covering its application, advantages, disadvantages, ramifications, and suggested enhancements. Although the law provides a solid foundation for recycling, waste segregation, and community involvement, issues with public compliance, local government capability, and enforcement still exist. Achieving long-term sustainability and environmental protection objectives requires addressing these constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文对菲律宾2000年《生态固体废物管理法》（RA 9003）进行了总结和批判性评估，分析了该法律在实施、优势、劣势、影响和改进建议方面的情况。

title: Holy Days, Lost Days?
affiliations: ZEW – Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research

detail.title: Holy Days, Lost Days?

publicationDetails.detailsText: ZEW - Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper No. 25-056
publicationDetails.journalName: ZEW - Leibniz Centre for European Economic Research Discussion Paper Series

detail.abstract: Do public holidays meaningfully affect economic output? In Germany, strict Sunday laws create a unique natural experiment: when public holidays fall on Sundays, they typically do not additionally disrupt business activity. Exploiting this variation across states and years, I estimate the economic cost of a "lost" workday. Using monthly manufacturing data and a stacked event-study approach, I find that weekday holidays lead to modest but measurable reductions in output. Scaling the estimates implies annual GDP losses between 0.06% and 0.28%, depending on whether the effect is assumed to apply only to manufacturing or to the whole economy.

AI.tldr: 德国周日法律创造了一个自然实验：当公共假日落在周日时，通常不会额外干扰商业活动。利用这种跨州和跨年的变化，研究发现工作日假期会导致适度的产出减少，年度GDP损失在0.06%到0.28%之间。
AI.research_question: 公共假日是否显著影响经济产出？
AI.motivation: 德国严格的周日法律创造了一个独特的自然实验环境，可以研究工作日假期的经济成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 利用自然实验方法，通过比较工作日假期和周日假期的经济影响来估计工作日的经济价值。
AI.method: 使用月度制造业数据和堆叠事件研究方法，分析跨州和跨年的假期变化对产出的影响。
AI.findings: 工作日假期导致适度的产出减少，估计年度GDP损失在0.06%到0.28%之间。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了工作日经济价值的实证估计，为理解假期对经济产出的影响提供了新的证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估假期安排的经济成本提供了量化依据，有助于优化假期政策。

title: XD Thinking™: A Governance-First Framework for Infrastructure Transformation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: XD Thinking™: A Governance-First Framework for Infrastructure Transformation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: UrbanTechplus is a authorised partner of Nexus Twin
declarations.funderStatement: Personally fuinded by author

detail.abstract: Australia’s infrastructure sector faces a convergence of pressures: stalled productivity growth, a $600 billion delivery backlog, an urgent energy transition, and the global spotlight of Brisbane 2032. Previous reform waves, BIM adoption, digital twin pilots, alliancing, and policy frameworks — have delivered incremental improvements but failed to achieve systemic change. Their critical weakness has been isolation: technology, contracts, and policy pursued in silos without enforceable integration. XD Thinking™ is proposed as a governance-first framework that aligns three pillars: NEC4 contractual clauses (X10, X20, X21, X29), international standards (ISO 19650, 41001, 55000), and dimensional modelling (2D–10D). Together these elements embed lifecycle value, digital deliverables, and ESG outcomes into procurement and delivery. Unlike past approaches, XD Thinking™ treats contracts as governance instruments, ensuring that what has historically been optional innovation becomes enforceable practice. Global evidence reinforces the case. The International Olympic Committee’s New Norm introduced over 80 reforms to reduce cost and risk in Games delivery, yet the Oxford Olympics Study (Budzier and Flyvbjerg 2024) shows overruns remain the rule. The gap is not a lack of ideas but the absence of governance enforcement. XD Thinking™ provides that missing layer, operationalising reform principles through integrated, binding mechanisms. The paper sets out the conceptual foundations of XD Thinking™, compares it to prior reforms, and demonstrates its application across Australian and international cases. It concludes with a call to action for governments, industry, and academia to adopt XD Thinking™ as the paradigm for governance-driven infrastructure reform.

AI.tldr: XD Thinking™是一个治理优先的框架，通过整合NEC4合同条款、国际标准和维度建模，将生命周期价值、数字化交付和ESG成果嵌入基础设施采购和交付过程，解决以往改革中技术、合同和政策各自为政的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何通过治理驱动的框架实现基础设施领域的系统性变革，解决技术、合同和政策各自为政的问题？
AI.motivation: 澳大利亚基础设施部门面临生产力增长停滞、6000亿澳元交付积压、能源转型紧迫和布里斯班2032奥运会全球关注等多重压力，以往改革未能实现系统性变革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论、合同治理、国际标准框架（ISO 19650, 41001, 55000）、维度建模（2D-10D）
AI.method: 概念框架开发、案例比较分析（澳大利亚和国际案例）、合同条款分析（NEC4 X10, X20, X21, X29）
AI.findings: XD Thinking™通过整合合同、标准和建模，能够将历史上可选的创新转变为可执行的实践，填补了治理执行层面的空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了治理驱动的改革范式，将合同视为治理工具，建立了技术、合同和政策三位一体的整合框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府、行业和学术界提供了可操作的实施框架，能够有效解决基础设施交付中的系统性挑战，特别是在大型项目如奥运会中的成本超支问题。

title: The State as a Disciplined Actor within the Macro-Market: Institutional Limits and Digital Oversight
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The State as a Disciplined Actor within the Macro-Market: Institutional Limits and Digital Oversight

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants or sensitive data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper introduces the concept of the "macro-market," an integrated framework in which economic and political subsystems interact continuously. While Keynesian economics (Keynes, 1936) stressed the stabilizing role of the State, Austrian economists (Mises, 1922; Hayek, 1944) saw it as a source of distortion, and Chicago and Public Choice scholars (Friedman, 1962; Buchanan & Tullock, 1962) analyzed it as a separate political market. This article argues for a broader "Macro-Market" perspective where political and economic systems are inseparable. Within this framework, the State is a participant with coercive powers but should be disciplined through constitutional limits and continuous citizen oversight, potentially enabled by blockchain-based plebiscites and future digital infrastructures. Historical cases (U.S. New Deal, WWII mobilization, Swiss debt brake, Estonian e-governance, 2020 Pandemic) illustrate the argument.

AI.tldr: 本文提出'宏观市场'概念，将经济和政治子系统视为不可分割的整体框架。与凯恩斯主义、奥地利学派和芝加哥学派不同，作者主张国家应作为具有强制力的参与者，通过宪法限制和公民监督来约束其行为，并探讨区块链等技术在实现这一目标中的潜在作用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个将经济和政治系统视为不可分割整体的整合框架？国家在这一框架中应扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学理论对国家和市场关系的理解存在局限：凯恩斯主义强调国家稳定作用，奥地利学派认为国家导致扭曲，芝加哥学派将政治视为独立市场。需要更整合的视角来理解两者的互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观市场理论 - 将经济和政治系统视为相互作用的整合框架；宪法经济学；公共选择理论；制度经济学
AI.method: 理论构建与历史案例分析相结合，包括美国新政、二战动员、瑞士债务刹车机制、爱沙尼亚电子政务、2020年疫情应对等案例
AI.findings: 经济和政治系统在实践中不可分割；国家作为具有强制力的参与者需要制度约束；数字技术（如区块链）可能增强公民监督能力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出'宏观市场'整合框架，超越传统经济学对国家和市场关系的二元对立理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度设计提供新思路，强调宪法限制和公民监督的重要性，探讨数字技术在约束国家权力中的潜在应用

title: How League Structure Shapes Behaviour: Evidence from Regulatory Changes in Mexico and South Korea
affiliations: University of Liverpool - Management School (ULMS)

detail.title: How League Structure Shapes Behaviour: Evidence from Regulatory Changes in Mexico and South Korea
detail.abstract: This paper estimates the causal impact of entry regulation on organisational behaviour and market outcomes by exploiting two natural experiments in professional football. It examines the consequences of transitioning between a promotion-andrelegation system and a closed league in Mexico's Liga MX and South Korea's K-League 1. Using a difference-indifferences strategy, the analysis compares the evolution of match-level outcomes in the treated leagues with those in suitable control groups-Brazil's Brasileirão and Japan's J-League. Closing the league in Liga MX reduced competitive balance-matches became, on average, less close-lowered stadium attendance by around 40%, and decreased global search interest by about 8 Google Trends points, while also making managerial replacements less effective. Introducing promotion and relegation in the K-League 1 increased competitive intensity and enhanced the efficacy of managerial changes. Together, these findings provide the first causal evidence on how league design shapes incentives and behaviour in professional sports, with broader implications for industries where performancebased entry rules influence organisational strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过墨西哥Liga MX和韩国K-League 1的两个自然实验，研究了升降级制度对职业足球组织行为和市场竞争的影响。研究发现封闭联赛降低了竞争平衡、上座率和全球关注度，而引入升降级制度则增强了竞争强度和经理更换的有效性。
AI.research_question: 联赛准入规则（升降级制度）如何影响职业足球的组织行为和市场竞争结果？
AI.motivation: 理解联赛设计对组织激励和行为的影响，为体育产业及其他受绩效基础准入规则影响的行业提供洞见
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织经济学、激励理论、竞争平衡理论
AI.method: 双重差分法，利用墨西哥Liga MX从升降级转为封闭联赛、韩国K-League 1从封闭联赛引入升降级的自然实验，与巴西Brasileirão和日本J-League作为对照组
AI.findings: 封闭联赛降低了竞争平衡（比赛更不激烈）、上座率下降约40%、全球搜索兴趣下降约8个Google Trends点，经理更换效果减弱；引入升降级制度增强了竞争强度，提高了经理更换的有效性
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了联赛设计如何塑造职业体育激励和行为的因果证据，扩展了组织经济学和竞争理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为职业体育联盟的治理结构设计提供实证依据，对受绩效基础准入规则影响的其他行业具有借鉴意义

detail.abstract:
This study examines how restaurants convey authenticity in destinations not renowned for their gastronomy, with a particular focus on the impact of overtourism. Drawing on a supply-side perspective, it examines restaurateurs’ strategies for conveying authenticity through a thematic analysis of 21 in-depth, semi-structured interviews conducted in Venice, an overtourism hotspot, and the nearby Euganean Hills[1], a more tranquil, locally visited destination. Using thematic analysis and set theory, the study identifies three intersecting components of authenticity—commitment, community, and territory—that collectively characterise restaurateurs’ approaches. The findings reveal the importance of workers’ dedication to family traditions, engagement with local communities, and connection to the territory in shaping authentic gastronomic experiences. This research advances the destination marketing literature by elucidating the managerial and social dynamics behind authentic food offerings. It provides practical insights for restaurateurs seeking to maintain authenticity amid varying tourist flows and highlights investment directions for policymakers to mitigate overtourism.


[1] The authors thank dr. Vittoria Galeazzo, master graduate at the Venice School of Management, for her collaboration in data collection.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨在非著名美食目的地中餐厅如何传达真实性，特别关注过度旅游的影响。通过对威尼斯和尤加内安山丘21个深度访谈的主题分析，识别了真实性三个交叉组成部分：承诺、社区和领土。研究发现员工对家庭传统的奉献、与当地社区的互动以及与领土的联系在塑造真实美食体验中的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在非著名美食目的地中，餐厅如何传达真实性？过度旅游对真实性传达策略有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究在非著名美食目的地中餐厅如何应对过度旅游挑战，维持真实性体验，为目的地营销提供新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 真实性理论、供给方视角、目的地营销理论
AI.method: 21个深度半结构化访谈的主题分析和集合论分析，比较威尼斯（过度旅游热点）和尤加内安山丘（宁静本地目的地）
AI.findings: 识别真实性三个交叉组成部分：承诺（员工对家庭传统的奉献）、社区（与当地社区互动）、领土（与地理区域联系）；这些要素共同塑造真实美食体验
AI.theory_contributions: 推进目的地营销文献，阐明真实食品供应的管理和社会动态；提出真实性三维框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为餐厅经营者提供在变化旅游流量中维持真实性的实用见解；为政策制定者提供缓解过度旅游的投资方向

detail.title: At the Crossroads: Law Libraries, DEI, and the Future of Legal Information
detail.abstract: This article explores the pivotal challenges and dynamic opportunities currently facing law libraries as they strive to balance tradition with evolving demands in legal information services. The authors discuss how law libraries are at a turning point, navigating the need to preserve foundational services and institutional knowledge while also embracing innovation, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives to remain relevant in a rapidly changing environment. They highlight the importance of proactive leadership, adaptation to new technologies, and cultivating inclusive practices as means for law libraries to thrive and lead in the future of legal information access and service.

title: Quantifying Intangible Capital Shares and their Implications for Productivity and Growth
affiliations: Stanford Graduate School of Business, University of Chicago Booth School of Business and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Quantifying Intangible Capital Shares and their Implications for Productivity and Growth

publicationDetails.journalName: Chicago Booth Research Paper Series
Chicago Booth: Fama-Miller Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the role of intangible capital in shaping productivity and growth in U.S. firms using a novel dataset of nearly 21,000 mergers and acquisitions from 2002 to 2024-totaling $15.5 trillion in acquired assets-that provides detailed information on target firms' tangible and intangible asset values in the year immediately preceding their acquisition. We document a sharp rise in the importance of intangibles-especially customer data-which now account for more than half of total acquired value. We also show that the average useful life of intangible assets has lengthened over time, and these durations strongly predict valuation levels. Using target firms' pre-acquisition financials, combined with the values of their tangible and intangible assets at the time of acquisition, we analyze production before acquisition and find that intangible capital's output share now rivals that of tangible capital. Incorporating intangibles into a standard production function for these firms also substantially reshapes their productivity measurement: over 70% of firms change total factor productivity (TFP) rank, with some firms shifting in ranking by as many as seven deciles. The average absolute change in firm-level TFP is 42%, with sector-level changes exceeding 70% in manufacturing. Finally, adjusted TFP outperforms unadjusted TFP in forecasting future sales growth. Our findings highlight how the rise of intangible assets alters our understanding of productivity and growth in key sectors of the economy.

AI.tldr: 基于2002-2024年21,000起并购交易数据的研究发现，无形资产（特别是客户数据）在收购价值中占比已超过一半，且无形资产的使用寿命延长显著影响估值。将无形资产纳入生产函数后，70%以上企业的全要素生产率排名发生变化，调整后的TFP能更好地预测未来销售增长。
AI.research_question: 无形资产如何影响美国企业的生产率和增长？
AI.motivation: 随着无形资产在经济中的重要性日益增加，传统生产函数可能无法准确衡量企业生产率和增长，需要重新评估无形资产的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 标准生产函数理论，但扩展纳入无形资产作为生产要素
AI.method: 使用2002-2024年21,000起并购交易数据，分析目标企业在被收购前的财务数据和有形/无形资产价值，构建包含无形资产的生产函数
AI.findings: 1)无形资产占收购价值超50%；2)无形资产使用寿命延长预测估值水平；3)无形资产产出份额与有形资本相当；4)纳入无形资产后70%企业TFP排名变化；5)调整后TFP能更好预测未来销售增长
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了生产函数理论，将无形资产作为重要生产要素，重新定义了企业生产率的衡量方法
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业估值、投资决策和生产率测量提供了新视角，帮助政策制定者更准确理解经济增长动力

title: Uncovered Interest Parity: Financial Crises

detail.title: Uncovered Interest Parity: Financial Crises

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No personal or financial relationship
declarations.funderStatement: Self

detail.abstract: Crises are invariably a major area of study. Post 2007-08, world has been saddled with one crisis after the other. The kinds of crises have ranged from sovereign debt crisis to banking crisis. Inflation has also been an accompanying factor. Some countries are battling a high inflation; others are on the verge of deflation. The policy measures for these countries, differ significantly. Stock market bubbles and Stock market crash are also real worries in case of free capital inflows. This also has implications for the exchange rate of a country’s currency in relation to other currencies. This paper incorporates all these elements into the study of exchange rate and interest rate relationship in emerging countries as opposed to numerous such studies for the developed countries. The countries chosen for the study are Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Brazil and Paraguay from Latin America; Bhutan, Vietnam, Malaysia, Thailand and Korea from Asia. Exchange rate regimes also vary across countries. Even though a lot of countries have adopted a floating exchange rate, fixed and managed float exchange rate regimes are followed in numerous countries. With high foreign capital flows in the absence of substantial controls, maintaining a fixed exchange rate over the years is difficult indeed. Countries inevitably find themselves staring at a currency or debt crises in the absence of a sustainable current account deficit that is balanced by high capital inflows and a corresponding capital account surplus. This study attempts to study Uncovered Interest Parity over the long term to assess its predictive power, whether the concept holds any relevance at all. The impact of crises on the UIP condition is also being studied which remains hitherto uncharted territory in terms of body of research work in the domain. The study differs in terms of interest rates and exchange rates data being used. Use of lending rates data as a proxy for interest rates earned on assets gives a different dimension to the exercise being undertaken.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨新兴市场国家在危机背景下汇率与利率关系的长期表现，特别是检验无抛补利率平价(UIP)的预测能力。研究选取拉丁美洲和亚洲10个新兴国家，使用贷款利率数据作为利率代理变量，分析危机对UIP条件的影响。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场国家在长期内无抛补利率平价(UIP)是否具有预测能力？危机对UIP条件有何影响？
AI.motivation: 2007-08年后世界面临多重危机（主权债务危机、银行危机、通胀/通缩、股市泡沫等），这些危机对汇率和利率关系产生影响。现有研究多关注发达国家，对新兴市场国家的研究不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无抛补利率平价(UIP)理论，即两国利率差异应等于预期汇率变动率。
AI.method: 选取阿根廷、墨西哥、智利、巴西、巴拉圭（拉丁美洲）和不丹、越南、马来西亚、泰国、韩国（亚洲）10个新兴国家，使用贷款利率数据作为利率代理变量，分析长期UIP表现。
AI.findings: 研究结果将揭示UIP在新兴市场国家的长期预测能力，以及危机对UIP条件的具体影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了危机对UIP条件影响的研究空白，为UIP理论在新兴市场国家的适用性提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场国家在危机时期的汇率和利率政策制定提供参考，帮助政策制定者更好地管理资本流动和汇率风险。

reference: RETHINKING NGO ACCOUNTABILITY & REGULATION: STANDARDS, INSTITUTIONS, & NEW FRONTIERS (Eds. Domenico Carolei & Angela Crack, forthcoming 2026).
title: The People's AI: NGO Accountability Lessons from the OpenAI Board Scandal
affiliations: George Washington University Law School and George Washington University School of Law

detail.title: The People's AI: NGO Accountability Lessons from the OpenAI Board Scandal

publicationDetails.detailsText: RETHINKING NGO ACCOUNTABILITY & REGULATION: STANDARDS, INSTITUTIONS, & NEW FRONTIERS (Eds. Domenico Carolei & Angela Crack, forthcoming 2026).

detail.abstract:
In the United States, a fundamental axiom of the law of nonprofit organizations is that nonprofits do not have owners. The practical scope of this limitation was very publicly tested, however, by the high-profile developments of the artificial intelligence nonprofit, OpenAI, when the board of the organization voted to fire its chief executive. This decision was swiftly overturned due to agitation by investors in the charity’s joint venture. Microsoft, one of the three largest companies in the world as measured by market capitalization, is the primary investor in OpenAI's joint venture.

This article uses the controversy surrounding the governance of OpenAI as a launching point for evaluating the potential role of owners in regulating nonprofits. In a world where nonprofits do functionally have owners, as appeared to be the case in OpenAI, this article asks whether it is desirable for the public to be a fractional owner in nonprofits. This is a novel research question since the framework of ownership presents a form of accountability that is generally viewed as outside the scope for nonprofits. This article explores the feasibility and implications of establishing the new accountability device of fractional public ownership in nonprofits, giving control rights while preserving the nondistribution constraint required of the sector. This research also has implications far beyond the United States, since fractional public ownership of NGOs could be a regulatory device available in all jurisdictions that allow for the incorporation and regulation of NGOs.

AI.tldr: 本文以OpenAI治理争议为切入点，探讨非营利组织是否应引入公众分权所有权作为新的问责机制。
AI.research_question: 在非营利组织实际上存在所有者的情况下，公众是否应该成为非营利组织的分权所有者？
AI.motivation: OpenAI董事会解雇CEO的决定被投资者推翻，暴露了非营利组织治理的现实问题，挑战了'非营利组织无所有者'的传统法律原则。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非营利组织治理理论、所有权与问责机制理论、非分配约束原则
AI.method: 案例分析法，以OpenAI治理争议为实证研究对象
AI.findings: 非营利组织在实践中可能存在事实上的所有者，公众分权所有权可能成为一种可行的问责机制
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了非营利组织分权公众所有权的理论框架，拓展了非营利组织治理理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为非营利组织治理提供了新的监管工具，具有跨国适用性，可在所有允许NGO注册的司法管辖区实施

title: A Study on Principle-based Analysis on Responsible Business Conduct of Indian Listed Companies
affiliations: Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs

detail.title: A Study on Principle-based Analysis on Responsible Business Conduct of Indian Listed Companies
detail.abstract: Purpose-The study analyzes the Chairperson's messages of the listed Indian companies to test the extant by which the leadership communication resonates with the spirit of BRSR and the principles of NGRBC. It will help understand the level of focus of the Indian corporates for conducting business in a responsible manner addressing ESG aspects. Design/ Methodology-The sample size of the study are the top 593 Indian listed companies by their market capitalisation. The study employs coded segment analysis MAXQDA Pro and analyses the findings with paired t-test. Findings-The findings reveal that the focus of the leadership of the studied companies is to create a positive impact on the society, with their actions, activities, and products offered. While the aspects of governance & environment were found to be relatively insignificant statistically, however, it cannot be concluded that these issues are not within the thoughts of the leadership. Rather, it can safely, assumed that the companies have evolved and integrated the governance and environmental aspects into their daily operations and thus, no separate mention is needed. Originality-The research study is unique with respect to the sample size and data analysis findings and perspectives.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析印度上市公司董事长致辞，检验领导层沟通与BRSR精神和NGRBC原则的契合程度，了解印度企业在ESG方面的关注水平。研究发现企业领导层主要关注对社会产生积极影响，而治理和环境方面在统计上相对不显著，可能已融入日常运营。
AI.research_question: 印度上市公司领导层沟通在多大程度上与BRSR精神和NGRBC原则产生共鸣？
AI.motivation: 了解印度企业在负责任经营和ESG方面的关注程度
AI.theoretical_framework: BRSR（商业责任和可持续发展报告）框架、NGRBC（国家负责任商业行为指南）原则
AI.method: 对593家市值最高的印度上市公司进行编码段分析，使用MAXQDA Pro软件，配对t检验分析
AI.findings: 企业领导层主要关注对社会产生积极影响，治理和环境方面统计上不显著，可能已融入日常运营
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了印度企业ESG沟通的实证证据，扩展了领导层沟通与可持续发展原则契合度的研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业改进ESG沟通策略提供参考，帮助监管机构了解企业ESG实践现状

title: Marketing Distribution Channels in the European Automotive Supply Chain: The Greek Case
affiliations: University of Piraeus and Harokopio University

detail.title: Marketing Distribution Channels in the European Automotive Supply Chain: The Greek Case
detail.abstract: This article is engaged with the planning of distribution channels, mainly in the sector of car industry in Europe and the supply of the Greek market with cars. This subject has significant importance, because of the rapid progress and extension of application of Marketing and Logistics Management during the last thirty years, by the use of modern information technology, network and digital, in the frame of the so-called 'technological explosion'. This expanding move has succeeded in overcoming the divergence of views and practices connected with the past, and to achieve understanding and collaboration, in formulating a 'new strategy' for the corporation adjustment to the new 'landscape' of trade and technologies. The convergence of this parallel advance has contributed to the 'holistic' approach of the supply chain and planning of the Distribution Channels, aiming at improvement of business performance. The factors that affect the corporation distribution strategy in international markets are examined, focusing on the physical channels and more generally on distribution practices applied by multinational companies. More specifically, the strategies of autos entry in the international markets are identified, along with the application of modern Logistics in the Automotive industry. In this article the results of research on the European physical distribution channels, from the car factories to the importers in Greece, are presented and evaluated. Finally, certain important conclusions are presented with regard to the strategy of distribution channels of companies to this sector and the possibilities of further research for the determination of the optimal channels supplying the markets.

AI.tldr: 本文研究欧洲汽车行业分销渠道规划，特别关注希腊汽车市场的供应。探讨了营销和物流管理在现代信息技术背景下的发展，分析了影响跨国公司分销策略的因素，并提出了汽车行业分销渠道优化的建议。
AI.research_question: 影响跨国公司在国际市场中分销策略的因素是什么？特别是在汽车行业如何规划最优的分销渠道？
AI.motivation: 过去三十年来，营销和物流管理在现代信息技术、网络和数字技术的推动下快速发展，这种'技术爆炸'需要企业制定新的战略来适应新的贸易和技术环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链整体方法、分销渠道规划理论、国际市场营销理论、物流管理理论
AI.method: 对欧洲汽车工厂到希腊进口商的实体分销渠道进行研究分析

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在技术爆炸背景下分销渠道规划的整体方法，深化了对跨国公司分销策略影响因素的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为汽车行业企业提供了分销渠道优化的实践指导，帮助企业适应新的贸易和技术环境，改善业务绩效。

title: Sociotechnical Transition Dynamics: Towards an AI Adoption Framework in UK Construction Projects
affiliations: University of Southampton, University of Birmingham - Birmingham Business School and University of Birmingham - Birmingham Business School

detail.title: Sociotechnical Transition Dynamics: Towards an AI Adoption Framework in UK Construction Projects
detail.abstract: The UK construction industry has persistently lagged in productivity relative to other sectors, despite the role of Project Management (PM) in engendering successful project outcomes. As Artificial Intelligence continues to advance, there is increasing scope for these technologies to enhance the efficiency and performance of project management in construction. At present, applications remain largely exploratory and are most commonly seen in the form of chatbots, data analytics, and generative AI. These tools offer the prospect of improved productivity and project quality, however barriers to widespread adoption persist. Human-related challenges, particularly concerns over job security, limited trust, and deficiencies in relevant skills, continue to constrain progress. Resource constraints, including data quality and security concerns, further impede AI integration. This study examines both current and prospective applications of AI in the UK construction sector, with specific attention to the enablers of and barriers to adoption. Drawing on semi-structured interviews with senior project managers operating in diverse organisational contexts, the analysis highlights three themes that shape the trajectory of AI adoption: (1) limited and exploratory use of AI, (2) human-related barriers, and (3) resource constraints. Whilst these challenges constrain current adoption, project professionals anticipate significant integration within three to seven years, though views on the timeline vary. As such, we propose a Sociotechnical AI Adoption Dynamics Framework, which provides a structured means through which project professionals may address the humanrelated and resource constraints inhibiting adoption, whilst capitalising on technological and organisational enablers to enhance productivity and project outcomes in the construction industry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI在英国建筑业项目管理中的应用现状、障碍和前景，提出了一个社会技术AI采用动态框架来解决人力相关和资源约束问题。
AI.research_question: AI在英国建筑业项目管理中的采用现状、障碍和前景是什么？
AI.motivation: 英国建筑业生产力持续落后于其他行业，而AI技术有潜力提升项目管理效率和绩效，但目前应用仍处于探索阶段且面临多重障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术系统理论，关注技术、组织和人力因素的相互作用。
AI.method: 半结构化访谈，对象为在不同组织环境中工作的资深项目经理。
AI.findings: 识别出三个影响AI采用轨迹的主题：(1)有限且探索性的AI使用，(2)人力相关障碍，(3)资源约束。专业人士预计3-7年内将有显著整合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了社会技术AI采用动态框架，为理解AI采用过程中的复杂互动提供理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为建筑行业专业人士提供了解决AI采用障碍的结构化方法，帮助利用技术和组织推动因素提升生产力和项目成果。

title: FinTech at Micro, Meso, and Macro Levels: A Bibliometric and Thematic Examination of Sectors and Indices
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Roorkee and Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Roorkee

detail.title: FinTech at Micro, Meso, and Macro Levels: A Bibliometric and Thematic Examination of Sectors and Indices
detail.abstract: FinTech has emerged as a transformative force across multiple sectors, reshaping financial markets, business models, and access to capital through technology-enabled solutions. While prior reviews have examined FinTech within specific domains such as banking, lending, or sustainability, there remains a lack of systematic synthesis that evaluates its broader sectoral effects and its measurement through FinTech-related indices. This study conducts a systematic literature review and bibliometric analysis of 132 peer-reviewed articles published between 2008 and 2025, drawing data from Scopus and Web of Science. Guided by PRISMA and PSALSAR frameworks, the review integrates quantitative bibliometric mapping with qualitative thematic synthesis to capture research dynamics at the micro, meso, and macro levels. Descriptive results highlight exponential growth in publications since 2020, with China, the United States, and the United Kingdom as the leading contributors, and Finance Research Letters and International Review of Financial Analysis as the most influential outlets. Citation and co-word network analyses reveal recurring themes including digital financial inclusion, bank FinTech development, digital transformation, FinTech innovation, and financial risk. Thematic analysis underscores sectoral applications in banking, SMEs, green finance, corporate governance, households, and capital markets, each relying on composite indices such as the Digital Financial Inclusion Index, Bank FinTech Development Index, and Digital Transformation Index to evaluate performance and impact. The review identifies gaps in crosscountry comparative studies, sector-specific index construction, and integration of advanced data sources such as AI and social media analytics. This study contributes to the literature by consolidating fragmented research, proposing refined index-based approaches, and offering future research directions. It also provides actionable insights for policymakers and practitioners seeking to leverage FinTech for inclusive, sustainable, and innovation-driven financial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述和文献计量分析，综合评估了金融科技在多个领域的广泛影响及其通过相关指数的测量方式。研究发现金融科技在数字普惠金融、银行金融科技发展、数字化转型等方面具有显著影响，并识别了跨国家比较研究和特定行业指数构建等方面的研究空白。
AI.research_question: 金融科技在不同领域的广泛影响如何通过相关指数进行系统性评估和测量？
AI.motivation: 虽然已有研究在银行、借贷或可持续性等特定领域考察了金融科技，但缺乏对其更广泛行业影响的系统性综合评估以及通过金融科技相关指数进行测量的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于PRISMA和PSALSAR框架，结合定量文献计量映射和定性主题综合，在微观、中观和宏观层面捕捉研究动态。
AI.method: 对2008-2025年间发表的132篇同行评审文章进行系统性文献综述和文献计量分析，数据来源于Scopus和Web of Science。
AI.findings: 自2020年以来出版物呈指数级增长；中国、美国和英国是主要贡献者；主要主题包括数字普惠金融、银行金融科技发展、数字化转型等；识别了银行、中小企业、绿色金融等领域的行业应用。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了碎片化研究，提出了基于指数的精细化方法，并为未来研究方向提供了指导。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和从业者提供了可操作的见解，帮助他们利用金融科技构建包容性、可持续性和创新驱动的金融体系。

title: The Laws of Online Hiring: Two Axioms and One Corollary Reframing the Structural Logic of Digital Labor Markets
affiliations: The Job Applicant Perspective

detail.title: The Laws of Online Hiring: Two Axioms and One Corollary Reframing the Structural Logic of Digital Labor Markets

declarations.ethicsApproval: AI was used for references and editing but the ideas involved were all mine and the paper is the sole responsibility of the author.

detail.abstract: This paper proposes a foundational axiomatic framework for understanding dysfunction in digital labor markets. Drawing on systems theory, behavioral economics, and platform studies, it argues that online hiring ecosystems have collapsed under the weight of asymmetrical information, misaligned incentives, and emotional disconnection between their human stakeholders. The proposed Two Axioms and One Corollary articulate the minimal structural conditions under which online markets for labor can remain stable and trustworthy. Axiom 1 asserts that if job-seeker time is not treated as a currency, the online labor market will devolve into rent-seeking in disguise. Axiom 2 identifies empathy-not as sentiment, but as the measurable architecture of information transfer-as the condition enabling platforms to sense error and self-correct. The resulting Corollary states that markets remain coherent only when vendor profit is positively correlated with user success, never inversely related to it. Together, these laws provide a theoretical baseline for future research in algorithmic hiring, trust infrastructure, and the economics of digital intermediation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个理解数字劳动力市场功能障碍的基础公理框架，基于系统理论、行为经济学和平台研究，指出在线招聘生态系统因信息不对称、激励错位和情感脱节而崩溃。提出了两个公理和一个推论，阐明了在线劳动力市场保持稳定和可信的最低结构条件。
AI.research_question: 在线劳动力市场在什么结构条件下能够保持稳定和可信？
AI.motivation: 在线招聘生态系统因信息不对称、激励错位和情感脱节而崩溃，需要建立理论框架来理解数字劳动力市场的功能障碍。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统理论、行为经济学、平台研究
AI.method: 公理化方法，提出两个公理和一个推论作为理论基础
AI.findings: 提出了三个核心原则：1）求职者时间必须被视为货币；2）同理心作为信息传递的可测量架构；3）供应商利润必须与用户成功正相关
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了数字劳动力市场功能障碍的基础公理框架，为算法招聘、信任基础设施和数字中介经济学研究提供理论基准

title: Global Oil Market Shocks, Exchange Rate and Economic Activity in Nigeria (1999-2016)
affiliations: Nigerian Economic Summit Group and Obafemi Awolowo University

detail.title: Global Oil Market Shocks, Exchange Rate and Economic Activity in Nigeria (1999-2016)
detail.abstract: The study investigated how global the oil market factors and their shocks affect exchange rate and economic activity in Nigeria. These factors were expressed in terms of the determinants of oil price movements; namely, changes in global oil production, global real economic activity and speculative behavior of the oil market players. The study examined the spillover effect of these factors on the economy and how their shocks (specific to changes in oil price) are related to exchange rate and economic activity in Nigeria within the period of 1999 to 2016. Analysis of the relationships between global oil market shocks, exchange rate and economic activity were based on secondary data. Monthly data from January, 1999 to August, 2016 were sourced on variables such as world crude oil production, real global aggregate economic activity index, oil price which represented the global oil market factors and were used to generate the shocks series of oil supply shocks, aggregate demand shocks and oil specific demand shocks. In addition, data were sourced on the naira exchange rate and Nigerian stock market capitalization. These sets of data were sourced from the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN) database, Energy Information Administration (EIA) Database, Federal Reserve Economic Data (FRED) Database and University of Michigan Database. These data were analyzed using both descriptive and econometric technique. Findings from the study revealed that the major drivers of shocks to the price of oil are the speculative activities of oil market players and the real global economic activity which have positive effect on oil price. Meanwhile, changes in oil production was found to be insignificant to oil price. It was revealed that the sharp fall in oil price in 2014 was predominantly as a result of the speculative activities of oil market players. Both global xii real economic activity and the speculative activities of oil market players affect economic activity positively and exchange rate negatively. Oil supply shocks were revealed have positive effect on the economic activity but insignificant to exchange rate. Aggregate demand shocks have positive effect on economic activity and negative effect on exchange rate. Oil specific demand shocks have positive effect on economic activity and exchange rate. Lastly, exchange rate and economic activity generally are insignificant to each other but individual specific shocks were revealed to affect significantly. Negative adjustment in exchange rate shocks have positive effect as positive economic activity shocks have negative effect on exchange rate. Therefore, the study concluded that oil price movement is important in affecting exchange rate and economic activity in Nigeria as the factors that determine oil price are significant in affect macroeconomic variable. The shocks of these factors that are specific to oil price are as well important in impacting on the economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了全球石油市场因素及其冲击如何影响尼日利亚的汇率和经济活动。研究发现石油价格冲击主要受投机活动和全球实际经济活动驱动，这些因素对经济活动有正向影响，对汇率有负向影响。
AI.research_question: 全球石油市场因素及其冲击如何影响尼日利亚的汇率和经济活动？
AI.motivation: 研究石油价格波动对尼日利亚这样的石油出口国经济的影响，特别是2014年油价暴跌背后的原因及其对宏观经济的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于石油市场冲击理论，将石油价格冲击分解为供给冲击、总需求冲击和特定需求冲击。
AI.method: 使用1999年1月至2016年8月的月度数据，采用描述性和计量经济学分析方法，数据来源包括CBN、EIA、FRED等数据库。
AI.findings: 石油价格冲击主要由投机活动和全球实际经济活动驱动；供给冲击对经济活动有正向影响但对汇率不显著；总需求冲击对经济活动有正向影响，对汇率有负向影响；特定需求冲击对经济活动和汇率都有正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对石油市场冲击传导机制的理解，特别是不同类型冲击对汇率和经济活动的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚政策制定者提供了管理石油价格波动对经济影响的政策建议，强调了监控投机活动和全球经济活动的重要性。

title: Airline Industry Dynamics 1993–2022

detail.title: Airline Industry Dynamics 1993–2022
detail.abstract: I examine the U.S. airline industry from 1993 to 2022, a period marked by financial distress and turbulent dynamics in demand, cost, and competition. I estimate a structural model with semiparametric demand and nonparametric marginal costs to capture flexible relationships among product characteristics. The results show that markups and variable profits declined mainly in the late 1990s and early 2000s, then remained relatively stable. Counterfactual decompositions indicate that increased consumer price sensitivity was the dominant driver of reduced profitability, outweighing contributions from increased costs and other factors, while mergers and low-cost carrier expansion on markups largely offset each other.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1993-2022年美国航空业，发现利润率下降主要归因于消费者价格敏感度增加，而并购和低成本航空公司扩张的影响相互抵消。
AI.research_question: 美国航空业在1993-2022年期间利润率变化的主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究航空业在财务困境和需求、成本、竞争动荡时期的动态变化
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构模型，包含半参数需求和非参数边际成本，捕捉产品特征间的灵活关系
AI.method: 使用1993-2022年美国航空业数据，估计结构模型进行反事实分解

title: Scarcity by Design: How Recommendation Algorithms Impact Prices, Participation, and Customer Welfare
affiliations: Singapore Management University - Lee Kong Chian School of Business, Cornell University - SC Johnson Graduate School of Business and Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School

detail.title: Scarcity by Design: How Recommendation Algorithms Impact Prices, Participation, and Customer Welfare
detail.abstract: Recommendation systems are central to digital platforms, but their design often focuses on maximizing immediate match quality. This myopic view overlooks the long-term equilibrium effects driven by strategic responses from market participants. We develop an infinite-horizon equilibrium model of a two-sided marketplace that incorporates strategic sequential search by customers, strategic pricing by suppliers, and endogenous entry from both, to characterize the platform's long-term revenue-maximizing recommendation strategy. We find that maximizing immediate recommendation quality by always recommending the best-fit suppliers can be suboptimal; instead, it may be optimal to concentrate a portion of the recommendations on the very worst supplier types. This strategy, which we term "Scarcity by Design," exploits strategic feedback loops. We identify conditions (high customer patience, sufficient market thickness) under which this strategy is profitable, noting it typically benefits the platform and suppliers at the expense of customer surplus. Leveraging the structure of the optimal policy, we illustrate the revenue benefit of the optimal policy against benchmarks widely used in practice. We then extend the analysis to personalized recommendations across heterogeneous customer segments by leveraging a structural property that renders the high-dimensional optimization problem tractable. We decompose the Value of Information (VoI) from personalization into an efficiency gain (Matching Gain) and a strategic feedback gain (Equilibrium Price Manipulation), which reveals the underlying mechanism and the role customer patience plays in mediating these two gains. While personalization always increases platform and supplier revenues, it may increase or decrease the aggregate customer welfare. Interestingly, we demonstrate that personalization can create asymmetric distributional welfare effects, often harming vulnerable customer segments. This suggests a role for regulatory oversight to ensure fairness.

AI.tldr: 论文开发了一个无限期均衡模型，发现在推荐系统中最大化即时匹配质量可能不是最优策略。相反，通过'稀缺性设计'策略，将部分推荐集中在最差供应商类型上，可以优化平台长期收入。个性化推荐能增加平台和供应商收入，但可能损害客户福利，特别是弱势客户群体。
AI.research_question: 平台在双边市场中如何设计长期收入最大化的推荐策略？
AI.motivation: 现有推荐系统设计过于短视，只关注即时匹配质量，忽视了市场参与者的战略反应所带来的长期均衡效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限期均衡模型，包含客户的战略顺序搜索、供应商的战略定价以及双方的内生进入决策。
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，构建双边市场均衡模型，推导最优推荐策略，并进行基准比较和个性化推荐扩展分析。
AI.findings: 最大化即时推荐质量可能不是最优策略；'稀缺性设计'策略在特定条件下（高客户耐心、足够市场厚度）能提高平台收入；个性化推荐能分解为效率增益和战略反馈增益。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了'稀缺性设计'概念，揭示了推荐系统中的战略反馈循环机制；将个性化推荐的价值分解为匹配增益和均衡价格操纵增益。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台提供了长期收入最大化的推荐策略设计指导；揭示了个性化推荐可能对弱势客户群体造成不公平影响，建议监管介入确保公平性。

title: Connecting the Souths: Identifying Strategic Sectors for Africa-Latin America Trade, industrial and Value Chain Cooperation
affiliations: Desiderio Consultants Ltd. and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Connecting the Souths: Identifying Strategic Sectors for Africa-Latin America Trade, industrial and Value Chain Cooperation
detail.abstract: Amidst rising geopolitical uncertainty and tensions, Africa and Latin America & the Caribbean (LAC) possess significant, yet untapped potential for developing resilient South-South value chains. This paper conducts a comparative analysis of their business environments and identifies structural and regulatory challenges to cross-continental industrial collaboration. Sectors with the greatest complementarities-including agri-food, light manufacturing (such as textiles and apparel), digital services, and logistics-are highlighted as priorities for cooperation. Based on this analysis, the paper proposes a pragmatic, phased, corridor-focused strategy to operationalize South-South value-chain integration. Key elements of this roadmap include the establishment of strategic pilot initiatives, the adoption of Mutual Recognition Agreements (MRAs) to harmonize certification, testing and inspection procedures, the deployment of blended-finance instruments to de-risk joint investments, and the integration of informal economic actors to ensure inclusivity. This approach aims to translate identified complementarities into sustainable, institutionalized value chains that strengthen interregional trade and economic resilience.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较分析非洲与拉美加勒比地区的商业环境，识别了跨大陆产业合作的结构性和监管挑战，提出了以走廊为重点的分阶段战略来实施南南价值链整合。
AI.research_question: 非洲与拉美加勒比地区如何发展有韧性的南南价值链？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治不确定性和紧张局势加剧背景下，非洲与拉美加勒比地区在建立南南价值链方面具有巨大但尚未开发的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 南南合作理论、价值链理论、区域经济一体化理论
AI.method: 比较分析方法，识别结构性和监管挑战
AI.findings: 农业食品、轻工制造、数字服务和物流等领域具有最大的互补性；需要解决监管协调和投资风险问题
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了南南价值链整合的理论框架，强调走廊战略和分阶段实施的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的操作路线图，包括试点项目、互认协议、混合金融工具和包容性整合等实用策略

title: Arbitration in Greece
affiliations: University of Leicester Law School

detail.title: Arbitration in Greece
detail.abstract: This article discusses the foundations of arbitration in Greece, including topics such as the arbitration market, the arbitration community, arbitration practice, and arbitration institutions.  The interviews on which the article is based were performed as part of a research project funded by the United Kingdom’s Economic and Social Research Council.  Interviews were performed in 47 countries, including 127 cities and 1,086 interviewees.  Further information on the project is available on the project website (https://commercialarbitrationineurope.wordpress.com).  5 interviews were performed in Greece, involving 14 participants, with all interviews taking place in Athens on 9 & 12 June 2023.  All interviews were performed by the author.  Interviews were recorded and then professionally transcribed.

AI.tldr: 本文基于在英国经济与社会研究理事会资助的研究项目中进行的访谈，探讨了希腊仲裁的基础，包括仲裁市场、仲裁社群、仲裁实践和仲裁机构等主题。
AI.research_question: 希腊仲裁的基础是什么？

title: Interrogating the Paradox--Availability of Funds and Paucity of Infrastructure/Social Amenities in Nigerian Local Government Areas: Conundrum of the Selected State (2011-2018)
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke and Federal University Otuoke

detail.title: Interrogating the Paradox--Availability of Funds and Paucity of Infrastructure/Social Amenities in Nigerian Local Government Areas: Conundrum of the Selected State (2011-2018)
detail.abstract: Concerns have been expressed very often as to why the intergovernmental relations in the federal system of many developing countries, especially in the Sub-Sahara Africa are predictably chequered. Lack of devolution of power to LGAs in Nigeria is usually at the expense of grassroots development especially with regards to infrastructure/social amenities. Besides, the confusion surrounding progressive decline in provision of rural infrastructure to the local government areas of the state despite humongous monthly fiscal allocations to the LGAs by Federation Account Allocation Committee (FAAC) equally creates existential problems to the rural dwellers. It is on this note that the study seeks to investigate the apparently disturbing paradox in Imo State. Data were sourced from both secondary and primary sources. Secondary data was sourced from government gazette and related literature while primary data was elicited from respondents through structured questionnaire. Multiple regression and graphical/pictorial analytical techniques were used for secondary and primary data respectively. The findings indicated that lack of transformative leadership exhibited in embezzlement of funds and indifference in leadership on the part of the State agents were the significant causes of poor development in the rural areas of Imo State. The study recommended inter alia; the enforcement of attitudinal change and punitive sanctions on the political and administrative classes in the state through legal measures to protect public funds for service delivery.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了尼日利亚伊莫州地方政府发展困境的悖论：尽管有巨额财政拨款，但农村基础设施持续恶化。研究发现缺乏变革型领导和腐败是主要原因，建议通过法律措施实施态度转变和惩罚性制裁。
AI.research_question: 为什么尼日利亚伊莫州地方政府在获得巨额财政拨款的情况下，农村基础设施仍持续恶化？
AI.motivation: 关注发展中国家联邦制度中政府间关系的困境，特别是尼日利亚地方政府权力下放不足导致基层发展受阻，以及巨额财政拨款与农村基础设施持续衰退之间的悖论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 联邦制度下的政府间关系理论、权力下放理论、变革型领导理论
AI.method: 混合研究方法：从政府公报和相关文献获取二手数据，通过结构化问卷获取一手数据；使用多元回归分析二手数据，图形/图示分析技术分析一手数据
AI.findings: 缺乏变革型领导、资金挪用和领导漠不关心是伊莫州农村地区发展滞后的重要原因
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家联邦制度中政府间关系困境的理解，特别是权力下放与基层发展之间的关系
AI.practical_contributions: 建议通过法律措施强制实施态度转变和对政治行政阶层的惩罚性制裁，以保护公共资金用于服务提供

title: Public Sector Organizational Performance in Nigeria: A Benefit-Cost Involution Implementation of Treasury Single Account (TSA)
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke and Federal University Otuoke

detail.title: Public Sector Organizational Performance in Nigeria: A Benefit-Cost Involution Implementation of Treasury Single Account (TSA)
detail.abstract: The study examined the benefit-cost involution of the implementation of treasury single account in respect to public sector organizational performance in Nigeria. As a descriptive research work with heavy dependence on secondary data, after due introduction and conceptualization of the key concepts of the research study-Treasury Single Account and Public Sector Organization, retrospect of Nigerian public sector organizations, rational for the adoption of TSA in public sector organizations in Nigeria, preconditions for setting up TSA, functions of TSA, types of account under a TSA System, and operation of TSA in public sector organizations in Nigeria were examined. The findings of the study revealed that the operation or implementation of TSA in public sector organizations in Nigeria has its own benefits and costs. Therefore, for the benefits of implementing TSA in public sector organizations in Nigeria to over poise the costs, the study recommended that the federal government should show the political will to assure the policy's long-term viability, as well as tenaciously push TSA implementation at both state and local government levels across the country to ensure the success of TSA policy in promoting public sector organization performance in Nigeria among others.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了尼日利亚实施国库单一账户对公共部门组织绩效的成本效益关系，发现实施TSA既有收益也有成本，建议联邦政府展现政治意愿以确保政策长期可行性，并在全国各级推行TSA实施。

title: Voter Apathy in Nigerian Electoral Democracy: An Insidious Enigma to National Development
affiliations: Federal University Otuoke, Alex Ekwueme Federal University and Gregory University

detail.title: Voter Apathy in Nigerian Electoral Democracy: An Insidious Enigma to National Development
detail.abstract: This paper examines voter apathy in Nigerian electoral democracy as an insidious enigma to national development, with an emphasis on the 2023 General Elections. Elections in democracies play a vital role in ensuring the representation of popular will and securing the legitimacy of the political system. However, in situations where voter apathy is pronounced in the electoral processes of democratic countries, national development in such countries is nearly defeated. Voter apathy remains an insidious enigma for national development, and Nigeria provides an example of such a country. What is the way out? To answer this question, the paper made use of the decision-making theory by Richard Synder as its theoretical framework, adopted a qualitative research design, relied on secondary sources of data, and analyzed the collected data using the qualitative content data analysis method. The findings of the study revealed the factors causing voters' apathy in Nigerian electoral democracy and their consequences on the country's national development. Recommendations were made based on the findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了尼日利亚选举民主中的选民冷漠问题，重点关注2023年大选。研究发现选民冷漠是阻碍国家发展的隐蔽难题，并揭示了导致选民冷漠的因素及其对国家发展的影响。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚选举民主中选民冷漠对国家发展的影响是什么？如何解决这一问题？

AI.theoretical_framework: Richard Synder的决策理论
AI.method: 定性研究设计，依赖二手数据来源，采用定性内容数据分析方法
AI.findings: 揭示了尼日利亚选举民主中导致选民冷漠的因素及其对国家发展的后果

title: An Evaluation of the Impact of Training and Development on Organisational Performance: A Case Study of the Department of Economic Development in the Gauteng Province
affiliations: NATIONAL ELECTRONIC MEDIA INSTITUTE OF SOUTH AFRICA

detail.title: An Evaluation of the Impact of Training and Development on Organisational Performance: A Case Study of the Department of Economic Development in the Gauteng Province
detail.abstract: In contemporary studies, most organisations consider employee training and development as the foundation for gaining a sustainable competitive advantage. Contrarily, the influence of training and development on organisational performance in the South African public-sector remains fundamentally unexamined. This study is thus concerned with an evaluation of the impact of training and development on organisational performance using a case study of the Provincial Department of Economic Development in the Gauteng Province.  The main problem identified in this study is that there is a lack of knowledge of the impact of training and development on organisational performance within the Gauteng Provincial Department of Economic Development. In South Africa, public-sector organisations do not evaluate the impact of training and development programmes and/or they repeatedly evaluate training inadequately. This study argues that the impact of training and development in the public-sector organisations lacks evaluation.  This study used a descriptive quantitative research design. A survey enabled the collection of primary data (structured questionnaire). Data analysis employed descriptive statistics and inferential statistics. The sample included 131 employees. This study used a simple random sampling technique to select each population element.  The main findings of the study are that training has a positive impact on the performance of the employees in the department. The department provides training programmes that are not relevant to the tasks of employees. Training evaluation is the most ignored step in the training process and the department do not know how to evaluate training. The department does not have a tool to measure the impact of training and development. The study therefore recommends that the department should implement training and development programmes strategically. It should provide continuous training programmes and should adopt Kirkpatrick’s model for evaluating training. It should provide its employees with feedback. Employees must receive training in areas relevant to their tasks.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了南非豪登省经济发展部门培训与发展对组织绩效的影响，发现培训对员工绩效有积极影响，但存在培训内容与任务不相关、培训评估缺失等问题。
AI.research_question: 培训与发展对南非公共部门组织绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 大多数组织认为员工培训是获得可持续竞争优势的基础，但南非公共部门培训与发展对组织绩效的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 培训与发展理论，组织绩效理论
AI.method: 描述性定量研究设计，使用结构化问卷调查收集主要数据，采用描述性统计和推断性统计进行数据分析，样本包括131名员工，采用简单随机抽样技术。
AI.findings: 培训对部门员工绩效有积极影响；部门提供的培训项目与员工任务不相关；培训评估是培训过程中最被忽视的环节；部门不知道如何评估培训；部门没有衡量培训与发展影响的工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了南非公共部门培训与发展影响研究的空白，为培训评估理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议部门战略性地实施培训与发展项目，提供持续培训，采用柯克帕特里克模型评估培训，向员工提供反馈，确保培训内容与任务相关。

title: Global Risks in Higher Education: Emergence of a Risk-Based Leadership Model.
affiliations: Center for AI and Digital Policy

detail.title: Global Risks in Higher Education: Emergence of a Risk-Based Leadership Model.
detail.abstract:
Higher education in the United States has played an important role in the economic and social growth of the nation (Burkhardt, 2007). Marginson and Rhoades (2002) contended that imperial models from Great Britain and France influenced the ideology and structure of the early U.S. higher education. The U.S. model for higher education comprises a mix of public and private actors supporting and funding colleges and universities, who exercise academic freedom (p. 288). The power of U.S. corporations abroad has driven the influence of American higher education in global environments. Essential to the analysis of global influences is the consideration that higher education institutions also shape the policies of global and national organizations. International students populate the classrooms in the United States, bringing with them a myriad of cultures, beliefs, and educational needs that are transforming the educational arena (Chen & Barett, 2000).

This document will present an analysis of the challenges of globalization in American higher education as described in the Glonacal Model (Marginson & Rhoades, 2002). A discussion on global leadership will be presented using the GLOBE project (Javidan et al, 2006) combined with the model of critical attributes of Newman, Couturier, and Scurry (2004). The last two sections include a proposal of enhancement of Bolt’s (2000) Three-dimension Leadership Model. The Three-Dimensional Framework for Global Higher Education (Thomson, 2009) will include global risk considerations, emotional intelligence competencies, and GLOBE leadership dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了全球化对美国高等教育的挑战，基于Glonacal模型探讨了全球领导力问题，并提出改进Bolt三维领导力模型的框架。
AI.research_question: 全球化如何影响美国高等教育，以及如何构建适应全球化挑战的领导力模型？
AI.motivation: 美国高等教育在国家经济和社会发展中发挥重要作用，但面临全球化带来的文化多样性、教育需求变化等挑战，需要重新思考领导力模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: Glonacal模型（Marginson & Rhoades, 2002）、GLOBE项目（Javidan et al, 2006）、Newman等人的关键属性模型、Bolt三维领导力模型（2000）
AI.method: 理论分析和模型构建方法，整合现有理论框架提出新的三维高等教育全球框架
AI.findings: 提出了包含全球风险考量、情绪智力能力和GLOBE领导力维度的三维高等教育全球框架
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Bolt的三维领导力模型，整合了全球风险、情绪智力和文化维度，为高等教育全球化研究提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构应对全球化挑战提供了实用的领导力发展框架，有助于培养具备全球视野和跨文化能力的领导者

title: Mapping the relationship between transformational leadership, trust in leadership and employee championing behavior during organizational change
affiliations: BRAC University , University of Malaya (UM) and University of Malaya

detail.title: Mapping the relationship between transformational leadership, trust in leadership and employee championing behavior during organizational change
detail.abstract: Linking social bond theory and psychological contract theory, this study examined the influence of transformational leadership on employee championing behavior and tested the mediating role of trust in leadership between transformational leadership and championing behavior in the context of organizational change. This study collected data through a questionnaire survey from 300 full-time employees who were working in Bangladesh's banking sector. The structural equation modelling technique was used to test the proposed hypothesizes. The results of this study reveal that transformation leadership significantly influences employee trust in leadership and championing behavior during organizational change. Also, this study uncovers the mediating effect of trust in leadership in the relationship between transformational leadership and employee championing behavior during organizational change.

AI.tldr: 本研究结合社会纽带理论和心理契约理论，探讨了变革型领导对员工拥护行为的影响，并验证了领导信任在变革型领导与拥护行为之间的中介作用。通过对孟加拉国银行业300名全职员工的问卷调查，研究发现变革型领导显著影响员工对领导的信任和拥护行为，且领导信任在两者关系中起中介作用。

AI.findings: 变革型领导显著影响员工对领导的信任和拥护行为；领导信任在变革型领导与员工拥护行为之间起中介作用
