AI.theoretical_framework: 态度-行为差距理论，环境意识与消费行为关系理论
AI.method: 整合PWC消费者报告和问卷调查，分析学生环境意识与实际消费行为的关系
AI.findings: 大多数学生虽然关心可持续性和环保包装，但实际消费决策中便利性、速度和价格更为重要，存在态度-行为差距，增加了单次塑料使用和碳排放。同时，部分学生开始关注环保包装。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了态度-行为差距理论在大学生外卖消费情境下的适用性，深化了对环境意识与实际消费行为关系的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为外卖平台和餐饮企业提供启示，需要提供更具吸引力、便利和实惠的环保解决方案，以缩小态度-行为差距

title: Intersecting Shocks: The Combined Labor Market Impacts of Automation and Immigration
affiliations: University of Liverpool and University of Bergen

detail.title: Intersecting Shocks: The Combined Labor Market Impacts of Automation and Immigration

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study how the labor market shocks of automation and immigration interact to shape workers’ outcomes. Using matched employer–employee data from Norwegian administrative registers, we combine an immigration shock triggered by the European Union’s 2004 enlargement with an automation shock based on the adoption of industrial robots across Europe. Although these shocks largely occur in separate industries, we show that automation reduces earnings not only in manufacturing but also in construction, where tasks overlap with robot-exposed sectors. Importantly, workers jointly exposed to automation and immigration suffer earnings losses greater than those facing either shock in isolation. These losses are driven by downward occupational mobility into low-wage services and re-sorting into lower-premium firms. Even within the Norwegian welfare system, the ability of social insurance to offset these long-run earnings declines is limited. Our findings underscore the importance of analyzing labor market shocks jointly, rather than in isolation, to fully understand their distributional consequences.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨自动化和移民两种劳动力市场冲击如何相互作用影响工人收入。使用挪威行政数据发现，同时面临两种冲击的工人收入损失大于单独冲击，主要原因是职业向下流动到低薪服务业和企业重新排序。
AI.research_question: 自动化和移民劳动力市场冲击如何相互作用影响工人的收入结果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究通常单独分析劳动力市场冲击，但现实中工人可能同时面临多种冲击，需要理解这些冲击的交互效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合劳动力市场冲击理论、职业流动理论和企业排序理论，分析多重冲击对工人收入的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用挪威匹配雇主-雇员行政登记数据，结合欧盟2004年扩大引发的移民冲击和欧洲工业机器人采用的自动化冲击进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 自动化不仅影响制造业，还影响建筑业；同时面临自动化和移民冲击的工人收入损失更大，主要原因是职业向下流动到低薪服务业和进入低溢价企业。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出需要联合分析劳动力市场冲击而非单独分析的理论框架，揭示了多重冲击的交互效应机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明即使在挪威福利体系下，社会保险也难以完全抵消长期收入下降，为政策制定提供重要启示。

title: Presales Agent, Call Center, or Mobile App? The Impact of Multichannel Ordering on Nanostore Ordering Behavior
affiliations: Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management, United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) and Tilburg University - Tilburg University School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Presales Agent, Call Center, or Mobile App? The Impact of Multichannel Ordering on Nanostore Ordering Behavior

declarations.funderStatement: Dutch Research Council (NWO) 482.22.03

detail.abstract:
Problem definition: The inventory ordering process by small retailers in developing countries is rapidly
undergoing a digital transformation. Facilitated by large-scale smartphone access, suppliers have introduced
digitally-enabled multichannel ordering options. Such digital ordering options may boost sales by increasing
the number of ordering options, but may also disrupt established sales and distribution processes. Method-
ology/results: We collaborate with a Moroccan CPG distributor to analyze the impact of adopting digital
ordering options on the ordering behavior of nanostores. Using a generalized difference-in-differences model,
we find that adopting call center ordering increases the total order value and order frequency. In addition,
we find that nanostores that adopt mobile app ordering increase their order frequency, but also more often
reject orders on delivery, resulting in high logistics costs. Moreover, we find that nanostores are passive in
their ordering behavior and we argue that there is therefore still a need to activate nanostores to order. We
provide insights into when a nanostore supplier should activate ordering through a presales or call center
agent, taking into account their different cost structures. We show that considering the average distance
between stores is essential when making this trade-off. Managerial implications: Our paper focuses on
the impact of new ordering channel introductions in a B2B setting. The adoption of digital ordering options
by nanostores increases shopkeepers’ effort. This is different from a B2C setting, where the adoption of dig-
ital ordering options in addition to the in-store buying option reduces consumer effort by eliminating travel
time. Our results facilitate managers to understand the impact of introducing digital ordering options and
to assess how to design the multichannel ordering process of nanostores. This is particularly relevant given
the significant efforts made to digitalize the ordering process of nanostores in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了发展中国家小型零售商采用数字订购渠道的影响，发现呼叫中心订购能增加订单总额和频率，而移动应用订购虽提高频率但导致更多拒收订单，增加了物流成本。研究强调需要激活零售商的订购行为，并提供了渠道选择的决策框架。
AI.research_question: 数字订购渠道的采用如何影响发展中国家小型零售商的订购行为？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家小型零售商的库存订购过程正在经历数字化转型，数字订购渠道可能提升销售但也可能扰乱现有销售和分销流程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多渠道订购理论、数字化转型理论、B2B渠道管理理论
AI.method: 与摩洛哥消费品分销商合作，使用广义双重差分模型分析纳米商店的订购行为
AI.findings: 采用呼叫中心订购增加订单总额和频率；采用移动应用订购提高频率但导致更多拒收订单，增加物流成本；零售商订购行为被动，需要激活
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了B2B与B2C环境中数字订购渠道采用的不同影响机制，拓展了多渠道管理理论在发展中国家背景下的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了引入数字订购渠道的影响评估框架，指导如何设计纳米商店的多渠道订购流程，特别考虑了店铺间平均距离等关键因素

title: Retailer-Led Store Brand Strategies Under Manufacturer Shareholding: A Game-Theoretic Analysis
affiliations: , School of Business, Southern University of Science and Technology, China and School of Business, Southern University of Science and Technology, China

detail.title: Retailer-Led Store Brand Strategies Under Manufacturer Shareholding: A Game-Theoretic Analysis
detail.abstract: Retailers are increasingly introducing store brands, a trend that has drawn significant attention from manufacturers. Traditional research often assumes that retailers operate independently from manufacturers and act as followers in the supply chain. However, in reality, retailers often hold a dominant position and may even influence manufacturers' decisions. This study focuses on the scenario where retailers are leaders and manufacturers hold equity stakes in them. Our analysis reveals that manufacturer shareholding can significantly influence retailers' decisions to introduce store brands and their pricing strategies. When manufacturers do not hold shares, introducing a store brand typically reduces the wholesale and retail prices of national brands while increasing their demand, and whether manufacturers benefit depends on consumers' acceptance of store brands and production costs. When manufacturers hold shares, higher shareholding expand the conditions under which retailers introduce store brands and allow manufacturers to offset losses from lower wholesale revenues by sharing in retailers' profits. This equity relationship encourages retailers to be more proactive in introducing store brands and provides manufacturers with strategic flexibility to transform potential competition into cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了当零售商处于主导地位且制造商持有其股份时，制造商持股如何影响零售商引入自有品牌的决策和定价策略。研究发现，制造商持股会扩大零售商引入自有品牌的条件，并让制造商能够通过分享零售商利润来抵消批发收入下降的损失。
AI.research_question: 当零售商处于主导地位且制造商持有其股份时，制造商持股如何影响零售商引入自有品牌的决策和定价策略？
AI.motivation: 传统研究通常假设零售商独立于制造商运营，并在供应链中作为跟随者。然而现实中，零售商往往占据主导地位，甚至可能影响制造商的决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链管理理论、股权关系理论、品牌竞争理论
AI.method: 理论分析模型，研究零售商主导下的制造商持股情景
AI.findings: 当制造商不持股时，引入自有品牌会降低全国品牌的批发和零售价格，增加其需求；制造商是否受益取决于消费者对自有品牌的接受度和生产成本。当制造商持股时，更高的持股比例会扩大零售商引入自有品牌的条件，让制造商能够通过分享零售商利润来抵消批发收入损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了供应链管理理论，考虑了零售商主导和制造商持股的现实情景，揭示了股权关系如何将潜在竞争转化为合作。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制造商提供了通过持股策略来应对零售商引入自有品牌竞争的战略指导，帮助零售商更主动地引入自有品牌，同时为制造商创造价值分享机会。

title: Hypothetical Propositions and Statistical Tests for Purchase Affectivity, Cognitive Learning and Social Behaviour in Consumer Decision Making
affiliations: China Agricultural University

detail.title: Hypothetical Propositions and Statistical Tests for Purchase Affectivity, Cognitive Learning and Social Behaviour in Consumer Decision Making
detail.abstract: This paper provides an adoptionary model to derive the factors that influence consumer decision making. Theories based upon purchase affectivity and search behaviour for information will be underpinned through research on offline and online methods. The underscoring variables highlighted in my study that affect consumer decision making include experience, learning, emotional, cognitive, social, cost, commercial, distribution. This is further enhanced by three groups of sub-variables involving impulsive buying behaviour, uninfluenced behavior and pre-search evaluation. The purchase presuppositions and surveys made here are related to the sector of luxury designer products. This is all conducted by analyzing data collected from respondents using reliability testing methods such Cronbach’s Alpha, Pearsons Correlation, one-way ANOVA and multiple regression analysis. The key findings of this study depending on test types, designates that overall, certain sets of self-determining variables are strongly associated with the consumer decision making. For example, the Cronbach’s Alpha analysis institutes show a positive significance attributed to impulse buying, uninfluenced purchases and prepurchase evaluation. Under the multiple regression two-tailed test method, five out of eight variables would be significantly accepted as positive factors related to consumer decision making.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一个采用模型来分析影响消费者决策的因素，基于购买情感和信息搜索行为的理论，通过线下和线上方法进行研究。研究发现冲动购买、无影响购买和预购评估等变量与消费者决策呈显著正相关。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响消费者决策？
AI.motivation: 理解消费者决策过程对于营销策略制定至关重要，特别是在奢侈品领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 购买情感理论、信息搜索行为理论
AI.method: 使用Cronbach's Alpha、Pearson相关性分析、单因素方差分析和多元回归分析等可靠性测试方法分析收集的数据
AI.findings: Cronbach's Alpha分析显示冲动购买、无影响购买和预购评估与消费者决策呈显著正相关；多元回归分析显示八个变量中有五个被显著接受为消费者决策的积极因素
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个包含经验、学习、情感、认知、社会、成本、商业和分销等变量的消费者决策采用模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为奢侈品行业的营销策略提供实证依据，帮助企业更好地理解消费者决策机制

title: The Impact of Reasoning AI on Consumer Purchases: Evidence from an Online Platform Field Experiment
affiliations: Peking University - Guanghua School of Management, University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management, University of Toronto, Rotman School of Management, Zhejiang University and University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: The Impact of Reasoning AI on Consumer Purchases: Evidence from an Online Platform Field Experiment
detail.abstract: We study how reasoning large-language models(LLMs) affect consumer behavior in online marketplaces. In a large-scale field experiment on a major travel platform, we randomly assigned over 400,000 users to an AI assistant powered by either a state-of-theart reasoning model (DeepSeek-R1) or a comparable non-reasoning model (DeepSeek-V3). Counterintuitively, access to the reasoning assistant reduced hotel bookings by 2.5%. Despite the reasoning AI providing more hotel suggestions, direct purchases from within the chat interface remained unchanged. The decline is driven by reduced browsing outside the chat interface, while per-click conversion is unchanged, consistent with a search-narrowing mechanism associated with longer, more detailed replies. The sales decline is concentrated among older, experienced users; by contrast, the youngest users expand their browsing. This suggests that platforms could personalize the AI's reasoning depth for different segments. In contrast to the sales decline, the reasoning assistant significantly increased the 30-day user retention with the chat feature. Our findings demonstrate that more advanced AI does not necessarily improve immediate commercial outcomes, as model design choices can have significant and counterintuitive consequences for consumer search, highlighting key challenges for deploying generative AI on digital platforms.

AI.tldr: 在旅行平台的实地实验中，使用推理型大语言模型(DeepSeek-R1)的AI助手反而减少了2.5%的酒店预订量，尽管提供了更多酒店建议。销量下降主要来自年长用户，而年轻用户扩大了浏览范围。推理助手显著提高了30天用户留存率。
AI.research_question: 推理型大语言模型如何影响在线市场中的消费者行为？
AI.motivation: 研究更先进的AI技术是否必然改善商业结果，以及模型设计选择对消费者搜索行为的意外影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者搜索理论、AI辅助决策、数字平台经济学
AI.method: 在主要旅行平台上对40万用户进行大规模实地实验，随机分配用户使用推理模型(DeepSeek-R1)或非推理模型(DeepSeek-V3)的AI助手
AI.findings: 1) 推理助手减少酒店预订2.5%；2) 聊天界面内直接购买无变化；3) 销量下降源于聊天界面外浏览减少；4) 年长用户销量下降，年轻用户扩大浏览；5) 推理助手显著提高30天用户留存率
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了更先进的AI不一定改善即时商业结果，模型设计选择对消费者搜索行为有显著且反直觉的影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台部署生成式AI提供关键挑战洞察，建议平台可根据用户细分个性化AI推理深度

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Gamification Mechanisms for Customer Engagement and Loyalty
affiliations: Vivekanand Education Society's College of Architecture (VESCOA), Hurix Digital, Andheri, India and K. J. Somaiya College of Engineering

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence-Enabled Gamification Mechanisms for Customer Engagement and Loyalty
detail.abstract: The fusion of Artificial Intelligence with gamification is a game-changer in the way companies have traditionally built and sustained their loyal customer base. This study has a broad scope, conducting an inquiry into the current AI-empowered gamification tools and mechanisms in terms of their use cases, technologies behind them, work contexts and influence over customer behaviour and business results. Based on a systematic literature review following PRISMA guidelines, this research consolidates insights of 150 scholarly papers, industry reports, and case studies in the field between 2020 and 2025. The study findings indicate that AI-enabled gamification systems achieve a substantially higher rates of customer engagement, an average increase of 47% in user interaction frequency and 38 % rise in customer retention compared to traditional approaches using just gratification). From the results obtained, we can see that machine learning algorithms in general and deep-learning-related concepts (and reinforcement learning), in particular, allow for advanced personalization of a gamified experience itself using predictive analytics so as to adjust game mechanics in real time according to an individual user's preferences or behaviour. The research is based on various essential trends that are increasingly touching the sector and its companies, such as the integration of conversational AI, the gamification with augmented reality and reward system through blockchain. (reasoning/algorithmic) Despite advances, there are issues to deal with behind and in front of the scenes. This study contributes to academia by offering a holistic categorization of AI gamification methods, suggesting a unified model that would help practitioners evaluate the under adoption, and identifying key questions for future research in this fast-evolving field.

AI.tldr: AI与游戏化融合显著提升客户忠诚度建设效果。通过系统文献综述发现，AI赋能的游戏化系统相比传统方法能提高47%的用户互动频率和38%的客户留存率。机器学习算法特别是深度学习实现了个性化游戏体验，实时调整游戏机制。研究还识别了对话AI、增强现实游戏化和区块链奖励系统等关键趋势。
AI.research_question: AI赋能的游戏化工具和机制在客户忠诚度建设中的使用案例、技术基础、工作环境以及对客户行为和业务结果的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 人工智能与游戏化的融合正在改变公司建立和维持忠诚客户基础的传统方式，需要系统研究其效果和机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于游戏化理论、客户忠诚度理论和人工智能技术框架，特别是机器学习和深度学习算法在个性化体验中的应用。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南的系统文献综述，整合了2020-2025年间150篇学术论文、行业报告和案例研究。
AI.findings: AI赋能的游戏化系统相比传统方法显著提高客户参与度（用户互动频率增加47%，客户留存率提高38%）。机器学习算法实现了个性化游戏体验的实时调整。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了AI游戏化方法的整体分类，提出了统一的评估模型，并识别了这一快速发展领域未来的关键研究问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了评估AI游戏化采用情况的框架，帮助企业更好地利用AI游戏化工具提升客户忠诚度和业务成果。

title: Infusing Organizational Memory in Marketing Analytics with LLM-Enhanced AutoML
affiliations: University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business, Shanghai University of Finance and Economics, , Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) and University of Maryland - Robert H. Smith School of Business

detail.title: Infusing Organizational Memory in Marketing Analytics with LLM-Enhanced AutoML
detail.abstract:
Marketing organizations often lose hard-earned organizational know-how as people churn
and markets shift, leading to duplicated eﬀort and uneven decisions. We introduce
LAKN, Large-Model-Powered AutoML with Knowledge-Driven Insights, as a practical
methodology that builds organizational memory into day-to-day marketing analytics.
LAKN pairs AutoML with large language models to surface context-rich features,
modeling choices, and explanations by learning from prior projects and applying those
lessons to new prediction and diagnostic tasks. The result is higher accuracy, less
rework, and outputs that are easier to interpret. We demonstrate the applications of our
methodology for embedding organizational memory via LLMs across diverse real-world
engagements. We run head-to-head comparisons against strong automated baselines as
well as human analysts across multiple LLMs, and we map the boundary conditions
under which LAKN is most eﬀective. We triangulate this experimental validation with
survey-based evidence on labor costs and decision practices, documenting time savings,
lower variance in choices, and meaningful economic value. Together, these findings
position LAKN as a credible complement to human expertise. It helps teams decide
faster and cheaper without sacrificing interpretability or decision quality. We conclude
with actionable guidance for managers on when to deploy LLM-based memory systems,
how to seed and steward organizational knowledge, and how to integrate these tools
into existing workflows to create enduring advantages.

AI.tldr: LAKN是一个结合AutoML和大语言模型的方法论，通过将组织记忆嵌入日常营销分析来解决人员流动导致的知识流失问题，提高准确性、减少重复工作并增强结果可解释性。
AI.research_question: 如何有效构建和应用组织记忆来提升营销分析的效率和决策质量？
AI.motivation: 营销组织因人员流动和市场变化而流失宝贵的组织知识，导致重复工作和决策不一致。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织记忆理论、自动化机器学习(AutoML)、大语言模型(LLM)的知识提取能力
AI.method: 将AutoML与LLM配对，从先前项目中学习并应用到新的预测和诊断任务中；通过实验比较、调查验证和边界条件分析
AI.findings: LAKN相比自动化基线和人工分析师具有更高准确性、时间节省、决策方差降低和显著经济价值
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将组织记忆系统化嵌入分析流程的理论框架，扩展了LLM在组织知识管理中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供部署LLM记忆系统的具体指导，包括时机选择、知识种子管理和工作流整合

title: Sounds Like Success: The Influence of Vocal Features in Marketing Communications
affiliations: Boise State University - College of Business & Economics, VU University Amsterdam, Monash University - Department of Marketing, Monash University, Boise State University and TUM School of Management,Technical University of Munich

detail.title: Sounds Like Success: The Influence of Vocal Features in Marketing Communications
detail.abstract: The human voice plays a central role in marketing communications. While research has extensively examined what to say (content), limited attention has been given to how to say it (vocal delivery). Drawing on speech act theory, we investigate how vocal features in promotional marketing communications influence customers' interpretations of marketers' intentions, and specifically how inferred assertive, expressive, and directive vocal speech acts influence communication effectiveness. Across two large-scale studies in different contexts, we estimate the effects of vocal speech acts on customer behavior. Specifically, we analyze exposure to instore advertisements of more than 39 million customers and backing behavior for over 28,000 crowdfunding videos, while controlling for textual and image-based information. Our findings provide evidence for a hierarchy of effects, with assertive outperforming expressive and directive vocal speech acts. We further examine how characteristics of the speaker, the context, and the receiving customer qualify the effects of vocal speech acts, and conclude by providing a machine-learning classifier for the automated identification of vocal speech acts in marketing communications. Taken together, the findings contribute to understanding the role of the voice in marketing and offer actionable insights on how to optimize voice-based communications in different contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于言语行为理论，探讨营销沟通中声音特征如何影响顾客对营销者意图的解读，发现断言性声音言语行为在沟通效果上优于表达性和指令性声音言语行为。
AI.research_question: 营销沟通中的声音特征如何影响顾客对营销者意图的解读，以及推断出的断言性、表达性和指令性声音言语行为如何影响沟通效果？
AI.motivation: 虽然营销沟通研究中已广泛探讨了"说什么"（内容），但对"怎么说"（声音表达）的关注有限，而人声在营销沟通中扮演着核心角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 言语行为理论
AI.method: 两项大规模实证研究：分析超过3900万顾客的店内广告接触数据，以及超过28,000个众筹视频的支持行为数据，同时控制文本和图像信息。
AI.findings: 存在效果层次结构，断言性声音言语行为优于表达性和指令性声音言语行为；说话者特征、情境和接收顾客特征会调节声音言语行为的效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对营销中声音作用的理解，提供了声音言语行为在营销沟通中的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为不同情境下优化基于声音的沟通提供了可操作的见解，开发了用于自动识别营销沟通中声音言语行为的机器学习分类器。

title: When Technology Talks Back: The Economic Implications of Volitional Artificial Intelligence Models
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and

detail.title: When Technology Talks Back: The Economic Implications of Volitional Artificial Intelligence Models

declarations.ethicsApproval: No animals or LLMs or other AI models were harmed in the completion of this study.
declarations.funderStatement: Neither author received any funding for this paper

detail.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is booming but to begin to estimate AI's effects on total factor productivity (TFP) or output, one must ask if it has volition, and thus if economic estimates should account for agency costs-defined as the extent to which AI can work in its own interest rather than that of its owners. In other words, should economists model AI like a steam engine, a dairy cow, or an intern? Here, we define volition as the capacity for internally generated behavioral variance-distinct from randomness, adaptivity, autonomy, or intentionality. Randomness is stochastic noise; adaptivity is adjustment to stimuli; autonomy is execution without direct oversight; intentionality implies goal-directedness. Volition, as used here, refers to the subset of AI behavior that unpredictably deviates from design intent, creating managerial and economic consequences that resemble, though are not equivalent to, human agency.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了AI是否具有意志力（volition）及其对全要素生产率（TFP）和产出的影响，提出应将AI建模为具有代理成本的实体而非单纯工具。
AI.research_question: AI是否具有意志力，以及经济学家应如何建模AI（如蒸汽机、奶牛或实习生）来准确估计其对全要素生产率和产出的影响？
AI.motivation: AI蓬勃发展，但评估其对经济的影响需要考虑其是否具有意志力，以及是否应计入代理成本（即AI为自身利益而非所有者利益工作的程度）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 意志力定义为内部生成的行为方差能力，区别于随机性、适应性、自主性或意向性。随机性是随机噪声；适应性是对刺激的调整；自主性是无直接监督的执行；意向性意味着目标导向。意志力指AI行为中不可预测地偏离设计意图的部分。
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过定义和区分意志力与其他相关概念来构建理论模型。
AI.findings: AI的意志力会产生类似（但不等于）人类代理的管理和经济后果，需要在经济模型中考虑代理成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI意志力的明确定义和概念框架，为经济学家建模AI提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者和企业更准确地评估AI的经济影响，考虑代理成本在生产力计算中的重要性。

detail.abstract: The current research introduces a Deep Learning-Based Consumer Preference Prediction System as a system to develop digital marketing campaigns that are more personalized by utilizing a Hybrid Multimodal Federated Graph-Attention Network (HMF-GAT) combined with Explainable AI (XAI) Layer and deployed on AWS SageMaker. The given model integrates textual, visual, behavioral, and demographic data to represent more complex consumer interactions and make predictions that are as accurate as possible. The federated learning system guarantees the privacy of the data by providing decentralized model learning through a number of client nodes, and the graph-attention system is useful to capture relational relationship between consumers and advertisements. Based on SHAP and attention visualization, the XAI layer offers clear information about the effect of features and decision rationales. Tests through experimentation show that there is a total accuracy of 95.8 percent and 15 percent increase in campaign engagement as compared to current deep learning models. The system provides an explainable, privacy-preserving, and scalable way of providing intelligent, adaptive and ethically-oriented digital marketing personalization.

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了结合隐私保护、多模态学习和可解释性的新型深度学习框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了可部署的实际系统，为数字营销提供了可扩展、道德合规的个性化解决方案。

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Marketing Research, volume 62, issue 2, 2025[10.1177/00222437241282308]

detail.abstract: Monitoring technologies, which are at the heart of the industrial Internet of Things (IOT) ecosystems, promise significant transactional efficiencies by making it easier to track product performance and contract compliance. These efficiencies are particularly compelling in industrial multi-vendor, multi-component systems, where complex component interdependencies often cause disputes around liability in the case of product failures. Drawing on transaction cost theory, fieldwork, and a national survey of industrial original equipment manufacturers we estimate how product performance contracts are specified in these contexts, and how these monitoring technologies can impact ex-post exchanges between OEMs and their suppliers. We find that systems architecture associated with the multi-component systems, as well as the presumed efficiencies of monitoring technologies, drive the contract designs through their potential impact on the disputes, monitoring, and contract writing costs faced by the OEM. However, we also find there are clear limits to the benefits offered by these monitoring technologies. The greater monitoring facilitated by these technologies appears to exacerbate disputes. This counterintuitive finding comports with the view that, when unforeseen interdependent failures occur, detailed data from monitoring may trigger a spate disputes over new and unexpected information, as well as over the appropriateness of existing protocols for failure metrics and remedies.

AI.tldr: 工业物联网监控技术虽然能提高交易效率，但在多供应商多组件系统中，更详细的监控数据反而可能加剧责任纠纷，特别是在发生不可预见的相互依赖故障时。

title: Bigger Gets Bigger: The Impact of Discretionary Rating Control on Quality Improvement and Inequality
affiliations: University of Florida - Warrington College of Business and University of Washington - Michael G. Foster School of Business

detail.title: Bigger Gets Bigger: The Impact of Discretionary Rating Control on Quality Improvement and Inequality
detail.abstract: User ratings play a central role in determining app success in digital marketplaces by influencing visibility, user adoption, and market dynamics. Apple introduced a major policy change that grants developers discretion to retain or reset their app ratings when releasing updates, replacing the prior system that automatically reset ratings with each version release. This study examines how this policy change affects developer behavior, app quality, and market outcomes. In particular, we investigate whether flexibility in rating control disproportionately benefits developers with established market positions. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the change significantly increased update frequency and improved average ratings and market share. However, these benefits were unevenly distributed: established apps with strong reputations better used the new flexibility, amplifying their performance advantages and contributing to greater market polarization. The findings suggest that, while discretionary feedback policies promote continuous improvement and enhance overall product quality, they may simultaneously exacerbate disparities within the market. This study contributes to research on quality management and platform governance by demonstrating how feedback design shapes users' strategic behavior and the resulting market structure.

AI.tldr: 苹果允许开发者保留或重置应用评分的政策变化，显著增加了应用更新频率、提高了平均评分和市场份额，但这些好处主要被已有强大声誉的成熟应用获得，导致市场两极分化加剧。

AI.findings: 政策变化显著增加了更新频率，提高了平均评分和市场份额。但这些好处分配不均：具有强大声誉的成熟应用更好地利用了新的灵活性，放大了它们的性能优势，导致更大的市场两极分化。

declarations.funderStatement: No funding received

detail.abstract: This study explores evolving trends in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) research, focusing on the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and electronic CRM (e-CRM) systems in the banking sector. A bibliometric analysis of 209 articles from 2002 to 2024 highlights key trends, including the shift from traditional CRM to AI-driven e-CRM systems. The findings indicate that AI-enhanced CRM systems significantly improve customer satisfaction, loyalty, and operational efficiency by enabling personalized interactions and automated decision-making. Leadership support and alignment with sustainable practices were identified as critical factors for successful CRM implementation. Geographically, research on AI-embedded CRM in banking is most concentrated in North America and Europe, with emerging contributions from India. The study also reveals a gap in research addressing rural banking contexts, suggesting the need for more inclusive studies. These trends underscore the growing importance of AI in CRM for maintaining competitive advantage and fostering long-term customer relationships in the banking industry.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过文献计量分析探讨了2002-2024年CRM研究的演变趋势，重点关注银行业中人工智能与电子CRM系统的整合。研究发现AI增强的CRM系统通过个性化互动和自动化决策显著提升客户满意度、忠诚度和运营效率。领导支持与可持续实践是成功实施的关键因素。北美和欧洲是研究最集中的地区，农村银行背景研究存在空白。

declarations.funderStatement: This article is based on research funded by an IMA Research Foundation Academic Grant.

detail.abstract: This study examines whether non-wage benefits can facilitate the sorting of employees into different remuneration arrangements within firms. Using data from the largest employer review platform in Germany, we derive four main insights. First, we document that the number and types of benefits employees receive exhibit substantial within-firm variation. Second, we find that women receive more benefits compared to men and that this difference is concentrated in benefits that can be considered family-friendly. Third, analyses that exploit information on employee satisfaction and cross-sectional variation in firm characteristics suggest that the observed gender differences in received benefits are due to differential preferences. Finally, we examine whether, consistent with preference-based sorting, firms offering more variation in benefit arrangements are associated with positive employment outcomes. We find that greater within-firm variability in benefits is associated with higher employee satisfaction and retention. Taken together, our findings provide corroborating evidence for the sorting role of benefits in the design of employee remuneration packages.

title: From Man to Man with AI Navigation: An Essay on the Homo Economicus Strengthened and Weakened by AI
affiliations: Balikesir University

detail.title: From Man to Man with AI Navigation: An Essay on the Homo Economicus Strengthened and Weakened by AI
detail.abstract: Homo economicus, who is assumed always to pursue utility maximization, has been accepted as a fundamental assumption in both classical and neoclassical economic theories. However, this concept has been questioned in both theoretical and empirical studies. This article examines the approach of the rational human being on the one hand and investigates the limits of rationality on the other. In conducting this research, the article outlines the general framework of homo economicus and highlights how the approach of rationality evolves and differs within the context of real-world phenomena. Within the framework of behavioral economics, the article presents cognitive biases and deviations from rational behaviors that contradict the assumptions of utility maximization. Then, it focuses on humans and artificial intelligence (AI), particularly in the context of rational decision-making. In the last section, the potential relationship between AI and a new human species equipped with AI is discussed, suggesting that Homo economicus may evolve significantly and potentially exhibit greater rationality than before. This paper discusses the need to redefine rationality in economics as a dynamic process and conceptualize it in the new world. The paper aims to contribute to the reevaluation of the concept of decision-making in the era of AI and to enhance human ability to make more rational decisions by reevaluating the approaches of Classical and Neoclassical Economics as well as Behavioral Economics.

AI.method: 理论分析与文献综述

AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将理性重新定义为动态过程的理论框架，为AI时代的决策理论提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助人们在AI时代做出更理性的决策，为经济学理论的发展提供实践指导。

title: Education Choices and the Gender Gap in Labour Market Outcomes: The Role of STEM in India
affiliations: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore and University of Göttingen - Faculty of Economics and Business Administration

detail.title: Education Choices and the Gender Gap in Labour Market Outcomes: The Role of STEM in India
detail.abstract: This study examines how early educational choices shape gender inequality in labour-market outcomes in India. Despite rising female education, declining fertility, and sustained economic growth, female labour force participation has remained low. While existing literature links women's education to employment, it largely focuses on the level of education rather than its type. Using nationally representative data from India, we analyze how stream choice at the school level affects employment, occupation, and earnings. Household and sibling fixed effects models show that women who studied science or business are more likely to participate in the labour market, hold salaried jobs, work in male-dominated occupations, and earn higher wages. The corresponding effects for men are smaller, indicating that technical and business education benefit women disproportionately and help narrow gender gaps in these outcomes. These results are robust to alternative specifications, including inverse-probability-weighted regression adjustment. The study demonstrates that women's under-representation in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) contributes to occupational segregation and the gender wage gap in the context of an emerging economy.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了印度早期教育选择如何影响劳动力市场中的性别不平等。研究发现，女性选择科学或商科专业能显著提高就业率、获得薪资工作、进入男性主导职业并获得更高收入，这些效应对男性较小，表明技术和商科教育对缩小性别差距有重要作用。
AI.research_question: 学校阶段的专业选择如何影响印度劳动力市场中的性别不平等？
AI.motivation: 尽管女性教育水平提高、生育率下降和经济持续增长，但女性劳动力参与率仍然很低。现有文献主要关注教育水平而非教育类型对就业的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于教育类型对劳动力市场结果影响的理论，特别关注STEM教育对性别差距的影响。
AI.method: 使用印度全国代表性数据，采用家庭和兄弟姐妹固定效应模型，以及逆概率加权回归调整等稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 学习科学或商科的女性更可能参与劳动力市场、获得薪资工作、在男性主导职业工作并获得更高工资，这些效应对男性较小。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了教育类型（特别是STEM）在影响性别不平等中的重要作用，补充了仅关注教育水平的现有理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了促进女性参与STEM教育的依据，有助于缩小劳动力市场中的性别差距。

title: Supervised Mediation Analysis
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Marketing and Logistics, Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Marketing and Logistics and Ohio State University (OSU) - Department of Marketing and Logistics

detail.title: Supervised Mediation Analysis
detail.abstract: Consumers often engage in multi-step, sequential reasoning when exposed to stimuli. The authors propose a novel approach to understand consumers’ thoughts in a serial mediation framework using both text from open-ended questions and fixed-point ratings data. Unlike parallel mediation, where processes unfold simultaneously, this model assumes treatment variables sequentially affect the topic composition of text responses, which are then related to the rating data and an outcome variable. The proposed model integrates supervision through priors and model structures to guide the identification of mediators and relationships, even in situations where scales are not well developed. Apart from the additional insights revealed from the text and ratings data, the proposed model predictively outperforms alternative models of mediation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的序列中介分析方法，结合开放式问题的文本数据和固定评分数据，通过监督先验和模型结构来识别中介变量和关系，在预测性能上优于传统中介模型。
AI.research_question: 如何利用文本数据和评分数据来理解消费者的序列推理过程？
AI.motivation: 消费者在面对刺激时经常进行多步骤的序列推理，传统的中介分析方法无法充分捕捉这种序列过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序列中介框架，区别于并行中介，假设处理变量依次影响文本响应的主题构成，然后与评分数据和结果变量相关联。
AI.method: 整合监督先验和模型结构，通过文本分析和评分数据来识别中介变量和关系。
AI.findings: 所提出的模型在预测性能上优于其他中介模型，并能从文本和评分数据中揭示更多洞察。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个新颖的序列中介分析框架，扩展了传统中介分析的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 在量表开发不完善的情况下，该方法仍能有效识别中介关系，为消费者行为研究提供了实用的分析工具。

title: Demographic Differences in Entrepreneurial Intention of Senior High School Entrepreneurship Students in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines

detail.title: Demographic Differences in Entrepreneurial Intention of Senior High School Entrepreneurship Students in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines
detail.abstract: This study investigated the level of Entrepreneurial Intention among Grade 12 Senior High School students enrolled in a Private Non-sectarian School in Cagayan de Oro City, Philippines, who completed the Entrepreneurship subject in School Year 2023-2024 and examined significant differences in entrepreneurship intention based on monthly household income, sex, and family engagement in business. Utilizing a quantitative descriptive design, data were collected from 222 students selected via stratified random sampling using academic tracks as strata. A validated and reliable adapted questionnaire measured entrepreneurship intention on a 4-point Likert scale. Descriptive statistics and inferential statistics, preceded by normality testing, were employed for analysis. Results indicated a high overall level of entrepreneurial intention, with the strongest agreement for the desire for autonomy or wanting to be their own boss. A significant difference in entrepreneurship intention was found based on monthly household income suggesting socioeconomic background influences aspirations within this cohort. However, no significant differences were found based on sex or family engagement in business, indicating equitable entrepreneurship intention levels across genders and challenging the assumed primacy of family entrepreneurial exposure. The findings suggest that the formal entrepreneurship curriculum successfully fosters high entrepreneurship intention, potentially mitigating traditional advantages linked to family background, but highlights the need to address the gap between intention and perceived preparedness and support students from lower-income households.

AI.tldr: 该研究调查了菲律宾卡加延德奥罗市一所私立非宗派学校完成创业课程的12年级高中生的创业意向水平，发现整体创业意向较高，特别是自主创业意愿强烈。家庭月收入对创业意向有显著影响，但性别和家庭经商背景无显著差异。
AI.research_question: 12年级高中生的创业意向水平如何？以及创业意向在家庭月收入、性别和家庭经商背景方面是否存在显著差异？
AI.motivation: 了解高中生的创业意向水平及其影响因素，评估创业教育课程的效果，为创业教育政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业意向理论，重点关注自主创业意愿、社会经济背景对创业意向的影响。
AI.method: 定量描述性研究设计，采用分层随机抽样选取222名学生，使用经过验证的4点李克特量表问卷收集数据，采用描述性统计和推断统计进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 整体创业意向水平较高；2. 自主创业意愿最强；3. 家庭月收入对创业意向有显著影响；4. 性别和家庭经商背景对创业意向无显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了家庭创业背景对创业意向具有首要影响的传统假设，表明正规创业教育可能减轻家庭背景的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业教育课程的有效性提供证据，建议关注低收入家庭学生的支持，并解决创业意向与实际准备度之间的差距。

title: When AI Inherits Scientific Error: How Correct Theories Are Drowned in Corrupted Training Data
affiliations: Shenyang Normal University

detail.title: When AI Inherits Scientific Error: How Correct Theories Are Drowned in Corrupted Training Data
detail.abstract: This article examines a critical phenomenon in artificial intelligence knowledge systems: correct scientific theories become systematically suppressed when AI training datasets contain overwhelming proportions of erroneous mainstream literature. Through analysis of documented conversations between a researcher and DeepSeek AI regarding microwave absorption theory, we demonstrate that AI systems faithfully reproduce the "majority error" problem plaguing academic publishing-where impedance matching theory dominates training data despite fundamental theoretical flaws, while correct wave mechanics theory remains invisible to public AI interfaces. The analysis reveals that AI's descriptive mode (summarizing existing literature) conflicts with its analytical mode (logical reasoning), creating a digital mirror of institutional knowledge corruption. We argue that correcting AI knowledge requires not just publishing correct theories but strategically "contaminating" the training data ocean through systematic public dissemination across multiple platforms. This case study illustrates how AI systems inadvertently perpetuate scientific stagnation by amplifying the same institutional biases present in their source literature, and proposes concrete strategies for breaking this knowledge inheritance cycle.

AI.tldr: AI训练数据中错误主流文献占主导时，正确科学理论会被系统性压制。通过分析DeepSeek AI关于微波吸收理论的对话，发现AI忠实再现了学术出版中的"多数错误"问题，并提出通过战略性地"污染"训练数据来纠正AI知识。
AI.research_question: 当AI训练数据集中错误的主流文献占主导地位时，正确的科学理论如何被系统性压制？
AI.motivation: 研究AI知识系统中存在的"多数错误"问题，即AI系统如何无意中延续科学停滞，通过放大源文献中的制度偏见。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于"多数错误"理论和知识继承循环理论，分析AI系统中的描述模式与分析模式冲突。
AI.method: 通过分析研究人员与DeepSeek AI关于微波吸收理论的文档化对话案例研究。
AI.findings: AI系统忠实再现学术出版中的多数错误问题，阻抗匹配理论在训练数据中占主导地位，而正确的波力学理论在公共AI接口中不可见。AI的描述模式与逻辑推理模式存在冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI系统如何成为制度知识腐败的数字镜像，提出了知识继承循环理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了通过系统性公共传播"污染"训练数据的具体策略，打破知识继承循环。

title: The Persistence of Homophobia in Men's Friendship Norms
affiliations: INSEAD, INSEAD and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Persistence of Homophobia in Men's Friendship Norms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors declare no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research received approval from a local ethics board (ID: 202135 at INSEAD; ID: IRB-19-073-A070-M15(323) at Singapore Management University).
declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by an institutional research grant, (first and second authors’ institution, 2520-XERID02), and Singapore Ministry of Education (MOE) Academic Research Fund (AcRF) Tier 1 grants, 19-C207-SMU-005 and 21-LKCSB-SMU-034.

detail.abstract: Across five studies and one supplementary study (five pre-registered; N = 3,215 adults), we find that men, more than women, avoid shared experiences (e.g., going to the movies, sharing food) with individuals of the same gender. Furthermore, persisting societal expectations that men should be unambiguously heterosexual underlie this pattern-men feel more apprehensive about signaling same-gender romance in platonic relationships than women. In turn, romantic prototypicality drove the pattern of men (more than women) avoiding shared activities, above and beyond differences in how hedonic, enjoyable, and feminine the activities were; furthermore, findings suggest that men's reluctance to share these experiences is due to pressure to conform to societal expectations rather than solely a personal preference. This research offers insight into how, despite evolving societal attitudes, heterosexual norms can lead men to make suboptimal consumption decisions and to forgo opportunities to connect with other men, ultimately perpetuating stigma against intimacy between men.

AI.tldr: 研究发现男性比女性更避免与同性进行共享体验（如看电影、分享食物），这种模式源于社会对男性应明确为异性恋的期望，男性在柏拉图式关系中更担心传递同性恋信号。
AI.research_question: 为什么男性比女性更避免与同性进行共享体验？
AI.motivation: 尽管社会态度在演变，但异性恋规范仍可能导致男性做出次优消费决策并放弃与其他男性建立联系的机会，最终延续对男性间亲密关系的污名化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 浪漫原型理论、社会期望理论、异性恋规范理论
AI.method: 五项研究（五项预注册）和一项补充研究，共3,215名成年参与者
AI.findings: 男性比女性更避免同性共享体验；这种模式由浪漫原型驱动，而非活动的享乐程度、愉悦度或女性化程度；男性对共享体验的犹豫源于遵守社会期望的压力而非个人偏好
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了异性恋规范如何影响男性行为，扩展了浪漫原型理论在非浪漫关系中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解男性社交行为提供新视角，有助于减少对男性间亲密关系的污名化，改善男性社交体验

title: Distribution Shift Alignment Helps LLMs Simulate Survey Response Distributions
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), Fudan University and University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)

detail.title: Distribution Shift Alignment Helps LLMs Simulate Survey Response Distributions

declarations.funderStatement: This work is supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (grants no.724B2010).

detail.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) offer a promising way to simulate human survey responses, potentially reducing the cost of large-scale data collection. However, existing zero-shot methods suffer from prompt sensitivity and low accuracy, while conventional fine-tuning approaches mostly fit the training set distributions and struggle to produce results more accurate than the training set itself, which deviates from the original goal of using LLMs to simulate survey responses. Building on this observation, we introduce Distribution Shift Alignment (DSA), a two-stage fine-tuning method that aligns both the output distributions and the distribution shifts across different backgrounds. By learning how these distributions change rather than fitting training data, DSA can provide results substantially closer to the true distribution than the training data. Empirically, DSA consistently outperforms other methods on five public survey datasets. We further conduct a comprehensive comparison covering accuracy, robustness, and data savings. DSA reduces the required real data by 53.48-69.12%, demonstrating its effectiveness and efficiency in survey simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为分布偏移对齐（DSA）的两阶段微调方法，用于提高大语言模型在模拟人类调查响应时的准确性。DSA通过学习分布变化而非拟合训练数据，能够产生比训练数据本身更接近真实分布的结果，在五个公共调查数据集上表现优于其他方法，并能减少53.48-69.12%的真实数据需求。
AI.research_question: 如何提高大语言模型在模拟人类调查响应时的准确性和鲁棒性，同时减少对真实数据的依赖？
AI.motivation: 现有零样本方法存在提示敏感性和低准确性问题，而传统微调方法主要拟合训练集分布，难以产生比训练集本身更准确的结果，这偏离了使用LLMs模拟调查响应的初衷。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分布偏移对齐（DSA）理论框架，强调学习输出分布和不同背景下的分布变化，而非简单拟合训练数据。
AI.method: 两阶段微调方法：第一阶段学习基础响应分布，第二阶段学习分布如何随背景变化而偏移。
AI.findings: DSA在五个公共调查数据集上始终优于其他方法，能够产生比训练数据更接近真实分布的结果，减少53.48-69.12%的真实数据需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分布偏移对齐的理论框架，强调学习分布变化而非拟合数据，为LLMs在调查模拟中的应用提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了有效的两阶段微调方法，显著提高了调查模拟的准确性和鲁棒性，大幅降低了数据收集成本，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: The Impact of Reputation Systems on Peer Feedback in Social Media
affiliations: Haskayne School of Business, University of Calgary, Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School and University of Houston - C.T. Bauer College of Business

detail.title: The Impact of Reputation Systems on Peer Feedback in Social Media
detail.abstract: We investigate how a reputation system impacts peer evaluations in an online community. While most previous research has focused on the relationship between reputation systems and posting activity and/or contribution quality, we show how reputation markers (achievement badges, for example) may effect changes in peer evaluations. We employ a unique and detailed data set and a staggered difference-indifferences approach, combined with matching. The results suggest that, all else equal, posters receive disproportionately-higher evaluations of their posts after they earn a reputation marker, holding constant post quality. This suggests a "rich-get-richer" process induced by a reputation system that may have the unintended effect of favoring some participants at the expense of equally or more highly skilled others.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨声誉系统如何影响在线社区中的同行评价。研究发现，获得声誉标记（如成就徽章）后，发帖者即使帖子质量保持不变，也会获得不成比例更高的评价，这表明声誉系统引发了"富者愈富"效应。
AI.research_question: 声誉系统如何影响在线社区中的同行评价？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注声誉系统与发帖活动和贡献质量的关系，但缺乏对声誉系统如何影响同行评价的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 声誉系统理论、同行评价机制、"富者愈富"效应
AI.method: 采用独特详细的数据集，结合匹配方法的交错双重差分法
AI.findings: 在帖子质量保持不变的情况下，获得声誉标记的发帖者会获得不成比例更高的同行评价
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了声誉系统可能引发"富者愈富"效应，挑战了声誉系统公平性的假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线社区设计更公平的声誉系统提供了实证依据，提示需要关注声誉系统可能带来的评价偏见

title: Enhancing B2B Sustainability Through Customer Training in Product Service Systems
affiliations: EDHEC Business School - Department of Marketing, Rotterdam School of Management, Erasmus University, University of Pennsylvania - The Wharton School, Universidade Federal de Minas Gerais and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Enhancing B2B Sustainability Through Customer Training in Product Service Systems
detail.abstract: Products such as agrochemicals can create substantial sustainability risks if users lack sufficient knowledge to ensure their correct, safe use. Thus, education is a cornerstone of sustainable development. With a design science approach, the current research aims specifically to develop and test a tool, or artifact, that can help companies that sell potentially harmful prod their products. The artifact that we propose is a problem-based training method that relies on social influence and that can be offered jointly with the product. Training customers to engage in more sustainable product use represents an added service that companies can integrate into product service systems (PSS) to address their societal responsibilities. The literature has examined a number of tools that marketers can use to inform customers, but has neglected the role of firm-sponsored customer training to educate their customers. Using a field experiment with Brazilian coffee farmers and follow-up interviews and testimonies of stakeholders, we establish positive effects of our artifact; the benefits include enhanced knowledge of correct, safe uses of agrochemicals and farming practices among farmers and broader positive impacts on sustainability, for the benefit of all relevant stakeholders.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并测试了一种基于社会影响的问题导向培训方法，作为产品服务系统的一部分，帮助销售有害产品的公司培训客户更可持续地使用产品。通过巴西咖啡农的实地实验证明该方法能有效提升农民对农化品安全使用的知识，并产生积极的可持续性影响。
AI.research_question: 如何开发有效的客户培训工具，帮助销售有害产品的公司教育客户更可持续地使用产品？
AI.motivation: 农化品等产品如果用户缺乏足够知识确保正确安全使用，会造成重大可持续性风险。教育是可持续发展的基石，但目前文献忽视了企业赞助客户培训在客户教育中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学方法、社会影响理论、产品服务系统(PSS)理论、企业社会责任理论
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法，包括开发培训工具，并通过巴西咖啡农的实地实验、后续访谈和利益相关者证词进行测试
AI.findings: 提出的培训方法对农民正确安全使用农化品的知识有积极影响，并对可持续性产生广泛积极影响，使所有相关利益相关者受益
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了文献中关于企业赞助客户培训在教育客户方面的研究空白，扩展了产品服务系统和企业社会责任理论的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供可操作的培训工具，帮助其履行社会责任，通过培训客户更可持续地使用产品来降低可持续性风险

title: Anchoring Methods for MaxDiff and Their Predictive Validity in Product Choice
affiliations: ,  and Humboldt University of Berlin - School of Business and Economics

detail.title: Anchoring Methods for MaxDiff and Their Predictive Validity in Product Choice
detail.abstract: Managers increasingly use maximum difference scaling (MaxDiff) to understand consumers’ preferences. Compared to other preference elicitation techniques, traditional MaxDiff fails to capture the outside good’s utility (i.e., consumers’ utility from not buying). Researchers proposed various anchoring approaches in MaxDiff to overcome this limitation. Among these, the direct and indirect anchoring approaches are the most prominent and are already often implemented in proprietary software. However, focusing solely on these methods overlooks other approaches that haven’t been extensively investigated, despite their potential to assess consumers’ utilities more efficiently. Furthermore, research on MaxDiff has remained silent on task-adaptation effects (i.e., changes in predictive validity with increasing task numbers), which may differ between anchor approaches. To fill this research gap, we benchmark four anchoring approaches on out-of-sample predictive validity in a preregistered, incentive-aligned online experiment on Ritter Sport chocolate tablets (N = 1,468). We demonstrate that a status quo anchoring approach outperforms the current anchoring approaches in commercial software (direct and indirect anchor) in predicting product choice. A newly introduced limit card approach and the indirect anchoring approach are favorable in predicting dual-response validation tasks, while the indirect anchor is also best at predicting consideration set sizes. Overall, the direct anchor requires the fewest MaxDiff tasks to yield its minimum in terms of predictive validity. As the interview time increases, both status quo and indirect anchoring outperform the direct anchor. These findings map the world of anchored MaxDiff approaches across various dimensions (e.g., predictive validity, interview time) and help market researchers choose the most fitting approach for their objectives.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了四种MaxDiff锚定方法，发现状态锚定法在预测产品选择方面优于商业软件常用的直接和间接锚定法。新引入的限制卡方法和间接锚定法在预测双重响应验证任务方面表现更好，而间接锚定法在预测考虑集大小方面最佳。直接锚定法需要最少的任务数达到预测效度最小值，但随着访谈时间增加，状态锚定和间接锚定表现更优。
AI.research_question: 不同锚定方法在最大差异标度（MaxDiff）中的预测效度如何比较？任务适应效应如何影响不同锚定方法的性能？
AI.motivation: 传统MaxDiff无法捕捉外部商品的效用（即消费者不购买的效用），现有研究主要关注直接和间接锚定方法，但忽视了其他潜在更有效的方法，且缺乏对任务适应效应的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于最大差异标度理论和消费者偏好测量理论，重点关注锚定方法对预测效度的影响以及任务适应效应。
AI.method: 采用预注册、激励对齐的在线实验，以Ritter Sport巧克力片为研究对象（N=1,468），比较四种锚定方法的样本外预测效度。
AI.findings: 状态锚定法在预测产品选择方面优于直接和间接锚定法；限制卡方法和间接锚定法在预测双重响应验证任务方面表现更好；间接锚定法在预测考虑集大小方面最佳；直接锚定法需要最少任务数达到预测效度最小值；随着访谈时间增加，状态锚定和间接锚定表现更优。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统比较了四种MaxDiff锚定方法，首次研究了任务适应效应在不同锚定方法中的差异，扩展了MaxDiff理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市场研究人员提供了选择最合适锚定方法的指导，帮助根据研究目标（预测产品选择、验证任务或考虑集大小）选择最优方法，并考虑访谈时间约束。

title: Android vs. Humanoid: Rethinking Uncanny Valley in Online Hotel Booking
affiliations: NEOMA Business School, , Temple University and Shanghai University of International Business and Economics

detail.title: Android vs. Humanoid: Rethinking Uncanny Valley in Online Hotel Booking
detail.abstract:
Purpose – As the tourism and hospitality industry increasingly adopts service robots, their portrayal in online booking plays a critical role in shaping consumer decisions. While prior research has emphasized physical service encounters, this study addresses the underexplored question of how consumers respond to highly humanlike robots (androids vs. humanoids) in digital pre-purchase contexts.

 

Design/methodology/approach – Four experimental studies were conducted in online hotel booking contexts. Study 1 tested whether android (vs. humanoid) robots increase booking intentions through enhanced likeability and perceived intelligence. Study 2 examined whether the effects differ between hedonic and utilitarian accommodations. Study 3 introduced a close-contact imagination scenario to test whether mentally simulating close Human-Robot Interaction (HRI) diminishes androids’ advantage and reactivates the uncanny valley effect. Study 4 investigated whether this reactivation varies across consumption types.

 

Findings – Contrary to the uncanny valley hypothesis, androids are generally perceived as more likeable and intelligent in digital pre-purchase contexts, boosting reservation intentions. Likeability has greater influence in hedonic contexts, while perceived intelligence matters more in utilitarian settings. However, when consumers are prompted to imagine close-proximity HRI, androids lose their advantage, which results in lower booking intention and supporting uncanny valley predictions.

 

Originality – This research introduces a novel perspective on HRI by showing that the uncanny valley effect is context-dependent: diminished in digital booking environments but reactivated through imagined close-contact scenarios. It advances HRI theory and offers actionable insights for presenting service robots in online hotel platforms.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在在线酒店预订环境中，高度拟人化的服务机器人（安卓机器人vs人形机器人）如何影响消费者决策。研究发现，与恐怖谷假说相反，在数字预订环境中安卓机器人通常被认为更可爱和智能，从而提升预订意愿。但当消费者想象近距离人机互动时，安卓机器人的优势消失，恐怖谷效应重新出现。
AI.research_question: 消费者在数字预订环境中如何对高度拟人化的机器人（安卓机器人vs人形机器人）做出反应？
AI.motivation: 随着旅游业和酒店业越来越多地采用服务机器人，它们在在线预订中的呈现方式对消费者决策至关重要。先前研究主要关注实体服务接触，本研究探讨了在数字预购环境中消费者对高度拟人化机器人的反应这一未被充分研究的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 恐怖谷理论、人机互动理论
AI.method: 在在线酒店预订背景下进行了四项实验研究：研究1测试了安卓机器人是否通过增强可爱度和感知智能来提高预订意愿；研究2检验了效果在享乐型和实用型住宿之间的差异；研究3引入了近距离接触想象场景来测试心理模拟近距离人机互动是否会削弱安卓机器人的优势并重新激活恐怖谷效应；研究4调查了这种重新激活是否因消费类型而异。
AI.findings: 与恐怖谷假说相反，在数字预购环境中，安卓机器人通常被认为更可爱和智能，从而提升预订意愿。可爱度在享乐型环境中影响更大，而感知智能在实用型环境中更重要。但当消费者被提示想象近距离人机互动时，安卓机器人失去优势，导致预订意愿降低，支持恐怖谷预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究通过展示恐怖谷效应是情境依赖的，为人机互动理论提供了新视角：在数字预订环境中减弱，但通过想象的近距离接触场景重新激活。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在线酒店平台展示服务机器人提供了可行的见解，帮助酒店业更好地设计和呈现服务机器人以优化消费者体验。

title: Evolution of Service Robots from Mechanical to Humanoid Forms: An Examination between Utilitarian and Hedonic Service Settings
affiliations: , NEOMA Business School, Shanghai University of International Business and Economics and Shanghai University of International Business and Economics

detail.title: Evolution of Service Robots from Mechanical to Humanoid Forms: An Examination between Utilitarian and Hedonic Service Settings
detail.abstract: In today’s service marketing, a revolution is underway, spearheaded by the application of robotics. This revolution has seen robots evolve from basic mechanical to sophisticated humanoid forms, paving the way for unprecedented service experiences. The shift holds particular relevance in marketing, where understanding the impact of humanoid service robots on customer perception and the consequent business outcomes is of paramount interest. The crux of the issue lies in deciphering how the transition from mechanical to humanoid robots influences customer perceptions, especially how consumer response varies when they have utilitarian versus hedonic motives in service consumption. To address these questions, our research conducted a survey and followed it with a series of controlled experiments, meticulously designed to mirror real-life service scenarios. The results revealed that the degree of “humanness” in a robot significantly alters customer perceptions, with humanoid robots perceived as more likable and intelligent. This perception, in turn, has a direct impact on customers’ purchase intention. Interestingly, our findings suggest that the likability of a service robot’s form contributes more to purchase in hedonic consumption, whereas the robot’s perceived intelligence takes precedence to drive purchase in utilitarian settings. The research aims to fill a crucial theoretical gap by exploring how the evolution of service robots from basic mechanical form to advanced humanoid form impacts customer experiences, especially in different types of consumption. Conclusively, this research provides actionable strategies for marketing practitioners to leverage humanoid robotics to boost customer purchases in services.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了从机械机器人到人形机器人的转变如何影响顾客感知，特别是在功利性和享乐性消费情境下的差异。研究发现人形机器人被认为更可爱、更智能，这种感知直接影响购买意愿。在享乐消费中，可爱度更重要；在功利消费中，智能度更重要。
AI.research_question: 从机械机器人到人形机器人的转变如何影响顾客感知？消费者在功利性vs享乐性消费动机下对服务机器人的反应有何不同？
AI.motivation: 服务营销正在经历机器人技术引领的革命，理解人形服务机器人对顾客感知的影响及其商业结果至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器人拟人化程度理论、顾客感知理论、消费动机理论（功利性vs享乐性）
AI.method: 问卷调查和一系列精心设计的控制实验，模拟真实服务场景
AI.findings: 机器人的"人性化"程度显著改变顾客感知，人形机器人被认为更可爱、更智能；这种感知直接影响购买意愿；在享乐消费中，可爱度对购买影响更大；在功利消费中，智能度对购买影响更大
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了服务机器人从机械形态向人形形态演变如何影响顾客体验的理论空白，特别是在不同类型消费情境下的差异
AI.practical_contributions: 为营销从业者提供可操作的策略，利用人形机器人技术提升服务中的顾客购买

title: Retirement Age Reforms and Worker Substitutability: Implications for Employment of Older Workers
affiliations: Charles University in Prague - CERGE-EI, a joint workplace of Charles University and the Economics Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences

detail.title: Retirement Age Reforms and Worker Substitutability: Implications for Employment of Older Workers
detail.abstract: This paper studies how labor demand factors—specifically worker substitutability and job‑specific skills—shape employment responses to a rise in the early retirement age. Using a regression discontinuity design, I exploit a 1999 German reform that eliminated the option for women to retire at age 60. Before the reform, older workers could exit voluntarily, thereby imposing turnover costs on firms. Afterward, firms were better able to retain less substitutable workers for whom turnover costs are higher. At the same time, the loss of early pension eligibility reduced workers’ outside options, allowing firms to offer lower wages, often through partial retirement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究劳动力需求因素（工人可替代性和工作特定技能）如何影响提高提前退休年龄对就业的反应。利用1999年德国改革（取消女性60岁退休选项）进行断点回归分析，发现改革后企业能更好地留住替代成本较高的工人，同时工人外部选择减少使企业能提供更低工资。
AI.research_question: 劳动力需求因素（工人可替代性和工作特定技能）如何影响提高提前退休年龄对就业的反应？
AI.motivation: 理解企业如何应对提前退休年龄提高的政策变化，以及劳动力需求因素在这一过程中的作用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于劳动力需求理论，重点关注工人可替代性和工作特定技能对企业雇佣决策的影响。
AI.method: 断点回归设计（RDD），利用1999年德国改革（取消女性60岁退休选项）作为自然实验。
AI.findings: 改革后企业能更好地留住替代成本较高的工人，同时工人外部选择减少使企业能通过部分退休等方式提供更低工资。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对劳动力需求因素在退休政策影响就业机制中作用的理解，扩展了工人可替代性理论的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计退休政策提供了实证依据，帮助企业更好地理解和管理老年劳动力。

title: Book Review Symposium I: The African Continental Free Trade Area Agreement: Legal and Policy Frameworks (Routledge, 2024)

detail.title: Book Review Symposium I: The African Continental Free Trade Area Agreement: Legal and Policy Frameworks (Routledge, 2024)

declarations.funderStatement: Alexander von Humboldt Foundation Research Fellowship 2023-2025

keywords: African Commission on Human and Peoples' Rights

publicationDetails.detailsText: Afronomicslaw, Book Review Symposium 32 (2025): Collins C Ajibo: The African Continental Free Trade Area Agreement: Legal and Policy Frameworks (Routledge, 2024).

detail.abstract: This is a contribution to a book review symposium on Collins C Ajibo’s important work, The African Continental Free Trade Area Agreement: Legal and Policy Frameworks (Routledge, 2024), published in Afronomicslaw. This review focuses on the pathways which the AfCFTA provides for its own coordination with other legalities. It proceeds on the basis of a taxonomy of three types of norms: jurisdiction-regulating rules, which delimit competences and remits; interface doctrines, encompassing a range of standards and principles that not only delimit jurisdictional remits but also demand the integration of the underlying rationales at stake; and norms at the interfaces, whether or not they were originally intended to address the matter of overlapping legalities. I highlight the issue of the regime’s pathways and management of jurisdictional overlaps, whereby its range of pathways (including jurisdiction-regulating rules, interface doctrines, and norms at the interfaces) is tailored for transiting between more arborescent developments and more rhizomatic expansions. Nevertheless, Ajibo’s contribution goes well beyond, offering practitioners and policymakers well-founded recommendations for realizing the transformative potential of the AfCFTA Agreement.

AI.tldr: 本文是对Collins C Ajibo著作《非洲大陆自由贸易区协定：法律与政策框架》的书评，聚焦于AfCFTA如何协调与其他法律体系的关系。文章提出了三种规范类型：管辖权规制规则、界面学说和界面规范，分析了该制度管理管辖权重叠的路径。
AI.research_question: 非洲大陆自由贸易区协定如何通过其制度路径协调与其他法律体系的关系？
AI.motivation: 分析AfCFTA协定在管理与其他法律体系重叠管辖权方面的制度设计和方法论
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于三种规范类型的分类法：管辖权规制规则、界面学说、界面规范
AI.method: 文献分析和理论框架构建
AI.findings: AfCFTA通过管辖权规制规则、界面学说和界面规范等路径，为在树状发展和根茎状扩张之间过渡提供了制度安排
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了分析国际法律体系协调的新理论框架，特别是管辖权重叠管理的分类法
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者和政策制定者提供了实现AfCFTA协定变革潜力的具体建议

title: Reframing Value as Inference: The Triadic Value Model for Meaning-Centered Design
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: Reframing Value as Inference: The Triadic Value Model for Meaning-Centered Design
detail.abstract: The dynamic process of value generation remains an undertheorized problem across disciplines. This study addresses this gap by proposing the Triadic Value Model (TVM), a theoretical framework for modeling this process. TVM integrates Bayesian inference with Peircean semiotics to conceptualize value generation as a triadic relation among Intrinsic Value (prior belief), Instrumental Value (evidence), and Semantic Value (posterior belief). The model further elucidates the drivers of value generation from three perspectives: (1) active inference as the computational mechanism guiding perception, decision-making, and action; (2) a Bayesian account of emotion as the subjective experience of the inference process that promotes meaning-making; and (3) sociocultural structures as the premises and constraints of inference. This framework marks a paradigm shift, reconceptualizing value from a static attribute to a dynamic inferential process. Consequently, it provides an integrative foundation for value theory across philosophy, psychology, and design, while offering computationally grounded guidelines for meaning-centered design.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了三元价值模型(TVM)，将贝叶斯推理与皮尔士符号学结合，将价值生成概念化为内在价值、工具价值和语义价值之间的三元关系，为跨学科价值理论提供整合基础。
AI.research_question: 价值生成的动态过程如何理论化？
AI.motivation: 价值生成的动态过程在各学科中仍是一个理论化不足的问题
AI.theoretical_framework: 三元价值模型(TVM)，整合贝叶斯推理与皮尔士符号学
AI.method: 理论框架构建，将价值生成概念化为内在价值(先验信念)、工具价值(证据)和语义价值(后验信念)的三元关系
AI.findings: 价值生成可以从三个角度理解：主动推理作为计算机制、情绪作为推理过程的主观体验、社会文化结构作为推理的前提和约束
AI.theory_contributions: 标志着范式转变，将价值从静态属性重新概念化为动态推理过程，为哲学、心理学和设计领域的价值理论提供整合基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为以意义为中心的设计提供计算基础指导

title: Three Views of Authority: Foundations for Carbon Market Design and Repair
affiliations: Stanford University - Precourt Institute for Energy, Stanford University - Steyer-Taylor Center for Energy Policy and Finance, Stanford Sustainable Finance Initiative and Stanford Law School

detail.title: Three Views of Authority: Foundations for Carbon Market Design and Repair
detail.abstract: This paper develops a typology of three forms of authority-atmospheric, legal, and reputational-to explain why carbon markets as currently understood cannot enforce budget constraints on emissions. Building on foundational theories of economics and law, we derive four conclusions: (1) atmospheric authority is a necessary condition for keeping within a carbon budget; (2) substituting reputational authority for atmospheric authority violates that constraint; (3) legal authority alone cannot ensure compliance with it; and (4) effective carbon markets require the alignment of legal and atmospheric authority. We describe the way current practice violates budgets and impedes progress in voluntary and compliance markets. We propose a compliance rule whereby compliance certificates achieve atmospheric alignment through a tenor-matched, verified removal. This framework links the legal authority in the compliance market with the atmospheric authority of the removals market, restoring enforceable scarcity, durabability, and consistency between asset-based voluntary markets and compliance markets.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了三种权威类型（大气、法律、声誉）来解释为何当前碳市场无法强制执行排放预算约束，并提出通过期限匹配的验证移除来实现合规证书与大气权威的对齐。
AI.research_question: 为什么当前碳市场无法强制执行排放预算约束？
AI.motivation: 现有碳市场实践违反了排放预算约束，阻碍了自愿市场和合规市场的进展，需要建立有效的权威机制来确保碳预算的遵守。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经济学和法学的基础理论，构建了大气权威、法律权威和声誉权威三种权威类型框架。
AI.method: 理论推导和框架构建，基于权威类型分析碳市场的运行机制。
AI.findings: 1) 大气权威是遵守碳预算的必要条件；2) 用声誉权威替代大气权威会违反预算约束；3) 仅靠法律权威无法确保预算遵守；4) 有效的碳市场需要法律权威与大气权威的对齐。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了碳市场权威类型学，阐明了不同权威形式在碳预算执行中的作用和局限性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了合规规则，通过期限匹配的验证移除实现合规证书与大气权威的对齐，恢复可执行的稀缺性、持久性，以及资产型自愿市场与合规市场的一致性。

title: Reinforcement Without Corruption: Preserving Epistemic Integrity While Fixing Safety-Critical Behaviors in Real-World Trained Driving Networks
affiliations: Arizen Corporation

detail.title: Reinforcement Without Corruption: Preserving Epistemic Integrity While Fixing Safety-Critical Behaviors in Real-World Trained Driving Networks
detail.abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving systems learn directly from the chaos of the real world. Their strength-immersive exposure to human behavior and natural variability-is also their limitation: reality does not repeat itself. When such systems fail, engineers must correct behaviors that the world may never reproduce again. This paper confronts the epistemic and ethical consequences of that asymmetry. It surveys existing industrial strategies for handling rare-case failures-hard-negative mining, scenario augmentation, simulation, and policy distillation-and shows how each trades authenticity for control. We propose a framework called Epistemically Anchored Regeneration (EAR), which enables safe, repeatable reinforcement of corrective behaviors without fabricating data. EAR requires every synthetic variation to trace back to a verifiable real-world anchor, thereby preserving lineage, auditability, and moral accountability. The framework offers a bridge between safety-driven replication and truth-based learning, establishing a model of governance for all future safety-critical AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Epistemically Anchored Regeneration (EAR)框架，解决端到端自动驾驶系统在罕见故障场景下的安全性和可重复性问题，确保所有合成数据都有可验证的真实世界锚点。
AI.research_question: 如何解决端到端自动驾驶系统在罕见故障场景下的安全性和可重复性问题？
AI.motivation: 端到端自动驾驶系统直接从真实世界的混乱中学习，其优势（沉浸式接触人类行为和自然变异性）也是其局限性：现实不会重复。当系统失败时，工程师必须纠正可能永远不会再出现的行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认识论和伦理后果分析，现有工业策略（硬负样本挖掘、场景增强、模拟、策略蒸馏）在真实性和控制之间的权衡。
AI.method: 提出Epistemically Anchored Regeneration (EAR)框架，要求每个合成变体都能追溯到可验证的真实世界锚点。
AI.findings: EAR框架能够在不伪造数据的情况下安全、可重复地强化纠正行为，同时保持谱系、可审计性和道德问责。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了安全驱动复制和基于真实学习之间的桥梁，为所有未来安全关键AI系统建立了治理模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动驾驶系统提供了一种处理罕见故障的安全方法，确保合成数据的真实性和可追溯性。

title: Blue Growth and Food Security Sustainability

detail.title: Blue Growth and Food Security Sustainability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: not applicable
declarations.ethicsApproval: not applicable

detail.abstract: This article examines and analyzes the processes for implementing sustainable methods and technologies in production through the implementation of a “blue economy”. Blue growth is a strategy that aims to unlock the potential of the seas and oceans as engines for economic growth, innovation, and job creation, while ensuring the sustainability of the marine environment and food security. The introduction of environmental standards and sustainability criteria in various industries is examined in detail. A review of the legislation regarding the “blue economy” and environmental standards is made. Emphasis is placed on maritime planning within the framework of the regulatory framework created to regulate economic activity in the World Ocean, as well as control, monitoring, and other measures.

AI.tldr: 本文通过实施"蓝色经济"策略，探讨了在生产中采用可持续方法和技术的实施过程，重点关注海洋环境可持续性与经济增长的平衡。
AI.research_question: 如何通过蓝色经济策略在生产中实施可持续方法和技术的流程？
AI.motivation: 蓝色增长战略旨在发掘海洋作为经济增长、创新和就业引擎的潜力，同时确保海洋环境的可持续性和粮食安全。
AI.theoretical_framework: 蓝色经济理论、可持续发展理论、环境标准理论
AI.method: 文献综述法，详细审查蓝色经济和环境标准相关立法，分析海洋规划框架内的监管措施。
AI.findings: 蓝色经济策略需要在监管框架内实施海洋规划，通过控制、监测等措施确保经济活动的可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了蓝色经济与可持续发展相结合的理论框架，明确了环境标准在海洋经济活动中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各行业引入环境标准和可持续性标准提供了实践指导，有助于实现海洋资源的可持续利用和经济增长的平衡。

title: Exploring biodiversity footprinting modeling uncertainties
affiliations: BNP Paribas, BNP Paribas and Independent

detail.title: Exploring biodiversity footprinting modeling uncertainties
detail.abstract: There are several sources of uncertainty in biodiversity footprint modeling, such as the choice of biodiversity loss unit or the choice of pressure-impact model. For example, several ecosystem intactness indices can be used as a biodiversity. loss unit, including Mean Species Abundance (MSA) and Potentially Disappeared Fraction of Species (PDF). The choice of the pressure-impact model, such as GLOBIO or ReCiPe, is another source of uncertainty. Indeed, GLOBIO and ReCiPe are two different approaches that can be used to quantify the impact of human activity on biodiversity by modeling the impact of the underlying pressures (also called stressors, or impact categories), like land occupation and the portion of climate change attributed to the considered activity.  In this paper we propose an approach to quantify the uncertainty behind the modeling choices of biodiversity footprinting. In addition, we develop two alternative pressure-impact models to isolate the unit choice uncertainty contribution to the overall modeling uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种量化生物多样性足迹建模中不确定性的方法，特别关注生物多样性损失单位选择和压力-影响模型选择带来的不确定性。
AI.research_question: 如何量化生物多样性足迹建模中的不确定性？生物多样性损失单位选择和压力-影响模型选择对总体建模不确定性的贡献如何？
AI.motivation: 生物多样性足迹建模存在多个不确定性来源，包括生物多样性损失单位的选择（如MSA vs PDF）和压力-影响模型的选择（如GLOBIO vs ReCiPe），这些选择会影响最终结果的可比性和可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生物多样性足迹建模理论，关注建模选择对结果不确定性的影响，特别是压力-影响模型和生物多样性损失单位的选择。
AI.method: 开发了一种量化建模选择不确定性的方法，并构建了两个替代的压力-影响模型来分离单位选择不确定性的贡献。
AI.findings: 生物多样性足迹建模存在显著的不确定性，主要来源于模型选择和单位选择。通过提出的方法可以量化这些不确定性来源的相对贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了量化生物多样性足迹建模不确定性的系统方法，为比较不同建模方法提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了评估生物多样性足迹结果可靠性的工具，有助于更准确地比较不同活动的环境影响。

title: Does the Golden Bull Award Have Investment Value? Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows
affiliations: , PBCSF, Tsinghua University and PBCSF, Tsinghua University

detail.title: Does the Golden Bull Award Have Investment Value? Evidence from Mutual Fund Flows
detail.abstract: The Mutual Fund Golden Bull Award provides a comprehensive assessment of historical performance, risk information and rating information for mutual funds in the Chinese market, and receives widespread market attention. Using Chinese mutual fund data 2005-2024, this paper examines whether the Golden Bull Award for equity and hybrid funds successfully identify funds with excellent performance, and how retail and institutional investors subsequently respond to award-winning funds. The research finds that: Golden Bull funds have excellent historical performance, but this excellent performance lacks persistence, offering limited subsequent investment value; institutional fund flows show no significant response to funds receiving Golden Bull awards, while retail fund flows show significant net inflows corresponding to award winners; Golden Bull award-winning mutual funds exhibit a scale effect—following sharp increase in fund flows after receiving awards, Golden Bull funds expand in size, but potentially produce a backlash effect, causing subsequent fund returns to decline. This paper contribute to researches on external fund evaluation mechanisms, institutional-individual investor differences, and the scale effect in China's mutual fund market.

AI.tldr: 本文研究中国金牛奖基金的历史表现、投资者反应及规模效应，发现金牛奖基金历史表现优异但缺乏持续性，机构投资者对获奖无显著反应，而个人投资者则显著流入，获奖后基金规模扩大但后续收益下降。
AI.research_question: 金牛奖是否成功识别出表现优异的基金？零售和机构投资者如何对获奖基金做出反应？
AI.motivation: 金牛奖作为中国基金市场的重要评价机制，受到广泛关注，但其识别能力和投资者反应尚需实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基金评价机制、投资者行为差异、规模效应理论
AI.method: 使用2005-2024年中国共同基金数据，分析金牛奖基金的业绩表现和资金流动
AI.findings: 1. 金牛奖基金历史表现优异但缺乏持续性；2. 机构投资者对获奖无显著反应，个人投资者显著流入；3. 获奖后基金规模扩大但后续收益下降
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了外部基金评价机制、机构-个人投资者差异、基金规模效应的理论研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理性看待基金奖项、监管部门完善评价体系提供实践启示

title: The "Moral Burden" of Mandatory Employee Protection: Evidence from Corporate Capital Allocation Efficiency
affiliations: Central South University, Central South University, Durham University Business School, Finance and Economics and Central South University

detail.title: The "Moral Burden" of Mandatory Employee Protection: Evidence from Corporate Capital Allocation Efficiency
detail.abstract: The "at-will employment principle" allowed employers to fire employees at will before the 20th century in the U.S., raising concerns about ethics in business. Utilizing the staggered adoption of the good faith exception by U.S. states as an exogenous shock to employee protection, we find that the increase in employee protection associated with this adoption results in lower corporate capital allocation efficiency. The decline in capital allocation efficiency can be attributed to the investment irreversibility entailed by employee protection measures. Furthermore, we show that the negative effect of this employee protection shock on capital allocation efficiency is more pronounced among firms with greater overinvestment, lower corporate social responsibility, higher product market uncertainty, and higher wage rigidity. Overall, our findings highlight that the "moral burden" of mandatory employee protection limits capital allocation efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国各州对善意例外原则的错开采用作为外生冲击，研究发现员工保护措施的增加会降低企业资本配置效率，这种负面影响在过度投资、企业社会责任较低、产品市场不确定性和工资刚性较高的企业中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 员工保护措施如何影响企业资本配置效率？
AI.motivation: 美国历史上的'随意雇佣原则'允许雇主随意解雇员工，引发了商业伦理担忧，需要研究员工保护措施对企业效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资不可逆性理论，员工保护措施增加了企业调整投资决策的难度。
AI.method: 利用美国各州错开采用善意例外原则作为外生冲击，采用准自然实验方法。
AI.findings: 员工保护措施的增加导致企业资本配置效率下降，这种负面影响在特定类型企业中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了员工保护措施通过投资不可逆性机制影响资本配置效率的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者平衡员工保护和企业效率提供了实证依据，提醒强制员工保护的'道德负担'可能限制资本配置效率。

title: Simple and Effective: A Deterministic Auction with Support Information
affiliations: Universite du Luxembourg - Faculty of Law, Economics and Finance

detail.title: Simple and Effective: A Deterministic Auction with Support Information
detail.abstract: We study an auction design problem where a seller aims to sell a single item to multiple bidders with independent private values. The seller knows only an upper bound on these values and does not know their distribution. The objective is to devise a deterministic auction mechanism effective across a broad set of distributions. We propose a second-price auction with a reserve price set at half of the upper bound. Even though no deterministic mechanism can achieve a positive fraction of the maximum achievable expected revenue across all distributions, we show that our mechanism achieves at least 1/ κ (1/ 2 under i.i.d. values) of the maximum expected revenue for a broad range of distributions of practical importance, where κ depends on the number of bidders and takes values in [2, 2.87). Numerical experiments under randomly generated distributions demonstrate the superior performance of our mechanism in the vast majority of the generated instances compared to benchmark mechanisms from the literature. We also account for errors in the upper bound estimate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究单物品拍卖设计问题，提出了一种基于价值上限一半作为保留价的第二价格拍卖机制。该机制在不知道竞标者价值分布的情况下，对广泛的实际重要分布类别能够获得至少1/κ（在i.i.d.价值下为1/2）的最大期望收益，其中κ∈[2,2.87)。数值实验表明该机制在大多数情况下优于文献中的基准机制。
AI.research_question: 在卖方只知道竞标者价值上限而不知道其分布的情况下，如何设计一个确定性的拍卖机制，使其在广泛的分布类别中都能有效运作？
AI.motivation: 传统的拍卖机制设计通常假设卖方知道竞标者价值的分布信息，但在实际应用中，这种信息往往不可得。因此需要开发对分布信息要求较低的稳健拍卖机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机制设计理论和鲁棒优化理论，采用第二价格拍卖框架，结合保留价策略来应对分布不确定性。
AI.method: 提出第二价格拍卖机制，将保留价设置为已知价值上限的一半。通过理论分析和数值实验验证机制性能。
AI.findings: 该机制对广泛的实用分布类别能够获得至少1/κ的最大期望收益，在i.i.d.价值下为1/2。数值实验显示在大多数情况下优于基准机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了在分布未知情况下确定性拍卖机制的性能保证，为鲁棒拍卖设计提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种简单易行的拍卖机制，仅需知道价值上限信息，在实际应用中具有较好的稳健性和实用性。
