AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和发展伙伴加强税收征管能力、改善公共财政提供了具体政策建议

title: Central Banks' Contribution to Financial Stability: From Central Bank Money Issuance to Macroprudential Supervision
affiliations: Swiss National Bank - Financial Stability

detail.title: Central Banks' Contribution to Financial Stability: From Central Bank Money Issuance to Macroprudential Supervision
detail.abstract: We define financial stability as a condition where the financial sector and its individual entities fulfill their macroeconomic functions. Banks, for example, are supposed to conduct liquidity and maturity transformation and create liquidity for the real economy. Financial stability does not emerge automatically out of individual agents' actions, but requires collective action. To create this public good, different stakeholders are necessary. Central banks have always played a central role due to their monopoly to issue central bank money, both in ordinary and emergency times. However, the contribution of central banks to financial stability extends beyond this. Today, they typically engage in macroprudential supervision, contribute to financial sector regulation, and, in some cases, have macroprudential tools such as countercyclical capital buffers at their disposal. Many central banks also have microprudential supervisory mandates, which are not covered in this chapter. Looking ahead, two issues appear to be of key importance for central banks in the context of financial stability: first, the role of central bank money issuance in the age of digitalization and against the backdrop of growing non-bank financial intermediaries (NBFIs) and, second, the precise meaning and scope of macroprudential supervision, not least to avoid regulatory fallacies.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了金融稳定性的概念，分析了中央银行在维护金融稳定中的核心作用，包括货币发行、宏观审慎监管等职能，并探讨了数字化时代和影子银行发展对中央银行角色的影响。
AI.research_question: 中央银行在维护金融稳定中扮演什么角色？特别是在数字化时代和影子银行发展的背景下，中央银行的职能如何演变？
AI.motivation: 金融稳定不会自动实现，需要集体行动和多方利益相关者的参与。中央银行作为货币发行垄断者，在维护金融稳定中具有独特地位，但其具体角色和职能范围需要明确界定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融稳定性理论、公共物品理论、中央银行职能理论、宏观审慎监管框架
AI.method: 概念分析和理论探讨，基于中央银行职能的历史演变和当前实践
AI.findings: 中央银行通过货币发行、宏观审慎监管、金融部门监管等多种方式维护金融稳定。在数字化和影子银行发展背景下，中央银行需要重新思考其货币发行角色和宏观审慎监管的边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对中央银行在金融稳定中多重角色的理解，提出了在数字化时代中央银行职能演变的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行制定金融稳定政策提供指导，帮助避免监管误区，明确宏观审慎监管的范围和界限

title: Investment Security and Investment Attractiveness of the Ibero-America Countries
affiliations: MGIMO University

detail.title: Investment Security and Investment Attractiveness of the Ibero-America Countries
detail.abstract: Investment policy and investment strategies in global markets are a very relevant research topic due, on the one hand, to the tightening rhetoric of sanctions restrictions for different countries of the world and the increasing trend of protectionist economic policies of these countries, on the other hand, the inevitability of searching for investment opportunities and developing investment attraction scenarios to ensure economic growth, industrial development and technological leadership. Investment security as a tool is necessary not only to increase the inflow of investments (which do not bring threats of technological monopolism or pressure from foreign entities), but also to ensure the safety of investor's control over the assets at his disposal. But at the same time, investments serve as the basis for the technological sovereignty formation and are capable of both supporting and limiting the achievement of sovereignty. It is proved that, despite the diversity of approaches to national models of technological development and investment security, the statement remains unshakable that changes are based on investment potential. It is determined that for the countries of Ibero-America, the export-raw material model may be more attractive than in the conditions of increasing globalism, and such a model has the right to be considered in conditions of targeted control over the distribution of income from the sale of resources to achieve sovereign goals. At the same time, it is possible to expand the system of investment security indicators based on the coordination of the goals of states, business and society on the way to achieving economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了全球市场中的投资政策与策略，分析了投资安全作为工具在确保经济成长、技术主权形成中的作用，特别关注了Ibero-America国家的出口原材料模式及其在主权目标达成中的适用性。
AI.research_question: 在全球制裁限制加剧和保护主义经济政策上升的背景下，如何通过投资安全策略来平衡投资流入与技术主权的关系？
AI.motivation: 全球市场投资政策的重要性日益凸显，一方面是由于制裁限制的收紧和保护主义政策的增加，另一方面是寻找投资机会和吸引投资以确保经济成长、工业发展和技术领导地位的必然性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投资安全理论、技术主权理论、出口原材料模型理论、投资潜力理论
AI.method: 理论分析与论证，基于现有投资安全和技术主权理论的整合与扩展
AI.findings: 投资安全不仅是增加投资流入的工具，还能确保投资者对资产的控制安全；投资是技术主权形成的基础，既能支持也能限制主权的达成；Ibero-America国家的出口原材料模式在目标控制收入分配下可能更具吸引力；投资安全指标系统可通过协调国家、企业和社会的目标来扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了投资安全理论，将其与技术主权形成联系起来；提出了在保护主义上升背景下投资安全的新视角；丰富了出口原材料模型在主权目标达成中的应用理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了在复杂国际环境下平衡投资流入与技术主权的策略框架；为Ibero-America国家提供了基于出口原材料模式的投资安全实施方案；提出了通过协调多方目标来扩展投资安全指标系统的具体方法。

title: Ties That Bind, Costs That Fall? CEO-Board Connections and the Cost of Debt

detail.title: Ties That Bind, Costs That Fall? CEO-Board Connections and the Cost of Debt
detail.abstract: This study examines how CEO-board connections influence firms' cost of debt, drawing on competing governance perspectives regarding the role of board friendliness. The role conflict view suggests that close social ties between CEOs and directors weaken monitoring, reduce corporate investment in valuable risky projects (due to managerial conservatism), and lower borrowing costs, while the role alignment view argues that such ties enhance monitoring through trust and information flow, which may increase investment in valuable risky projects, and consequently raise debt costs by shifting the risk from shareholders to bondholders. To evaluate these perspectives, I combine a stacked difference-indifferences design with instrumental variable analyses exploiting exogenous, CEO turnover-driven shocks to CEO-board connections, and a Heckman two-step procedure to address potential sample selection bias. Results show that CEO-board connections are negatively associated with firms' bond spreads, consistent with the role conflict view. Establishing channel, I show that this relationship operates through reduced corporate risk-taking, measured by the volatility of returns and leverage. Moreover, the negative effect of CEO-board connections on debt costs is amplified in nuanced information environments (specifically, when analyst coverage is high, forecast error is high, or both conditions jointly hold). Together, these findings demonstrate that interpersonal dynamics within the boardroom have material implications for debt pricing. The study contributes to the literature by clarifying the conditions under which friendly boards lower financing costs, and it adds to practice by identifying a novel governance channel that creditors can incorporate into credit risk assessments.

AI.tldr: CEO与董事会的社会关联通过降低企业风险承担来降低债务成本，这一效应在信息环境复杂时更加显著，支持了角色冲突理论而非角色协调理论。
AI.research_question: CEO与董事会的社交关联如何影响企业的债务成本？
AI.motivation: 探讨董事会友好性在治理中的竞争性观点：角色冲突理论认为CEO-董事关联削弱监督，降低风险承担和债务成本；角色协调理论则认为这种关联通过信任和信息流增强监督，可能增加风险承担和债务成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色冲突理论 vs 角色协调理论；CEO-董事会关联对企业风险承担和债务成本的影响机制。
AI.method: 结合堆叠差分设计、工具变量分析（利用CEO更替驱动的外生冲击）和Heckman两步法处理样本选择偏差。
AI.findings: CEO-董事会关联与债券利差负相关；这一关系通过降低企业风险承担（回报波动率和杠杆率）实现；在复杂信息环境中（分析师覆盖度高、预测误差大）效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了友好董事会降低融资成本的条件；识别了董事会内部人际关系对债务定价的重要影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为债权人识别了一个新的治理渠道，可纳入信用风险评估；揭示了董事会动态对债务融资的实际影响。

title: On Risk Pricing and Arbitrage in the Cryptomarket
affiliations: Université de Rennes 1, Université de Rennes 1, Université de Rennes 1, Univ Rennes, CNRS, CREM - UMR6211, F-35000 Rennes (France) and Université de Rennes 1

detail.title: On Risk Pricing and Arbitrage in the Cryptomarket
detail.abstract: This paper constitutes a tentative step towards factor investing in cryptocurrencies, adopting a stance that exploits market mispricing and risk timing. In the spirit of the Arbitrage Pricing Theory (APT), we examine the risk exposure profile (beta) of a panel of 29 coins to 8 risk factors. We study price anomalies through high-minus-low (High-beta returns minus Low-beta returns) portfolios and offer a tentative approximation of risk premia. The risk exposure profile reveal distinct classifications of coins with respect to systematic risks. The HML portfolios shed light on the extent to which market participants allocate weights to risk factors and on the resulting pricing differentials among cryptocurrencies. In this sense, they reveal underlying market risk preferences and highlight the potential benefits of long–short strategies. The estimated premia confirm the distinction between factors for which investors demand remuneration for bearing risk and those that carry negative premia. We introduce a dynamic optimisation architecture that adjusts factor exposure through a time-varying penalty. It implements a profitable factor-tilting strategy whose signal is extracted from a chartist analysis of the HML portfolios. Overall, this exploration offers valuable insights for portfolio design. It provides guidance for fundamental analysis through a detailed risk exposure profile. It showcase chartist signal extraction, evidencing that the HML portfolios act as effective risk trackers, to illustrate informed tactical allocation through factor tilting.

AI.tldr: 本文对加密货币进行因子投资探索，利用市场错误定价和风险时机，基于APT理论分析29种加密货币对8个风险因子的暴露情况，构建HML组合研究价格异常，并开发动态优化架构实现盈利性因子倾斜策略。
AI.research_question: 如何在加密货币市场中实施因子投资策略，通过风险因子暴露分析和动态优化实现超额收益？
AI.motivation: 加密货币市场存在系统性风险暴露差异和市场错误定价机会，需要开发有效的因子投资框架来指导投资决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 套利定价理论(APT)、因子投资理论、风险溢价理论、技术分析理论
AI.method: 构建29种加密货币对8个风险因子的暴露面板，建立高减低(HML)组合分析价格异常，开发带有时变惩罚的动态优化架构，从HML组合的技术分析中提取信号。
AI.findings: 加密货币在系统性风险暴露上存在明显分类差异；HML组合揭示了市场参与者的风险因子权重分配和定价差异；某些因子具有正风险溢价，而某些因子具有负溢价；动态因子倾斜策略能够实现盈利。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统因子投资理论扩展到加密货币领域，验证了APT理论在加密市场的适用性，提出了基于HML组合技术分析的信号提取方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资组合设计提供指导，通过详细风险暴露分析支持基本面分析，展示HML组合作为有效风险追踪器的技术信号提取，说明通过因子倾斜进行战术配置的价值。

title: Teacher transfers: equalizing deficits across schools
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, Indian Statistical Institute, Columbia University, University of Liverpool Management School and

detail.title: Teacher transfers: equalizing deficits across schools
detail.abstract: The Right to Free and Compulsory Education Act (2009) (RTE) of the Government of India prescribes student-teacher ratios for state-run schools. One method advocated by the Act to achieve its goals is the redeployment of teachers from surplus to deficit (in teacher strength) schools. We consider a model where teachers can either remain in their initially assigned schools or be transferred to a deficit school in their acceptable set. The planner's objective is specified in terms of the post-transfer deficit vector that can be achieved. We show that there exists a transfer whose post-transfer deficit vector Lorenz dominates all achievable post-transfer deficit vectors. We provide a two-stage algorithm to derive the Lorenz-dominant post-transfer deficit vector, and show that this algorithm is strategy-proof for teachers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了印度《免费义务教育权利法案》中教师重新部署问题，提出了一个两阶段算法来获得洛伦兹占优的教师缺口分配方案，并证明该算法对教师具有策略防护性。
AI.research_question: 如何在教师重新部署过程中实现最优的教师缺口分配，并确保教师不会通过策略性行为操纵结果？
AI.motivation: 印度《免费义务教育权利法案》要求通过教师重新部署来达到规定的师生比例，但实际操作中需要解决如何公平有效地分配教师资源的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于匹配理论和公平分配理论，特别是洛伦兹占优概念，用于评估不同教师分配方案的公平性。
AI.method: 构建教师转移模型，教师可选择留在原校或转移到可接受的缺编学校，提出两阶段算法来获得洛伦兹占优的教师缺口向量。
AI.findings: 存在一种转移方案，其转移后的教师缺口向量洛伦兹占优于所有可实现的缺口向量，且该算法对教师具有策略防护性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将洛伦兹占优概念应用于教师重新部署问题，发展了公平分配理论在教育资源配置中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实现教师重新部署的有效算法，确保公平性和策略防护性，有助于《免费义务教育权利法案》的实施。

title: Recovering Preferences from Mistakes: An Auxiliary Task Approach

detail.title: Recovering Preferences from Mistakes: An Auxiliary Task Approach
detail.abstract: Risk preferences recovered from lottery valuation data are not robust to unverifiable assumptions about the structure of mistakes in the valuations. To address this, we develop a novel approach utilizing Oprea's (2024) deterministic mirrors-deterministic payments that preserve key structural features of lotteries. We estimate the mistake structure in deterministic mirrors-where certain payments enable identification of mistake patterns-through a mixture model incorporating two types of mistakes frequently observed, then apply these estimates to correct lottery valuations. The corrected valuations are closer to risk neutrality than raw valuations; when they deviate from risk neutrality, they are predominantly risk averse. These patterns align the corrected valuations with expected utility theory, in contrast to the raw valuations which exhibit strong probability weighting. Our approach offers a generalizable framework for preference recovery: researchers can use auxiliary tasks with known correct answers to discipline assumptions about mistakes.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种新方法，通过确定性镜像任务来识别估值错误结构，然后修正彩票估值中的错误。修正后的估值更接近风险中性，且与期望效用理论一致，而原始估值则表现出强烈的概率加权特征。
AI.research_question: 如何在不依赖不可验证假设的情况下，从彩票估值数据中稳健地恢复风险偏好？
AI.motivation: 从彩票估值数据中恢复的风险偏好对错误结构的不可验证假设不稳健，这限制了风险偏好估计的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Oprea(2024)的确定性镜像理论，该理论使用确定性支付来保留彩票的关键结构特征。
AI.method: 通过混合模型估计确定性镜像中的错误结构（包含两种常见错误类型），然后将这些估计应用于修正彩票估值。
AI.findings: 修正后的估值比原始估值更接近风险中性；当偏离风险中性时，主要表现出风险厌恶。修正后的估值与期望效用理论一致，而原始估值则表现出强烈的概率加权特征。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个可推广的偏好恢复框架：研究人员可以使用已知正确答案的辅助任务来约束关于错误的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险偏好测量提供了更稳健的方法，减少了因错误结构假设不当导致的估计偏差。

title: British Home Children in Canada: The Assimilation of Unaccompanied Minors *
affiliations: Department of Economics, Queen's University, Wilfrid Laurier University and Royal Military College of Canada

detail.title: British Home Children in Canada: The Assimilation of Unaccompanied Minors *
detail.abstract: In this paper we study the economic outcomes of foreign born men who arrived in Canada between 1869 and 1921 as unaccompanied minors. The Home Children who are the focus of our study were brought to Canada as part of an effort by charitable and religious organizations to improve living conditions for disadvantaged urban youth in Britain. We find that on average, men who arrived in Canada as Home Children were at a severe and persistent earnings disadvantage relative to observationally equivalent native born workers and other British born men who arrived as minors accompanied by their families. However, we also find that the assimilation experiences of the Home Children were highly variable-earnings penalties were smaller and assimilation rates were faster for the Home Children who were occupationally and geographically mobile, and the Home Children who enjoyed more careful placement and greater monitoring effort experienced more rapid earnings convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了1869-1921年间作为无人陪伴未成年人抵达加拿大的外国出生男性的经济结果。研究发现，这些"家庭儿童"相比同等条件的本土出生工人和其他有家人陪伴的英国出生未成年人，存在严重且持续的收入劣势，但他们的同化经历差异很大。
AI.research_question: 作为无人陪伴未成年人抵达加拿大的"家庭儿童"的经济成果如何？他们与本土出生工人和其他英国出生移民的经济表现有何差异？
AI.motivation: 研究"家庭儿童"这一特殊移民群体的经济同化过程，了解慈善和宗教组织为改善英国城市贫困青少年生活条件而实施的移民计划的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移民经济同化理论、人力资本理论、社会网络理论
AI.method: 历史数据分析，比较"家庭儿童"与本土出生工人和其他英国出生移民的经济表现
AI.findings: "家庭儿童"相比同等条件的本土出生工人和其他有家人陪伴的英国出生未成年人存在严重且持续的收入劣势；但同化经历差异很大，职业和地理流动性强的"家庭儿童"收入劣势较小、同化速度更快；获得更细致安置和更多监督的"家庭儿童"收入收敛速度更快
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对特殊移民群体经济同化过程的理解，揭示了安置和监督质量对移民经济成果的重要影响
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策制定提供参考，强调移民安置和监督质量对移民经济融入的重要性

title: Bank Runs without a Cause: Frequency, Contagion, and Mitigation Measures in the U.S., 1889-1929
affiliations: and Middle Tennessee State University - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Bank Runs without a Cause: Frequency, Contagion, and Mitigation Measures in the U.S., 1889-1929

declarations.ethicsApproval: NA
declarations.funderStatement: No dedicated funding was received to support this work.

detail.abstract: How frequent and contagious were bank runs without a cause in the United States? We introduce a novel dataset of bank runs in the United States from 1889 to 1929, compiled from digitized historical newspapers, to examine the frequency, geographic distribution, causes, duration, and characteristics of bank runs during a formative period in U.S. financial history. Due to the lack of institution-specific reporting, we exclude the Panic of 1893, the Panic of 1907, and the Financial Crisis of 1914. Outside of these panics, we record 273 no-cause runs, an average of 6.8 per year. Slightly over 79% of these runs were averted within an average of 2.23 days. Only five non-cause runs spread to a total of 13 additional banks. While our data confirm the use of previously identified run-mitigation mechanisms, including clearinghouse associations, suspension of redemption, information disclosures, and changes in management, we detail additional common mechanisms: 1) the noninvocation of the redemption clause, 2) forfeiture of interest, 3) passbook speculation, 4) direct loans from financial institutions, 5) assurances from community, business, financial, and governmental institutions, 6) prominent displays of reserves, 7) modified banking hours, 8) unique clearinghouse association roles, and 9) reorganization. Our paper provides new insights into our understanding of early bank runs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过构建1889-1929年美国银行挤兑新数据集，发现在排除重大金融恐慌后，美国平均每年发生6.8次无原因银行挤兑，其中79%在2.23天内被成功阻止，仅有少数传染到其他银行。
AI.research_question: 美国无原因银行挤兑的频率和传染性如何？
AI.motivation: 研究美国金融历史形成时期的银行挤兑特征，填补对早期银行挤兑理解的空白
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行挤兑理论，金融恐慌理论
AI.method: 构建1889-1929年银行挤兑新数据集，基于数字化历史报纸资料
AI.findings: 记录273次无原因挤兑，平均每年6.8次；79%在2.23天内被阻止；仅5次传染到13家其他银行；识别出9种新的挤兑缓解机制
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了对早期银行挤兑特征的新理解，丰富了银行挤兑理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为现代银行风险管理提供了历史经验，识别了有效的挤兑缓解机制

title: When Silicon Valley Meets Wall Street: A Theory of Financial Overengineering
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Finance and University of Lausanne - School of Economics and Business Administration (HEC-Lausanne)

detail.title: When Silicon Valley Meets Wall Street: A Theory of Financial Overengineering
detail.abstract: We study a model of financial markets with asymmetric information, in which a trading firm hires a financial engineer to develop proprietary technology to obtain an informational edge. The signal produced through this hiring is firmspecific and non-contractible, leading to a bilateral monopoly in wage determination. The model admits multiple self-fulfilling equilibria in technology innovation. In one equilibrium, excessive and inefficient innovation arises due to technological opacity and misaligned incentives between the firm and the engineer. The model connects financial market outcomes to contractual frictions in the finance industry and yields novel empirical implications for identifying inefficiencies in financial technology investment.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个金融市场信息不对称模型，分析交易公司雇佣金融工程师开发专有技术获取信息优势的行为。由于信号具有公司特定性和不可契约性，形成了工资决定的双边垄断，导致技术创新的多重自我实现均衡。
AI.research_question: 在信息不对称的金融市场中，交易公司雇佣金融工程师开发专有技术的行为如何影响技术创新效率和市场结果？
AI.motivation: 研究金融科技投资中的效率问题，探讨合同摩擦如何导致金融市场中的技术创新扭曲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息不对称理论、双边垄断理论、自我实现均衡理论、代理理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建金融市场信息不对称模型，分析雇佣关系和工资决定机制
AI.findings: 模型存在多重自我实现均衡，其中一种均衡下会出现过度且低效的技术创新，这源于技术不透明和公司与工程师之间的激励错配
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融市场结果与金融业合同摩擦联系起来，为理解金融技术创新效率提供了新的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为识别金融科技投资中的效率低下提供了新的实证启示，有助于监管机构和市场参与者更好地理解金融技术创新动态

title: Implementing the Multilateral Instrument in India -The Notification Conundrum
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Implementing the Multilateral Instrument in India -The Notification Conundrum
detail.abstract:
In the Sky High Leasing Co. Ltd. v. ACIT  [2025] ITA No. 1198/Mum/2025, the Indian Income-tax Appellate Tribunal examined whether, in the absence of a separate protocol or notification amending the concerned double tax avoidance agreement (DTAA), the principal purpose test provision in the MLI can be read to restrict or alter the benefits otherwise available under the DTAA. The ruling followed the India Supreme Court ruling in Nestlé, SA, [Civil Appeal No. 1420 of 2023] which dealt with the most favored nation clause in India’s treaties. 

This article provides a brief description of the constitutional requirements in India to enter into treaties and grant them the force of law. It then examines the notification requirement under Indian domestic law to implement tax treaties and their revisions, particularly in the context of the MLI signed by India.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度所得税上诉法庭在Sky High Leasing Co. Ltd. v. ACIT案中的裁决，探讨了在缺乏单独议定书或通知修订相关双重征税避免协议的情况下，MLI中的主要目的测试条款是否可用于限制或改变DTAA下的利益。文章还考察了印度宪法对条约签署的要求以及国内法下实施税收条约及其修订的通知要求。
AI.research_question: 在缺乏单独议定书或通知修订相关DTAA的情况下，MLI中的主要目的测试条款是否可用于限制或改变DTAA下的利益？
AI.motivation: 随着多边工具（MLI）的引入，需要明确其在印度国内法下的实施机制，特别是在缺乏单独修订议定书的情况下如何适用主要目的测试条款。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于印度宪法框架、条约法原则和国内税收法律体系，分析条约签署和实施的法定要求。
AI.method: 案例分析法，通过分析Sky High Leasing Co. Ltd. v. ACIT案和印度最高法院在Nestlé案中的裁决，结合印度宪法和国内法规定进行法律分析。
AI.findings: 需要明确的通知程序来实施MLI条款，在缺乏单独修订议定书的情况下，MLI中的主要目的测试条款可能无法直接用于限制DTAA利益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解MLI在印度法律体系下的实施机制提供了理论框架，明确了条约修订的法定程序要求。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税务从业者和企业提供了关于MLI条款适用性的实践指导，强调了正式通知程序在条约实施中的重要性。

title: Comparison of Oracles: Part I
affiliations: Ben Gurion University of the Negev, Durham University Business School and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Comparison of Oracles: Part I

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no relevant or material financial interests that relate to the research described in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: Lagziel acknowledges the support of the Israel Science Foundation, Grant #2074/23. Lehrer acknowledges the support of the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG, German Research Foundation) -- Project Number 461570745, and the Israel Science Foundation, Grant #591/21. Wang acknowledges the support of National Natural Science Foundation of China #72303161.

detail.abstract: We analyze incomplete-information games where an oracle publicly shares information with players. One oracle dominates another if, in every game, it can match the set of equilibrium outcomes induced by the latter. Distinct characterizations are provided for deterministic and stochastic signaling functions, based on simultaneous posterior matching, partition refinements, and common knowledge components. This study extends the work of Blackwell (1951) to games, and expands the study of Aumann (1976) on common knowledge, along with the companion Part II, which develops a theory of information loops.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不完全信息博弈中信息共享机制的比较，提出了一个oracle优于另一个oracle的判定标准，并分别对确定性和随机性信号函数提供了特征化描述。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，一个信息共享机制（oracle）优于另一个机制？
AI.motivation: 将Blackwell（1951）的信息比较理论扩展到博弈情境中，并扩展Aumann（1976）关于共同知识的研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于同时后验匹配、分区细化和共同知识组件的理论框架。
AI.method: 分析不完全信息博弈中信息共享机制的比较，使用博弈论和信号理论方法。
AI.findings: 提供了确定性和随机性信号函数的特征化描述，建立了oracle优势的判定标准。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Blackwell的信息比较理论扩展到博弈领域，深化了对共同知识的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计有效的信息共享机制提供了理论指导，有助于优化博弈中的信息传递策略。

title: The impact of AI and digital platform work on employment and income inequality in India
affiliations: Delhi Public School, Bangalore East

detail.title: The impact of AI and digital platform work on employment and income inequality in India
detail.abstract: This paper examines the effects of artificial intelligence (AI) and digital platform work on wages and income inequality in India from 2015 to 2024. Using panel data from hand-picked sources: the PLFS, CMIE, and NITI Aayog, we find that the intensity of AI and platform work share both positively contribute to increasing inequality. More specifically, a one-unit increase in state-level AI raises the state-level Gini coefficient by approximately 0.04 points, while an increase in platform work share raises the state-level Gini coefficient by 0.03 points. This effect is even more pronounced when AI and platform work functions are combined. The inequality impact is felt more in high technology states like Karnataka and Maharashtra. From the decomposition analysis, the primary drivers of inequality growth are linked to skill and regional differences rather than sectoral shifts. Ultimately, this paper argues that India's digital transformation will exacerbate structural inequalities in the country's labor market without broader policies to support inclusive growth-especially as it relates to re-skilling of workers, access to technology, and improved protections for gig workers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2015-2024年人工智能和数字平台工作对印度工资和收入不平等的影响。研究发现AI强度和平台工作份额都加剧了不平等，AI每增加1单位使基尼系数上升0.04点，平台工作份额增加使基尼系数上升0.03点。这种效应在高科技邦更为明显，主要驱动因素是技能和地区差异。
AI.research_question: 人工智能和数字平台工作如何影响印度的工资和收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 随着印度数字经济的快速发展，了解AI和平台工作对收入分配的影响对于制定包容性增长政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术变革与收入不平等理论，结合数字平台经济对劳动力市场结构的影响。
AI.method: 使用2015-2024年面板数据，数据来源包括PLFS、CMIE和NITI Aayog，采用回归分析和分解分析。
AI.findings: AI强度和平台工作份额都显著增加了收入不平等，两者结合效应更强；高科技邦（如卡纳塔克邦、马哈拉施特拉邦）受影响更大；不平等增长主要源于技能和地区差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字技术对发展中国家收入不平等影响的理论研究，揭示了AI和平台工作的复合效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据，建议通过再培训、技术普及和零工工人保护等措施促进包容性增长。

title: On the Repeated Volunteer's Dilemma with Equal Cost Sharing
affiliations: University of Iowa - Henry B. Tippie College of Business - Department of Economics, Zhongnan University of Economics and Law, National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow) - International College of Economics and Finance and Economics and Management School, Wuhan University

detail.title: On the Repeated Volunteer's Dilemma with Equal Cost Sharing
detail.abstract: We study the symmetric volunteer's dilemma with binary actions and cost sharing, where the volunteering cost is split equally among volunteers. In the one-shot game, all pure-strategy Nash equilibria involve a single volunteer, while Pareto optimality allows any non-zero number. In the infinitely repeated game, all Pareto optima can be sustained in a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium based on a grim-trigger strategy: trivially under undiscounted payoffs, and provided the discount factor exceeds a threshold under discounted payoffs. This threshold is non-monotonic in the number of volunteers; it is zero with one volunteer, highest with two, and decreases with both more volunteers beyond two and more players. Thus, the scope for tacit cooperation is universal with one volunteer, minimal with two, then improving as more join in, all the way to universal again only in the limit with more and more players and volunteers. Considering both equity and scope for cooperation as criteria, the grand coalition as volunteers emerges as the best cooperation scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了对称志愿者困境中的成本分摊博弈，发现在单次博弈中纳什均衡只有一个志愿者，而重复博弈中所有帕累托最优都能通过触发策略维持。合作门槛在志愿者数量为2时最高，随着志愿者增多而降低。
AI.research_question: 在对称志愿者困境的成本分摊博弈中，重复博弈如何影响合作的可能性？不同志愿者数量对合作门槛有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究志愿者困境中的合作机制，特别是成本分摊如何影响重复博弈中的合作稳定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论、志愿者困境、重复博弈理论、纳什均衡、帕累托最优、子博弈完美均衡
AI.method: 理论分析，包括单次博弈的纳什均衡分析和重复博弈的触发策略分析
AI.findings: 1. 单次博弈中纯策略纳什均衡只有一个志愿者；2. 重复博弈中所有帕累托最优都能通过触发策略维持；3. 合作门槛在志愿者数量为2时最高，随志愿者增多而降低；4. 大联盟作为志愿者是最佳合作情景
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了志愿者困境中成本分摊对合作门槛的非单调影响，完善了重复博弈理论在集体行动问题中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织集体行动提供了理论指导，说明在志愿者困境中鼓励更多人参与可以降低合作门槛

title: Data Sharing Regulation in Europe - Introduction
affiliations: and University of Warsaw, Faculty of Management

detail.title: Data Sharing Regulation in Europe - Introduction
detail.abstract:
The introductory chapter of Data Sharing Regulation in Europe (Routledge, 2025), edited by Laura Zoboli and Maciej Bernatt, sets the conceptual and analytical framework for the volume. It situates data sharing as a strategic challenge for the European Union’s digital economy and examines the emerging EU regulatory architecture designed to address it. The chapter outlines the economic rationale for data sharing, emphasizing its role in fostering innovation, competition, and efficiency within and across sectors, while noting Europe’s lag in comparison to other major economies.

Against this backdrop, the chapter introduces the EU’s evolving “data acquis” — including the Data Act, the Data Governance Act, the Open Data Directive, and the Digital Markets Act — and discusses their complementary and sometimes overlapping roles in enabling Business-to-Business (B2B), Business-to-Government (B2G), and Government-to-Business (G2B) data exchanges. It highlights the tension between promoting data flows and safeguarding individual rights, intellectual property, and competition, framing data sharing as a field that demands legal coherence and balance among these domains.

The introduction also presents the book’s methodological approach and structure. Drawing on interdisciplinary legal analysis and the findings of the research project Business-to-Business Data Sharing within the EU Digital Market (University of Warsaw, NCN Opus Grant), the volume explores how the EU’s data strategy can be optimized to encourage innovation while maintaining fairness and accountability. By mapping general and sectoral regulations and addressing the interplay among data protection, IP, and competition law, the book contributes to the ongoing debate on the coherence of EU data governance and the development of Common European Data Spaces as a vehicle for harmonization.

AI.tldr: 本章为《欧洲数据共享监管》一书奠定概念框架，分析欧盟数据共享监管架构，探讨促进创新与保护权利之间的平衡问题。
AI.research_question: 欧盟如何通过数据共享监管架构促进数字经济发展，同时平衡创新与权利保护？
AI.motivation: 欧盟在数据经济方面落后于其他主要经济体，需要建立有效的监管框架来促进数据共享，同时保护个人权利、知识产权和竞争。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据共享的经济理性、欧盟数据监管体系（数据法、数据治理法、开放数据指令、数字市场法）、法律协调理论
AI.method: 跨学科法律分析，基于华沙大学研究项目"欧盟数字市场中的企业间数据共享"的发现
AI.findings: 欧盟正在形成互补但有时重叠的数据监管架构，需要在促进数据流动与保护权利之间寻求平衡
AI.theory_contributions: 为欧盟数据治理的协调性辩论做出贡献，推动欧洲共同数据空间作为协调工具的发展
AI.practical_contributions: 通过映射一般和部门法规，解决数据保护、知识产权和竞争法之间的相互作用，为优化欧盟数据战略提供参考

title: Estimating the Impact of the Bitcoin Halving on Its Price Using Synthetic Control

detail.title: Estimating the Impact of the Bitcoin Halving on Its Price Using Synthetic Control

declarations.funderStatement: Nobody funded this research paper.

detail.abstract: The third Bitcoin halving that took place in May 2020 cut down the mining reward from 12.5 to 6.25 BTC per block and thus slowed down the rate of issuance of new Bitcoins, making it more scarce. The fourth and most recent halving happened in April 2024, cutting the block reward further to 3.125 BTC. If the demand did not decrease simultaneously after these halvings, then the neoclassical economic theory posits that the price of Bitcoin should have increased due to the halving. But did it, in fact, increase for that reason, or is this a post hoc fallacy? This paper uses synthetic control to construct a weighted Bitcoin that is different from its counterpart in one aspect – it did not undergo halving. Comparing the price trajectory of the actual and the simulated Bitcoins, I find evidence of a positive effect of the 2024 Bitcoin halving on its price three months later. The magnitude of this effect is one-fifth of the total percentage change in the price of Bitcoin during the study period – from April 2nd, 2023, to July 21st, 2024 (17 months). The second part of the study fails to obtain a statistically significant and robust causal estimate of the effect of the 2020 Bitcoin halving on Bitcoin’s price. This is the first paper analyzing the effect of halving causally, building on the existing body of correlational research.

AI.tldr: 该论文使用合成控制法分析比特币减半事件对价格的影响，发现2024年减半在三个月后对比特币价格有正向影响，影响幅度为研究期间总价格变化的五分之一，但未能获得2020年减半的显著因果效应估计。
AI.research_question: 比特币减半事件是否真的导致比特币价格上涨？还是只是事后归因谬误？
AI.motivation: 比特币减半理论上应通过减少供应而推高价格，但这是否是真实的因果关系需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典经济理论（供应减少而需求不变时应推高价格）
AI.method: 合成控制法，构建未经历减半的模拟比特币作为对照组
AI.findings: 2024年比特币减半在三个月后对价格有正向影响，影响幅度为研究期间总价格变化的20%；2020年减半的因果效应不显著
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从因果推断角度分析比特币减半效应，超越了相关关系研究
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币投资者和政策制定者提供了减半事件实际影响的实证证据

title: Global Uncertainty, Defensive Stability? Revisiting the NPL Paradox in Emerging Economies' Banking Sectors
affiliations: Western Sydney University

detail.title: Global Uncertainty, Defensive Stability? Revisiting the NPL Paradox in Emerging Economies' Banking Sectors
detail.abstract: This paper explores the transmission of global economic policy uncertainty (GEPU) to credit risk in Bangladesh's banking sector, a financially open emerging market characterised by chronically elevated non-performing loans (NPLs). Contrary to standard theoretical expectations that rising global uncertainty heightens systemic risk and weakens asset quality, this study identifies a consistent, statistically significant inverse relationship: higher GEPU is associated with lower reported NPL ratios. The analysis, based on annual data from 2000 to 2021, employs Johansen VECM, FMOLS, DOLS, and CCR models with interaction terms capturing institutional quality, financial depth, and sovereign leverage. The estimated long-run result indicates that a one-point rise in global economic policy uncertainty reduces Bangladesh's NPL ratio by 0.64 percentage points. The analysis identifies a structural masking mechanism. In times of heightened uncertainty, regulatory forbearance, credit contraction, and loan restructuring suppress observed defaults, creating a false impression of stability. At the same time, underlying vulnerabilities in the banking sector continue to grow 1. The findings reveal that deeper financial depth and higher public debt amplify hidden risks, particularly when strong institutions enable risk-shifting under periods of regulatory discretion. The analysis concludes that Bangladesh's perceived banking resilience to global uncertainty is illusory, driven by policy-induced concealment of risk rather than authentic financial robustness. The findings have significant implications for macroprudential oversight in emerging economies. They highlight the importance of transparent loan classification, forwardlooking provisioning, prudent sovereign exposure management, and systematic monitoring of uncertainty to ensure that reported asset quality accurately reflects underlying risk.

AI.tldr: 研究发现全球政策不确定性上升反而降低孟加拉国银行不良贷款率，但这是一种结构性掩盖机制造成的假象，实际风险仍在积累。
AI.research_question: 全球政策不确定性如何影响孟加拉国银行部门的信用风险？
AI.motivation: 孟加拉国作为金融开放的新兴市场，长期存在高不良贷款问题，但全球不确定性上升反而与不良贷款率下降相关，这与理论预期相矛盾。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、资产质量理论、监管宽容理论
AI.method: 使用2000-2021年年度数据，采用Johansen VECM、FMOLS、DOLS和CCR模型，包含制度质量、金融深度和主权杠杆的交互项
AI.findings: 全球政策不确定性每上升1点，孟加拉国不良贷款率下降0.64个百分点；存在结构性掩盖机制，监管宽容、信贷收缩和贷款重组掩盖了实际违约
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了全球不确定性对新兴市场信用风险的复杂传导机制，挑战了传统理论预期
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴经济体宏观审慎监管提供重要启示：需要透明贷款分类、前瞻性拨备、审慎主权敞口管理和系统性不确定性监测

title: Scenario Planning for Treasury Management in Persistent Inflation
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Scenario Planning for Treasury Management in Persistent Inflation
detail.abstract: Persistent inflation poses complex challenges for treasury management, demanding adaptive frameworks that can anticipate uncertainty, assess fiscal risks, and ensure liquidity stability. Traditional fiscal tools often prove inadequate in volatile macroeconomic environments where inflation expectations remain unanchored. This paper explores the role of scenario planning as a strategic instrument for strengthening treasury resilience under prolonged inflationary conditions. By integrating economic forecasting, fiscal stress testing, and data-driven modeling, scenario planning enables treasuries to simulate diverse inflation trajectories and evaluate their implications for cash flow, debt management, and public expenditure. Drawing insights from both advanced and emerging economies, the paper argues that treasury institutions must evolve from reactive fiscal control toward proactive strategic foresight. It also highlights how digital transformation, predictive analytics, and institutional coordination enhance the adaptability of treasury systems to inflation shocks. The study concludes that a scenario-based approach can provide policymakers with dynamic risk maps-tools that foster fiscal agility, sustain market confidence, and preserve long-term economic stability in inflationary contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在持续通胀环境下，情景规划作为增强国库韧性的战略工具，通过整合经济预测、财政压力测试和数据驱动建模，帮助国库机构从被动财政控制转向主动战略预见。
AI.research_question: 情景规划如何作为战略工具来增强国库在持续通胀环境下的韧性？
AI.motivation: 传统财政工具在通胀预期不稳定的宏观经济环境中往往不足，需要适应性框架来应对不确定性、评估财政风险并确保流动性稳定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情景规划理论、财政风险管理理论、战略预见理论
AI.method: 整合经济预测、财政压力测试和数据驱动建模，模拟多样化通胀轨迹并评估其对现金流、债务管理和公共支出的影响
AI.findings: 情景规划方法能为政策制定者提供动态风险地图，促进财政灵活性、维持市场信心，并在通胀背景下保持长期经济稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 将情景规划理论应用于国库管理领域，发展了从被动财政控制到主动战略预见的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为国库机构提供了实用的情景规划工具和方法，帮助其在通胀环境中增强韧性、优化债务管理和现金流管理

title: Employee Ownership, Market Feedback, and Corporate Investment
affiliations: Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of Finance, Stevens Institute of Technology - School of Business and Central University of Finance and Economics (CUFE) - School of Finance

detail.title: Employee Ownership, Market Feedback, and Corporate Investment
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of employee ownership on firms' investment responsiveness to stock market feedback. Using data from Chinese listed firms, we find that employee ownership significantly enhances the sensitivity of corporate investment to Tobin's q. This effect is more pronounced in firms with higher information asymmetry, greater labor intensity, weaker corporate governance, and higher financial distress risk. While employee ownership is linked to increased subsequent profitability volatility, it also mitigates financial mismatch and downside operating risk. Our findings also suggest that employee ownership drives a shift in corporate strategy, leading to more aggressive approaches and improved risk preferences. These results highlight the role of employee ownership in mitigating agency problems and enhancing firms' ability to incorporate market information into investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 员工持股显著增强企业投资对托宾Q的敏感性，在信息不对称程度高、劳动密集度高、公司治理弱、财务困境风险大的企业中效果更明显。员工持股虽然增加后续盈利波动性，但能缓解资源错配和下行经营风险，推动企业采取更积极的战略和改善风险偏好。
AI.research_question: 员工持股如何影响企业对股票市场反馈的投资响应性？
AI.motivation: 探讨员工持股在缓解代理问题、促进企业将市场信息融入投资决策中的作用机制
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论、信息不对称理论、公司治理理论
AI.method: 使用中国上市公司数据，分析员工持股与企业投资对托宾Q敏感性的关系
AI.findings: 员工持股显著增强投资对托宾Q的敏感性；在信息不对称高、劳动密集度高、公司治理弱、财务困境风险大的企业中效果更显著；增加盈利波动性但缓解资源错配和下行风险；推动企业战略更积极和风险偏好改善
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对员工持股缓解代理问题机制的理解，揭示了其在促进企业吸收市场信息方面的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计员工持股计划提供参考，帮助投资者理解员工持股对企业投资行为和风险特征的影响

title: Contractibility, Peer-to-Peer Insurance, and Moral Hazard
affiliations: University of Hong Kong,  and Université Laval

detail.title: Contractibility, Peer-to-Peer Insurance, and Moral Hazard
detail.abstract: We study how prevention interacts with risk sharing in peer-to-peer (P2P) insurance. Under symmetric information, where efforts are contractible, we characterize first-best outcomes via a Pareto-efficient risk-sharing program that jointly selects risk allocation and prevention. We show that the interaction is one-way: only sharing rules respond to effort. Under asymmetric information, when efforts are noncontractible, we develop a hidden-action principal–agent framework—the Pareto–Nash–Stackelberg game—in which a social planner (principal) chooses a Pareto-efficient sharing rule and members (agents) simultaneously choose efforts in Nash equilibrium. Noncontractibility yields three consequences: (i) pooling may fail to form; (ii) even when risk sharing is established, equilibrium efforts fall strictly below the first-best, revealing moral hazard in P2P pooling; and (iii) a substitution arises between risk cession and prevention. We further propose retention constraints as a contractual response to asymmetric information; these constraints can steer the trade-off between risk sharing and efforts.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了P2P保险中预防措施与风险分担的相互作用。在信息对称时，风险分担规则会响应预防努力；在信息不对称时，会产生道德风险，导致预防努力低于最优水平，并出现风险转移与预防之间的替代关系。
AI.research_question: P2P保险中预防措施与风险分担如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 理解在P2P保险环境中，预防努力与风险分担机制之间的复杂关系，特别是在信息不对称情况下的道德风险问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 帕累托-纳什-斯塔克尔伯格博弈框架，结合委托代理理论和帕累托效率风险分担模型。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，包括对称信息下的帕累托效率风险分担规划，以及不对称信息下的隐藏行动委托代理框架。
AI.findings: 1) 信息对称时只有风险分担规则响应预防努力；2) 信息不对称时可能无法形成风险池；3) 均衡预防努力低于最优水平；4) 风险转移与预防之间存在替代关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Pareto-Nash-Stackelberg博弈框架，揭示了P2P保险中道德风险的具体机制，以及风险分担与预防努力之间的替代关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了保留约束作为应对信息不对称的合同解决方案，可以引导风险分担与预防努力之间的权衡。

title: Who benefits from capacity reduction programs? Insights from the U.S. Pacific Coast groundfish fishery
affiliations: Department of Agricultural and Resource Economics, UC Davis, University of California, Davis and University of California

detail.title: Who benefits from capacity reduction programs? Insights from the U.S. Pacific Coast groundfish fishery

declarations.funderStatement: Funding for this work was provided by the Lenfest Ocean Program (00034197), Walton Family Foundation (00106537), and Sanchirico's Agricultural Extension Service project (CA-D*-ESP-7853-H).

detail.abstract: Overextraction and excess capacity are longstanding challenges in natural resource industries. Capacity reduction programs are an increasingly common policy response designed to reduce capacity, reallocate access rights, and improve environmental and economic outcomes. Yet little is known about how such programs distribute benefits and costs among participants who remain in the industry. This paper estimates the benefits accruing from the U.S. Pacific Coast Groundfish Buyback Program, which retired over one-third of its vessel capacity through a voluntary $46 million reverse auction. Exploiting spatial variation in capacity reductions across ports within a difference-indifferences design, we find that active vessels operating in ports with larger relative reductions realized substantial revenue gains, while those elsewhere saw small or negligible gains. Conservative estimates suggest the program generated approximately $24.7 million in additional revenues net of variable costs and program fees over the first seven years, yielding approximately $5.25 in benefits per dollar paid in fees. However, returns varied widely depending on the degree of local capacity reduction. These findings demonstrate that while capacity reduction programs can yield significant economic gains, their uneven impacts raise important questions about program design and the balance between efficiency and equity.

AI.tldr: 美国太平洋海岸底层鱼回购计划通过自愿反向拍卖减少了超过三分之一的渔船容量，研究发现港口容量减少程度不同的地区收益差异显著，该计划在7年内产生了约2470万美元的净收益，每1美元费用带来5.25美元收益，但收益分配不均。
AI.research_question: 容量减少计划如何在留在行业内的参与者之间分配收益和成本？
AI.motivation: 过度捕捞和产能过剩是自然资源行业的长期挑战，容量减少计划作为政策应对措施日益普遍，但对其在参与者间收益分配的影响了解甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 容量减少计划理论、资源经济学、空间差异分析
AI.method: 利用港口间容量减少的空间差异，采用双重差分设计分析美国太平洋海岸底层鱼回购计划
AI.findings: 在容量减少较大的港口运营的活跃船只实现了显著收入增长，而其他地区船只收益较小或可忽略；计划在7年内产生约2470万美元净收益，每1美元费用带来5.25美元收益，但收益因当地容量减少程度而异。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了容量减少计划收益分配的不均衡性，为理解此类政策在效率与公平之间的权衡提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计容量减少计划提供了实证依据，强调了考虑地区差异和收益分配公平性的重要性。

title: Dynamic Pricing of Information: Belief Divergence and Surplus Extraction
affiliations: Kyoto University - Institute of Economic Research, Osaka University - Institute of Social and Economic Research and The University of Hong Kong - University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Dynamic Pricing of Information: Belief Divergence and Surplus Extraction
detail.abstract: We consider a screening problem in which a data seller offers a dynamic payment schedule for a sequence of experiments to a privately informed buyer. Different buyer types face different expected costs for the same payment schedule. This payment gap can be optimized to reduce information rent. Dynamic mechanisms strictly increase seller revenue compared to the optimal static mechanism, and may even extract full surplus under some conditions. We obtain a full characterization of optimal dynamic mechanisms, which can take the simple form of a binary experiment at each stage. Payments are backloaded and experiments become progressively more informative over stages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数据卖家向具有私有信息的买家提供动态支付计划的问题。通过优化支付差距来减少信息租金，动态机制相比静态机制能显著提高卖家收益，在某些条件下甚至能提取全部剩余价值。最优动态机制可简化为每阶段进行二元实验，支付后置且实验信息量逐步增加。
AI.research_question: 在数据筛选问题中，如何设计最优的动态支付机制来最大化卖家收益？
AI.motivation: 传统静态机制在信息不对称情况下无法充分利用支付差距来减少信息租金，动态机制有潜力进一步提高卖家收益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机制设计理论、信息租金理论、动态合约理论
AI.method: 理论建模与分析，构建动态支付机制模型，比较静态与动态机制的表现
AI.findings: 动态机制能严格增加卖家收益，在某些条件下可提取全部剩余价值；最优机制形式为每阶段进行二元实验，支付后置且实验信息量逐步增加
AI.theory_contributions: 完整刻画了最优动态机制的特征，证明了动态机制相比静态机制的严格优势
AI.practical_contributions: 为数据交易市场提供了实用的动态定价策略，帮助卖家更有效地获取信息租金

title: What Is the Optimal Presidential Age?
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: What Is the Optimal Presidential Age?
detail.abstract: We study how the age of the sitting U.S. president shapes financial markets and influence household preferences. Age proxies two opposing forces, experience (rising with age) and energy (declining with age). To address endogeneity, we instrument presidential age with Election Day weather shocks (temperature deviations and rain across the 50 largest cities) and estimate reduced-form effects, then use simulated method of moments to decompose age into experience and energy components. Market outcomes display pronounced nonlinearity: stock returns and volatility are concave in age, peaking at ≈62.8 and ≈59.5, respectively. Sentiment, uncertainty, and preference measures align with this tradeoff. The decomposition shows experience dominating up to the early 60s, after which waning energy offsets gains. We discuss policy implications, including whether an upper age cap could be justified from a market stability perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国总统年龄对金融市场和家庭偏好的影响，发现年龄代表经验（随年龄增长）和精力（随年龄下降）两种相反力量。使用选举日天气冲击作为工具变量，发现股票收益和波动率与年龄呈凹函数关系，峰值分别在62.8岁和59.5岁。经验在60岁前占主导，之后精力衰退抵消收益。
AI.research_question: 美国总统年龄如何影响金融市场和家庭偏好？
AI.motivation: 年龄同时代表经验（随年龄增长）和精力（随年龄下降）两种相反力量，需要研究其对金融市场的影响
AI.theoretical_framework: 年龄作为经验和精力的代理变量，经验随年龄增长，精力随年龄下降
AI.method: 使用选举日天气冲击（温度偏差和降雨）作为工具变量，采用简化形式效应估计，使用模拟矩方法分解年龄为经验和精力成分
AI.findings: 市场结果呈现显著非线性：股票收益和波动率与年龄呈凹函数关系，峰值分别在≈62.8岁和≈59.5岁。情绪、不确定性和偏好指标与此权衡一致
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将总统年龄分解为经验和精力两个维度，揭示了年龄对金融市场影响的非线性关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定提供参考，包括从市场稳定性角度考虑是否应设置年龄上限

title: Truncated Global Structural Transformation: Why Universal Industrialization is Impossible
affiliations: Clean Technology Hub

detail.title: Truncated Global Structural Transformation: Why Universal Industrialization is Impossible
detail.abstract: Global Structural Transformation (TGST), demonstrating that the process is constrained by a finite "global industrial space." First, we model how demand-side saturation, governed by Engel's Law, and accelerating productivity growth in manufacturing, cap the sector's global employment share. Second, we develop a simple allocation model proving that, given this stable global share, fewer than ten countries-housing a majority of the world's population-can simultaneously achieve manufacturing employment shares exceeding 25%. Third, we frame the relentless pursuit of industrial policy as a multi-player Prisoner's Dilemma, where individually rational strategies generate a collectively suboptimal equilibrium of overcapacity and thin industrialization. Given the improbability of optimal solutions like large-scale territorial reconfiguration, the paper concludes that the global economy is trapped in a development dilemma, necessitating a pluralistic rethinking of strategies for national welfare under conditions of non-industrialization.

AI.tldr: 全球结构转型受限于有限的"全球工业空间"，制造业就业份额被需求饱和和生产率增长所限制，导致只有少数国家能实现高制造业就业份额，形成发展困境。
AI.research_question: 全球结构转型的约束条件是什么？为什么只有少数国家能实现高制造业就业份额？
AI.motivation: 理解全球工业化进程中的结构性限制和发展困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 恩格尔定律、生产率增长理论、囚徒困境博弈理论、全球工业空间概念。
AI.method: 建模分析需求侧饱和和生产率增长对制造业就业份额的影响；开发分配模型证明高制造业就业份额的国家数量限制；运用博弈论框架分析工业政策竞争。
AI.findings: 制造业全球就业份额受需求饱和和生产率增长限制；少于10个国家能同时实现25%以上制造业就业份额；工业政策竞争导致产能过剩和薄工业化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"全球工业空间"概念，建立全球结构转型的约束理论框架，将工业政策竞争建模为囚徒困境。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示发展中国家工业化面临的系统性约束，建议重新思考非工业化条件下的国家福利策略。

title: You Know, So I Know! Endogenous Information Acquisition and Observability in a Threshold Public Goods Game
affiliations: University of Groningen - Faculty of Economics and Business and University of Groningen

detail.title: You Know, So I Know! Endogenous Information Acquisition and Observability in a Threshold Public Goods Game

keywords: private and public acquisition. JEL Classification: C71

detail.abstract: We investigate how endogenous information acquisition and its observability affect threshold public goods provision under uncertainty. Our experiment shows that allowing players to acquire private signals about uncertain thresholds increases provision by 12 percentage points over baseline, benefiting exclusively from information acquirers. When acquisition choices become observable, provision rises another 11 percentage points, primarily when both players acquire information and coordinate efficiently. We find observable acquisition serves as an effective coordination device. Our results demonstrate that transparency about information-gathering activities, not just information content, mitigates strategic uncertainty and enhances collective action.

AI.tldr: 研究显示，在不确定条件下，允许参与者获取关于公共物品提供阈值的私人信号能提高12%的提供率，而当获取行为可观察时，提供率再提高11%，主要因为可观察的信息获取行为能有效协调集体行动。
AI.research_question: 内生信息获取及其可观察性如何影响不确定条件下阈值公共物品的提供？
AI.motivation: 研究信息获取过程本身（而不仅仅是信息内容）对集体行动的影响，特别关注信息获取行为的可观察性如何缓解战略不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 阈值公共物品博弈理论、内生信息获取理论、协调博弈理论
AI.method: 实验方法，比较不同信息获取条件（不允许获取、允许但不观察、允许且可观察）下的公共物品提供行为
AI.findings: 1）允许信息获取使公共物品提供率提高12%；2）信息获取行为可观察时提供率再提高11%；3）可观察的信息获取行为作为有效的协调机制，特别是在双方都获取信息时能实现高效协调
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了信息获取过程的可观察性（而不仅仅是信息内容）在缓解战略不确定性和促进集体行动中的重要作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计信息共享机制提供指导，强调信息获取过程的透明度对协调集体行动的重要性

title: Social Movements and Women in the Labor Market: Evidence from #MeToo
affiliations: The University of Osaka - Osaka School of International Public Policy (OSIPP)

detail.title: Social Movements and Women in the Labor Market: Evidence from #MeToo
detail.abstract: While progress has been made toward gender equality, gender gaps in the workplace persist despite legal protections and organizational interventions. This study examines social movements as an underexplored factor shaping labor market outcomes by analyzing the #MeToo movement, during which women shared their experiences of sexual harassment on online platforms. Exploiting temporal variation before and after the #MeToo movement and geographical variation in #MeToo interest across the United States, the analysis shows that the #MeToo movement increases female labor force participation in metro areas with high #MeToo interest relative to those with low #MeToo interest. Wages for female workers also rise, particularly in gender-segregated occupations. These changes are accompanied by increases in the reporting of workplace sex crimes and female managerial representation. This study highlights that shifts in public awareness through social movements can translate into meaningful economic change, particularly when movements garner widespread attention.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现#MeToo运动通过提高公众意识，显著增加了女性劳动力参与率，提升了女性工资水平（特别是在性别隔离职业中），同时增加了职场性犯罪报告和女性管理职位比例。
AI.research_question: #MeToo运动如何影响女性劳动力市场结果？
AI.motivation: 尽管已有法律保护和组织干预，职场性别差距仍然存在。社会运动作为一个未被充分探索的因素，可能影响劳动力市场结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会运动理论、劳动力市场性别差异理论
AI.method: 利用#MeToo运动前后的时间变异性和美国各地区#MeToo关注度的地理变异性进行实证分析
AI.findings: #MeToo运动在高关注度地区显著提高了女性劳动力参与率；女性工资上升，特别是在性别隔离职业中；职场性犯罪报告和女性管理职位比例增加
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了社会运动通过改变公众意识影响劳动力市场结果的机制，拓展了性别平等研究的理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过社会运动促进性别平等的证据，为组织改善性别平等实践提供了启示

title: Between Diversity and Cohesion: Rethinking Migration and Civic Integration in the West
affiliations: BizChange Strategy Consulting Ltd

detail.title: Between Diversity and Cohesion: Rethinking Migration and Civic Integration in the West
detail.abstract: This paper examines the evolving relationship between migration, multiculturalism, and civic cohesion in Western democracies, focusing primarily on Europe with the Netherlands as a central case and New Zealand as a comparative example. It argues that while cultural diversity can enrich societies, unstructured or weak integration frameworks risk fragmenting civic identity. Using historical and policy analysis, the study traces the shift from the Netherlands' 1970s guest-worker programs to contemporary multiculturalism, revealing how optimism about diversity often overlooked the social, linguistic, and civic foundations of belonging. The paper reviews competing theories-multiculturalism, assimilation, and civic integration-before analysing contemporary challenges such as labour-market participation, language barriers, and social trust. It concludes that sustainable diversity depends on an explicit commitment to civic literacy, reciprocity, and shared norms that bind democratic societies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了西方民主国家中移民、多元文化主义与公民凝聚力之间不断演变的关系，指出虽然文化多样性可以丰富社会，但缺乏结构化的整合框架会危及公民认同。通过历史和政策分析，研究发现可持续的多样性依赖于对公民素养、互惠和共享规范的明确承诺。
AI.research_question: 移民、多元文化主义与公民凝聚力之间的关系如何演变？什么样的整合框架能够促进可持续的多样性？
AI.motivation: 研究西方民主国家中文化多样性对公民凝聚力的影响，探讨如何平衡多元文化主义与公民认同之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多元文化主义理论、同化理论、公民整合理论
AI.method: 历史分析和政策分析，以荷兰为主要案例，新西兰作为比较案例
AI.findings: 文化多样性可以丰富社会，但缺乏结构化的整合框架会分裂公民认同；可持续多样性需要明确的公民素养、互惠和共享规范承诺
AI.theory_contributions: 整合了多元文化主义、同化理论和公民整合理论，提出了可持续多样性的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了促进公民凝聚力的具体建议，强调公民素养、语言能力和共享规范的重要性

title: The Political Economy of Legal Institutions in China's Corporate Governance
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley - School of Law

detail.title: The Political Economy of Legal Institutions in China's Corporate Governance
detail.abstract: This Essay provides a critical analysis of Tamar Groswald Ozery's Law and Political Economy in China: The Role of Law in Corporate Governance and Market Growth, an innovative work that reinterprets the function of law in China's corporate governance and market development. Ozery's central thesis posits that Chinese legal institutions serve a dual mandate to promote market growth while reinforcing the institutional authority of the Party-state over economic governance. Her account traces this evolution in three eras, culminating in the post-2010 phase of Legalized Politicization. Building on this framework, this Essay offers an updated assessment that incorporates recent regulatory developments, particularly the state's initiatives to strengthen the roles of independent directors and institutional investors in corporate governance. It argues that these mechanisms highlight the path-dependent character of China's governance model, where incremental legal progress coexists with enduring structural constraints. Through a comparative perspective with the United States, the Essay concludes that although both systems display mixed signs of convergence, with China moving toward stronger investor protection and the United States adopting a more intervention-oriented approach, their underlying legal and governance logics remain fundamentally distinct.

AI.tldr: 本文对Ozery关于中国法律在政经中作用的著作进行批判性分析，指出中国法律机构具有促进市场增长和强化党政权威的双重使命。文章更新了该框架，纳入独立董事和机构投资者等新监管措施，认为中国治理模式具有路径依赖性，法律进步与结构约束并存。通过中美比较，发现虽有趋同迹象但根本逻辑仍不同。
AI.research_question: 中国法律在企业治理和市场发展中扮演什么角色？近期监管改革如何影响这一角色？
AI.motivation: 重新审视Ozery关于中国法律政经关系的理论框架，结合最新监管发展进行更新评估
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律政治经济学、路径依赖理论、制度变迁理论
AI.method: 批判性文献分析、比较法分析、案例研究
AI.findings: 中国法律机构具有双重使命：促进市场增长与强化党政权威；治理模式具有路径依赖性；中美系统虽有趋同但根本逻辑不同
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了法律政治经济学框架，深化了对中国法律双重使命的理解，发展了路径依赖理论在治理研究中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解中国近期监管改革提供分析框架，为投资者和政策制定者提供比较视角

title: When America Sneezes: US Monetary Policy & Information Spillovers to European Credit Markets
affiliations: University of Bath - School of Management, ALBA Graduate Business School, National Technical University of Athens (NTUA), Foundation for Economic and Industrial Research (IOBE) and University of Lethbridge

detail.title: When America Sneezes: US Monetary Policy & Information Spillovers to European Credit Markets
detail.abstract: This study asks a simple but consequential question: how do U.S. policy rate changes and monetary 'news' transmit across borders to shape European corporate credit, through which channels, over what horizons, and along which margins? We answer by marrying a continuous-time partial-adjustment model of diffusion and policy response with a GVAR-based external instrument, and a high-dimensional panel of syndicated loans, time-aligning shocks with contract formation and absorbing rich lender-borrower heterogeneity. The evidence is clear: lenders price both operational and information components, often with opposite-signed effects within the same facility, while quantities adjust gradually, producing persistent pullbacks and a reallocation of risk within syndicates. Together, the theory-data loop pins down a direct link from international monetary spillovers to firm-level credit supply and clarifies the distinct role of central bank communication in cross-border financial conditions, highlighting the role of communication alongside policy rates for European monitoring, coordination, and financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨美国货币政策变化如何通过不同渠道影响欧洲企业信贷，发现贷款人同时考虑操作性和信息性因素，信贷数量逐步调整，导致风险在银团内部重新分配。
AI.research_question: 美国政策利率变化和货币政策'新闻'如何通过哪些渠道、在什么时间范围内、沿着哪些边界影响欧洲企业信贷？
AI.motivation: 理解国际货币政策溢出效应对企业层面信贷供应的直接影响，明确央行沟通在跨境金融条件中的独特作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合连续时间部分调整扩散模型和政策响应模型，以及基于GVAR的外部工具。
AI.method: 使用高维银团贷款面板数据，将冲击与合同形成时间对齐，并吸收丰富的贷款人-借款人异质性。
AI.findings: 贷款人同时定价操作性和信息性成分，通常在同一贷款设施内产生相反符号的效应；信贷数量逐步调整，产生持续的收缩和银团内部风险重新分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立国际货币政策溢出与企业层面信贷供应之间的直接联系，阐明央行沟通在跨境金融条件中的独特作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调沟通与政策利率在欧洲监测、协调和金融稳定中的重要性，为政策制定提供实证依据。

title: The Price of Political Partisanship
affiliations: WU Vienna University of Economics and Business

detail.title: The Price of Political Partisanship
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the asset pricing implications of political partisanship in US equity markets. Using a measure based on the political contributions of CEOs, I find that partisan firms significantly underperform politically neutral firms. This underperformance persists after accounting for risk factors and other known determinants of returns. The evidence suggests that the return differential arises from investor demand for ideological alignment, with certain investors favoring aligned firms, thereby inflating their prices and compressing expected returns. I validate this through a structural demand system estimation and further tests on polarization-dependent return patterns, highlighting a demand-driven equilibrium rooted in non-pecuniary ideological preferences.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，基于CEO政治捐款衡量的党派性公司显著表现不如政治中立公司，这种表现差异源于投资者对意识形态一致性的需求偏好。
AI.research_question: 美国股市中政治党派性对资产定价的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 探讨政治党派性如何影响公司表现和股票回报，揭示意识形态偏好对资本市场的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者意识形态偏好和需求驱动的资产定价理论
AI.method: 使用CEO政治捐款衡量党派性，进行风险因素调整后的表现分析，结构需求系统估计和极化依赖性回报模式测试
AI.findings: 党派性公司显著表现不如政治中立公司，这种表现差异持续存在且源于投资者对意识形态一致性的需求偏好
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于非货币性意识形态偏好的需求驱动均衡理论，扩展了资产定价理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了识别党派性风险的新视角，帮助理解意识形态偏好对投资决策的影响

reference: Journal of Interdisciplinary Perspectives, volume 3, issue 11, 2025[10.69569/jip.2025.674]
title: Student Loans as a Mediator Between Financial Stress and Academic Engagement: Evidence from Philippine Higher Education
affiliations: Mindanao State University - Iligan Institute of Technology

detail.title: Student Loans as a Mediator Between Financial Stress and Academic Engagement: Evidence from Philippine Higher Education

declarations.funderStatement: None declared

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Interdisciplinary Perspectives, volume 3, issue 11, 2025[10.69569/jip.2025.674]

detail.abstract: This study investigates the mediating role of student loans in the relationship between financial stress and academic engagement among tertiary students in a private, for-profit higher education institution in the Philippines. Anchored in the Challenge-Hindrance Stressor Framework, the research explores how financial stress, commonly viewed as a hindrance, may also function as a challenge stressor that motivates adaptive academic behaviors. Using a quantitative, causal research design, data were collected from 377 students and analyzed through Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). Results show that financial stress significantly predicts student loan applications, positively influencing academic engagement. Moreover, financial stress directly affects engagement, suggesting that it may stimulate proactive coping responses in resource-constrained contexts. The findings extend the Challenge-Hindrance Stressor Framework to a non-Western educational context and point out the critical role of student loans as a financial lifeline that supports academic engagement, particularly in private institutions not covered by the free tuition provisions of Republic Act No. 10931. Beyond theoretical contributions on stress appraisal, the study maintains key policy implications: expanding student loan access, ensuring transparent financial aid, and integrating financial literacy programs are vital to complement existing reforms in Philippine higher education. The study calls for policies that strengthen equity and sustainability in financing private higher education by situating student loans as both an economic necessity and an academic enabler.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨学生贷款在菲律宾私立营利性高校学生的财务压力与学业参与度之间的中介作用。基于挑战-阻碍压力框架，研究发现财务压力不仅直接促进学业参与，还通过学生贷款申请间接影响学业参与。
AI.research_question: 学生贷款在财务压力与学业参与度之间起什么中介作用？
AI.motivation: 探讨在菲律宾私立高校中，财务压力如何影响学生学业参与，特别是在免费学费政策（共和国法案10931号）未覆盖的机构中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 挑战-阻碍压力框架（Challenge-Hindrance Stressor Framework）
AI.method: 定量因果研究设计，收集377名学生数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析
AI.findings: 财务压力显著预测学生贷款申请，并正向影响学业参与度；财务压力也直接影响学业参与，表明在资源受限情境下可能激发主动应对反应
AI.theory_contributions: 将挑战-阻碍压力框架扩展到非西方教育情境，深化对压力评估的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 政策启示：扩大学生贷款获取渠道、确保透明财务援助、整合金融素养教育，以加强菲律宾私立高等教育的公平性和可持续性

title: Adam Smith Canons of Taxation: An Analysis of the IRS vs. GAAP Tax Policy
affiliations: Wichita State University

detail.title: Adam Smith Canons of Taxation: An Analysis of the IRS vs. GAAP Tax Policy
detail.abstract: This study applies Adam Smith's principles of taxation-equity, certainty, convenience, and economy canons, along with modern extensions such as flexibility, neutrality, and productivity, to critically analyze the U.S. Internal Revenue Service's deferred tax policies. Deferred taxes, arising from temporary differences between GAAP and the IRC often challenge Smith's ideals. Using a qualitative legal and comparative analysis of over more than 50 deferred tax items, this study evaluates key drivers including depreciation and carryforwards against classical and modern taxation principles. The analysis reveals that no deferred tax item fully satisfies all tax canons simultaneously, with approximately 70% receiving mixed compliance ratings. Certainty emerges as the strongest canon due to clear statutory frameworks, while convenience and economy demonstrate systematic failures due to complex compliance requirements. These findings contribute to economic tax research by bridging classical theory with contemporary fiscal policy, offering recommendations to enhance fairness and efficiency in modern tax systems through targeted simplification, materiality thresholds, and regulatory reform.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用亚当·斯密的税收原则（公平性、确定性、便利性、经济性）及现代扩展原则（灵活性、中立性、生产力），对美国国税局的递延税政策进行批判性分析。研究发现约70%的递延税项目仅部分符合税收原则，确定性表现最佳，便利性和经济性存在系统性失败。
AI.research_question: 美国国税局的递延税政策在多大程度上符合古典和现代税收原则？
AI.motivation: 递延税源于GAAP与IRC之间的暂时性差异，常常挑战亚当·斯密的税收理想，需要系统评估其与税收原则的符合程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亚当·斯密的税收四原则（公平性、确定性、便利性、经济性）及现代扩展原则（灵活性、中立性、生产力）。
AI.method: 定性法律和比较分析，评估超过50个递延税项目，重点关注折旧和结转等关键驱动因素。
AI.findings: 没有递延税项目完全满足所有税收原则，约70%获得混合合规评级；确定性因明确法定框架表现最强，便利性和经济性因复杂合规要求存在系统性失败。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过将古典理论与当代财政政策联系起来，为经济税收研究做出贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供针对性简化、重要性门槛和监管改革建议，以增强现代税收系统的公平性和效率。

title: U.S. Monetary Policy and Commodity Prices at the Zero Lower Bound: The Role of the Shadow Rate Revisited
affiliations: University of the German Federal Armed Forces - Helmut Schmidt Universität and University of the German Federal Armed Forces - Helmut Schmidt Universität

detail.title: U.S. Monetary Policy and Commodity Prices at the Zero Lower Bound: The Role of the Shadow Rate Revisited
detail.abstract: We estimate structural vectorautoegressive (SVAR) models on monthly U.S. data from January 1996 to December 2019 to reexamine empirically whether and, if so, how the impact of monetary policy shocks on commodity prices during the period of unconventional monetary policy after 2008 differed from their impact estimated for the period of conventional monetary policy. Our empirical results show that the choice of the shadow rate a researcher uses to model unconventional monetary policy at the zero-lower-bound can strongly affect estimated differences in the sign, magnitude, and shape of the response of commodity prices to a monetary policy shock across the two periods. We report results for an aggregate commodity price index, three different subcategories of commodities, and different data transformations and specifications of the SVAR model.

AI.tldr: 本文使用结构向量自回归模型重新检验了2008年后非常规货币政策时期与常规货币政策时期，货币政策冲击对大宗商品价格影响的差异。研究发现，在零利率下限时期使用的影子利率选择会显著影响估计结果。
AI.research_question: 2008年后非常规货币政策时期与常规货币政策时期，货币政策冲击对大宗商品价格的影响是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 重新实证检验非常规货币政策时期与常规货币政策时期，货币政策冲击对大宗商品价格影响的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构向量自回归模型，货币政策传导机制理论
AI.method: 使用1996年1月至2019年12月的美国月度数据，估计结构向量自回归模型，比较不同时期货币政策冲击的影响
AI.findings: 影子利率的选择会强烈影响估计结果，包括大宗商品价格对货币政策冲击响应的符号、幅度和形状的差异
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了在零利率下限时期影子利率选择对货币政策冲击估计结果的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者在非常规货币政策时期选择合适的影子利率提供了实证依据

title: THE 6R FRAMEWORK: A NEW MODEL FOR EQUITABLE AND TRANSFORMATIVE PARTNERSHIPS
affiliations: University of Portsmouth

detail.title: THE 6R FRAMEWORK: A NEW MODEL FOR EQUITABLE AND TRANSFORMATIVE PARTNERSHIPS
detail.abstract: The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development positions Multi-Stakeholder Partnerships (MSPs) as essential vehicles for achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). However, the prevailing discourse often prioritizes quantitative participation over qualitative partnership integrity, leading to critiques of power asymmetries, shallow engagement, and a lack of transformative impact. This paper introduces the "6R Framework" (Representation → Redistribution, Relevance, Reciprocal Reward, Risk, Rules of Engagement, Results) as a critical analytical and diagnostic tool. Grounded in critical development theory and aligned with UN principles of effective development cooperation, the 6Rs provide a structured lens to interrogate the equity, systemic relevance, and governance of SDG partnerships. The framework's urgency is underscored by empirical evidence revealing significant shortcomings in current SDG implementation mechanisms. Despite record levels of private finance mobilisation, its distribution remains highly inequitable, favouring middle-income countries and economic infrastructure while marginalising Least Developed Countries (LDCs) and social sectors (OECD, 2025). Concurrently, analyses of UN-registered MSPs show that while partnerships have become more inclusive, they often fail to address critical SDG interlinkages and suffer from a lack of transparency and robust accountability (Glass et al., 2023). By embedding the framework within this empirical reality and academic literature on power and participation, this manuscript argues for a paradigm shift from partnership-as-means to partnership-as-ends, where the very process of collaborating becomes a mechanism for redistributing power and fostering transformative, sustainable change.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"6R框架"来分析可持续发展目标伙伴关系，强调需要从注重数量参与转向关注伙伴关系质量，以解决权力不对称和缺乏变革性影响的问题。
AI.research_question: 如何评估和改善可持续发展目标多利益相关方伙伴关系的公平性、系统相关性和治理质量？
AI.motivation: 当前可持续发展目标伙伴关系过于注重数量参与而忽视质量，存在权力不对称、浅层参与和缺乏变革性影响的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判发展理论、联合国有效发展合作原则、权力与参与理论
AI.method: 提出6R分析框架（代表→再分配、相关性、互惠回报、风险、参与规则、结果），结合实证证据和文献分析
AI.findings: 当前可持续发展目标实施机制存在显著缺陷：私人融资分配不公、伙伴关系缺乏透明度、未能解决关键可持续发展目标关联性
AI.theory_contributions: 从"伙伴关系作为手段"到"伙伴关系作为目的"的范式转变，将合作过程本身视为重新分配权力和促进变革的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和实践者提供诊断工具，帮助评估和改进可持续发展目标伙伴关系的公平性和有效性

title: Partially decentralised information with multiple goods
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: Partially decentralised information with multiple goods
detail.abstract: This paper performs an analysis of interconnected markets with partially decentralised information in which agents condition on prices in submitted market schedules in the rational expectations tradition. The main focus is on the interaction between information externalities with the relation of goods on the demand side, i.e. them being substitutes or complements. I continue to investigate the framework introduced in Vives (2017), which studied a single market without a connection between goods or information, reinforcing some of its main results regarding information externalities. I also show that with the naive behaviour of the agents stronger degree of connection between goods is better for the welfare due to the possibility of simultaneously relying on information from two markets and reducing overall noise. However, these results are sensitive to the assumption of the absence of correlation between signals, while its presence significantly complicates the model. This exogenous correlation partially explains rather ambiguous results for fully rational agents, where an endogenous correlation arises between two public signals that are incorporated in prices.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了具有部分分散信息的互联市场，研究商品替代性或互补性如何与信息外部性相互作用。研究发现，在非理性行为下，商品间更强的关联性有利于福利；但对于完全理性代理人，结果较为模糊，因为价格中会内生形成公共信号相关性。
AI.research_question: 互联市场中商品替代性或互补性与信息外部性如何相互作用？
AI.motivation: 延续Vives(2017)的单市场研究框架，扩展到互联市场情境，探讨商品间关系对信息外部性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性预期传统下的部分分散信息市场模型，基于Vives(2017)框架扩展
AI.method: 理论模型分析，比较不同行为假设（理性vs非理性）下的市场均衡
AI.findings: 1) 非理性行为下，商品间更强关联性有利于福利；2) 完全理性代理人结果模糊，存在内生公共信号相关性；3) 信号相关性假设对结果有重要影响
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了互联市场中的信息外部性理论，揭示了商品关系与信息外部性的复杂互动机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实市场中信息传递和价格形成机制提供理论指导，特别是在商品具有替代或互补关系的市场环境中

title: Effective Markovian Projection Using Coefficient Matching: Application to Forward Starting Options
affiliations: University of Cape Town (UCT), University of Cape Town (UCT) and

detail.title: Effective Markovian Projection Using Coefficient Matching: Application to Forward Starting Options
detail.abstract: We investigate a framework that reconciles stochastic local volatility (SLV) and stochastic volatility (SV) models while maintaining tractability and market consistency. At its core is an Effective Coefficient Matching technique, which projects complex models onto simpler counterparts with semi-analytic accuracy of order O(ε 2). We also derive a semi-analytic pricing formula for forward starting options within a broad class of stochastic volatility models. The representation characterizes the forward implied volatility surface in closed form, enhances pricing accuracy, and allows forward dynamics to be embedded into calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个调和随机局部波动率(SLV)和随机波动率(SV)模型的框架，通过有效系数匹配技术将复杂模型投影到更简单的对应模型上，并推导了随机波动率模型中前向起始期权的半解析定价公式。
AI.research_question: 如何调和随机局部波动率(SLV)和随机波动率(SV)模型，同时保持可处理性和市场一致性？
AI.motivation: 现有随机波动率模型在复杂性和可处理性之间存在权衡，需要开发既能保持模型准确性又具有计算效率的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机局部波动率(SLV)和随机波动率(SV)模型的理论框架，使用有效系数匹配技术进行模型投影。
AI.method: 采用有效系数匹配技术，将复杂模型投影到更简单的对应模型，达到O(ε²)的半解析精度。
AI.findings: 开发了前向起始期权的半解析定价公式，能够以闭式表征前向隐含波动率曲面，提高定价精度并允许将前向动态嵌入校准过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了调和SLV和SV模型的统一框架，发展了有效系数匹配技术，推导了前向起始期权的半解析定价公式。
AI.practical_contributions: 提高了期权定价的准确性，增强了模型校准能力，为金融衍生品定价提供了更有效的工具。

title: Illicit tobacco in Canada: A comparative policy analysis of Ontario and Quebec using multiple streams framework
affiliations: University of Waterloo - School of Public Health Sciences and University of Toronto

detail.title: Illicit tobacco in Canada: A comparative policy analysis of Ontario and Quebec using multiple streams framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by the University of Toronto Research Ethics Board (RIS Protocol number 41927).
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by Public Safety Canada (contract number 7249833). They had no role in the study design, collection, analysis and interpretation of data, and writing of this manuscript.

detail.abstract:
Background: Canada experiences high levels of illicit tobacco market activity, whereby the production, manufacturing, and distribution of product has evolved over time.

 

Objective: In this cross-jurisdictional comparative analysis, we explain how and why Canada continues to experience high levels of illicit tobacco market activity by comparing key developments in Ontario and Quebec from 2010 and 2021.

 

Methods: We conducted semi-structured interviews with key informants from health organizations, industry, academia, law enforcement, and governments between January and June 2022 and reviewed relevant documents about the Canadian illicit tobacco market. We undertook a theoretical thematic analysis according to John Kingdon’s Multiple Streams Framework.

 

Results: Both provinces recognize illicit tobacco markets as persistent issues, but Quebec’s acceptance of a manageable 10–15% market share fosters stability, whereas Ontario’s allocation system, amongst other issues, sustains a market share of 30-35%. Quebec has implemented refund–rebate policies supported by the well‑resourced Actions Concertées pour Contrer les Économies Souterraines Tabac enforcement program. By contrast, Ontario has relied on incremental licensing reforms and a modest Contraband Tobacco Enforcement Team. Quebec demonstrates political intent to contain illicit trade by balancing enforcement with economic pragmatism, while Ontario hesitates to adopt stricter measures due to concerns over Indigenous relations.


Conclusion: This analysis isolates the mechanisms of credible measurement, administratively feasible design, political alignment, and sustained programmatic capacity. Without cross‑stream coalitions and governance innovations, policy failure will persist, particularly in Ontario. This research offers a template for comparative analyses of illicit markets which can be applied to jurisdictions internationally.

AI.tldr: 本文通过比较安大略省和魁北克省2010-2021年非法烟草市场发展，解释了加拿大持续存在高水平非法烟草市场活动的原因。研究发现魁北克省通过接受10-15%的可控市场份额和实施有效的执法计划实现稳定，而安大略省由于分配制度等问题维持30-35%的市场份额。
AI.research_question: 加拿大为何持续存在高水平非法烟草市场活动？安大略省和魁北克省在应对非法烟草市场方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 加拿大非法烟草市场活动水平较高，且生产和分销模式随时间演变，需要跨司法管辖区的比较分析来解释这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: John Kingdon的多重流框架（Multiple Streams Framework）
AI.method: 2022年1月至6月对卫生组织、行业、学术界、执法部门和政府的关键信息人进行半结构化访谈，并审查加拿大非法烟草市场相关文件，进行理论主题分析。
AI.findings: 魁北克省接受10-15%的可控市场份额并实施有效的执法计划，实现市场稳定；安大略省由于分配制度等问题维持30-35%的市场份额。魁北克省通过执法与经济实用主义平衡展现政治意图，而安大略省因担心原住民关系而犹豫采取更严格措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 识别了可信测量、行政可行设计、政治一致性和持续项目能力等机制，为国际司法管辖区非法市场比较分析提供模板。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了应对非法烟草市场的实践指导，强调跨流联盟和治理创新的重要性，特别是在安大略省的政策失败案例中。

title: Evaluating the Club convergence and Sustainable Total factor Productivity: Integrating Human Development with Environmental Externalities
affiliations: Indian Institute of Science Education and Research (IISER) Bhopal, Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal and Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Madras

detail.title: Evaluating the Club convergence and Sustainable Total factor Productivity: Integrating Human Development with Environmental Externalities

keywords: Biocapacity Evaluating the Club convergence and Sustainable Total factor Productivity: Integrating Human Development with Environmental Externalities

detail.abstract: Expanding the conventional total factor productivity (TFP) analysis holds profound importance in theoretical and empirical research for advancing the objectives of sustainable development. In this context, the present study evaluates the Sustainable Total Factor Productivity (STFP), by integrating critical ecological and social dimensions. Specifically, we use biocapacity per capita as a measure of the regenerative ability of ecosystems an essential ecological input, alongside standard economic inputs such as labor, capital energy consumption. On the output side, the Human Development Index (HDI) is taken as desirable output to capture socioeconomic progress, whereas undesirable environmental externalities are represented through emissions of carbon dioxide (CO 2), methane (CH 4), and nitrous oxide (N 2 O) has been taken as undesirable outputs. By incorporating these variables, this paper provides a comprehensive and nuanced of the STFP that reflects both economic advancement and environmental sustainability. This study uses the DEA based Malmquist-Luenberger Productivity Index to evaluate the STFP change, further the club convergence was used to evaluate the convergence. The results provide several important insights. First, approximately 53% of the sampled countries experienced positive growth in STFP during the study period, with technological innovation serving as the primary driver rather than improvements in technical efficiency. Second, countries that have strategically invested in sustainable technologies such as the United Arab Emirates and Singapore emerged as the top performers, exhibiting the most significant gains in sustainable productivity. Third, although the hypothesis of overall global convergence in STFP is statistically rejected, the results reveal the formation of three distinct convergence clubs. These clubs reflect heterogeneous sustainable development trajectories, indicating that countries are clustering into groups with similar dynamics of sustainable productivity growth rather than progressing uniformly.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过整合生态和社会维度，评估可持续全要素生产率（STFP）。使用人均生物承载力作为生态输入，人类发展指数作为期望产出，温室气体排放作为非期望产出。研究发现53%的国家STFP呈正增长，技术创新是主要驱动力；形成三个收敛俱乐部，表明各国可持续发展轨迹存在异质性。
AI.research_question: 如何评估可持续全要素生产率（STFP）及其收敛模式？
AI.motivation: 扩展传统的全要素生产率分析对于推进可持续发展目标具有重要的理论和实证意义
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续全要素生产率（STFP）框架，整合生态和社会维度
AI.method: 基于DEA的Malmquist-Luenberger生产率指数和俱乐部收敛分析
AI.findings: 1. 53%的国家STFP正增长，技术创新是主要驱动力；2. 阿联酋和新加坡等投资可持续技术的国家表现最佳；3. 形成三个收敛俱乐部，拒绝全球收敛假设
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了传统TFP分析框架，整合了生态和社会维度，提出了STFP概念
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者识别可持续发展绩效差异和收敛模式提供了实证依据，有助于制定针对性的可持续发展政策

title:
Direct Engagement by Index Funds: Evidence from
State Street Global Advisors

detail.title:
Direct Engagement by Index Funds: Evidence from
State Street Global Advisors
detail.abstract: We provide the first evidence on passive investor engagements using data from one of the largest passive investors, State Street Global Advisors. We find that State Street's targets cluster in industries. Passive investors lower the costs of engagement by targeting an industry rather than a firm. Within an industry, State Street, unlike activist hedge funds, tend to target firms that are larger and have higher Tobin's Q. Engagements by State Street improve firm performance and value. Following the engagements, firms lower CEO total compensation and increase board independence. Moreover, firms tend to lower dividends and repurchases but increase R&D investments.
