detail.title: Operationalising Common European Data Spaces
detail.abstract: How Common European Data Spaces help businesses adhere to Article 10 (Data and data governance) of the EU AI Act by providing more data available for access and reuse in regards to all stages of the AI system lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 欧洲数据空间通过提供更多可访问和重用的数据，帮助企业遵守欧盟AI法案第10条（数据与数据治理），覆盖AI系统生命周期的各个阶段。
AI.research_question: 欧洲数据空间如何帮助企业遵守欧盟AI法案第10条关于数据治理的要求？
AI.motivation: 欧盟AI法案第10条对AI系统的数据治理提出了严格要求，企业需要更多高质量数据来满足合规要求，欧洲数据空间为此提供了解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数据治理理论、AI伦理框架和欧盟数据空间政策框架，探讨数据可用性与AI合规之间的关系。
AI.method: 分析欧盟AI法案第10条要求，评估欧洲数据空间的数据提供机制，研究数据访问与重用对AI生命周期各阶段的影响。
AI.findings: 欧洲数据空间显著增加了高质量数据的可用性，帮助企业满足AI法案的数据质量、多样性和代表性要求，降低合规风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了数据治理与AI合规的理论联系，提出了数据空间作为AI法案实施支撑机制的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了具体的合规路径，展示了如何利用欧洲数据空间获取符合AI法案要求的数据资源。

title: Picturing Diversity: Patterns of Race/Ethnicity and Gender Representation on Corporate Websites
affiliations: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, Kenan-Flagler School of Business, Strategy and Entrepreneurship Area  and University of North Carolina Kenan-Flagler Business School

detail.title: Picturing Diversity: Patterns of Race/Ethnicity and Gender Representation on Corporate Websites
detail.abstract: We measure, describe, evaluate and offer initial explanations for the levels of and intertemporal changes in the racial/ethnic and male/female diversities of the adults shown on the DEI page of S&P 500® firms' websites before George Floyd's murder (Q4:2019), after George Floyd's murder (Q4:2024), and after President Trump's second presidential term began (Q2:2025). Defining racial/ethnic and male/female diversity as being optimally representative when their densities match the US adult population, we report five main findings. [1] Racial/ethnic densities pre-George Floyd reflected an imbalance in representation: Asians and Blacks were over-represented, while Hispanics and Whites were under-represented. [2] Black female over-representation and White male under-representation increased post-George Floyd. [3] Post-President Trump II, Asians and Blacks remain over-represented, Hispanics and Whites under-represented. [4] Similar but smaller racial/ethnic misrepresentations are present on firms' Home and About Us pages. [5] Whereas pre-George Floyd, male/female densities on DEI webpages matched the US adult population, after George Floyd's murder females have been over-represented. We offer the preliminary explanations that our race/ethnicity findings reflect firms' responses to internal and external pressures arising from U.S. social movements of the 2010s, which were galvanized by a series of police-involved shootings of Black victims, whereas Asian/Hispanic over-/under-representations stem from large differences in educational qualifications that lead firms for profit-maximizing reasons aimed at recruiting the best prepared talent to visually connect more with Asian than with Hispanic visitors to their DEI, Home and About Us pages.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了标普500公司DEI网页在乔治·弗洛伊德事件前后和特朗普第二任期开始后的人口多样性变化，发现种族/族裔代表性存在不平衡，亚洲人和黑人过度代表，西班牙裔和白人代表不足，性别代表性在乔治·弗洛伊德事件后也出现女性过度代表的情况。
AI.research_question: 标普500公司DEI网页在乔治·弗洛伊德事件前后和特朗普第二任期开始后，种族/族裔和性别多样性的水平、变化及其原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究企业在社会运动（如乔治·弗洛伊德事件）和政治环境变化（如特朗普第二任期）下，如何通过网站展示其多样性承诺，以及这些展示是否真正反映人口代表性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代表性理论和企业响应社会压力理论，探讨企业如何通过视觉展示来应对内外部多样性压力。
AI.method: 对比分析标普500公司在三个时间点（2019年Q4、2024年Q4、2025年Q2）DEI网页、主页和关于我们页面上成年人的种族/族裔和性别密度，与美国成年人口数据进行对比。
AI.findings: 1）乔治·弗洛伊德事件前种族/族裔代表性不平衡：亚洲人和黑人过度代表，西班牙裔和白人代表不足；2）乔治·弗洛伊德事件后黑人女性过度代表和白人男性代表不足加剧；3）特朗普第二任期后亚洲人和黑人仍过度代表，西班牙裔和白人代表不足；4）类似但较小的种族/族裔误代表出现在公司主页和关于我们页面；5）乔治·弗洛伊德事件后DEI网页出现女性过度代表。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业多样性展示理论，揭示了企业在社会运动和政治环境变化下的策略性响应模式，以及教育资格差异如何影响种族代表性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业多样性管理提供实证依据，帮助理解企业DEI实践的实际效果与局限性，为政策制定者和利益相关者评估企业多样性承诺提供参考。

title: Can Retail Central Bank Digital Currencies Improve the Delivery of Social Safety Nets?
affiliations: World Bank, Sveriges Riksbank and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Can Retail Central Bank Digital Currencies Improve the Delivery of Social Safety Nets?

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper explores how retail central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) could enhance the delivery of social safety nets (SSNs). It assesses CBDC design features and their implications for payment administration and delivery. Findings suggest that using CBDCs solely as payment delivery solutions offers limited advantages over existing systems such as faster payment systems. However, leveraging CBDCs as payment administration platforms—with peer-to-peer transfers, decentralized ledger access, and advanced programmability—could transform SSN delivery by enabling agencies to automate transfers, operate independently from private financial intermediaries, and monitor transactions directly. These benefits come with significant challenges, including privacy concerns, compliance risks, and infrastructure requirements. The paper emphasizes that realizing CBDCs’ full potential for SSNs will depend on thoughtful integration with existing systems and a clear understanding of their comparative advantages. Aimed at social protection policymakers and finance specialists, it highlights the need for collaboration between CBDC developers and SSN administrators to ensure that digital currencies effectively support inclusive and efficient benefit delivery.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨零售央行数字货币如何改善社会安全网支付，发现仅作为支付工具优势有限，但作为支付管理平台可实现自动化转账、去中介化等重大改进，同时面临隐私、合规等挑战。
AI.research_question: 零售央行数字货币如何增强社会安全网的支付交付？
AI.motivation: 探索CBDC在改善社会安全网支付效率和包容性方面的潜力，为政策制定者提供决策参考。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字货币理论、支付系统理论和公共政策执行理论。
AI.method: 评估CBDC设计特征及其对支付管理和交付的影响分析。
AI.findings: CBDC仅作为支付工具优势有限，但作为支付管理平台可实现自动化转账、去中介化操作和直接交易监控。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了CBDC作为支付管理平台的新理论框架，区分了支付工具与支付平台的不同价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了CBDC整合社会安全网的具体路径和注意事项，强调跨部门协作的重要性。

title: Beyond Singularity and Multipolarity: Functional Fragmentation in the International Monetary System

detail.title: Beyond Singularity and Multipolarity: Functional Fragmentation in the International Monetary System
detail.abstract: The international monetary system (IMS) has long been interpreted through the lens of singularity, where global stability hinges on a single dominant currency fulfilling all core monetary functions-store of value, medium of exchange, and unit of account. This paper challenges that paradigm by introducing the concept of functional fragmentation. The IMS is evolving toward different currencies increasingly specializing in specific roles, without any single issuer monopolizing the system. The transformation draws on wholesale central bank digital currencies (wCBDCs) and distributed ledger technologies (DLTs), but also reflects deliberate institutional choices shaped by geopolitical tensions and the erosion of trust in dollar-centric infrastructure. The U.S. dollar is likely to maintain its primacy in global reserves, but new platforms are enabling regional currencies to gain ground in payments and settlement. First, emerging markets are building wCBDC-based networks designed to bypass traditional correspondent banking. Second, the European Union is advancing interoperability and financial infrastructure resilience to safeguard the euro's regional role. Third, the USA and the UK, slower to adopt CBDCs, are leveraging regulatory frameworks around stablecoins to reinforce dollar dominance through fintech intermediaries. The implications for global liquidity, reserve strategies, and financial stability are profound, requiring renewed attention to institutional coordination and systemic design in a modular, post-hegemonic IMS.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了国际货币体系的单一性范式，提出了功能碎片化概念，指出国际货币体系正朝着不同货币专门化特定角色的方向发展，美元仍将保持储备主导地位，但新兴市场wCBDC网络、欧盟互操作性建设和美英稳定币监管正在重塑支付格局。
AI.research_question: 国际货币体系如何从单一主导货币范式向功能碎片化转型？
AI.motivation: 挑战传统的单一货币主导国际货币体系范式，解释当前体系向多货币功能专门化发展的趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能碎片化理论、货币功能专门化、后霸权国际货币体系理论
AI.method: 概念分析、制度分析、技术发展分析
AI.findings: 1) 美元保持全球储备主导地位但支付功能被侵蚀；2) 新兴市场通过wCBDC网络绕过传统代理银行；3) 欧盟推进互操作性建设；4) 美英通过稳定币监管强化美元主导
AI.theory_contributions: 提出功能碎片化概念，挑战单一货币主导范式，建立后霸权国际货币体系分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供模块化国际货币体系设计指导，帮助理解wCBDC和稳定币对全球流动性和金融稳定的影响

title: Momentum Factor or Factor Momentum in REIT Market?
affiliations: School of Finance, HSE University, HSE University and HSE University

detail.title: Momentum Factor or Factor Momentum in REIT Market?
detail.abstract: We study the application of factor investing in the market for real estate (REITs). The analysis of traditional factor strategies, such as momentum, value, size and profitability, reveals their unstable and atypical behavior in comparison to the equity market, however, there is a strong momentum effect in the factor strategies. We propose a new dynamic strategy, which is based on the factor momentum effect. The strategy buys the factor portfolios with the best past performance and sells short the factor portfolios with the worst past performance, with monthly rebalancing. The factor momentum strategy yields a significant positive average return and alpha of about 6% pa, it has high Sharpe and Sortino ratios. The strategy outperforms all traditional single-factor strategies in different market states and sub-periods. The superior returns in adverse market conditions makes it particularly attractive.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了因子投资在房地产投资信托（REITs）市场的应用，发现传统因子策略表现不稳定，但存在强烈的因子动量效应。作者提出基于因子动量效应的动态策略，该策略每月买入过去表现最佳的因子组合并卖空表现最差的因子组合，年化收益率约6%，在不同市场状态下均优于传统单因子策略。
AI.research_question: 因子投资策略在REITs市场中是否有效？如何利用因子动量效应构建更优的投资策略？
AI.motivation: 传统因子策略在股票市场中表现良好，但在REITs市场中的行为不稳定且非典型，需要探索更有效的因子投资方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 因子投资理论、动量效应理论、资产定价理论
AI.method: 基于因子动量效应的动态策略：每月买入过去表现最佳的因子组合，卖空表现最差的因子组合，并进行月度再平衡
AI.findings: 因子动量策略产生显著正平均回报和约6%年化alpha，具有高夏普比率和索提诺比率，在不同市场状态和子期间均优于所有传统单因子策略，在不利市场条件下表现尤为突出
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了因子投资理论在REITs市场的应用，提出了基于因子动量效应的新投资框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为REITs投资者提供了有效的动态投资策略，在不利市场条件下仍能获得超额回报

title: America's AI Action Plan, AI Arbitration, And Smart Contracts: The Policy Architecture of Automated Adjudication
affiliations: University of Hamburg - Institute of Law and Economics

detail.title: America's AI Action Plan, AI Arbitration, And Smart Contracts: The Policy Architecture of Automated Adjudication
detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is moving into the core of arbitration. Algorithms now assist with arbitrator selection, streamline case management, and even generate draft awards. These developments raise familiar concerns about fairness, but the more pressing question is how—and how quickly—AI arbitration will be adopted. The release of America’s AI Action Plan (AAAP) in 2025 provides an essential lens for answering that question. Although the Plan does not directly regulate AI in arbitration, it defines AI as a national innovation asset and promotes an ecosystem built on trust, transparency, and adaptive oversight.

This Article argues that the AAAP is an indirect catalyst for adopting and normalizing AI arbitration and smart contract enforcement. The Plan lowers practical and conceptual barriers to integrating AI into adjudicative processes by encouraging standards development, supervised experimentation, and cross-sector collaboration. It further suggests that the Plan’s emphasis on trustworthy automation and measurable reliability may extend naturally to smart contract technology, legitimizing its role both as a source of disputes and as a mechanism for executing arbitral awards.

Building on this analysis, the Article concludes with a Model AAAP Policy on AI Arbitration and Smart Contract Enforcement—a set of proposed rules that translate the Plan’s national governance principles into actionable standards for private dispute resolution. These provisions operationalize transparency, human oversight, fairness, and security within automated adjudication, demonstrating how the AAAP’s trust-based innovation framework can guide the responsible evolution of digital justice.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国AI行动计划（AAAP）如何间接促进AI仲裁和智能合约执行的采用与规范化，并提出了一个模型政策框架来指导自动化争议解决的负责任发展。
AI.research_question: 美国AI行动计划（AAAP）如何影响AI仲裁和智能合约执行的采用与规范化？
AI.motivation: AI技术正在进入仲裁核心领域，引发公平性担忧，但更紧迫的问题是AI仲裁将如何以及多快被采纳。2025年发布的AAAP为回答这一问题提供了重要视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信任、透明度和适应性监管的AI治理框架；AI作为国家创新资产的定位；智能合约作为争议来源和执行机制的双重角色。
AI.method: 政策分析框架，分析AAAP对AI仲裁和智能合约执行的间接催化作用，并提出模型政策建议。
AI.findings: AAAP通过鼓励标准制定、监督实验和跨部门合作，降低了将AI整合到裁决过程中的实践和概念障碍；其强调可信自动化和可衡量可靠性的原则可自然扩展到智能合约技术。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AAAP作为AI仲裁间接催化剂的理论框架；建立了国家AI治理原则与私人争议解决标准之间的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 制定了AI仲裁和智能合约执行的模型政策，将国家治理原则转化为可操作的私人争议解决标准，具体化透明度、人工监督、公平性和安全性要求。

title: The Measurement of Security Perceptions Based on Statistical Approach Related to Urban Public Park Design
affiliations: Sam Ratulangi University, Sam Ratulangi University, Sam Ratulangi University, Sam Ratulangi University and University of Debrecen

detail.title: The Measurement of Security Perceptions Based on Statistical Approach Related to Urban Public Park Design
detail.abstract: Urban public parks are essential for health, social inclusion, and recreation, yet their use is strongly influenced by how safe visitors feel within them. This study examines the relationship between park design and facilities, perceived safety, and park utilization. Using a quantitative approach with survey data analyzed through Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), the findings show that design and facilities significantly influence perceived safety, which in turn mediates their effect on utilization. Results confirm both a direct and an indirect pathway, emphasizing the central role of safety perception in shaping behavioral outcomes. The study highlights practical implications for urban planners: enhancing lighting, accessibility, and maintenance not only improves the physical environment but also strengthens perceptions of safety, ultimately increasing public engagement with parks.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过结构方程模型分析发现，公园设计和设施通过影响感知安全间接影响公园使用率，强调感知安全在塑造行为结果中的核心作用。
AI.research_question: 公园设计和设施如何通过感知安全影响公园使用率？
AI.motivation: 城市公共公园对健康、社会包容和休闲至关重要，但其使用受到游客安全感的重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境行为理论和感知安全理论，探讨物理环境特征如何通过心理感知影响行为结果。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，使用调查数据并通过结构方程模型(SEM)进行分析。
AI.findings: 设计和设施显著影响感知安全，感知安全进而中介性地影响公园使用率；研究确认了直接和间接两条影响路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了感知安全在环境特征与行为结果之间的中介作用，深化了对环境-心理-行为关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供实践启示：改善照明、可达性和维护不仅能优化物理环境，还能增强安全感，最终提高公众对公园的参与度。

title: A Review of Multimodal Vision-Language Models: Foundations, Applications, and Future Directions

detail.title: A Review of Multimodal Vision-Language Models: Foundations, Applications, and Future Directions
detail.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have rapidly become a central focus in both research and practical applications, owing to their remarkable ability to understand and generate text with a level of fluency comparable to human communication. Recently, these models have evolved into multimodal large language models (MM-LLMs), extending their capabilities beyond text to include images, audio, and video. This advancement has enabled a wide array of applications, including text-to-video synthesis, image captioning, and text-to-speech systems. MM-LLMs are developed either by augmenting existing LLMs with multi-modal functionality or by designing multi-modal architectures from the ground up. This paper presents a comprehensive review of the current landscape of LLMs with multi-modal capabilities, highlighting both foundational and cutting-edge MM-LLMs. It traces the historical development of LLMs, emphasizing the transformative impact of transformer-based architectures such as OpenAI's GPT series and Google's BERT, as well as the role of attention mechanisms in improving model performance. The review also examines key strategies for adapting pre-trained models to specific tasks, including fine-tuning and prompt engineering. Ethical challenges, including data bias and the potential for misuse, are discussed to stress the importance of responsible AI deployment. Finally, we explore the implications of open-source versus proprietary models for advancing research in this field. By synthesizing these insights, this paper underscores the significant potential of MM-LLMs to reshape diverse applications across multiple domains.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了多模态大语言模型(MM-LLMs)的发展现状，从纯文本LLMs演进到支持图像、音频、视频的多模态能力，涵盖技术架构、应用领域、伦理挑战和开源vs专有模型的影响。
AI.research_question: 多模态大语言模型(MM-LLMs)当前的技术发展状况、应用前景和面临的挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型从纯文本向多模态演进，需要系统梳理这一新兴领域的技术路线、应用场景和发展趋势，为研究者和实践者提供全面的参考框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于transformer架构的注意力机制、预训练模型适配策略（微调、提示工程）、多模态融合技术。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，系统梳理和分析现有MM-LLMs的研究成果、技术路线和应用案例。
AI.findings: MM-LLMs通过增强现有LLMs或重新设计架构实现多模态能力；在文本-视频合成、图像描述、文本-语音等应用领域展现出巨大潜力；面临数据偏见、滥用等伦理挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了MM-LLMs的技术发展脉络，系统化分析了多模态融合的理论基础和技术实现路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者和开发者提供了MM-LLMs的技术路线图和应用指南，强调了负责任AI部署的重要性，并探讨了开源与专有模型对领域发展的影响。

title: Macroeconomic News and Repricing of Monetary Policy Expectations
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department and Bank for International Settlements (BIS) - Monetary and Economic Department

detail.title: Macroeconomic News and Repricing of Monetary Policy Expectations
detail.abstract: We analyze how short-term government bond yields in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada respond to inflation and labor market news to infer the monetary policy reaction function as perceived by financial markets. Our findings reveal that the perceived reaction function varies across countries and evolves over time. Furthermore, we document significant spillovers from U.S. macroeconomic news to other countries, underscoring the pivotal role of U.S. monetary policy in shaping the global financial system.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析美英加三国短期政府债券收益率对通胀和就业市场新闻的反应，推断金融市场感知的货币政策反应函数，发现该函数存在跨国差异和时变特征，并揭示了美国宏观经济新闻对其他国家的显著溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 金融市场感知的货币政策反应函数在不同国家和时间维度上如何变化？美国宏观经济新闻对其他国家有何溢出效应？
AI.motivation: 理解金融市场对货币政策反应的认知差异，以及美国在全球金融体系中的主导地位。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策反应函数理论、金融市场预期理论、国际金融溢出效应理论
AI.method: 分析短期政府债券收益率对通胀和就业市场新闻的反应，推断感知的货币政策反应函数
AI.findings: 1) 感知的货币政策反应函数存在跨国差异；2) 该函数随时间演变；3) 美国宏观经济新闻对其他国有显著溢出效应
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了货币政策反应函数的跨国比较研究，深化了对金融市场预期形成机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供金融市场对货币政策反应的实时洞察，帮助理解全球金融体系的相互依存关系

title: Motives and Constraints in the Implementation of Argentina's 2017 Tax Reform
affiliations: University of Maryland - Department of Economics and University of Buenos Aires (UBA) - Faculty of Economic Science, Students

detail.title: Motives and Constraints in the Implementation of Argentina's 2017 Tax Reform
detail.abstract: This paper examines the motives, constraints, and sequencing behind Argentina's 2017 tax reform, drawing on the authors' direct involvement in its design and implementation. We document how a large inherited fiscal imbalance, a disinflation program that mechanically raised real pension spending under the pre-existing indexation rule, minority status in Congress, and limited administrative capacity jointly narrowed the feasible policy set. Within those constraints, the reform aimed to be near-revenue-neutral while rebalancing the system toward investment and employment: phasing down corporate rates with dividend taxation and inflation adjustment, reducing the labor wedge at the bottom via a per-worker deduction, rationalizing VAT and excises (including carbon and health-motivated taxes), and coordinating with provinces to cap and de-cascade the turnover tax (ISIB) through a Fiscal Consensus. We trace how coalition politics and sectoral vetoes reshaped the package, why forward guidance and escape clauses were embedded ex ante, and how the 2018 sudden stop, followed by policy reversals, limited the reform's realized growth dividend. We draw four lessons: credibility is a fiscal instrument; provincial coordination beats technocratic perfection; discretionary levers invite rent-seeking; and targeting informality and compliance margins yields higher returns than blunt rate changes. The analysis offers a pragmatic template for tax reform under macroeconomic fragility, federal fragmentation, and state-capacity constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了阿根廷2017年税收改革的动机、约束条件和实施顺序，基于作者直接参与改革设计和实施的经验。研究发现，在财政失衡、少数党地位和行政能力限制下，改革旨在实现收入中性，同时通过降低企业税率、减少劳动税楔、优化增值税和消费税等措施重新平衡税收体系。
AI.research_question: 阿根廷2017年税收改革的动机、约束条件和实施顺序是什么？
AI.motivation: 阿根廷面临严重的财政失衡、通货膨胀计划导致实际养老金支出增加、国会少数党地位以及有限的行政能力，这些因素共同限制了可行的政策选择范围。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于税收改革理论、联邦制协调理论和政策实施理论，分析在宏观经济脆弱性、联邦分权和行政能力约束下的税收改革设计。
AI.method: 基于作者直接参与改革设计和实施的第一手经验，采用案例研究方法分析改革过程。
AI.findings: 改革在约束条件下实现了近收入中性，重新平衡了税收体系，但2018年的突然停止和政策逆转限制了改革的增长红利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了四个重要教训：可信度是财政工具；省级协调优于技术官僚完美主义；自由裁量权引发寻租；针对非正规性和合规性边际比简单税率变化更有效。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在宏观经济脆弱性、联邦分权和行政能力约束下进行税收改革提供了实用的模板。

title: The Growth and Performance of Artificial Intelligence in Asset Management
affiliations: University of Melbourne - Department of Finance, University of Texas at Austin - McCombs School of Business and Southern Methodist University (SMU) - Finance Department

detail.title: The Growth and Performance of Artificial Intelligence in Asset Management
detail.abstract: This paper examines AI adoption in asset management and its investment implications. We document that AI-driven investing is concentrated among hedge funds, particularly those employing macro strategies. AI funds exhibit greater alpha comovement and are launched by investment advisers facing stronger performance incentives. These funds significantly outperformed non-AI hedge funds on a risk-adjusted basis, but their outperformance declined over time and disappeared with the growth of AI-driven investing. Nevertheless, AI funds continued to outperform sibling funds managed by the same advisers. Our findings highlight both the alpha-generating potential and the limitations of AI as a source of investment performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了AI在资产管理中的应用及其投资影响。研究发现AI投资主要集中在采用宏观策略的对冲基金中，这些基金表现出更高的alpha联动性，且由业绩激励更强的投资顾问发起。AI基金在风险调整基础上显著优于非AI对冲基金，但随着AI投资增长，这种优势逐渐消失。不过AI基金仍持续优于同一顾问管理的兄弟基金。
AI.research_question: AI在资产管理中的采用情况及其投资影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能技术在金融领域的应用日益广泛，需要了解AI在资产管理中的实际效果和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资组合理论、alpha生成理论和市场竞争理论。
AI.method: 实证分析，通过比较AI基金和非AI对冲基金的表现数据。
AI.findings: AI投资主要集中在宏观策略对冲基金；AI基金有更高的alpha联动性；AI基金初期显著优于非AI对冲基金，但随着AI投资增长优势消失；AI基金仍优于同一顾问管理的兄弟基金。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI作为alpha来源的潜力和局限性，为AI在金融投资中的应用提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产管理公司采用AI技术提供了实践指导，帮助投资者理解AI投资策略的实际效果和风险。

title: Analysing the Impacts of an External Power Supplier in a Renewable Energy Community
affiliations: Montanuniversität Leoben, Montanuniversitaet Leoben and Montanuniversitaet Leoben

detail.title: Analysing the Impacts of an External Power Supplier in a Renewable Energy Community

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors contributed to the conception and writing of this research paper. The authors have no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this research paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics Approval and Consent to Participate Not applicable.

detail.abstract: Renewable energy communities (REC) offer the possibility of joint production and supply of renewable energy sources. This article presents the framework conditions of REC in Austria and comprehensively analyses the financial and ecological effects of an REC using a newly developed analysis tool. The results show positive financial and ecological effects of the REC being investigated by introducing an external power supplier. A sensitivity analysis was applied to evaluate all parameters used in the simulation model and to identify the key influencing variables which are the grid electricity price, the inflation rate and the discount rate.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了奥地利可再生能源社区(REC)的财务和生态效益，通过新开发的分析工具发现引入外部电力供应商能带来积极影响，关键影响因素包括电网电价、通胀率和贴现率。
AI.research_question: 可再生能源社区(REC)在奥地利框架条件下的财务和生态效益如何？
AI.motivation: 可再生能源社区提供了联合生产和供应可再生能源的可能性，需要评估其实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可再生能源社区框架、财务效益分析理论、生态效益评估理论
AI.method: 使用新开发的分析工具进行综合财务和生态效应分析，并应用敏感性分析评估关键参数
AI.findings: 通过引入外部电力供应商，所调查的可再生能源社区显示出积极的财务和生态效应
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了可再生能源社区财务和生态效益的综合分析框架，识别了关键影响因素
AI.practical_contributions: 为可再生能源社区的实际运营提供了决策支持，明确了电网电价、通胀率和贴现率等关键影响因素

title: Ample Reserves for Whom? The Role of Foreign Banks in U.S. Monetary Policy Implementation *
affiliations: and Northwestern University

detail.title: Ample Reserves for Whom? The Role of Foreign Banks in U.S. Monetary Policy Implementation *
detail.abstract: This paper examines how foreign banks constrain the Federal Reserve's ability to shrink its balance sheet under the ample-reserves framework. Although they represent a small share of traditional U.S. banking business, foreign banks hold a disproportionately large share of reserves at the Federal Reserve. Their demand is highly elastic, shaped by global regulatory asymmetries and cross-border arbitrage incentives. Using regulatory and high-frequency data, we document systematic differences in reserve management across bank types. Exploiting exogenous variation in supply shocks, we show that reserve demand is heterogeneous and asymmetric across policy regimes: foreign banks absorb most inflows during quantitative easing (QE), but adjust less during quantitative tightening (QT), when large domestic banks shed reserves more actively. We develop a heterogeneous-demand model that links these behaviors to the aggregate reserve demand curve and shows that uncertainty specific to foreign banks increases the Federal Reserve's optimal reserve supply during QT.

AI.tldr: 本文研究外国银行如何限制美联储在充足准备金框架下缩减资产负债表的能力。外国银行虽然在美国传统银行业务中占比较小，但在美联储持有的准备金比例却不成比例地高。它们的准备金需求具有高度弹性，受全球监管不对称和跨境套利激励的影响。研究发现，在量化宽松(QE)期间外国银行吸收大部分资金流入，但在量化紧缩(QT)期间调整较少，而大型国内银行则更积极地减少准备金。
AI.research_question: 外国银行如何约束美联储在充足准备金框架下缩减资产负债表的能力？
AI.motivation: 外国银行在美联储持有不成比例的高额准备金，其需求受全球监管不对称和跨境套利激励影响，可能影响美联储的货币政策执行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性需求模型，将银行行为与总准备金需求曲线联系起来。
AI.method: 使用监管数据和高频数据，利用供应冲击的外生变异进行分析。
AI.findings: 准备金需求在不同政策制度下具有异质性和不对称性：外国银行在QE期间吸收大部分资金流入，但在QT期间调整较少；大型国内银行在QT期间更积极地减少准备金。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了异质性需求模型，揭示了外国银行特定不确定性增加了美联储在QT期间的最优准备金供应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美联储货币政策执行提供重要参考，揭示了外国银行在资产负债表缩减过程中的特殊作用及其对货币政策传导的影响。

title: Inflation Determinants in Kazakhstan A Tale of (at least) Two Stories * †
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Inflation Determinants in Kazakhstan A Tale of (at least) Two Stories * †
detail.abstract: This paper assesses the relative contribution of domestic and external factors to headline inflation in Kazakhstan. We confirm earlier results that inflation is primarily imported, and we provide novel details on the sources of imported inflation and its transmission channels. We find that domestic factors like fiscal policy and more recently utility tariff increases are the key determinants of domestic inflationary pressures. We provide new information on the likely determinants of inflation expectations through which domestic and external factors affect inflation. We find that monetary policy has only been partially successful at containing domestic and external pressures with insufficient liquidity sterilization, likely contributing to weakening of the interest rate transmission channel. Finally, we find that shocks are highly persistent and bringing back inflation to its target is likely to be a difficult and long process for the Central Bank.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了哈萨克斯坦通胀中国内和外部因素的相对贡献，确认通胀主要来自进口，并详细分析了进口通胀的来源和传导渠道。研究发现国内因素（财政政策、公用事业关税）是主要通胀压力来源，货币政策在应对压力方面仅部分成功，通胀冲击具有高度持续性。
AI.research_question: 哈萨克斯坦通胀中国内因素和外部因素的相对贡献是什么？进口通胀的来源和传导渠道如何影响总体通胀？
AI.motivation: 理解哈萨克斯坦通胀的驱动因素，特别是国内和外部因素的相对重要性，为央行制定有效货币政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀决定因素理论，包括进口通胀理论、货币政策传导机制、通胀预期理论。
AI.method: 实证分析，可能使用时间序列分析或计量经济学方法评估不同因素对通胀的贡献。
AI.findings: 1. 通胀主要来自进口；2. 国内因素（财政政策、公用事业关税）是主要通胀压力来源；3. 货币政策仅部分成功应对压力；4. 通胀冲击具有高度持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了进口通胀来源和传导渠道的新细节，深化了对通胀预期决定因素的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为哈萨克斯坦央行制定通胀目标政策提供实证依据，指出流动性冲销不足削弱了利率传导渠道的有效性。

title: Navigating the 2022 Inflation Surge
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Navigating the 2022 Inflation Surge

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the effectiveness of inflation targeting (IT) frameworks during the global inflation surge of 2022, a shock primarily driven by large adverse supply side disruptions following the onset of the War in Ukraine. The empirical findings suggest that (de jure) IT frameworks did not systematically deliver better inflation outcomes during this episode. The decline in inflation back towards historical norms was broadly comparable across (de jure) IT and non-IT country groups. While (de jure) IT central banks hiked their policy rates by more than non-IT central banks on average, this did not help with achieving better inflation outcomes. Also, we find no evidence of a more flexible exchange rate after the shock in (de jure) IT central banks. These findings suggest that (de jure) IT does not necessarily imply an advantage for monetary policy, particularly in the face of large, global supply shocks. Further analysis is warranted on how monetary policy frameworks can adapt to an environment characterized by more frequent and persistent supply-side disruptions. While using a de facto classification of IT regimes would be preferable, the absence of a comprehensive database makes this infeasible.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在2022年全球通胀飙升期间，名义上的通胀目标制框架并未系统性带来更好的通胀结果，特别是在面对大型全球供应冲击时。
AI.research_question: 通胀目标制框架在2022年全球通胀飙升期间的有效性如何？
AI.motivation: 检验通胀目标制在面对主要由乌克兰战争引发的大规模负面供应冲击时的表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀目标制理论、货币政策框架有效性理论
AI.method: 实证分析，比较名义通胀目标制国家和非通胀目标制国家的通胀表现
AI.findings: 1) 名义通胀目标制未系统性带来更好通胀结果；2) 通胀回落幅度在两组国家中相似；3) 名义通胀目标制央行加息更多但未改善通胀结果；4) 未发现名义通胀目标制央行汇率更灵活
AI.theory_contributions: 质疑通胀目标制在面对大型全球供应冲击时的有效性，挑战传统货币政策框架假设
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行政策制定提供实证依据，建议重新思考货币政策框架如何适应更频繁持久的供应冲击环境

title: Data Privacy in the Digital Economy Agreement (DEA): Balancing Economic Growth with Individual Rights in Rwanda
affiliations: Open Christian University and African Leadership University

detail.title: Data Privacy in the Digital Economy Agreement (DEA): Balancing Economic Growth with Individual Rights in Rwanda
detail.abstract: Rwanda's digital economic integration via Digital Economy Agreements (DEAs) presents a challenge: balancing economic growth with data privacy. This study rigorously analyzes Rwanda's data protection framework, assessing alignment with international standards and identifying vulnerabilities and ethical dilemmas arising from digital trade. Employing qualitative methods, including document analysis, comparative evaluation, and AI-assisted text mining, we juxtapose Rwanda's Data Protection and Privacy Law (2021) against global benchmarks, notably the GDPR, and regional African norms. Findings indicate that while Rwanda has legislated key data subject rights and principles, effective implementation is hindered by resource constraints at the Rwanda Data Protection Authority (RDPA), low public awareness, a stringent data localization mandate, and weak cross-border data governance, potentially exposing data to exploitation. Deviations from international best practices in data portability and enforcement penalties, alongside a centralized supervisory structure, raise concerns about regulatory independence. Ethical challenges include conflicts over data sovereignty, digital colonialism risks, algorithmic labor exploitation, and tensions between global privacy norms and local communitarian values. These are analyzed through the lenses of Digital Sovereignty, Postcolonial Tech Ethics, and African Communitarianism. To address these issues, we propose strategies such as adaptive data governance with flexible transfer mechanisms, investment in privacy-by-design and technological sovereignty, AI-powered regulatory intelligence, embedding ethical values in data projects, and asserting international leadership for African-aligned data governance models. This study contributes novel methodology (AI-driven comparative analysis) and theory (integrating Digital Sovereignty with African Communitarianism) to data governance literature, providing a roadmap for Rwanda and other emerging nations to navigate the complexities of the digital economy, protect individual rights, and foster sustainable growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过AI辅助文本挖掘等方法，分析卢旺达数据保护框架与国际标准的对齐情况，识别数字贸易中的数据隐私漏洞和伦理困境，并提出适应性治理策略。
AI.research_question: 卢旺达的数据保护框架如何在数字经济发展中平衡经济增长与数据隐私保护？
AI.motivation: 卢旺达通过数字经济协议推动经济一体化，但面临经济增长与数据隐私保护的平衡挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字主权、后殖民技术伦理、非洲社群主义
AI.method: 定性方法，包括文件分析、比较评估和AI辅助文本挖掘
AI.findings: 卢旺达虽立法确立了关键数据主体权利和原则，但实施受限于资源约束、公众意识低、严格的数据本地化要求和薄弱的跨境数据治理，存在数据被利用的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了新颖的方法论（AI驱动的比较分析）和理论（将数字主权与非洲社群主义整合）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为卢旺达和其他新兴国家提供了在数字经济中保护个人权利和促进可持续增长的路线图。

title: Geopolitical Risk and the Collapse of the Option to Wait *
affiliations: Université du Québec en Outaouais and Université du Québec en Outaouais

detail.title: Geopolitical Risk and the Collapse of the Option to Wait *
detail.abstract: While real options theory predicts that uncertainty increases the value of waiting, it remains unclear how escalating geopolitical risks affect the timing of irreversible investment. This paper develops a real option framework where geopolitical risk follows a mean-reverting jump-diffusion process with dissipation, diffusion and sudden shocks. Unlike standard models where uncertainty affects payoffs, geopolitical risk enters through discounting, as political instability increases required returns. We show that beyond a critical geopolitical risk threshold, the option to defer investment collapses, inducing firms to accelerate investment or abandon projects. Comparative statistics reveal that the critical threshold of geopolitical risk decreases with the risk-free rate, political tensions, interventions, and jump intensity. These results challenge the consensus in real options theory that uncertainty always increases the value of waiting.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个实物期权框架，研究地缘政治风险如何影响不可逆投资时机。与标准模型不同，地缘政治风险通过贴现率影响投资决策，当风险超过临界阈值时，等待期权价值消失，企业会加速投资或放弃项目。
AI.research_question: 地缘政治风险如何影响不可逆投资的时机选择？
AI.motivation: 实物期权理论预测不确定性会增加等待价值，但地缘政治风险对投资时机的影响尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实物期权理论，地缘政治风险遵循均值回归跳跃扩散过程（包含消散、扩散和突然冲击）。
AI.method: 开发实物期权框架，地缘政治风险通过贴现率进入模型，政治不稳定增加要求回报率。
AI.findings: 超过地缘政治风险临界阈值时，延迟投资期权价值消失，企业加速投资或放弃项目；临界阈值随无风险利率、政治紧张、干预和跳跃强度降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战实物期权理论共识：不确定性并不总是增加等待价值；地缘政治风险通过贴现率而非收益影响投资决策。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业在地缘政治风险环境下的投资决策提供指导，识别风险临界点，优化投资时机选择。

title: AI Agent Misinformation when Assisting Financial Decision-Making: Early Evidence From Stock Recommendations
affiliations: Monash University, Sun Yat-sen University (SYSU) - Lingnan (University) College and RMIT University

detail.title: AI Agent Misinformation when Assisting Financial Decision-Making: Early Evidence From Stock Recommendations

declarations.funderStatement: Yuhao Xuan acknowledges financial support from the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant number 72402243)

detail.abstract: To understand misinformation generated by AI agents when assisting financial decision-making, on each trading day from May 2024 to June 2025, we collected stock recommendations from ChatGPT. Our analysis reveals three channels through which AI agent misinformation manifests: training-data reliance, web-searching bias, and representative heuristic reasoning. Portfolios based on recommended stocks sometimes outperform market benchmarks but exhibit extremely high volatility across time. Taking out recommendations based on misinformation sometimes improves performance, but having AI agents revise their recommendations does not. Our study provides a systematic framework for evaluating AI agent reliability for automated investment advice or trading.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过收集ChatGPT在2024年5月至2025年6月期间的股票推荐，分析了AI代理在辅助金融决策时产生错误信息的三种渠道：训练数据依赖、网络搜索偏见和代表性启发式推理。研究发现基于AI推荐的组合有时能超越市场基准但波动性极高，剔除错误信息推荐有时能改善表现，但让AI修正推荐则无效。
AI.research_question: AI代理在辅助金融决策时如何产生错误信息？这些错误信息对投资表现有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解AI代理在金融决策中产生错误信息的机制，评估AI投资建议的可靠性。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI错误信息理论、行为金融学、投资组合理论
AI.method: 在2024年5月至2025年6月每个交易日收集ChatGPT的股票推荐，分析推荐组合的表现和波动性。
AI.findings: 1. AI错误信息通过三种渠道产生：训练数据依赖、网络搜索偏见、代表性启发式推理；2. AI推荐组合有时超越市场基准但波动性极高；3. 剔除错误信息推荐可改善表现；4. AI修正推荐无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了AI代理错误信息的系统分析框架，识别了三种错误信息产生渠道。
AI.practical_contributions: 为评估AI投资建议可靠性提供了实用框架，帮助投资者更好地使用AI辅助决策。

title: INFORMATION FROM THE CASH FLOW STATEMENTS AND SUSTAINABLE BANK LENDING: INSIGHTS FROM THE WOOD-BASED SECTOR IN BULGARIA
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Economics - Varna, University of Economics - Varna and University of Economics Varna

detail.title: INFORMATION FROM THE CASH FLOW STATEMENTS AND SUSTAINABLE BANK LENDING: INSIGHTS FROM THE WOOD-BASED SECTOR IN BULGARIA
detail.abstract: As sustainability becomes a core concern for financial institutions, the integration of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) considerations into lending practices is reshaping credit assessment criteria, especially in resource-intensive industries. This paper explores how information derived from cash flow statements influences sustainable bank lending decisions within the wood-based sector in Bulgaria. By focusing on the intersection of financial transparency and corporate sustainability, investment in sustainable practices, and long-term viability. Our study investigates how cash flow indicators such as operating cash flows, capital expenditures, and liquidity metrics interact with ESG disclosures to support or hinder access to green financing. The paper contributes to the growing dialogue on sustainable finance by emphasizing the role of traditional financial statements in complementing ESG information. Implications for regulators and financial institutions are also discussed, with recommendations for integrating cash flow-based and non-financial metrics into sector-specific credit risk frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了现金流量表信息如何影响保加利亚木材行业可持续银行贷款决策，强调财务透明度与ESG披露的交互作用对绿色融资获取的影响。
AI.research_question: 现金流量指标如何与ESG披露相互作用，影响木材行业可持续银行贷款决策？
AI.motivation: 随着可持续性成为金融机构的核心关切，将ESG因素纳入贷款实践正在重塑信用评估标准，特别是在资源密集型行业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务透明度与公司可持续性、可持续实践投资和长期生存能力的交叉点理论框架。
AI.method: 聚焦保加利亚木材行业，分析现金流量指标与ESG披露的交互作用。
AI.findings: 现金流量指标（如经营现金流、资本支出和流动性指标）与ESG披露相互作用，支持或阻碍绿色融资获取。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调传统财务报表在补充ESG信息方面的作用，推动可持续金融对话发展。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和金融机构提供建议，将基于现金流和非财务指标纳入特定行业信用风险框架。

title: The Distributive Effects of Online Judicial Auctions on Corporate Credit
affiliations: Peking University - China Center for Economic Research (CCER), Shanghai University of Economics and Finance, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: The Distributive Effects of Online Judicial Auctions on Corporate Credit

keywords: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) JEL classification: G21

detail.abstract: This paper investigates the distributional effects of judicial FinTech on corporate financing, leveraging China's staggered adoption of Online Judicial Auctions (OJAs). While the reform successfully enhances creditor protection-boosting auction volumes, prices, and reducing defaults-its benefits accrue unequally. Using a differencein-differences design with multiple firm-level datasets, we find that listed firms and large firms in the National Tax Survey dataset significantly increase their leverage, whereas small and medium enterprises (SMEs) experience negligible changes in debt, investment, or employment. This heterogeneity is systematically graded by firm size. The credit expansion for large firms is not met by an increase in aggregate bank lending, revealing a short-run inelasticity of credit supply. Consequently, the surge in demand triggers a reallocation of the existing credit pool, crowding out smaller firms, which subsequently face higher borrowing costs. Our findings demonstrate that even efficiency-enhancing judicial reforms can have redistributive consequences, underscoring the critical role of general equilibrium forces and the need for complementary policies to support SMEs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中国司法金融科技（在线司法拍卖）对企业融资的分配效应。虽然改革增强了债权人保护，但其收益分配不均：大型企业杠杆率显著增加，而中小企业融资、投资和就业无明显变化，存在信贷挤出效应。
AI.research_question: 司法金融科技改革（在线司法拍卖）对企业融资的分配效应是什么？
AI.motivation: 研究效率提升型司法改革可能产生的再分配后果，强调一般均衡力量的关键作用和需要配套政策支持中小企业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于债权人保护理论、信贷分配理论和一般均衡理论，分析司法改革对信贷市场的分配效应。
AI.method: 采用多期双重差分设计，结合多个企业级数据集（上市公司数据和全国税收调查数据）。
AI.findings: 1）大型企业杠杆率显著增加，中小企业无明显变化；2）信贷扩张未伴随银行总贷款增加，存在信贷供给短期无弹性；3）信贷需求激增导致现有信贷池重新分配，挤出中小企业并提高其借贷成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了效率提升型司法改革可能产生再分配后果，强调了一般均衡效应在制度变革中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于司法改革分配效应的实证证据，建议需要配套政策来支持中小企业发展。

title: Mapping Spatial Variation of Soil Carbon Concentration and Assessment of Carbon Stocks in an Agricultural Farm of Semiarid Region of India
affiliations: , Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)-Indian AgriculturalResearch Institute, Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR), Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR)-Indian AgriculturalResearch Institute and ICAR-Central Arid Zone Research Institute (CAZRI)

detail.title: Mapping Spatial Variation of Soil Carbon Concentration and Assessment of Carbon Stocks in an Agricultural Farm of Semiarid Region of India
detail.abstract: Soil carbon is a major indicator for sustainability of agricultural productivity and crucial for climate change studies. Spatial modeling and prediction map of surface soil (0.0-0.15 m) carbon concentration in a semiarid agricultural farm, New Delhi, India was generated using geo-statistical techniques. Average concentration of total carbon at surface soil was 5.7 g kg-1 , ranging from 0.72 to 14.49 g kg-1. Spatial ranges of soil organic carbon (SOC) and total carbon (TC) concentration were 180 m and 83 m respectively, as identified through semivariogram modeling. Depth-wise carbon density and stock were also assessed for five soil families under subgroup of Fluventic Haplustepts (1), Typic Haplustepts (3) and Calcic Haplustepts (1) in the farm (number of soil family within parenthesis). SOC density within 1.5 m depth ranged from 35.11 Mg ha-1 (in Calcic Haplustepts) to 57.16 Mg ha-1 (in Fluventic Haplustepts). Contrarily, soil inorganic carbon (SIC) density within 1.5 m depth varied from 16.98 Mg ha-1 (in Fluventic Haplustepts) to 403.68 Mg ha-1 (in Calcic Haplustepts). The farm having 293.1 ha of cultivated area had 27.94 Gg TC stock within 1.5 m depth, of which proportion of SIC stock (i.e. 51.1%) was higher than SOC stock (i.e. 48.9%), indicative of calcification process in semiarid ecosystem. The assessment of soil carbon concentration, density or stock assessment with georeferenced location of nationally important agricultural farm will be useful for spatiotemporal analysis of soil carbon changes, carbon emission and sequestration studies in context of global warming sceniario.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用地统计学技术对印度新德里半干旱农业农场表层土壤碳浓度进行空间建模和预测制图，评估了不同土壤类型的碳密度和储量，发现无机碳储量高于有机碳储量，表明半干旱生态系统存在钙化过程。
AI.research_question: 如何利用地统计学技术对半干旱农业农场的土壤碳浓度进行空间建模和预测？不同土壤类型的碳密度和储量分布特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 土壤碳是农业生产力可持续性的重要指标，对气候变化研究至关重要。需要了解半干旱农业生态系统中土壤碳的空间分布特征和储量状况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于地统计学理论，包括半变异函数建模、空间插值技术；土壤分类学框架（Fluventic Haplustepts、Typic Haplustepts、Calcic Haplustepts）；碳循环和钙化过程理论。
AI.method: 使用地统计学技术进行空间建模和预测制图，通过半变异函数分析确定空间范围，评估表层土壤（0.0-0.15 m）碳浓度，并分析1.5米深度内不同土壤类型的碳密度和储量。
AI.findings: 表层土壤总碳平均浓度为5.7 g kg-1；SOC和TC的空间范围分别为180 m和83 m；1.5米深度内SOC密度为35.11-57.16 Mg ha-1，SIC密度为16.98-403.68 Mg ha-1；293.1公顷耕地总碳储量为27.94 Gg，其中SIC占比51.1%，高于SOC的48.9%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了半干旱农业生态系统中土壤碳空间分布的定量分析，验证了钙化过程在碳储存中的重要性，为理解半干旱地区碳循环机制提供了实证基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为土壤碳变化的时空分析、碳排放和碳封存研究提供了基础数据，对农业可持续管理和气候变化应对策略制定具有指导意义。

title: Property Informality and Its Effect on Rural Land Prices in Colombia
affiliations: Fedesarrollo, Inter-American Development Bank and Harvard University - The Growth Lab

detail.title: Property Informality and Its Effect on Rural Land Prices in Colombia

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.

keywords: Colombia JEL CLASSIFICATION CODES: K25: Real Estate Law

detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of property informality on rural land prices in Colombia. It utilizes data for 16 land size categories for a fifth of Colombia’s municipalities. It employs the Gaussian copula approach to overcome endogeneity issues. The main finding is that an exogenous variation of property informality significantly reduces rural land prices for properties larger than three hectares, but not for smaller ones. Property informality is strongly endogenous to land prices (inversely for small properties but directly for larger properties). Our results indicate that exogenously reducing property informality of large landholdings by one standard deviation could increase their prices by 24 percent, equivalent to 44 percent of the municipalities’ GDP. These findings suggest that addressing property informality could substantially enhance the economic value of rural lands above certain size threshold, which would strengthen local tax revenues and improve rural economic conditions. Updating of cadaster values of large lands, which is often opposed by landholders, is crucial to unlock the potential of land titling.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了哥伦比亚农村土地产权非正规性对土地价格的影响。研究发现，产权非正规性显著降低了超过3公顷的大型农村土地的价格，但对小型土地没有影响。外生地减少大型土地产权非正规性一个标准差可使土地价格上涨24%，相当于市政GDP的44%。
AI.research_question: 产权非正规性如何影响哥伦比亚农村土地价格？
AI.motivation: 理解产权非正规性对农村土地价格的影响，为改善农村经济条件和增加地方税收收入提供政策依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产权经济学、土地市场理论、内生性问题理论
AI.method: 使用哥伦比亚16种土地规模类别的市政数据，采用高斯copula方法解决内生性问题
AI.findings: 产权非正规性显著降低超过3公顷的大型农村土地价格，但对小型土地无影响；产权非正规性与土地价格存在强内生性关系（小型土地负相关，大型土地正相关）
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了产权非正规性对不同规模土地价格的异质性影响，验证了产权非正规性与土地价格的内生性关系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对性建议：解决大型土地产权非正规性可显著提升土地价值，增强地方税收，改善农村经济状况；更新大型土地地籍价值对释放土地确权潜力至关重要

title: A RIGHT TO A SUSTAINABLE ECONOMY? EXPLORING THE INTERSECTION OF HUMAN RIGHTS, SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT AND POLITICAL ECONOMY

detail.abstract:
In this essay, I dig into the connection between socioeconomic rights, sustainable development, and political economy and, therefore, start a discussion about the necessity of creating a "Right to a Sustainable Economy (RSE)," with its implications and constraints in the International Human Rights Law system. I am proposing a unique foundation, taken from law and political economy, that the present literature lacks and consequently addresses a knowledge gap. My study intends to give an understanding of supporting inclusive policies and strategic litigation potentials before the UN and the Regional Systems of Human Rights, to make States and businesses accountable under international law and, in this way, empower individuals. This analysis attempts to add to the growing discourse on establishing a sustainable, global economy based on human rights. 
Author’s Accepted Manuscript. Forthcoming in IJHRCS (Inderscience). Version of Record available at DOI: 10.1504/IJHRCS.2024.10068482

detail.abstract: In this paper, we argue the case that immigrants are an important part of any urban area’s vitality by providing economic and demographic buffering (providing a larger workforce and keeping population steady or growing when the natural birth rate is declining), they also bring dynamic capacities that can strengthen a region’s ability to absorb, adapt, and transform in response to various challenges.

AI.research_question: 移民如何通过经济和人口缓冲以及动态能力贡献来增强城市地区的活力？

title: ERIS futures: Analysis and pricing
affiliations: muRisQ Advisory

detail.title: ERIS futures: Analysis and pricing

declarations.funderStatement: Written with the support of muRisQ SRL

detail.abstract: In this note we describe ERIS futures and propose a pricing mechanism for them. Those futures are swap futures associated with OTC cleared swaps. We come to the conclusion that the claim that they "replicate cash flows of OTC swaps" is reasonable in the context of the multi-curve framework. Currently their daily price settlement is based on a third party valuation and the futures are not standalone with prices based on actual futures trades. We also analysed the possibility to transform them into standalone instruments with price obtained from recent trade information. For that part, our answer is more prudent and mainly negative in large part due to the lack of liquidity along the curve.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了ERIS期货及其定价机制，认为其在多曲线框架下能够合理复制OTC互换的现金流，但指出当前基于第三方估值的定价方式存在问题，且由于缺乏流动性，难以将其转变为基于实际交易价格的独立工具。
AI.research_question: ERIS期货的定价机制如何？能否将其转变为基于实际交易价格的独立工具？
AI.motivation: 分析ERIS期货的定价机制，评估其声称能够复制OTC互换现金流的合理性，并探讨将其转变为独立定价工具的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多曲线框架理论，用于分析金融衍生品的定价和现金流复制机制。
AI.method: 理论分析和机制描述，基于现有ERIS期货的结构和定价方式进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 在多曲线框架下，ERIS期货能够合理复制OTC互换的现金流；2. 当前基于第三方估值的定价方式存在问题；3. 由于缺乏流动性，难以将其转变为基于实际交易价格的独立工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 为ERIS期货在多曲线框架下的定价机制提供了理论分析，验证了其复制OTC互换现金流的合理性。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出了当前ERIS期货定价机制的局限性，为市场参与者和监管机构提供了关于该产品流动性和定价独立性的重要见解。

title: How Cities and States can Self-Destruct

detail.title: How Cities and States can Self-Destruct
detail.abstract: Detroit was once a thriving city. Over time, it turned into a decaying slum. Other cities have suffered similar fates. One contributing factor is excessive taxation in relation to the benefit of living in the city that leads to an exodus that destroys its tax base. This paper provides perspective about how this can happen.

title: EU Big Tech Laws: An Emerging Public Utilities Regulation
affiliations: University of Namur

detail.title: EU Big Tech Laws: An Emerging Public Utilities Regulation
detail.abstract: This chapter examines whether the new EU Big Tech regulations-the Digital Markets Act and the Digital Services Act-can be interpreted as a form of public utilities regulation. The first section outlines the objectives and obligations established by these laws, along with the institutional ecosystem designed to ensure effective compliance and enforcement. It argues that their overarching goal is to diffuse and better govern the power of Big Tech, thereby restoring the early promises of the Internet. The second section compares the concepts and the evolution of common carrier and public utilities in the United States and the European Union, identifying a regulatory toolkit associated with public utilities. Applying this toolkit to the EU Big Tech laws, the chapter concludes that, while not originally conceived as public utility regulation, these laws share several of its core features and may represent an emerging form of such regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨欧盟《数字市场法》和《数字服务法》是否可被视为公共事业监管的新形式，通过比较欧美公共事业监管概念演变，发现这些法律虽非传统公共事业监管，但具备其核心特征

detail.abstract: Nearly 40% of households and 92% of small enterprises in India are financially excluded. The total credit demand is estimated to be around INR32.5 trillion. A large share of these borrowers do not have sufficient credit history, income documents, collateral assets and sufficient proof to establish residential or business stability which is often required by traditional lending institutions to evaluate their creditworthiness. To meet this growing demand for credit, many lending institutions have entered the market with niche lending models. However, the risky profile of underlying borrowers makes it difficult for the lending institutions to access capital from mainstream capital-market players such as mutual funds, insurance companies, bank treasuries, other financial institutions and asset management firms who have different risk-return expectations.

Spikes in geopolitical risk indices have been associated with lower bank stability, leading supervisors to closely monitor how they are being managed by lenders. title: The Impact of Bank Regulation on Banks’ Lending Activities: Evidence from the Europe Union.
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Impact of Bank Regulation on Banks’ Lending Activities: Evidence from the Europe Union.
detail.abstract: This study aims at investigating the impact of bank regulation, including capital regulation, activity restrictions, and the official disciplinary power, on banks’ lending activities. The research focuses on a sample of commercial banks operating within the European Union between 2008 and 2021. Using a fixed effect model with lagged independent variables, the findings of this study indicate that bank capital regulation and restrictions on activities have a negative correlation with risky loans, while the official disciplinary power does not show a significant relationship with risky loans. Furthermore, this study presents the impacts of bank size, deposit growth, bank profitability, bank capital strength, operational efficiency, and macroeconomic factors, including inflation, GDP growth, and unemployment ratio on risky loans to give further recommendations for policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨银行监管（资本监管、活动限制和官方纪律权力）对欧盟商业银行2008-2021年间贷款活动的影响。研究发现资本监管和活动限制与风险贷款负相关，而官方纪律权力与风险贷款无显著关系。

title: Recursive Utility, Social Discounting, and Sustainable Consumption
affiliations: Kyung Hee University - Department of Applied Mathematics

detail.title: Recursive Utility, Social Discounting, and Sustainable Consumption
detail.abstract: This paper extends the Campbell and Martin (2025, AER: Insights) model of sustainable consumption to a recursive utility framework that disentangles risk aversion and the elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS). In the standard CRRA formulation, the social discount rate consistent with sustainability depends entirely on risk aversion, since the EIS is mechanically tied to the same parameter. Under Epstein-Zin preferences, this linkage is broken: the sustainable rate of social discounting becomes governed not by risk attitudes but by intertemporal substitution. We show that sustainability constrains the effective discount rate to the certainty-equivalent return on wealth whenever impatience is excessive, yielding an endogenous correction to social discounting. A higher EIS relaxes this sustainability bound, allowing faster welfare-consistent growth, while a lower EIS tightens it, emphasizing intergenerational equity. Our results reinterpret sustainability as a recursive equilibrium condition rather than an external ethical rule, linking social discounting directly to the flexibility of intertemporal substitution.

AI.tldr: 本文在递归效用框架下扩展了可持续消费模型，解构了风险厌恶和跨期替代弹性(EIS)。研究发现可持续社会贴现率由跨期替代弹性而非风险态度决定，当缺乏耐心时，可持续贴现率被约束为财富的确定性等价回报。
AI.research_question: 在Epstein-Zin偏好下，可持续社会贴现率如何由跨期替代弹性而非风险态度决定？
AI.motivation: 标准CRRA框架中社会贴现率完全取决于风险厌恶参数，因为EIS与风险厌恶参数机械绑定，需要解构这种联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: Epstein-Zin递归效用理论，可持续消费理论，社会贴现理论
AI.method: 理论模型构建与分析，将Campbell和Martin(2025)的可持续消费模型扩展到递归效用框架
AI.findings: 可持续社会贴现率由跨期替代弹性决定而非风险态度；当缺乏耐心时，可持续贴现率被约束为财富的确定性等价回报；更高的EIS放松可持续性约束，允许更快的福利一致增长
AI.theory_contributions: 将可持续性重新解释为递归均衡条件而非外部伦理规则；建立了社会贴现与跨期替代弹性灵活性的直接联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了基于跨期替代弹性的可持续社会贴现率计算框架；强调代际公平在可持续政策中的重要性

title: Carbon Pricing, Strategic Play, and Market Efficiency *
affiliations: Technische Universität München (TUM), Technische Universität München (TUM) and Technische Universität München (TUM)

detail.title: Carbon Pricing, Strategic Play, and Market Efficiency *
detail.abstract: We examine the impact of carbon prices on firms' strategic play and market efficiency. We use data from electricity markets and study power-generating firms that compete in oligopoly games. Small firms that operate relatively clean power plants deviate from profit maximizing equilibrium play and price their plants out of the market. For higher carbon prices, that increase the relative value of their plants, these firms move closer to equilibrium play. Our results show that carbon pricing, by increasing the market stakes of cleaner plants, bolsters their ability to compete beyond the effect of merely internalizing the carbon externality. The improved pricing ability increases market efficiency and carbon abatement significantly.

AI.tldr: 碳价格通过提高清洁电厂的市场价值，促使小型清洁电厂更接近均衡策略，从而提升市场效率和碳减排效果
AI.research_question: 碳价格如何影响企业的战略行为和市场效率？
AI.motivation: 研究碳定价机制除了内部化碳外部性之外，是否还能通过改变企业战略行为来提升市场效率
AI.theoretical_framework: 寡头竞争理论、博弈论、碳定价理论
AI.method: 使用电力市场数据，分析发电企业在寡头竞争中的行为
AI.findings: 小型清洁电厂在碳价格较低时会偏离利润最大化均衡，但随着碳价格上升，这些企业更接近均衡策略，提高了市场效率和碳减排
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了碳定价理论，揭示了碳价格通过改变企业战略行为影响市场效率的机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的碳定价机制提供依据，有助于提升碳减排效果和市场效率

title: CEO Political Preferences and Equity Pricing
affiliations: , Technical University of Darmstadt and Concordia University, Quebec

detail.title: CEO Political Preferences and Equity Pricing
detail.abstract: This study examines whether equity markets systematically price CEOs' personal political preferences. Using a novel panel dataset of the 1,500 largest U.S. firms from 2009 to 2023, we show that CEO conservatism is associated with a significantly higher cost of equity, amounting to an annual premium of 49 basis points. This finding contrasts with prior evidence linking conservative leadership to financial prudence and lower cost of debt. The premium cannot be explained by standard risk factors or heightened firm-level risk. On the contrary, Republican-led firms display significantly lower idiosyncratic and total return volatility. Instead, our evidence points to a behavioral mechanism. Firms with conservative CEOs attract less investor attention, as reflected in 8% lower analyst coverage and 15% fewer extreme return events. Consistent with theories of limited recognition, this reduced attention translates into significantly lower valuation levels and correspondingly higher expected returns for Republican-led firms. Realized returns align with this pricing implication, as firms with conservative CEOs earn higher monthly returns ex post. Our study extends Upper Echelons Theory and research on CEO political preferences beyond internal corporate policies to equity valuation, revealing a novel pricing pattern based on CEO donations. By identifying an investor-attention channel, it links managerial traits to Behavioral Finance and offers an integrated framework explaining how executive ideology influences firms' costs of equity through investor recognition.

AI.tldr: 研究发现CEO保守主义与显著更高的股权成本相关，年溢价达49个基点，这与保守领导力通常与财务谨慎相关的传统认知相反。溢价源于行为机制：保守派CEO公司吸引较少投资者关注，导致估值较低和预期回报较高。
AI.research_question: 股权市场是否系统性地对CEO个人政治偏好进行定价？
AI.motivation: 现有研究显示保守领导力与财务谨慎和较低债务成本相关，但股权市场对CEO政治偏好的定价机制尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 高层梯队理论、行为金融学、有限认知理论
AI.method: 使用2009-2023年美国1500家最大公司的新面板数据集进行分析
AI.findings: 1) 保守派CEO公司股权成本高49个基点 2) 这些公司特质风险和总回报波动性更低 3) 分析师覆盖减少8%，极端回报事件减少15% 4) 事后月度回报更高
AI.theory_contributions: 将高层梯队理论和CEO政治偏好研究从内部政策扩展到股权估值，建立了管理者特质与行为金融学的联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了CEO政治偏好影响股权成本的整合框架，揭示了通过投资者认知渠道的影响机制。

title: Securing Accountability in Executive Management: The Advanced Role of Management Accountants as Accountability Partners
affiliations: University of Siegen, University of Siegen and University of Siegen

detail.title: Securing Accountability in Executive Management: The Advanced Role of Management Accountants as Accountability Partners

declarations.funderStatement: German “Stiftung für die Wissenschaft”

detail.abstract: Grounded in mindset theory and linked to the risk governance framework, this conceptual paper examines the evolution of management accountants' thinking and behavior. It introduces their role as "accountability partners," highlighting their advanced and essential supportive function within the organization. Germany's broad interpretation of the Business Judgment Rule builds the starting point, compelling executive management to implement a system for business decisions that guarantees a profound basis for strategic decision-making. Such a system needs a consistently accessible, adequate, and verifiable information base and must be able to handle all sorts of business risks. Our paper argues that management accountants play a crucial role in supporting executive management to maintain compliance in today's complex environment where regulatory frameworks, advanced reporting requirements, industry standards, and corporate codes of conduct pose significant challenges for executive managers.

AI.tldr: 基于心态理论和风险治理框架，本文探讨了管理会计师思维和行为的演变，提出他们作为"问责伙伴"的角色，在组织中发挥高级支持功能。以德国商业判断规则的广泛解释为起点，强调管理会计师在复杂监管环境中支持高管维持合规性的关键作用。
AI.research_question: 管理会计师如何作为"问责伙伴"支持高管在复杂监管环境中维持合规性？
AI.motivation: 在当今复杂的商业环境中，监管框架、高级报告要求、行业标准和公司行为准则对高管构成重大挑战，需要管理会计师提供专业支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 心态理论和风险治理框架
AI.method: 概念性论文，理论分析
AI.findings: 管理会计师的思维和行为已演变为"问责伙伴"角色，在组织中发挥高级支持功能，特别是在确保战略决策有坚实基础和处理各类业务风险方面。
AI.theory_contributions: 将心态理论与风险治理框架结合，提出管理会计师作为"问责伙伴"的新角色概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了管理会计师如何支持高管应对复杂监管环境的实践指导，特别是在德国商业判断规则背景下确保决策合规性。

title: Tensor-Based Multivariate Moment Inference under Dependence and Jumps
affiliations: VinUniversity

detail.title: Tensor-Based Multivariate Moment Inference under Dependence and Jumps
detail.abstract: This paper develops a tensor-based multivariate framework for constructing asymptotically valid confidence intervals and joint confidence regions for moment-based statistics when data exhibit serial dependence and jump discontinuities. The approach generalises existing univariate formulations by representing raw and mixed moments as a hierarchy of moment tensors, allowing higher-order dependencies and cross-sectional interactions to be treated within a unified analytical structure. The framework introduces a long-run covariance tensor that generalises the traditional covariance matrix to multivariate and higher-order settings. This tensor captures both temporal and cross-sectional dependence, including the effects of clustered jumps, and determines the geometry of the resulting confidence regions. Analytical derivations show how these dependence structures amplify asymptotic variances and reshape joint uncertainty regions in tensor space. The proposed formulation provides a coherent foundation for robust inference in multivariate econometric and financial applications. It delivers closed-form expressions for asymptotic covariances, ellipsoidal confidence regions, and sample-size requirements that remain valid under general forms of dependence and discontinuity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于张量的多元框架，用于构建在数据存在序列依赖性和跳跃不连续性时的渐近有效置信区间和联合置信区域。该方法通过将原始矩和混合矩表示为矩张量层次结构，推广了现有的单变量公式，允许在统一的分析结构中处理高阶依赖性和横截面相互作用。
AI.research_question: 如何在数据存在序列依赖性和跳跃不连续性的情况下，构建渐近有效的多元矩统计量的置信区间和联合置信区域？
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要针对单变量情况，无法充分处理多元和高阶依赖结构，特别是在存在跳跃不连续性的金融和经济应用中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于张量理论的多元矩统计框架，引入长期协方差张量来推广传统协方差矩阵，捕捉时间和横截面依赖结构。
AI.method: 将原始矩和混合矩表示为矩张量层次结构，构建长期协方差张量，推导渐近协方差的闭式表达式和椭圆置信区域。
AI.findings: 依赖结构会放大渐近方差并重塑张量空间中的联合不确定性区域，框架在一般依赖和不连续性形式下保持有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了统一的张量分析框架，推广了单变量公式，为多元和高阶依赖结构下的稳健推断提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为计量经济学和金融应用中的稳健推断提供了实用工具，包括闭式渐近协方差表达式、椭圆置信区域和样本量要求。

title: What Wisconsin's Pension Fund Taught Us About Crypto
affiliations: Marquette University

detail.title: What Wisconsin's Pension Fund Taught Us About Crypto
detail.abstract: The State of Wisconsin Investment Board (SWIB) made headlines in 2024 with a landmark investment in spot Bitcoin ETFs, and again in 2025 when it divested. This real-world case ignited a policy debate, with critics decrying crypto as a "risky gamble" for public pensions. But what is the actual fiduciary lesson from Wisconsin's foray? This paper provides the first comprehensive, portfolio-level empirical test of these claims. Simulating SWIB's approach, we measure the impact of a 0.5% allocation to a Bitcoin ETF within standard public pension portfolios from January 2024 to September 2025. Our results show that such a de minimis allocation resulted in no material increase in portfolio volatility or maximum drawdown, while consistently offering a marginal improvement in risk-adjusted returns. Nearly identical results were found for a comparable gold allocation. The central lesson from Wisconsin is clear: categorical opposition to crypto is not supported by portfolio-level metrics and is misaligned with prudent fiduciary principles. The path forward lies not in blanket prohibition, but in a policy framework centered on transparency, proportional governance, and modernized fiduciary education on alternative assets.

AI.tldr: 威斯康星州投资委员会在2024年投资现货比特币ETF并在2025年撤资的案例引发了政策辩论。本文通过模拟0.5%比特币ETF配置在公共养老金组合中的表现，发现这种微小配置并未显著增加组合波动性或最大回撤，反而略微改善了风险调整后收益。结果表明对加密货币的绝对反对缺乏投资组合层面的实证支持。
AI.research_question: 比特币ETF在公共养老金组合中的微小配置是否会对投资组合风险收益特征产生实质性影响？
AI.motivation: 威斯康星州投资委员会的比特币ETF投资案例引发了关于加密货币是否适合公共养老金的政策辩论，批评者认为这是"高风险赌博"，但缺乏投资组合层面的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于现代投资组合理论，探讨资产配置分散化效应和风险调整收益优化原则。
AI.method: 模拟威斯康星州投资委员会的方法，在标准公共养老金组合中配置0.5%比特币ETF，分析2024年1月至2025年9月期间的投资组合表现。
AI.findings: 0.5%的比特币ETF配置未显著增加投资组合波动性或最大回撤，反而持续提供风险调整后收益的边际改善。黄金配置也得出类似结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了对加密货币的绝对反对立场，为替代资产在现代投资组合中的作用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共养老金管理机构提供了基于实证的投资决策框架，建议建立以透明度、比例治理和现代化受托人教育为核心的政策框架。

title: Barriers to Benefits: Unemployment Insurance Take-Up and Labor Market Effects
affiliations: Stanford University, Department of Economics and Princeton University

detail.title: Barriers to Benefits: Unemployment Insurance Take-Up and Labor Market Effects
